Create `scripts/m1c-checkpoint/device.mjs`:

```js
/**
 * The M1c checkpoint's phone-side steps with an injected adb (so device.test.mjs drives them with a
 * mocked one and no device is ever touched by a test). Task 1: the trigger of the `pinnedFetch`
 * on-device control and the wait for its readout lines. Every call goes through M1a's guard
 * (`install.mjs` `guarded`): nothing that uninstalls, clears or deletes reaches adb.
 */
import * as I from '../m1a-checkpoint/install.mjs';
import * as L from './lib.mjs';

/** `am start` of the devnet app on the control's deep link — the exact adb arguments. */
export const TRIGGER_ARGS = Object.freeze([
  'shell', 'am', 'start', '-W',
  '-a', 'android.intent.action.VIEW',
  '-d', L.PINNED_CONTROL_LINK,
  L.DEVNET_PACKAGE,
]);

/**
 * Sends the deep link, then reads `logcat -d` every `pollSeconds` until a complete pinned-control
 * run appears that was not among `knownRunKeys` (the runs recorded before the trigger), or until
 * `timeoutSeconds` (the submit's JS deadline is 135 s; a malformed one answers at once).
 * Returns `{started, run, readouts, polls, startOutput}`; `run` is the new complete run or null.
 */
export function triggerPinnedControl({ adb, sleep, knownRunKeys = [], pollSeconds = 3, timeoutSeconds = 150 }) {
  const call = I.guarded(adb);
  const startOutput = call([...TRIGGER_ARGS]).out;
  const started = /Status: ok/.test(startOutput);
  const known = new Set(knownRunKeys);
  let readouts = [];
  let polls = 0;
  for (let waited = 0; waited <= timeoutSeconds; waited += pollSeconds) {
    sleep(pollSeconds);
    polls += 1;
    readouts = L.readoutsFromLog(call(['logcat', '-d']).out).readouts;
    const fresh = L.pinnedRuns(readouts).filter(r => r.complete && !known.has(r.key));
    if (fresh.length) {
      return { started, run: fresh[fresh.length - 1], readouts, polls, startOutput };
    }
  }
  return { started, run: null, readouts, polls, startOutput };
}
```

Create `scripts/m1c-checkpoint/m1c-checkpoint.mjs`:

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * The M1c checkpoint, desk side (spec 2026-11-08 shielded A0 M1 §16 "Checkpoints · M1c", §6.0).
 * README.md next to this file is the owner's checklist. Task 1's skeleton — the GATE before any
 * outcome logic: the `pinnedFetch` on-device control. Task 9 adds the unshield lines, `verify`,
 * the wipe and the production launch.
 *
 *   check-apks --apks DIR                  the two release APKs' BuildConfig (dexdump, incl. API_BASE)
 *                                          → DIR/CONFIG.json; the readout gate open in devnet.apk, closed
 *                                          in production.apk (with its negative control), the devnet API
 *                                          base ending in exactly one /v1
 *   install --apks DIR [--allow-fresh-production]
 *                                          M1a's preflight for BOTH packages (signer, rollback, STOP; M1a's
 *                                          install.mjs unchanged), then installs devnet.apk only and
 *                                          cold-launches it
 *   collect                                one `adb logcat -d`: new readouts → OUT/readouts.jsonl
 *   pinned-control --apks DIR [--judge-only]
 *                                          sends `noctura://a0-pinned-control` to the DEVNET app, waits for
 *                                          its three readout lines, judges §6.0 (M1c.P0–P3) against the API
 *                                          base of DIR/CONFIG.json → OUT/pinned-control.json; exit 0 only
 *                                          if every line passed. --judge-only judges what is recorded.
 *   common: [--out DIR] (default build/m1c-checkpoint) [--serial S]
 *
 * Never uninstalls, never clears data (every adb call goes through M1a's guard); never contacts
 * *.noc-tura.io, solscan.io or mainnet itself — the PHONE talks to the relayer, the desk reads the
 * phone's log.
 */
import { execFileSync, spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { appendFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { homedir, tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import * as I from '../m1a-checkpoint/install.mjs';
import * as M1B from '../m1b-checkpoint/device.mjs';
import * as D from './device.mjs';
import * as L from './lib.mjs';

const ROOT = resolve(new URL('.', import.meta.url).pathname, '../..');
const argv = process.argv.slice(2);
const cmd = argv[0];
const opt = (name, dflt) => {
  const i = argv.indexOf(`--${name}`);
  return i >= 0 ? argv[i + 1] : dflt;
};
const flag = name => argv.includes(`--${name}`);
const OUT = resolve(opt('out', join(ROOT, 'build/m1c-checkpoint')));
const die = msg => {
  console.error(`m1c-checkpoint: ${msg}`);
  process.exit(2);
};
const json = (f, v) => writeFileSync(join(OUT, f), JSON.stringify(v, null, 2) + '\n');

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ tools / adb

const sdk = () => process.env.ANDROID_HOME ?? join(homedir(), 'Android/Sdk');
function buildTool(name) {
  const bt = join(sdk(), 'build-tools');
  const v = existsSync(bt)
    ? readdirSync(bt)
        .sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, undefined, { numeric: true }))
        .reverse()
        .find(d => existsSync(join(bt, d, name)))
    : null;
  return v ? join(bt, v, name) : die(`${name} not found under ${bt} (ANDROID_HOME)`);
}
const adbPath = () => (existsSync(join(sdk(), 'platform-tools/adb')) ? join(sdk(), 'platform-tools/adb') : 'adb');
const serialArgs = () => (opt('serial') ? ['-s', opt('serial')] : []);
const rawAdb = args => {
  const r = spawnSync(adbPath(), [...serialArgs(), ...args], { encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 300000, maxBuffer: 64 << 20 });
  return { status: r.status, out: (r.stdout ?? '') + (r.stderr ?? '') };
};
const adb = I.guarded(rawAdb);
function oneDevice() {
  const devices = adb(['devices']).out.split('\n').filter(l => /\tdevice$/.test(l));
  if (!opt('serial') && devices.length !== 1) {
    die(`expected exactly one device, adb sees ${devices.length} (use --serial; wireless adb drops when the phone locks — re-pair)`);
  }
  mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
}
function apkSigners(apk) {
  try {
    return I.signerDigests(execFileSync(buildTool('apksigner'), ['verify', '--print-certs', apk], { encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }));
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}
const sha256File = f => createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(f)).digest('hex');
const badgingPkg = apk => execFileSync(buildTool('aapt2'), ['dump', 'badging', apk], { encoding: 'utf8' }).match(/^package: name='([^']+)'/m)?.[1];
function apks() {
  const dir = opt('apks') ?? die('needs --apks DIR (build-apks.sh writes devnet.apk, production.apk)');
  const devnet = join(dir, 'devnet.apk');
  const production = join(dir, 'production.apk');
  for (const f of [devnet, production]) {
    existsSync(f) || die(`missing ${f}`);
  }
  if (badgingPkg(devnet) !== L.DEVNET_PACKAGE || badgingPkg(production) !== L.PRODUCTION_PACKAGE) {
    die(`unexpected packages: devnet.apk=${badgingPkg(devnet)} production.apk=${badgingPkg(production)}`);
  }
  return { dir, devnet, production };
}
const sleep = s => spawnSync('sleep', [String(s)]);

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ readouts

const READOUTS = 'readouts.jsonl';
const recorded = () =>
  existsSync(join(OUT, READOUTS))
    ? readFileSync(join(OUT, READOUTS), 'utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean).map(l => JSON.parse(l))
    : [];
function record(readouts) {
  mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
  const { added } = M1B.mergeReadouts(recorded(), readouts, new Date().toISOString());
  for (const a of added) {
    appendFileSync(join(OUT, READOUTS), JSON.stringify(a) + '\n');
    const r = a.readout;
    console.log(`readout ${r.session}-${r.seq} ${r.event}${r.probe ? ` ${r.probe} run ${r.run}` : ''}${r.status !== undefined ? ` status ${r.status}` : ''}`);
  }
  return added;
}
function collect() {
  const { readouts, incomplete, invalid } = L.readoutsFromLog(adb(['logcat', '-d']).out);
  const added = record(readouts);
  if (incomplete.length) {
    console.log(`incomplete readouts (chunks missing — the log rotated?): ${incomplete.join(', ')}`);
  }
  for (const v of invalid) {
    console.log(`INVALID readout ${v.id}: ${v.why}`);
  }
  console.log(`collect: ${added.length} new readout(s), ${recorded().length} recorded in ${join(OUT, READOUTS)}`);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ commands

function checkApks() {
  const a = apks();
  const config = {};
  for (const [k, f] of [['devnet', a.devnet], ['production', a.production]]) {
    const tmp = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'm1c-dex-'));
    try {
      execFileSync('unzip', ['-q', '-o', f, 'classes*.dex', '-d', tmp]);
      for (const dex of readdirSync(tmp).filter(n => /^classes\d*\.dex$/.test(n))) {
        const c = L.buildConfigFromDexdump(execFileSync(buildTool('dexdump'), ['-f', join(tmp, dex)], { encoding: 'utf8', maxBuffer: 1 << 30 }));
        if (c) {
          config[k] = c;
        }
      }
    } finally {
      rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
    }
  }
  writeFileSync(join(a.dir, 'CONFIG.json'), JSON.stringify(config, null, 2) + '\n');
  const lines = L.judgeApkConfig(config);
  const control = L.judgeApkConfig({ devnet: config.devnet, production: config.devnet }).find(l => l.id === 'M1c.A2');
  for (const l of lines) {
    console.log(`${l.pass ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}  ${l.id}  ${l.text}\n        ${l.detail}`);
  }
  console.log(control.pass ? 'CONTROL FAILED: the production check passes the devnet APK' : 'control OK: the production check refuses the devnet APK');
  process.exit(lines.every(l => l.pass) && !control.pass ? 0 : 1);
}

function install() {
  const a = apks();
  oneDevice();
  const pre = I.preflightAll({
    adb: rawAdb,
    apkSigners,
    sha256File,
    outDir: OUT,
    allowFreshProduction: flag(I.ALLOW_FRESH_PRODUCTION.slice(2)),
    targets: [
      { pkg: L.DEVNET_PACKAGE, apk: a.devnet },
      { pkg: L.PRODUCTION_PACKAGE, apk: a.production },
    ],
  });
  const at = new Date().toISOString();
  appendFileSync(join(OUT, 'installs.log.jsonl'), JSON.stringify({ at, step: 'install', packages: pre }) + '\n');
  for (const p of pre) {
    console.log(
      p.installed
        ? `${p.pkg}: installed, same signer; rollback ${p.rollback.dir}\n  restore with: ${p.rollback.command}`
        : `${p.pkg}: not installed (a first install${p.fresh ? `, allowed by ${I.ALLOW_FRESH_PRODUCTION}` : ''})`,
    );
  }
  console.log(`installing ${L.DEVNET_PACKAGE} (devnet release; its data is kept) …`);
  I.installApk({ adb: rawAdb, pkg: L.DEVNET_PACKAGE, apk: a.devnet });
  const l = M1B.launchCheck({ adb: rawAdb, pkg: L.DEVNET_PACKAGE, id: 'M1c.L1', text: 'the devnet release APK launches on the phone', wait: () => sleep(10) });
  console.log(`${l.pass ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}  ${l.id}  ${l.text}\n        ${l.detail}`);
  json('launch-devnet.json', { ...l, at: new Date().toISOString() });
  process.exit(l.pass ? 0 : 1);
}

function pinnedControl() {
  const dir = opt('apks') ?? die('needs --apks DIR (its CONFIG.json, written by check-apks, holds the devnet API_BASE)');
  const cfgFile = join(dir, 'CONFIG.json');
  existsSync(cfgFile) || die(`missing ${cfgFile} — run check-apks first`);
  const apiBase = JSON.parse(readFileSync(cfgFile, 'utf8')).devnet?.API_BASE;
  mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
  let trigger = null;
  if (!flag('judge-only')) {
    oneDevice();
    collect();
    const knownRunKeys = L.pinnedRuns(recorded().map(x => x.readout)).map(r => r.key);
    console.log(`sending ${L.PINNED_CONTROL_LINK} to ${L.DEVNET_PACKAGE} and waiting for its three readout lines (≤ 150 s) …`);
    trigger = D.triggerPinnedControl({ adb: rawAdb, sleep, knownRunKeys });
    record(trigger.readouts);
    if (!trigger.started) {
      console.log(`the devnet app did not start on the link: ${trigger.startOutput.trim()}`);
    }
    if (!trigger.run) {
      console.log('no new complete pinned-control run appeared (is the installed devnet app this commit\'s? is the phone unlocked?)');
    }
  }
  const lines = L.judgePinnedControl({ readouts: recorded().map(x => x.readout), apiBase });
  for (const l of lines) {
    console.log(`${l.pass ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}  ${l.id}  ${l.text}\n        ${l.detail}`);
  }
  json('pinned-control.json', { at: new Date().toISOString(), apiBase, triggered: trigger ? { started: trigger.started, run: trigger.run?.key ?? null, polls: trigger.polls } : null, lines });
  const pass = lines.every(l => l.pass);
  console.log(pass ? 'GATE PASSED: outcome logic may be written (§6.0).' : 'GATE NOT PASSED: no outcome logic is written before this line passes (§6.0) — report the FAIL lines.');
  process.exit(pass ? 0 : 1);
}

try {
  switch (cmd) {
    case 'check-apks':
      checkApks();
      break;
    case 'install':
      install();
      break;
    case 'collect':
      oneDevice();
      collect();
      break;
    case 'pinned-control':
      pinnedControl();
      break;
    default:
      die(`unknown command ${cmd ?? '(none)'} — see the header of ${new URL(import.meta.url).pathname}`);
  }
} catch (e) {
  if (e instanceof I.CheckpointStop) {
    console.error(`STOP: ${e.message}`);
    process.exit(3);
  }
  throw e;
}
```

Create `scripts/m1c-checkpoint/build-apks.sh`:

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds the two APKs of the M1c checkpoint from ONE commit (spec §16: "each checkpoint also
# builds the production APK of the same commit"), into OUT (default build/m1c-checkpoint/apks):
#   devnet.apk       the devnet release app (ENVFILE=.env.devnet, com.nocturawallet.devnet)
#   production.apk   the production release app (ENVFILE=.env.production, com.nocturawallet)
# then reads both APKs' BuildConfig off the built files (m1c-checkpoint.mjs check-apks: the
# readout gate is open in devnet.apk and closed in production.apk, with its negative control; the
# devnet API_BASE ends in exactly one /v1 — the relayer URLs append bare paths to it) and writes
# COMMIT, SHA256SUMS and CONFIG.json next to them. (M1b's script, adapted; M1c Task 9 extends it.)
#
#   ANDROID_NDK_HOME=~/Android/Sdk/ndk/27.1.12297006 scripts/m1c-checkpoint/build-apks.sh [OUT]
#
# Needs: android/keystore.properties (release signing), the gitignored .env.devnet (NETWORK=devnet,
# FEATURES_SHIELDED=true, LOCAL_PROVING=true, APP_ID_SUFFIX=.devnet — README "Before you start")
# and .env.production at the repository root, a real node_modules (never a symlink: Gradle writes
# into node_modules/*/android/build). CARGO_TARGET_DIR may point at an existing target.
# DEVNET_ENVFILE (optional, an ABSOLUTE path) builds the devnet APK from another env file than the
# repository's .env.devnet (e.g. a temporary copy) — the same checks apply to it; the production
# APK is always built from .env.production.
set -euo pipefail
here=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
root=$(cd "$here/../.." && pwd)
out="${1:-$root/build/m1c-checkpoint/apks}"
: "${ANDROID_NDK_HOME:?set ANDROID_NDK_HOME (android/build.gradle ndkVersion 27.1.12297006)}"
export ANDROID_HOME="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}"
devnet_env="${DEVNET_ENVFILE:-$root/.env.devnet}"
case "$devnet_env" in /*) ;; *) echo "DEVNET_ENVFILE must be an absolute path" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
[ -f "$devnet_env" ] || { echo "missing $devnet_env" >&2; exit 2; }
for f in .env.production android/keystore.properties; do
  [ -f "$root/$f" ] || { echo "missing $f" >&2; exit 2; }
done
[ ! -L "$root/node_modules" ] || { echo "node_modules is a symlink — use a real copy (Gradle writes into it)" >&2; exit 2; }
# The devnet build must be the shielded DEVNET build (Task 6: a shielded build on any other
# network refuses to start); checked here before 30 minutes of Gradle, and again on the APK.
grep -qx 'NETWORK=devnet' "$devnet_env" || { echo "$devnet_env must set NETWORK=devnet (README \"Before you start\")" >&2; exit 2; }
grep -qx 'FEATURES_SHIELDED=true' "$devnet_env" || { echo "$devnet_env must set FEATURES_SHIELDED=true" >&2; exit 2; }
# The relayer URLs are ${API_BASE}/relayer/{quote,submit} (spec §6.0): the base must be https and end in /v1.
grep -Eq '^API_BASE=https://[^/]+/(.*/)?v1$' "$devnet_env" || { echo "$devnet_env must set API_BASE=https://…/v1 (README \"Before you start\")" >&2; exit 2; }
if grep -q '^FEATURES_SHIELDED=true' "$root/.env.production"; then
  echo ".env.production must not set FEATURES_SHIELDED=true" >&2
  exit 2
fi

commit=$(git -C "$root" rev-parse HEAD)
dirty=$(git -C "$root" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)
[ -z "$dirty" ] || echo "WARNING: the working tree has uncommitted changes — the APKs are not exactly $commit" >&2

"$root/native/noctura-prover/build-android.sh"

gradle=(./gradlew assembleRelease --console=plain --max-workers=3 -Pkotlin.compiler.execution.strategy=in-process)
apk="$root/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk"
mkdir -p "$out"
rm -f "$out"/*.apk "$out/CONFIG.json"
(cd "$root/android" && ENVFILE="$devnet_env" "${gradle[@]}")
cp "$apk" "$out/devnet.apk"
(cd "$root/android" && ENVFILE=.env.production "${gradle[@]}")
cp "$apk" "$out/production.apk"

echo "$commit${dirty:+ (dirty)}" > "$out/COMMIT"
(cd "$out" && sha256sum devnet.apk production.apk > SHA256SUMS)
node "$here/m1c-checkpoint.mjs" check-apks --apks "$out"
echo "built from $commit into $out:"
cat "$out/SHA256SUMS"
```

Create `scripts/m1c-checkpoint/README.md`:

````markdown
# M1c checkpoint — the owner's checklist (Task 1: the `pinnedFetch` gate)

Spec: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-08-shielded-a0-m1-design.md` §6.0 and §16 "Checkpoints · M1c". This file is
Task 1's part: **the gate before any unshield outcome logic is written.** Task 9 adds the two unshield checkpoints,
the wipe and restore, and the production launch to this same directory.

**What the gate proves, on your phone:** the relayer client's transport (`pinnedFetch`, then
`src/modules/shielded/a0/relayerTransport.ts`) hands an HTTP error answer back to the app as an answer, with its
status, instead of an exception that has lost the status. Jest proves the JavaScript half against the library's
source; only the phone proves the compiled native module, our certificate pins against the live
`api.noc-tura.io`, and the relayer's real answer.

**How:** the desk sends the deep link `noctura://a0-pinned-control` to the **devnet** app. The app (devnet build
only — the code is in the production app too, but its gate is closed there and it sends nothing) makes three
requests and writes one `NOCTURA-A0-READOUT` log line for each. Only public values are in those lines: the URL,
the HTTP status, the relayer's outcome word, whether the request threw, and the relayer's public quote.

1. a deliberately malformed `POST …/relayer/submit` (`{"kind":"noctura-m1c-pinned-control"}`). It must come back
   as **HTTP 400, outcome `invalid_request`, not thrown**. The relayer refuses it before it touches its key, its
   budget or the chain, so it costs nothing.
2. `GET …/relayer/quote`: **HTTP 200**, the quote of the A0 pool (`FeGSS…` / `8VMe…` / `ERkp…`) from the relayer
   fee payer `3jvhiz9qcJAe2zGHvRAiRYXiaFCdjEQrB9KuE5NuFaGe`.
3. the **negative control**: request 1 again, but through a copy of `pinnedFetch` that handles errors the old,
   broken way. It **must throw with the status lost**. If it does not, line 1 proves nothing (the library would
   not be rejecting error answers at all), and the gate fails.

The desk judges the lines (`M1c.P0`–`P3`). It never contacts `noc-tura.io` itself. The phone does.

## Before you start

- [ ] **The phone** is reachable over adb: USB, or wireless (`adb pair <ip:port>` once, then `adb connect
      <ip:port>`). `adb devices` must list exactly one `device`, or pass `--serial <ip:port>` to every command.
      **Wireless adb drops when the phone locks.** If a command says "expected exactly one device", unlock the phone
      and pair again.
- [ ] **`.env.devnet`** is M1b's (see `scripts/m1b-checkpoint/README.md` "Before you start"). This step also
      needs `API_BASE=https://api.noc-tura.io/api/v1`. It already ends in `/v1`, and the app appends
      `/relayer/quote` and `/relayer/submit` to it. `build-apks.sh` refuses an `API_BASE` that does not end in
      `/v1`.
- [ ] The phone is **unlocked with the screen on** when you run `pinned-control`. Android does not start an
      activity behind the lock screen. The wallet itself does **not** need to be unlocked: the control sends
      nothing of the wallet.

## Steps

```bash
# 1. both APKs from ONE commit (≈ 30 min; never at the same time as Jest or cargo)
ANDROID_NDK_HOME=~/Android/Sdk/ndk/27.1.12297006 scripts/m1c-checkpoint/build-apks.sh
#    → build/m1c-checkpoint/apks/{devnet.apk,production.apk,COMMIT,SHA256SUMS,CONFIG.json}
#    and the BuildConfig check (it also runs at the end of build-apks.sh):
node scripts/m1c-checkpoint/m1c-checkpoint.mjs check-apks --apks build/m1c-checkpoint/apks
#    PASS M1c.A1 (the devnet APK has the readout gate open), M1c.A2 (the production APK has it closed),
#    M1c.A3 (the devnet API_BASE ends in exactly one /v1), and "control OK".

# 2. install the devnet APK. This uses M1a's install.mjs unchanged: the installed signer of BOTH packages is
#    checked, rollback copies are pulled, and anything unexpected is a STOP (exit 3). It never uninstalls and
#    never clears data. The production APK is NOT installed in this step.
node scripts/m1c-checkpoint/m1c-checkpoint.mjs install --apks build/m1c-checkpoint/apks

# 3. the gate (≤ 150 s)
node scripts/m1c-checkpoint/m1c-checkpoint.mjs pinned-control --apks build/m1c-checkpoint/apks
#    exit 0 + "GATE PASSED" → Tasks 3 onward may write the outcome logic.
#    The record: build/m1c-checkpoint/{readouts.jsonl,pinned-control.json}
```

Run `pinned-control` **at most twice a minute**. Each run sends two submits, and the relayer allows 5 submits per
minute from one IP address. A third quick run gets HTTP 429 from the rate limiter, and P1 fails. To judge the
recorded lines again without sending anything: `… pinned-control --apks … --judge-only`.

## Reading a FAIL

| line | what you see in its detail | what it means / what to do |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | `threw true … pinFailure true` | our certificate pins did not match `api.noc-tura.io` (an E004 pin failure). **Stop.** Report it. Do not "fix" it by removing a pin. |
| P1 | `threw true … pinFailure false` | network or DNS failure, or the JS deadline. Check the phone's connection and run again. |
| P1 | `status 503 outcome transfer_disabled` / `relayer_disabled` | the relayer is switched off. Ask the program side. |
| P1 | `status 429` | rate limited. Wait one minute and run again. |
| P1 | `status 400 outcome unrecognised` or `null` | the relayer answered without the contract's outcome. Report it to the program side (contract §1). |
| P2 | another `feePayer` / `programId` / `pool` / `mint` | the relayer serves another key or pool than the pinned one. **Stop.** Report it. |
| P3 | `threw false … status 400` | the installed library RESOLVED the error answer, so P1 proves nothing. **Stop.** Report it. The transport's assumptions are wrong. |
| P0 | another URL | the devnet APK's `API_BASE` is not what `check-apks` read, or the app doubled `/v1`. Rebuild from a clean commit. |
| all | "no complete pinned-control run recorded" | the app did not start on the link (check `adb devices`, phone unlocked), or the installed devnet app is older than this commit (install again). |

## What is not proven here

- The unshield itself, the confirmation dialog and the relayed transaction (Tasks 6 and 7, checkpoint Task 9).
- The production app: its gate is read off its APK (`M1c.A2`) and tested in Jest. Its launch with "no readout
  line" is Task 9's step. This step never installs it.
````

#### Notes for the executor (Task 1)

- **The rulings this task took (each the most secure default; the owner may overturn any):**
  - **The trigger is a deep link with no route, read by a root hook. There is no button.** The desk can send
    `am start -a VIEW -d noctura://a0-pinned-control com.nocturawallet.devnet` with no UI to build or design.
    The link is unmatched in `deepLinkConfig`, so React Navigation's `getStateFromPath` returns `undefined`,
    which is tested with a configured-path control. With the gate closed, the hook adds no listener at all.
    It needs no wallet unlock because it sends nothing of the wallet. Any app on a devnet phone could fire the
    link; the cost is one malformed request and one quote. Cost if wrong: a hook to remove.
  - **The malformed submit is valid JSON with an unknown `kind`, not broken JSON.** Broken JSON would get Express's
    own 400 error page (HTML, no `outcome`) and would not exercise the relayer's answer. The coordinator's
    `validatePayload` (`relayerA0.js` at their f3f8eff) refuses an unknown `kind` right after "is an object".
    That is before its key, Redis or the chain, so the request costs nothing. It does count against the
    5-submits-per-minute limit (two per run; the README says at most two runs a minute).

    third parameter of `pinnedFetch`.** A parameter would let any caller switch the fix off. A named export with
    a source guard (exactly one caller, comments ignored, denominator ≥ 200 files) cannot be reached by accident.

    reaches the log: the outcome must be one of the twelve (else `unrecognised`), and the quote passes field by
    field in its shape (a sentinel test with a positive control).

  ```ts
  export const A0_ACCOUNT_REGISTRY_SCHEMA = 1;
  export const A0_MAX_ACCOUNTS = 100;                 // the main included (the extension's MAX_ACCOUNTS)
  export const A0_MAX_ACCOUNT_INDEX = 2 ** 31 - 1;
  export const A0_FRESH_HISTORY_SKIP_LIMIT = 20;      // candidates with history one reservation skips
  export const A0_ACCOUNT_DISCOVERY_GAP = 20;         // §7 "Accounts", ruling 7 — Task 5's
  export type A0AccountRole = 'main' | 'fresh-pending' | 'fresh-exit';
  export interface A0AccountEntry { scheme: string; role: A0AccountRole; address: string }
  export class A0AccountRegistryError extends Error { readonly code: A0AccountRegistryErrorCode }
  //   E_A0_STORE_LOCKED | E_A0_STORE_CHANGED | E_A0_ACCOUNTS_CORRUPT | E_A0_ACCOUNTS_SEED | E_A0_ACCOUNTS_MAIN
  //   | E_A0_ACCOUNTS_CLI | E_A0_ACCOUNTS_FULL | E_A0_ACCOUNTS_NO_FRESH | E_A0_ACCOUNTS_RPC
  //   | E_A0_ACCOUNTS_UNKNOWN | E_A0_ACCOUNTS_STATE | E_A0_ACCOUNTS_INVALID
  export type A0HistoryRpc = Pick<Connection, 'getSignaturesForAddress'>;
  export interface A0RegistryOptions { bound?: A0StoreBinding }
  export function parseA0Scheme(s: unknown): TransparentScheme | null;           // strict; no default
  export function a0AccountAddress(seed: Uint8Array, scheme: TransparentScheme): string;   // 64-byte seed; secret key zeroed
  export function lowestFreeA0Index(taken: Iterable<number>): number;
  export function hasA0AccountRegistry(o?): boolean;
  export function loadA0AccountRegistry(o?): readonly A0AccountEntry[] | null;    // null = no record (never [])
  export function openA0AccountRegistry(seed, o?): readonly A0AccountEntry[];     // creates [main] if absent; checks every entry against the seed
  export function a0SeedPublicKeys(seed, o?): string[];                          // every entry's address re-derived, then the seed's cli key and slip10:0 (always); de-duplicated
  export function reserveA0FreshAccount(rpc: A0HistoryRpc, seed, o?): Promise<A0AccountEntry>;   // → fresh-pending
  export function promoteA0FreshAccount(scheme: string, o?): 'promoted' | 'already';
  export function releaseA0FreshAccount(scheme: string, o?): boolean;            // false = nothing to release
  export function addA0RecoveredExitAccounts(indices: readonly number[], seed, o?): string[];   // Task 5
  ```

- **What later tasks rely on:**
  - **Task 4** (the verifier) takes the seed's public-key set as a plain `readonly string[]` argument; its caller (Task 7) passes `a0SeedPublicKeys(seed, {bound})`. The set is every registry entry (main — `cli` or `slip10:n` — and every `fresh-pending` / `fresh-exit`), each re-derived from the seed, plus ALWAYS the seed's `cli` key and `slip10:0` whatever the main is (controller ruling on concern 6), registry order first, no address twice; a stored address the seed does not derive refuses (`E_A0_ACCOUNTS_SEED`) rather than shrink the set.
  - **Task 5** (recovery) calls `addA0RecoveredExitAccounts(indices, seed, {bound})` once with every matched index (one write; refuses as a whole on a `cli` wallet with any index, a bad index or > 100 entries) and stops `A0_ACCOUNT_DISCOVERY_GAP` (20) past the highest match. A restore must create the registry even with no match: it calls `openA0AccountRegistry(seed, {bound})` (that is what an empty `indices` does).
  - **Task 7** (the flow):
    - reserves with `reserveA0FreshAccount(connection, seed, {bound})` when the user proceeds to the confirmation and only when the destination is "fresh" (it refuses a `cli` wallet with `E_A0_ACCOUNTS_CLI`, so S9 cannot be skipped by a caller); it passes the SAME devnet connection the tree sync uses — the registry makes no cluster check of its own (§2 allows exactly one request);
    - promotes with `promoteA0FreshAccount(scheme, {bound})` after the verifier passed (`'already'` from a second settler is success);
    - releases with `releaseA0FreshAccount(scheme, {bound})` on an outcome without `txSignature` and on a not-landed reconciliation; NEVER on `E_A0_RELAYER_DEADLINE` or a submit transport error (Task 1's hand-over: unknown, not "not forwarded");
    - a reservation that throws wrote nothing: the user can pick another destination.
  - **Task 8** (screens) and M1d read `loadA0AccountRegistry()` for display (stored addresses, no seed); `fresh-pending` entries are filtered out there (§10: never shown, never a Send source).

**The rule, stated once.** The registry is a cache of two things the user already has: the seed (every address re-derives from it)
and the chain (Task 5 rebuilds the exit accounts). So it is strict where a wrong answer costs something and never
"helpful": a record that does not decode exactly is an error, not an empty list (an empty list would hand out an
index already used and drop accounts from the no-seed-signer check); an absent record is `null`, created only by a
caller holding the seed; a stored address is trusted for display only, and every security use re-derives it.

- [ ] **Step 1: The offline account vectors.**

Create `scripts/a0-vectors/gen-account-vectors.mjs`:

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * Offline generator of the account vectors the A0 account registry is tested against (spec
 * 2026-11-08 shielded A0 M1 §10 "Derivation", §14 "multi-account derivation equal to the
 * extension's for slip10:0..3"; M1c Task 2).
 *
 * THE ANTI-CIRCULARITY BOUNDARY. The app and the extension derive `slip10:n` with ONE piece of code,
 * `core/keys/transparent.ts` (micro-key-producer/slip10 + @noble/curves). Nothing here imports it,
 * nor micro-key-producer, nor @noble, nor any base58 library: every value is computed by Node's own
 * crypto (OpenSSL) and a few lines below —
 *   - the BIP-39 seed: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512, 2048 rounds, salt "mnemonic" (+ empty passphrase);
 *   - SLIP-0010 ed25519 (hardened only): master = HMAC-SHA512("ed25519 seed", seed), child =
 *     HMAC-SHA512(c, 0x00 || k || ser32(i + 2^31)), path m/44'/501'/n'/0';
 *   - the `cli` scheme: the first 32 bytes of the seed, no derivation (`solana-keygen new`);
 *   - the Ed25519 public key: OpenSSL's, through a PKCS#8 private key → SPKI export;
 *   - base58: the Bitcoin alphabet, by BigInt division.
 * Before anything is written the script holds itself to two facts it did not compute:
 *   - slip10:0 of "abandon … about" is HAgk14JpMQLgt6rVgv7cBQFJWFto5Dqxi472uT3DKpqk (the address
 *     Phantom / Solflare show for that phrase, and the extension's published test vector,
 *     extension/src/vault/__tests__/accounts.test.ts);
 *   - each mnemonic's seed equals the seed of the same mnemonic in the A0 key vectors
 *     (native/noctura-prover/tests/fixtures/a0-key-vectors.json, written by @scure/bip39).
 * A mismatch stops the script. No network.
 *
 * Run by hand from the repository root:
 *   node scripts/a0-vectors/gen-account-vectors.mjs           write the fixture
 *   node scripts/a0-vectors/gen-account-vectors.mjs --check   regenerate and compare, write nothing
 */
import {createHmac, createPrivateKey, createPublicKey, pbkdf2Sync} from 'node:crypto';
import {readFileSync, writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {dirname, join, relative, resolve} from 'node:path';
import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';

const ROOT = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');
const OUT = join(ROOT, 'src/modules/shielded/a0/__tests__/fixtures/a0-account-vectors.json');
const KEY_VECTORS = join(ROOT, 'native/noctura-prover/tests/fixtures/a0-key-vectors.json');
const OUT_REL = relative(ROOT, OUT);

const fail = msg => {
  console.error(`gen-account-vectors: ${msg}`);
  process.exit(1);
};

const MNEMONICS = [
  'abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about',
  'zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo wrong',
];
/** The accounts §14 names (0..3) and the highest index the registry accepts (2^31 − 1). */
const INDICES = [0, 1, 2, 3, 2 ** 31 - 1];
const ANCHOR = {mnemonic: MNEMONICS[0], scheme: 'slip10:0', address: 'HAgk14JpMQLgt6rVgv7cBQFJWFto5Dqxi472uT3DKpqk'};

const B58 = '123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz';
function base58(bytes) {
  let n = BigInt(`0x${Buffer.from(bytes).toString('hex') || '0'}`);
  let out = '';
  while (n > 0n) {
    out = B58[Number(n % 58n)] + out;
    n /= 58n;
  }
  for (const b of bytes) {
    if (b !== 0) break;
    out = `1${out}`;
  }
  return out;
}

const seedOf = mnemonic => pbkdf2Sync(Buffer.from(mnemonic.normalize('NFKD')), Buffer.from('mnemonic'), 2048, 64, 'sha512');

function slip10Ed25519(seed, path) {
  let I = createHmac('sha512', 'ed25519 seed').update(seed).digest();
  let k = I.subarray(0, 32);
  let c = I.subarray(32);
  for (const i of path) {
    const data = Buffer.alloc(37);
    k.copy(data, 1);
    data.writeUInt32BE((i + 0x80000000) >>> 0, 33);
    I = createHmac('sha512', c).update(data).digest();
    k = I.subarray(0, 32);
    c = I.subarray(32);
  }
  return Buffer.from(k);
}

const PKCS8_ED25519 = Buffer.from('302e020100300506032b657004220420', 'hex');
function ed25519Public(privateKey32) {
  const priv = createPrivateKey({key: Buffer.concat([PKCS8_ED25519, privateKey32]), format: 'der', type: 'pkcs8'});
  const spki = createPublicKey(priv).export({format: 'der', type: 'spki'});
  if (spki.length !== 44) fail(`unexpected SPKI length ${spki.length}`);
  return spki.subarray(12);
}

const keyVectors = JSON.parse(readFileSync(KEY_VECTORS, 'utf8'));
const seeds = MNEMONICS.map(mnemonic => {
  const seed = seedOf(mnemonic);
  const known = keyVectors.seeds.find(s => s.mnemonic === mnemonic);
  if (!known) fail(`${relative(ROOT, KEY_VECTORS)} has no seed for "${mnemonic}"`);
  if (known.seed !== seed.toString('hex')) fail(`the seed of "${mnemonic}" differs from ${relative(ROOT, KEY_VECTORS)}`);
  const accounts = [{scheme: 'cli', address: base58(ed25519Public(seed.subarray(0, 32)))}];
  for (const n of INDICES) {
    accounts.push({scheme: `slip10:${n}`, address: base58(ed25519Public(slip10Ed25519(seed, [44, 501, n, 0])))});
  }
  return {mnemonic, seed: seed.toString('hex'), accounts};
});

const anchor = seeds.find(s => s.mnemonic === ANCHOR.mnemonic).accounts.find(a => a.scheme === ANCHOR.scheme);
if (anchor.address !== ANCHOR.address) fail(`slip10:0 of the anchor mnemonic is ${anchor.address}, not ${ANCHOR.address}`);
const all = seeds.flatMap(s => s.accounts.map(a => a.address));
if (new Set(all).size !== all.length) fail('two vectors share an address');

const doc = {
  description:
    'Transparent account addresses per TransparentScheme (spec §10): slip10:n = SLIP-0010 ed25519 m/44\'/501\'/n\'/0\', cli = ed25519 of seed[0..32]. ' +
    'Written by scripts/a0-vectors/gen-account-vectors.mjs from Node crypto (PBKDF2, HMAC-SHA512, OpenSSL Ed25519) and its own base58; it imports neither core/keys/transparent.ts nor micro-key-producer nor @noble. ' +
    `Anchored to ${ANCHOR.address} (slip10:0 of the first mnemonic, the extension's test vector) and to the seeds of a0-key-vectors.json. Rerun: node scripts/a0-vectors/gen-account-vectors.mjs [--check].`,
  anchor: ANCHOR,
  seeds,
};
const text = `${JSON.stringify(doc, null, 2)}\n`;

if (process.argv.includes('--check')) {
  const current = readFileSync(OUT, 'utf8');
  if (current !== text) fail(`${OUT_REL} differs from a fresh run`);
  console.log(`gen-account-vectors: ${OUT_REL} matches (${seeds.length} seeds × ${seeds[0].accounts.length} schemes)`);
} else {
  writeFileSync(OUT, text);
  console.log(`gen-account-vectors: wrote ${OUT_REL} (${seeds.length} seeds × ${seeds[0].accounts.length} schemes)`);
}
```

```bash
#   231b36ed43adad918fe86546c80217d548f9ffb160242422400332563aa2111a  src/modules/shielded/a0/__tests__/fixtures/a0-account-vectors.json
```

```ts
/**
 * The account registry (spec §10, S5, S9; §6.1 the fresh rule and the `fresh-pending`
 * reservation, I-5; §14 "multi-account derivation equal to the extension's for slip10:0..3; the
 * registry rules (cli single, lowest free index, no renumbering of main)").
 *
 * THE VECTORS are not the code under test's: `fixtures/a0-account-vectors.json` is written by
 * `scripts/a0-vectors/gen-account-vectors.mjs` from Node's own crypto (PBKDF2, HMAC-SHA512, OpenSSL
 * Ed25519) and its own base58 — it imports neither `core/keys/transparent.ts` nor
 * micro-key-producer nor @noble — and is anchored to HAgk14… (the extension's published vector).
 *
 * THE RPC is a fake `getSignaturesForAddress` with a set of addresses that have history; every
 * call is recorded. The real @solana/web3.js is loaded (`__testing__/realWeb3.ts`), so the
 * `PublicKey` the registry encodes with and hands to the RPC is the real one.
 */
import {readFileSync} from 'fs';
import {join} from 'path';
import {clearAllStores, initSecureMmkv, mmkvPublic, mmkvSecure} from '../../../../store/mmkv/instances';
import {MMKV_KEYS} from '../../../../constants/mmkvKeys';
import {storeTransparentScheme} from '../../../keyDerivation/derivationScheme';
import {
  A0_ACCOUNT_DISCOVERY_GAP,
  A0_FRESH_HISTORY_SKIP_LIMIT,
  A0_MAX_ACCOUNTS,
  A0AccountRegistryError,
  a0AccountAddress,
  a0SeedPublicKeys,
  addA0RecoveredExitAccounts,
  hasA0AccountRegistry,
  loadA0AccountRegistry,
  openA0AccountRegistry,
  parseA0Scheme,
  promoteA0FreshAccount,
  releaseA0FreshAccount,
  reserveA0FreshAccount,
  resetA0ReservationsForTests,
} from '../accountRegistry';
import type {A0AccountEntry, A0HistoryRpc} from '../accountRegistry';

jest.mock('@solana/web3.js', () =>
  jest.requireActual<typeof import('../__testing__/realWeb3')>('../__testing__/realWeb3').loadRealWeb3(),
);

interface Vectors {
  anchor: {mnemonic: string; scheme: string; address: string};
  seeds: {mnemonic: string; seed: string; accounts: {scheme: string; address: string}[]}[];
}
const VECTORS = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(__dirname, 'fixtures/a0-account-vectors.json'), 'utf8')) as Vectors;
const ABANDON = VECTORS.seeds[0]!;
const ZOO = VECTORS.seeds[1]!;
const seedOf = (v: typeof ABANDON): Uint8Array => Uint8Array.from(Buffer.from(v.seed, 'hex'));
const addr = (v: typeof ABANDON, scheme: string): string => v.accounts.find(a => a.scheme === scheme)!.address;
const KEY = 'v1_accounts';

/** A fake history RPC: `withHistory` addresses answer one signature; every call recorded. */
function historyRpc(withHistory: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(), hold?: Promise<void>) {
  const calls: {address: string; config: unknown; commitment: unknown}[] = [];
  const rpc: A0HistoryRpc = {
    getSignaturesForAddress: (async (address: {toBase58(): string}, config?: unknown, commitment?: unknown) => {
      calls.push({address: address.toBase58(), config, commitment});
      if (hold) {
        await hold;
      }
      return withHistory.has(address.toBase58())
        ? [{signature: '5'.repeat(88), slot: 1, err: null, memo: null, blockTime: 1}]
        : [];
    }) as unknown as A0HistoryRpc['getSignaturesForAddress'],
  };
  return {rpc, calls};
}

const code = (fn: () => unknown): string => {
  try {
    fn();
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof A0AccountRegistryError) {
      return e.code;
    }
    throw e;
  }
  throw new Error('did not throw');
};
const codeAsync = async (p: Promise<unknown>): Promise<string> => {
  try {
    await p;
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof A0AccountRegistryError) {
      return e.code;
    }
    throw e;
  }
  throw new Error('did not reject');
};
/** Let microtasks run until `cond` holds (the reservation reached its history request). */
async function until(cond: () => boolean): Promise<void> {
  for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !cond(); i++) {
    await Promise.resolve();
  }
  if (!cond()) {
    throw new Error('the condition never held');
  }
}
const raw = (): unknown => JSON.parse(mmkvSecure()!.getString(KEY)!);
const setRaw = (accounts: unknown[], extra: Record<string, unknown> = {}): void => {
  mmkvSecure()!.set(KEY, JSON.stringify({schema: 1, accounts, ...extra}));
};
const entry = (v: typeof ABANDON, scheme: string, role: string): A0AccountEntry =>
  ({scheme, role, address: addr(v, scheme)}) as A0AccountEntry;

beforeEach(() => {
  clearAllStores();
  initSecureMmkv('test-key');
  storeTransparentScheme({kind: 'slip10', account: 0});
  resetA0ReservationsForTests();
});

describe('derivation (§10, §14): equal to the offline vectors, never computed by the code under test', () => {
  it('the vector file is anchored to the extension\'s published slip10:0 and to the A0 key vectors\' seed', () => {
    expect(VECTORS.anchor).toEqual({
      mnemonic: 'abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about',
      scheme: 'slip10:0',
      address: 'HAgk14JpMQLgt6rVgv7cBQFJWFto5Dqxi472uT3DKpqk',
    });
    expect(addr(ABANDON, 'slip10:0')).toBe('HAgk14JpMQLgt6rVgv7cBQFJWFto5Dqxi472uT3DKpqk');
    const keyVectors = JSON.parse(
      readFileSync(join(__dirname, '../../../../../native/noctura-prover/tests/fixtures/a0-key-vectors.json'), 'utf8'),
    ) as {seeds: {mnemonic?: string; seed: string}[]};
    for (const v of [ABANDON, ZOO]) {
      expect(keyVectors.seeds.find(s => s.mnemonic === v.mnemonic)?.seed).toBe(v.seed);
    }
  });

  it.each([ABANDON, ZOO].flatMap(v => v.accounts.map(a => [v.mnemonic.split(' ')[0]!, a.scheme, a.address] as const)))(
    '%s / %s = %s',
    (word, scheme, address) => {
      const v = word === 'abandon' ? ABANDON : ZOO;
      expect(a0AccountAddress(seedOf(v), parseA0Scheme(scheme)!)).toBe(address);
    },
  );

  it('control: another seed\'s vector does not match (the comparison can fail)', () => {
    expect(a0AccountAddress(seedOf(ZOO), {kind: 'slip10', account: 0})).not.toBe(addr(ABANDON, 'slip10:0'));
  });

  it('parses scheme strings strictly: slip10:0 … slip10:2147483647 and cli; nothing else (no default)', () => {
    expect(parseA0Scheme('cli')).toEqual({kind: 'cli'});
    expect(parseA0Scheme('slip10:0')).toEqual({kind: 'slip10', account: 0});
    expect(parseA0Scheme('slip10:2147483647')).toEqual({kind: 'slip10', account: 2147483647});
    for (const bad of ['slip10:2147483648', 'slip10:01', 'slip10:-1', 'slip10:1.5', 'slip10:', 'slip10: 1', 'CLI', '', null, 3]) {
      expect(parseA0Scheme(bad)).toBeNull();
    }
  });

  it('refuses a seed that is not 64 bytes and an index past 2^31 − 1', () => {
    expect(code(() => a0AccountAddress(new Uint8Array(32), {kind: 'slip10', account: 0}))).toBe('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_INVALID');
    expect(code(() => a0AccountAddress(seedOf(ABANDON), {kind: 'slip10', account: 2 ** 31}))).toBe('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_INVALID');
  });
});

describe('the record (§10): encrypted instance, created with its main by a holder of the seed, fail closed', () => {
  it('no record is null, not an empty list; open creates [main] in the ENCRYPTED instance only', () => {
    expect(hasA0AccountRegistry()).toBe(false);
    expect(loadA0AccountRegistry()).toBeNull();
    const publicKeys = mmkvPublic.getAllKeys();
    expect(openA0AccountRegistry(seedOf(ABANDON))).toEqual([entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:0', 'main')]);
    expect(raw()).toEqual({schema: 1, accounts: [{scheme: 'slip10:0', role: 'main', address: addr(ABANDON, 'slip10:0')}]});
    expect(mmkvPublic.getAllKeys()).toEqual(publicKeys);
    expect(MMKV_KEYS.ACCOUNTS_REGISTRY).toBe(KEY);
  });

  it('the record holds public values only — no seed, no secret key', () => {
    openA0AccountRegistry(seedOf(ABANDON));
    const text = mmkvSecure()!.getString(KEY)!;
    expect(text).not.toContain(ABANDON.seed);
    expect(text).not.toContain(ABANDON.seed.slice(0, 64));
  });

  it('without the encrypted instance every call refuses (E_A0_STORE_LOCKED)', async () => {
    clearAllStores();
    expect(code(() => loadA0AccountRegistry())).toBe('E_A0_STORE_LOCKED');
    expect(code(() => openA0AccountRegistry(seedOf(ABANDON)))).toBe('E_A0_STORE_LOCKED');
    expect(code(() => releaseA0FreshAccount('slip10:1'))).toBe('E_A0_STORE_LOCKED');
    const {rpc, calls} = historyRpc();
    expect(await codeAsync(reserveA0FreshAccount(rpc, seedOf(ABANDON)))).toBe('E_A0_STORE_LOCKED');
    expect(calls).toEqual([]);
  });

  const main0 = (): A0AccountEntry => entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:0', 'main');
  it.each<[string, () => void]>([
    ['not JSON', () => mmkvSecure()!.set(KEY, '{')],
    ['another top-level key', () => setRaw([main0()], {pool: 'x'})],
    ['schema 2', () => setRaw([main0()], {schema: 2})],
    ['no entry', () => setRaw([])],
    ['no main', () => setRaw([entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:0', 'fresh-exit')])],
    ['two mains', () => setRaw([main0(), entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:1', 'main')])],
    ['two entries with one index', () => setRaw([main0(), {...entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:1', 'fresh-exit'), scheme: 'slip10:0'}])],
    ['a cli main with another entry', () => setRaw([entry(ABANDON, 'cli', 'main'), entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:1', 'fresh-exit')])],
    ['a cli entry that is not the main', () => setRaw([main0(), entry(ABANDON, 'cli', 'fresh-exit')])],
    ['index 2^31', () => setRaw([main0(), {scheme: 'slip10:2147483648', role: 'fresh-exit', address: addr(ABANDON, 'slip10:1')}])],
    ['a non-canonical index', () => setRaw([main0(), {...entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:1', 'fresh-exit'), scheme: 'slip10:01'}])],
    ['an unknown role', () => setRaw([main0(), {...entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:1', 'fresh-exit'), role: 'exit'}])],
    ['an address that is not a key', () => setRaw([{...main0(), address: '1111'}])],
    ['an entry with a field §10 does not list', () => setRaw([{...main0(), name: 'Account 1'}])],
    ['101 entries', () => setRaw([main0(), ...Array.from({length: 100}, (_x, i) => ({scheme: `slip10:${i + 1}`, role: 'fresh-exit', address: addr(ZOO, 'slip10:0')}))])],
  ])('a record with %s is CORRUPT — never read as empty', (_what, plant) => {
    plant();
    expect(code(() => loadA0AccountRegistry())).toBe('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_CORRUPT');
    expect(code(() => openA0AccountRegistry(seedOf(ABANDON)))).toBe('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_CORRUPT');
  });

  it('control: the same shape with valid values decodes', () => {
    setRaw([main0(), entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:1', 'fresh-exit'), entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:2', 'fresh-pending')]);
    expect(loadA0AccountRegistry()).toHaveLength(3);

  it('a stored address the seed does not derive refuses (E_A0_ACCOUNTS_SEED); so does another wallet\'s seed', () => {
    setRaw([main0(), {...entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:1', 'fresh-exit'), address: addr(ABANDON, 'slip10:2')}]);
    expect(code(() => a0SeedPublicKeys(seedOf(ABANDON)))).toBe('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_SEED');
    setRaw([main0()]);
    expect(code(() => a0SeedPublicKeys(seedOf(ZOO)))).toBe('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_SEED');
    expect(a0SeedPublicKeys(seedOf(ABANDON))).toEqual([addr(ABANDON, 'slip10:0'), addr(ABANDON, 'cli')]);
  });

  it('a registry whose main is not the wallet\'s scheme refuses (E_A0_ACCOUNTS_MAIN)', () => {
    openA0AccountRegistry(seedOf(ABANDON));
    storeTransparentScheme({kind: 'slip10', account: 1});
    expect(code(() => openA0AccountRegistry(seedOf(ABANDON)))).toBe('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_MAIN');

});

describe('the fresh rule (§6.1, §10): lowest free index across every role, then the history check', () => {
  it('reserves slip10:1 beside a slip10:0 main, as fresh-pending, after ONE history request at confirmed', async () => {
    const {rpc, calls} = historyRpc();
    const got = await reserveA0FreshAccount(rpc, seedOf(ABANDON));
    expect(got).toEqual(entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:1', 'fresh-pending'));
    expect(calls).toEqual([{address: addr(ABANDON, 'slip10:1'), config: {limit: 1}, commitment: 'confirmed'}]);
    expect(loadA0AccountRegistry()).toEqual([entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:0', 'main'), got]);
  });

  it('the lowest index not taken under ANY role: main 0, exit 1, pending 3 → 2, then 4', async () => {
    setRaw([entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:0', 'main'), entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:1', 'fresh-exit'), entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:3', 'fresh-pending')]);
    const {rpc} = historyRpc();
    expect((await reserveA0FreshAccount(rpc, seedOf(ABANDON))).scheme).toBe('slip10:2');
    expect((await reserveA0FreshAccount(rpc, seedOf(ABANDON))).scheme).toBe('slip10:4');
  });

  it('a main of slip10:3 stays slip10:3: the fresh account is slip10:0, and promote / release never touch the main', async () => {
    storeTransparentScheme({kind: 'slip10', account: 3});
    const {rpc} = historyRpc();
    const got = await reserveA0FreshAccount(rpc, seedOf(ABANDON));
    expect(got.scheme).toBe('slip10:0');
    expect(promoteA0FreshAccount('slip10:0')).toBe('promoted');
    const next = await reserveA0FreshAccount(rpc, seedOf(ABANDON));
    expect(next.scheme).toBe('slip10:1');
    expect(releaseA0FreshAccount('slip10:1')).toBe(true);
    expect(loadA0AccountRegistry()).toEqual([entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:3', 'main'), entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:0', 'fresh-exit')]);
    expect(code(() => promoteA0FreshAccount('slip10:3'))).toBe('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_STATE');
    expect(code(() => releaseA0FreshAccount('slip10:3'))).toBe('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_STATE');
  });

  it('a cli wallet gets no fresh index (S9): refused before any request, the registry stays [cli main]', async () => {
    storeTransparentScheme({kind: 'cli'});
    const {rpc, calls} = historyRpc();
    expect(await codeAsync(reserveA0FreshAccount(rpc, seedOf(ABANDON)))).toBe('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_CLI');
    expect(calls).toEqual([]);
    expect(loadA0AccountRegistry()).toEqual([entry(ABANDON, 'cli', 'main')]);
    expect(a0SeedPublicKeys(seedOf(ABANDON))).toEqual([addr(ABANDON, 'cli'), addr(ABANDON, 'slip10:0')]);
  });

  it('an index whose address has history is skipped; the next one is checked and reserved', async () => {
    const {rpc, calls} = historyRpc(new Set([addr(ABANDON, 'slip10:1'), addr(ABANDON, 'slip10:2')]));
    expect((await reserveA0FreshAccount(rpc, seedOf(ABANDON))).scheme).toBe('slip10:3');
    expect(calls.map(c => c.address)).toEqual(['slip10:1', 'slip10:2', 'slip10:3'].map(s => addr(ABANDON, s)));
  });

  it(`${A0_FRESH_HISTORY_SKIP_LIMIT} candidates with history refuse (E_A0_ACCOUNTS_NO_FRESH), nothing written; ${A0_FRESH_HISTORY_SKIP_LIMIT - 1} do not`, async () => {
    const seed = seedOf(ABANDON);
    const used = (k: number) => new Set(Array.from({length: k}, (_x, i) => a0AccountAddress(seed, {kind: 'slip10', account: i + 1})));
    const all = historyRpc(used(A0_FRESH_HISTORY_SKIP_LIMIT));
    expect(await codeAsync(reserveA0FreshAccount(all.rpc, seed))).toBe('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_NO_FRESH');
    expect(all.calls).toHaveLength(A0_FRESH_HISTORY_SKIP_LIMIT);
    expect(loadA0AccountRegistry()).toEqual([entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:0', 'main')]);
    const fewer = historyRpc(used(A0_FRESH_HISTORY_SKIP_LIMIT - 1));
    expect((await reserveA0FreshAccount(fewer.rpc, seed)).scheme).toBe(`slip10:${A0_FRESH_HISTORY_SKIP_LIMIT}`);
  });

  it('a history check that fails or answers no list reserves nothing', async () => {
    const failing: A0HistoryRpc = {
      getSignaturesForAddress: (() => Promise.reject(new Error('429'))) as unknown as A0HistoryRpc['getSignaturesForAddress'],
    };
    await expect(reserveA0FreshAccount(failing, seedOf(ABANDON))).rejects.toThrow('429');
    const odd: A0HistoryRpc = {
      getSignaturesForAddress: (() => Promise.resolve({})) as unknown as A0HistoryRpc['getSignaturesForAddress'],
    };
    expect(await codeAsync(reserveA0FreshAccount(odd, seedOf(ABANDON)))).toBe('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_RPC');
    expect(loadA0AccountRegistry()).toEqual([entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:0', 'main')]);
  });

  it('a second reservation started while the first is in flight picks the NEXT index (I-5)', async () => {
    let open!: () => void;
    const hold = new Promise<void>(r => {
      open = r;
    });
    const {rpc, calls} = historyRpc(new Set(), hold);
    const first = reserveA0FreshAccount(rpc, seedOf(ABANDON));
    const second = reserveA0FreshAccount(rpc, seedOf(ABANDON));
    await until(() => calls.length === 1);
    open();
    expect([(await first).scheme, (await second).scheme]).toEqual(['slip10:1', 'slip10:2']);
    expect(calls.map(c => c.address)).toEqual([addr(ABANDON, 'slip10:1'), addr(ABANDON, 'slip10:2')]);
    expect(loadA0AccountRegistry()!.map(e => [e.scheme, e.role])).toEqual([
      ['slip10:0', 'main'],
      ['slip10:1', 'fresh-pending'],
      ['slip10:2', 'fresh-pending'],
    ]);
  });

  it('a restore that takes the candidate during the history check: the reservation moves to the next index', async () => {
    let open!: () => void;
    const hold = new Promise<void>(r => {
      open = r;
    });
    const {rpc, calls} = historyRpc(new Set(), hold);
    const p = reserveA0FreshAccount(rpc, seedOf(ABANDON));
    await until(() => calls.length === 1);
    expect(addA0RecoveredExitAccounts([1], seedOf(ABANDON))).toEqual(['slip10:1']);
    open();
    expect((await p).scheme).toBe('slip10:2');
  });

  it(`a full registry (${A0_MAX_ACCOUNTS} entries) refuses before any request; ${A0_MAX_ACCOUNTS - 1} take one more`, async () => {
    const seed = seedOf(ABANDON);
    const fill = (k: number) =>
      setRaw([
        entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:0', 'main'),
        ...Array.from({length: k - 1}, (_x, i) => ({scheme: `slip10:${i + 1}`, role: 'fresh-exit', address: a0AccountAddress(seed, {kind: 'slip10', account: i + 1})})),
      ]);
    fill(A0_MAX_ACCOUNTS);
    const full = historyRpc();
    expect(await codeAsync(reserveA0FreshAccount(full.rpc, seed))).toBe('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_FULL');
    expect(full.calls).toEqual([]);
    fill(A0_MAX_ACCOUNTS - 1);
    expect((await reserveA0FreshAccount(historyRpc().rpc, seed)).scheme).toBe(`slip10:${A0_MAX_ACCOUNTS - 1}`);
    expect(loadA0AccountRegistry()).toHaveLength(A0_MAX_ACCOUNTS);
  });
});

describe('promote / release (§6.8) and the binding (R3-N5)', () => {
  it('promote: fresh-pending → fresh-exit; again → already; unknown → UNKNOWN', async () => {
    await reserveA0FreshAccount(historyRpc().rpc, seedOf(ABANDON));
    expect(promoteA0FreshAccount('slip10:1')).toBe('promoted');
    expect(promoteA0FreshAccount('slip10:1')).toBe('already');
    expect(loadA0AccountRegistry()![1]).toEqual(entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:1', 'fresh-exit'));
    expect(code(() => promoteA0FreshAccount('slip10:7'))).toBe('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_UNKNOWN');
  });

  it('release: a fresh-pending entry is removed and its index is handed out again; absent → false; fresh-exit → STATE', async () => {
    const {rpc} = historyRpc();
    await reserveA0FreshAccount(rpc, seedOf(ABANDON));
    expect(releaseA0FreshAccount('slip10:1')).toBe(true);
    expect(releaseA0FreshAccount('slip10:1')).toBe(false);
    expect(loadA0AccountRegistry()).toEqual([entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:0', 'main')]);
    expect((await reserveA0FreshAccount(rpc, seedOf(ABANDON))).scheme).toBe('slip10:1');
    promoteA0FreshAccount('slip10:1');
    expect(code(() => releaseA0FreshAccount('slip10:1'))).toBe('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_STATE');
  });

  it('a wipe + import during the history check: the reservation refuses (E_A0_STORE_CHANGED), the new store gains no record', async () => {
    let open!: () => void;
    const hold = new Promise<void>(r => {
      open = r;
    });
    const {rpc, calls} = historyRpc(new Set(), hold);
    const p = reserveA0FreshAccount(rpc, seedOf(ABANDON));
    await until(() => calls.length === 1);
    clearAllStores();
    initSecureMmkv('another-wallet');
    open();
    expect(await codeAsync(p)).toBe('E_A0_STORE_CHANGED');
    expect(mmkvSecure()!.getString(KEY)).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('promote / release / open with a stale binding refuse before reading or writing', async () => {
    await reserveA0FreshAccount(historyRpc().rpc, seedOf(ABANDON));
    const old = mmkvSecure();
    const before = mmkvSecure()!.getString(KEY);
    initSecureMmkv('test-key'); // the same data, another instance object (an import of the same phrase)
    expect(code(() => promoteA0FreshAccount('slip10:1', {bound: old}))).toBe('E_A0_STORE_CHANGED');
    expect(code(() => releaseA0FreshAccount('slip10:1', {bound: old}))).toBe('E_A0_STORE_CHANGED');
    expect(code(() => openA0AccountRegistry(seedOf(ABANDON), {bound: old}))).toBe('E_A0_STORE_CHANGED');
    expect(mmkvSecure()!.getString(KEY)).toBe(before);
    expect(promoteA0FreshAccount('slip10:1', {bound: mmkvSecure()})).toBe('promoted');
  });
});

describe('the public-key set and the restore\'s writer (handed to Tasks 4–7)', () => {
  it('the public-key set is every entry\'s address — main, fresh-pending, fresh-exit — re-derived from the seed', async () => {
    const {rpc} = historyRpc();
    await reserveA0FreshAccount(rpc, seedOf(ABANDON));
    promoteA0FreshAccount('slip10:1');
    await reserveA0FreshAccount(rpc, seedOf(ABANDON));
    expect(a0SeedPublicKeys(seedOf(ABANDON))).toEqual(['slip10:0', 'slip10:1', 'slip10:2', 'cli'].map(s => addr(ABANDON, s)));
  });

  it('a wallet whose main is slip10 (slip10:3) still reports its cli key and slip10:0 — each once', () => {
    storeTransparentScheme({kind: 'slip10', account: 3});
    expect(a0SeedPublicKeys(seedOf(ABANDON))).toEqual(['slip10:3', 'cli', 'slip10:0'].map(s => addr(ABANDON, s)));
    expect(loadA0AccountRegistry()).toEqual([entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:3', 'main')]);
  });

  it('the reverse: a cli wallet still reports its slip10:0 key (and its cli key once)', () => {
    storeTransparentScheme({kind: 'cli'});
    const keys = a0SeedPublicKeys(seedOf(ZOO));
    expect(keys).toEqual([addr(ZOO, 'cli'), addr(ZOO, 'slip10:0')]);
    expect(new Set(keys).size).toBe(keys.length);
    expect(loadA0AccountRegistry()).toEqual([entry(ZOO, 'cli', 'main')]);
  });

  it('recovered exits: added as fresh-exit, a fresh-pending one promoted, the main untouched, one write', async () => {
    storeTransparentScheme({kind: 'slip10', account: 3});
    await reserveA0FreshAccount(historyRpc().rpc, seedOf(ABANDON)); // slip10:0 pending
    const set = jest.spyOn(mmkvSecure()!, 'set');
    expect(addA0RecoveredExitAccounts([2, 0, 3, 2], seedOf(ABANDON))).toEqual(['slip10:0', 'slip10:2']);
    expect(set).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(loadA0AccountRegistry()).toEqual([
      entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:3', 'main'),
      entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:0', 'fresh-exit'),
      entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:2', 'fresh-exit'),
    ]);
    expect(addA0RecoveredExitAccounts([0, 2], seedOf(ABANDON))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('recovered exits refuse as a whole: a cli wallet, a bad index, more than 100 entries', () => {
    storeTransparentScheme({kind: 'cli'});
    expect(code(() => addA0RecoveredExitAccounts([0], seedOf(ABANDON)))).toBe('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_CLI');
    expect(addA0RecoveredExitAccounts([], seedOf(ABANDON))).toEqual([]);
    clearAllStores();
    initSecureMmkv('test-key');
    storeTransparentScheme({kind: 'slip10', account: 0});
    expect(code(() => addA0RecoveredExitAccounts([2 ** 31], seedOf(ABANDON)))).toBe('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_INVALID');
    const many = Array.from({length: A0_MAX_ACCOUNTS}, (_x, i) => i + 1);
    expect(code(() => addA0RecoveredExitAccounts(many, seedOf(ABANDON)))).toBe('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_FULL');
    expect(loadA0AccountRegistry()).toEqual([entry(ABANDON, 'slip10:0', 'main')]);
  });

  it('the account-discovery gap stays 20 (controller ruling 7: S15 raised the deposit gap only)', () => {
    expect(A0_ACCOUNT_DISCOVERY_GAP).toBe(20);
  });
});
```
