```ts
/**
 * The account registry (spec §10, S5, S9; §6.1 "Destination", I-5): the transparent accounts of
 * this seed the wallet knows, each a `TransparentScheme` string with a role.
 *
 * ROLES — `main` (the scheme the wallet was created or imported with,
 * `WALLET_TRANSPARENT_DERIVATION`, whatever it is: `slip10:3` stays `slip10:3`, never renumbered;
 * no call here changes it), `fresh-pending` (a fresh exit account reserved when the user proceeds
 * to the unshield confirmation, §6.1) and `fresh-exit` (the reservation promoted when the unshield
 * landed, §6.8, or an exit account found by a restore, §7). A `fresh-pending` entry is removed on a
 * known non-landing (`releaseA0FreshAccount`); it is never shown in the switcher nor a Send source
 * (M1d's rule — this module only stores it).
 *
 * RULES, as the extension's (`extension/src/shared/envelopeRules.ts`
 * `accountsPolicyOk` / `MAX_ACCOUNTS`, `extension/src/unlock/accountsFlow.ts` `isAccountIndex` /
 * `lowestFreeIndex`):
 *   - a `cli` wallet has exactly one account, its `main` (S9): no fresh index is ever handed out;
 *   - `slip10` indices are integers in 0 … 2^31 − 1, no two entries share one, at most 100 entries
 *     (the main included);
 *   - the fresh index is the lowest `slip10` index not in the registry under ANY role, then the
 *     history check: `getSignaturesForAddress(address, {limit: 1})` at `confirmed` must be empty
 *     (on the pool's cluster — devnet; it says nothing about mainnet). That request is the ONE
 *     fresh-account RPC request §2 states; an index with history is skipped (an account the
 *     extension or another wallet of this phrase uses) and the next one is checked, at most
 *     `A0_FRESH_HISTORY_SKIP_LIMIT` of them per reservation.
 *
 * ENTRIES — `{scheme, role, address}`. The address (base58 public key) is stored so that the
 * account list can be shown and polled without the seed (which sits behind biometrics); it is
 * derived from the seed when the entry is written, and every call that is handed the seed
 * re-derives every entry and refuses a stored address that differs (`E_A0_ACCOUNTS_SEED`). The
 * public-key set the post-landing verifier needs (`a0SeedPublicKeys`) is always the re-derived one,
 * plus the seed's `cli` key and `slip10:0` whatever the main is.
 *
 * STORAGE — the ENCRYPTED instance only (a plaintext list of one's own accounts is itself a link),
 * one key (`v1_accounts`, schema 1), one value; every write is one synchronous read-modify-write.
 * FAIL CLOSED: no encrypted instance → `E_A0_STORE_LOCKED`; a record that does not decode exactly
 * (any other key, a rule above broken) → `E_A0_ACCOUNTS_CORRUPT` — never an empty list. An absent
 * record is not an empty one either: it is created, with its main, only by a call that holds the
 * seed (`openA0AccountRegistry`).
 *
 * BINDING (M1b's R2-N1 / R3-N5 pattern) — every call takes an optional `bound`: the encrypted
 * instance its caller captured at its own entry. When given, the call refuses with
 * `E_A0_STORE_CHANGED` before reading or writing anything if the open instance is another one (an
 * in-app wipe + import in between), so a stale flow can neither write the old wallet's accounts
 * into the new wallet's registry nor create the new one's record. `reserveA0FreshAccount` captures
 * it itself at entry and holds it across its RPC await.
 *
 * ONE RESERVATION AT A TIME — reservations in this process run one after another (a promise
 * chain), so a second unshield started while the first one's history check is in flight picks the
 * NEXT index, never the same one.
 *
 * SECRETS — the seed is borrowed, never stored, never zero-filled here (the caller owns it); each
 * derived secret key is zero-filled at once. The record holds public values only.
 */
import type {MMKV} from 'react-native-mmkv';
import {PublicKey} from '@solana/web3.js';
import type {Connection} from '@solana/web3.js';
import {mmkvSecure} from '../../../store/mmkv/instances';
import {MMKV_KEYS} from '../../../constants/mmkvKeys';
import {deriveTransparentKeypair, schemeToString} from '../../keyDerivation/transparent';
import type {TransparentScheme} from '../../keyDerivation/transparent';
import {loadTransparentScheme} from '../../keyDerivation/derivationScheme';
import type {A0StoreBinding} from './noteStore';

export const A0_ACCOUNT_REGISTRY_SCHEMA = 1;
/** The most entries the registry holds, the main included (the extension's MAX_ACCOUNTS). */
export const A0_MAX_ACCOUNTS = 100;
/** The SLIP-0010 hardened limit of the account level (the extension's MAX_ACCOUNT_INDEX). */
export const A0_MAX_ACCOUNT_INDEX = 2 ** 31 - 1;
/** Candidates with history one reservation skips before it refuses (`E_A0_ACCOUNTS_NO_FRESH`). */
export const A0_FRESH_HISTORY_SKIP_LIMIT = 20;
/**
 * §7 "Accounts": a restore compares exit destinations with `ATA(slip10:n, mint)` for n = 0, 1, …
 * and stops this many consecutive indices past the highest match. Controller ruling 7 (M1c): S15
 * raised the DEPOSIT gap only; this one stays 20. M1c Task 5 consumes it.
 */
export const A0_ACCOUNT_DISCOVERY_GAP = 20;

export type A0AccountRole = 'main' | 'fresh-pending' | 'fresh-exit';

export interface A0AccountEntry {
  /** `slip10:n` | `cli` — the string `schemeToString` writes */
  scheme: string;
  role: A0AccountRole;
  /** the account's base58 public key, derived from the seed when the entry was written */
  address: string;
}

export type A0AccountRegistryErrorCode =
  /** no encrypted instance (before onboarding / after a wipe) */
  | 'E_A0_STORE_LOCKED'
  /** the caller's flow started on another encrypted instance (a wipe + import since) */
  | 'E_A0_STORE_CHANGED'
  /** the stored record does not decode exactly, or breaks a rule */
  | 'E_A0_ACCOUNTS_CORRUPT'
  /** a stored address is not the one the seed derives for its scheme */
  | 'E_A0_ACCOUNTS_SEED'
  /** the stored main is not the wallet's scheme (`WALLET_TRANSPARENT_DERIVATION`) */
  | 'E_A0_ACCOUNTS_MAIN'
  /** a `cli` wallet has no fresh accounts (S9) */
  | 'E_A0_ACCOUNTS_CLI'
  /** 100 entries already */
  | 'E_A0_ACCOUNTS_FULL'
  /** every candidate checked had history (A0_FRESH_HISTORY_SKIP_LIMIT of them) */
  | 'E_A0_ACCOUNTS_NO_FRESH'
  /** the history check's answer is not a list */
  | 'E_A0_ACCOUNTS_RPC'
  /** no entry with this scheme */
  | 'E_A0_ACCOUNTS_UNKNOWN'
  /** the entry is not in the role the call requires */
  | 'E_A0_ACCOUNTS_STATE'
  /** an argument out of range or shape (a seed not 64 bytes, a bad index or scheme) */
  | 'E_A0_ACCOUNTS_INVALID';

export class A0AccountRegistryError extends Error {
  readonly code: A0AccountRegistryErrorCode;
  constructor(code: A0AccountRegistryErrorCode, message: string) {
    super(`${code}: ${message}`);
    this.name = 'A0AccountRegistryError';
    this.code = code;
  }
}

/** The one RPC method the fresh rule uses (a `Connection` satisfies it). */
export type A0HistoryRpc = Pick<Connection, 'getSignaturesForAddress'>;

export interface A0RegistryOptions {
  /** the encrypted instance the caller captured at its entry (`mmkvSecure()` then) */
  bound?: A0StoreBinding;
}

const KEY = MMKV_KEYS.ACCOUNTS_REGISTRY;
const SLIP10 = /^slip10:(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,9})$/;
const ROLES: readonly A0AccountRole[] = ['main', 'fresh-pending', 'fresh-exit'];

const err = (code: A0AccountRegistryErrorCode, message: string): A0AccountRegistryError =>
  new A0AccountRegistryError(code, message);

/** A scheme string parsed STRICTLY (unlike `schemeFromString`, which defaults): null if it is not one. */
export function parseA0Scheme(s: unknown): TransparentScheme | null {
  if (s === 'cli') {
    return {kind: 'cli'};
  }
  if (typeof s !== 'string') {
    return null;
  }
  const m = SLIP10.exec(s);
  if (!m) {
    return null;
  }
  const n = Number(m[1]);
  return n <= A0_MAX_ACCOUNT_INDEX ? {kind: 'slip10', account: n} : null;
}

/** The address `scheme` derives from `seed` (core/keys/transparent.ts); the secret key is zero-filled. */
export function a0AccountAddress(seed: Uint8Array, scheme: TransparentScheme): string {
  if (!(seed instanceof Uint8Array) || seed.length !== 64) {
    throw err('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_INVALID', 'the seed is not 64 bytes');
  }
  if (scheme.kind === 'slip10' && !(Number.isSafeInteger(scheme.account) && scheme.account >= 0 && scheme.account <= A0_MAX_ACCOUNT_INDEX)) {
    throw err('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_INVALID', `account index ${scheme.account} is not in 0 … 2^31 − 1`);
  }
  const {publicKey, secretKey} = deriveTransparentKeypair(seed, scheme);
  secretKey.fill(0);
  return new PublicKey(publicKey).toBase58();
}

/** The lowest index not in `taken` (the extension's `lowestFreeIndex`). */
export function lowestFreeA0Index(taken: Iterable<number>): number {
  const set = new Set(taken);
  let i = 0;
  while (set.has(i)) {
    i += 1;
  }
  return i;
}

const isAddress = (v: unknown): v is string => {
  if (typeof v !== 'string') {
    return false;
  }
  try {
    return new PublicKey(v).toBase58() === v;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
};

const indexOf = (e: A0AccountEntry): number | null => {
  const s = parseA0Scheme(e.scheme);
  return s !== null && s.kind === 'slip10' ? s.account : null;
};

/** The registry's rules over a list (the extension's accountsPolicyOk, plus the roles). Null = ok. */
function ruleBroken(entries: readonly A0AccountEntry[]): string | null {
  if (entries.length === 0 || entries.length > A0_MAX_ACCOUNTS) {
    return `${entries.length} entries (1 … ${A0_MAX_ACCOUNTS})`;
  }
  const mains = entries.filter(e => e.role === 'main');
  if (mains.length !== 1) {
    return `${mains.length} main entries`;
  }
  if (mains[0]!.scheme === 'cli' && entries.length !== 1) {
    return 'a cli wallet has exactly one account';
  }
  const seenIndex = new Set<number>();
  const seenAddress = new Set<string>();
  for (const e of entries) {
    const s = parseA0Scheme(e.scheme);
    if (s === null) {
      return `scheme ${String(e.scheme)}`;
    }
    if (s.kind === 'cli' && e.role !== 'main') {
      return 'a cli entry that is not the main';
    }
    if (s.kind === 'slip10') {
      if (seenIndex.has(s.account)) {
        return `two entries with index ${s.account}`;
      }
      seenIndex.add(s.account);
    }
    if (!ROLES.includes(e.role)) {
      return `role ${String(e.role)}`;
    }
    if (!isAddress(e.address) || seenAddress.has(e.address)) {
      return `address ${String(e.address)}`;
    }
    seenAddress.add(e.address);
  }
  return null;
}

function decode(raw: string): A0AccountEntry[] {
  let o: unknown;
  try {
    o = JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    throw err('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_CORRUPT', `the ${KEY} record is not JSON`);
  }
  if (o === null || typeof o !== 'object' || Array.isArray(o)) {
    throw err('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_CORRUPT', `the ${KEY} record is not an object`);
  }
  const rec = o as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (Object.keys(rec).sort().join(',') !== 'accounts,schema' || rec.schema !== A0_ACCOUNT_REGISTRY_SCHEMA || !Array.isArray(rec.accounts)) {
    throw err('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_CORRUPT', `the ${KEY} record header`);
  }
  const entries = rec.accounts.map((a: unknown): A0AccountEntry => {
    if (a === null || typeof a !== 'object' || Array.isArray(a)) {
      throw err('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_CORRUPT', 'an entry that is not an object');
    }
    const e = a as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (Object.keys(e).sort().join(',') !== 'address,role,scheme') {
      throw err('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_CORRUPT', `an entry with the fields ${Object.keys(e).join(',')}`);
    }
    return {scheme: e.scheme as string, role: e.role as A0AccountRole, address: e.address as string};
  });
  const broken = ruleBroken(entries);
  if (broken !== null) {
    throw err('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_CORRUPT', broken);
  }
  return entries;
}

const encode = (entries: readonly A0AccountEntry[]): string =>
  JSON.stringify({
    schema: A0_ACCOUNT_REGISTRY_SCHEMA,
    accounts: entries.map(e => ({scheme: e.scheme, role: e.role, address: e.address})),
  });

function storage(bound?: A0StoreBinding): MMKV {
  const store = mmkvSecure();
  if (!store) {
    throw err('E_A0_STORE_LOCKED', 'the encrypted store is not open');
  }
  if (bound !== undefined && store !== bound) {
    throw err('E_A0_STORE_CHANGED', 'the encrypted store was replaced (wipe + import) while this flow was in flight; nothing written');
  }
  return store;
}

function readRecord(bound?: A0StoreBinding): A0AccountEntry[] | null {
  const raw = storage(bound).getString(KEY);
  return raw === undefined ? null : decode(raw);
}

function readExisting(bound?: A0StoreBinding): A0AccountEntry[] {
  const entries = readRecord(bound);
  if (entries === null) {
    throw err('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_UNKNOWN', `no ${KEY} record`);
  }
  return entries;
}

function write(entries: readonly A0AccountEntry[], bound?: A0StoreBinding): void {
  const broken = ruleBroken(entries);
  if (broken !== null) {
    throw err('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_INVALID', broken);
  }
  storage(bound).set(KEY, encode(entries));
}

/** Every entry re-derived from `seed`, and the main against the wallet's scheme. */
function checkAgainstSeed(entries: readonly A0AccountEntry[], seed: Uint8Array): void {
  const main = entries.find(e => e.role === 'main')!;
  const wallet = schemeToString(loadTransparentScheme());
  if (main.scheme !== wallet) {
    throw err('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_MAIN', `the registry's main is ${main.scheme}, the wallet's scheme is ${wallet}`);
  }
  for (const e of entries) {
    const derived = a0AccountAddress(seed, parseA0Scheme(e.scheme)!);
    if (derived !== e.address) {
      throw err('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_SEED', `${e.scheme} is stored as ${e.address}, the seed derives ${derived}`);
    }
  }
}

function openWith(seed: Uint8Array, bound?: A0StoreBinding): A0AccountEntry[] {
  const existing = readRecord(bound);
  if (existing !== null) {
    checkAgainstSeed(existing, seed);
    return existing;
  }
  const scheme = loadTransparentScheme();
  const created: A0AccountEntry[] = [{scheme: schemeToString(scheme), role: 'main', address: a0AccountAddress(seed, scheme)}];
  write(created, bound);
  return created;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ the API

/** Whether a registry record exists (decodable or not), without creating one. Throws LOCKED / CHANGED. */
export function hasA0AccountRegistry(options: A0RegistryOptions = {}): boolean {
  return storage(options.bound).getString(KEY) !== undefined;
}

/**
 * The registry as stored, without the seed: null when there is no record yet (never an empty
 * list). Throws LOCKED / CHANGED / CORRUPT. For display (M1d) — the addresses are the stored ones.
 */
export function loadA0AccountRegistry(options: A0RegistryOptions = {}): readonly A0AccountEntry[] | null {
  return readRecord(options.bound);
}

/**
 * The registry, created with its main if absent (the wallet's scheme, its address derived from
 * `seed`), and every entry checked against `seed` (`E_A0_ACCOUNTS_SEED`, `E_A0_ACCOUNTS_MAIN`).
 */
export function openA0AccountRegistry(seed: Uint8Array, options: A0RegistryOptions = {}): readonly A0AccountEntry[] {
  return openWith(seed, options.bound);
}

/**
 * The seed's public-key set (§6.8 "no signer of the tx is any key of this seed"): the address of
 * EVERY registry entry — the main, every `fresh-pending` and `fresh-exit` — each re-derived from
 * `seed` (a stored address that differs refuses), and ALWAYS the seed's `cli` key and `slip10:0`,
 * whatever the main scheme is (controller ruling on Task 2: another wallet app may use either key
 * of this phrase). Registry order first, then `cli`, then `slip10:0`; no address twice.
 */
export function a0SeedPublicKeys(seed: Uint8Array, options: A0RegistryOptions = {}): string[] {
  const keys = openWith(seed, options.bound).map(e => e.address);
  keys.push(a0AccountAddress(seed, {kind: 'cli'}));
  keys.push(a0AccountAddress(seed, {kind: 'slip10', account: 0}));
  return [...new Set(keys)];
}

let reservations: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();

/**
 * §6.1: reserve the fresh exit account — the lowest `slip10` index not in the registry under any
 * role whose address has no history — as `fresh-pending`, and return its entry. Refuses a `cli`
 * wallet (S9) and a full registry BEFORE any request. Reservations run one at a time.
 */
export function reserveA0FreshAccount(
  rpc: A0HistoryRpc,
  seed: Uint8Array,
  options: A0RegistryOptions = {},
): Promise<A0AccountEntry> {
  const bound = options.bound !== undefined ? options.bound : mmkvSecure();
  const run = reservations.then(
    () => reserveOnce(rpc, seed, bound),
    () => reserveOnce(rpc, seed, bound),
  );
  reservations = run.catch(() => undefined);
  return run;
}

async function reserveOnce(rpc: A0HistoryRpc, seed: Uint8Array, bound: A0StoreBinding): Promise<A0AccountEntry> {
  if (bound === null) {
    throw err('E_A0_STORE_LOCKED', 'the encrypted store is not open');
  }
  const skipped = new Set<number>();
  // Bounded: each pass either skips a candidate with history (at most the skip limit), finds it
  // taken by another writer after the await (each such index is then in the registry), or returns.
  for (let pass = 0; pass < A0_MAX_ACCOUNTS + A0_FRESH_HISTORY_SKIP_LIMIT; pass++) {
    const entries = openWith(seed, bound);
    if (entries.some(e => e.scheme === 'cli')) {
      throw err('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_CLI', 'a cli wallet has exactly one account (S9): no fresh account');
    }
    if (entries.length >= A0_MAX_ACCOUNTS) {
      throw err('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_FULL', `the registry holds ${entries.length} accounts`);
    }
    const taken = entries.map(indexOf).filter((n): n is number => n !== null);
    const index = lowestFreeA0Index([...taken, ...skipped]);
    if (index > A0_MAX_ACCOUNT_INDEX) {
      throw err('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_FULL', 'no slip10 index left');
    }
    const scheme = `slip10:${index}`;
    const address = a0AccountAddress(seed, {kind: 'slip10', account: index});
    const history: unknown = await rpc.getSignaturesForAddress(new PublicKey(address), {limit: 1}, 'confirmed');
    if (!Array.isArray(history)) {
      throw err('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_RPC', `the history check of ${scheme} did not answer a list`);
    }
    if (history.length > 0) {
      skipped.add(index);
      if (skipped.size >= A0_FRESH_HISTORY_SKIP_LIMIT) {
        throw err('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_NO_FRESH', `${skipped.size} candidate accounts have history`);
      }
      continue;
    }
    // after the await: re-read through the binding; another writer (a restore) may have taken it
    const now = openWith(seed, bound);
    if (now.some(e => e.scheme === scheme)) {
      continue;
    }
    if (now.length >= A0_MAX_ACCOUNTS) {
      throw err('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_FULL', `the registry holds ${now.length} accounts`);
    }
    const entry: A0AccountEntry = {scheme, role: 'fresh-pending', address};
    write([...now, entry], bound);
    return entry;
  }
  throw err('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_NO_FRESH', 'no candidate account could be reserved');
}

/**
 * §6.8: the unshield to a reserved account landed — `fresh-pending` → `fresh-exit`. Already
 * `fresh-exit` → no change (`'already'`; a second settler of the same exit). Any other role →
 * `E_A0_ACCOUNTS_STATE`; no such entry → `E_A0_ACCOUNTS_UNKNOWN`.
 */
export function promoteA0FreshAccount(scheme: string, options: A0RegistryOptions = {}): 'promoted' | 'already' {
  const entries = readExisting(options.bound);
  const i = entries.findIndex(e => e.scheme === scheme);
  if (i < 0) {
    throw err('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_UNKNOWN', `no entry ${scheme}`);
  }
  const e = entries[i]!;
  if (e.role === 'fresh-exit') {
    return 'already';
  }
  if (e.role !== 'fresh-pending') {
    throw err('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_STATE', `${scheme} is ${e.role}, not fresh-pending`);
  }
  const next = [...entries];
  next[i] = {...e, role: 'fresh-exit'};
  write(next, options.bound);
  return 'promoted';
}

/**
 * §6.8: the unshield to a reserved account is known not to have landed — the `fresh-pending`
 * entry is removed (its index is free again). No such entry → `false` (nothing to release; a
 * second settler). `main` / `fresh-exit` → `E_A0_ACCOUNTS_STATE`: never removed here.
 */
export function releaseA0FreshAccount(scheme: string, options: A0RegistryOptions = {}): boolean {
  const entries = readRecord(options.bound);
  const i = entries === null ? -1 : entries.findIndex(e => e.scheme === scheme);
  if (entries === null || i < 0) {
    return false;
  }
  const e = entries[i]!;
  if (e.role !== 'fresh-pending') {
    throw err('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_STATE', `${scheme} is ${e.role}, not fresh-pending`);
  }
  write(entries.filter((_e, j) => j !== i), options.bound);
  return true;
}

/**
 * §7 "Accounts" (M1c Task 5's writer): the `slip10` indices a restore matched to exit
 * destinations become `fresh-exit` — added if absent, promoted if `fresh-pending`, left as they
 * are if `fresh-exit` or `main`. ONE write; refuses as a whole (nothing written) a `cli` wallet
 * with any index, a bad index, or a result over 100 entries. Returns the schemes it added or promoted.
 */
export function addA0RecoveredExitAccounts(
  indices: readonly number[],
  seed: Uint8Array,
  options: A0RegistryOptions = {},
): string[] {
  for (const n of indices) {
    if (!(Number.isSafeInteger(n) && n >= 0 && n <= A0_MAX_ACCOUNT_INDEX)) {
      throw err('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_INVALID', `account index ${n} is not in 0 … 2^31 − 1`);
    }
  }
  const entries = openWith(seed, options.bound);
  if (indices.length === 0) {
    return [];
  }
  if (entries.some(e => e.scheme === 'cli')) {
    throw err('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_CLI', 'a cli wallet has exactly one account (S9): no exit account');
  }
  const next = [...entries];
  const changed: string[] = [];
  for (const n of [...new Set(indices)].sort((a, b) => a - b)) {
    const scheme = `slip10:${n}`;
    const i = next.findIndex(e => e.scheme === scheme);
    if (i < 0) {
      next.push({scheme, role: 'fresh-exit', address: a0AccountAddress(seed, {kind: 'slip10', account: n})});
      changed.push(scheme);
    } else if (next[i]!.role === 'fresh-pending') {
      next[i] = {...next[i]!, role: 'fresh-exit'};
      changed.push(scheme);
    }
  }
  if (next.length > A0_MAX_ACCOUNTS) {
    throw err('E_A0_ACCOUNTS_FULL', `${next.length} accounts after the restore (at most ${A0_MAX_ACCOUNTS})`);
  }
  if (changed.length > 0) {
    write(next, options.bound);
  }
  return changed;
}

/** TEST-ONLY: forget the reservation chain (a test that leaves one hanging). */
export function resetA0ReservationsForTests(): void {
  reservations = Promise.resolve();
}

#### Notes for the executor (Task 2)

- **The rulings this task took (each the most secure default; the owner may overturn any):**
  - **Each entry stores its address beside `{scheme, role}`.** §10 lists scheme + role. The address is added
    because the switcher and the balance polls (M1d) run without the seed, which is behind biometrics. It is
    written from the seed's derivation and is never trusted for a security decision: `openA0AccountRegistry`,
    `a0SeedPublicKeys`, `reserveA0FreshAccount` and `addA0RecoveredExitAccounts` re-derive every entry and refuse a
    mismatch (`E_A0_ACCOUNTS_SEED`). Cost if wrong: one field dropped behind the schema number.
  - **The main is checked against the wallet's scheme** (`WALLET_TRANSPARENT_DERIVATION`, public MMKV) on every
    seed-holding call (`E_A0_ACCOUNTS_MAIN`). A wipe clears both, and an import writes the scheme before the
    registry exists, so the two can only differ if one store was tampered with or a migration is missing.
  - **The history check:** `getSignaturesForAddress(address, {limit: 1}, 'confirmed')`. One page of one
    signature answers "any history". `confirmed` sees a tx a few seconds after it lands, `finalized` ~13 s
    later, and a missed recent tx would hand out an account that is in use. An index with history is skipped and
    not recorded (§10: "an index the extension added is skipped here only by the history check"), so the next
    reservation asks again. Each skip is one more request naming one more address of this seed, so a
    reservation stops after `A0_FRESH_HISTORY_SKIP_LIMIT` = 20 skips (`E_A0_ACCOUNTS_NO_FRESH`, nothing written).
    The number mirrors ruling 7's discovery gap. A failed request or an answer that is not a list reserves
    nothing (`E_A0_ACCOUNTS_RPC`).
  - **One reservation at a time.** A promise chain in the module: a second `reserveA0FreshAccount` waits for the
    first to settle (written or refused) and then sees its `fresh-pending` entry, so it takes the next index. That
    is the I-5 row ("a second unshield started meanwhile picks the next index"). After its await, a reservation
    re-reads the registry through its binding. If another writer (a restore) took the candidate meanwhile, it moves
    on. The loop is bounded (`A0_MAX_ACCOUNTS + A0_FRESH_HISTORY_SKIP_LIMIT` passes; the bound was added after mutation A3 made the unbounded loop spin forever — Step 6).
  - **`promote` / `release` are idempotent for a second settler, strict otherwise.** Promote of a `fresh-exit` →
    `'already'`; release of an absent entry → `false`. Both refuse `main` (and release refuses `fresh-exit`) with
    `E_A0_ACCOUNTS_STATE`, so no caller can drop or rename the main or forget a landed exit. Promote of an absent
    entry refuses (`E_A0_ACCOUNTS_UNKNOWN`). Task 7 decides whether a landed exit whose reservation is gone gets
    `addA0RecoveredExitAccounts`.
  - **The public-key set is wider than the registry (controller ruling on this task's concern 6).** §6.8's
    check is "any signer that is a key of this seed", so `a0SeedPublicKeys` returns every registry entry AND,
    always, the seed's `cli` key and `slip10:0`, whatever the main scheme is. The phrase may be used by
    `solana-keygen` (no path) or by Phantom / Solflare (`slip10:0`) beside this wallet. Duplicates are removed:
    for a `slip10:0` main the `slip10:0` key appears once. The rows are "a wallet whose main is slip10 (slip10:3)
    still reports its cli key and slip10:0" and its reverse "a cli wallet still reports its slip10:0 key", with
    mutations A27 (no `cli`), A28 (no `slip10:0`) and A29 (not de-duplicated). Cost if wrong: a relayed tx whose
    signer is one of those two keys is refused (it never would be: the only signer is the relayer's fee payer).
  - **The history check needs Task 7's devnet connection.** The registry makes exactly one request per
    candidate (§2) and no cluster check of its own (no `getGenesisHash`). Task 7 must pass the same devnet
    `Connection` its tree sync uses. A mainnet or foreign-cluster connection would answer "no history" for an
    account in use on devnet, and the registry cannot tell.
  - **The seed is borrowed.** These calls never zero-fill the caller's seed: Task 7 also needs it for `keysOpen`,
    which consumes it, so Task 7 orders the calls. Each derived secret key is zero-filled at once. A seed that is
    not 64 bytes refuses.
  - **The registry lives in `src/modules/shielded/a0/`, not in a general accounts module.** It shares the A0
    binding type and error codes, and only shielded code creates `fresh-*` roles. M1d may move it when the
    switcher arrives. Cost: an import path.
  - **The vectors are not micro-key-producer's.** The brief allows micro-key-producer/slip10, but that is the
    library `core/keys/transparent.ts` itself calls, so it would test the library against itself. The generator
    re-implements BIP-39 seeding and SLIP-0010 ed25519 on Node's `crypto` (PBKDF2, HMAC-SHA512, OpenSSL Ed25519
    via PKCS#8 → SPKI) with its own base58. It then holds itself to two facts it did not compute: HAgk14… (the
    extension's published vector, the address Phantom shows for "abandon … about") and the seeds in
    `a0-key-vectors.json`. Mutation A26 (the core's path without `/0'`) shows the vectors catch a derivation drift.
- **Deviations from the brief:**
  - `addA0RecoveredExitAccounts` (the restore's writer) and `A0_ACCOUNT_DISCOVERY_GAP` are added here, not in
    Task 5, so that every registry rule lives in one module. Task 5 calls them.
  - The vectors add `cli` and `slip10:2147483647` to the brief's `slip10:0..3`, and a second mnemonic
    (`zoo … wrong`), so that the comparison has a negative control.
- **What the next tasks must know:** see Interfaces → "What later tasks rely on". Measured in Jest on this machine:
  one derivation takes 1–3 ms (the vector rows). The 100-entry row runs three seed-holding calls over 99–100 entries
  in 870 ms. The flow pays such a call a few times per unshield. On the phone it is unmeasured.
- **Environment:** the clone's `node_modules/node_modules` self-symlink is absent (removed before Task 1). No second
  React appeared: the whole suite passes, `useReferralDeepLink.test.ts` included. Each full Jest run of this task printed "A worker process has failed to exit gracefully" once, next to `backupModule.test.ts`. That was not investigated, and the line was not checked at 552cca0.

#### Spec rev 3.4 lines (Task 2)
- §10 "Registry": entries are `{scheme, role, address}`. The address is derived from the seed when written, shown without the seed, and re-derived (a mismatch refuses) wherever it decides anything. The record is `{schema: 1, accounts}` under `v1_accounts` in the encrypted instance. A missing instance or an undecodable record is an error, never an empty list. An absent record is created with its main only by a call that holds the seed. Every writer is bound to the instance captured at its entry (`E_A0_STORE_CHANGED`).
- §6.1 / §10 "the history check": `getSignaturesForAddress(address, {limit: 1})` at `confirmed`. An index with history is skipped and not recorded. One reservation skips at most 20 such indices and then refuses (no fresh account offered). Reservations in one process run one at a time.
- §10: the stored main must equal `WALLET_TRANSPARENT_DERIVATION`. `fresh-pending` → `fresh-exit` and the removal of `fresh-pending` are the only role changes. `main` is never removed, renamed or changed, and `fresh-exit` is never removed.
- §6.8 "no signer of the tx is any key of this seed": the key set is every registry entry plus, always, the seed's `cli` key and `slip10:0`, whatever the main scheme is (de-duplicated).
- §7 "Accounts" (ruling 7): the account-discovery gap stays 20. S15's 100 is the deposit gap only.
- §14: "multi-account derivation equal to the extension's for `slip10:0..3`" is met against vectors from an independent SLIP-0010 implementation (Node `crypto`), anchored to the extension's published `slip10:0` of "abandon … about".
### Task 3: The relayer client — `src/modules/shielded/a0/relayerClient.ts` (spec §1 "Relayer", §6.4, §6.6, §6.7, §6.8, R5, R6), the pinned relayer in the A0 constants, the new IDL with 6011 / 6012 mapped (R1′). What it adds:
- **the quote:** refused unless `programId` / `pool` / `mint` are the pinned A0 constants and `feePayer` is the PINNED relayer `3jvhiz…FaGe` (ruling 9); u64 values as canonical decimal strings; `validForSeconds` an integer 1…60; `minFee.withdraw_change ≤ maxFee` (else `E_A0_QUOTE_FEE_ABOVE_MAX`, a clear message); `gasGrantLamports`, when present, within [rent(0) + 5,000, 50,000,000], with rent(0) read from the chain at quote time (ruling 2: no number pinned; 650,240 measured today, so the floor is 655,240); no key the contract does not list. The fee is exactly `minFee.withdraw_change` (R5). The fetch time is recorded, for the re-quote rule (`a0QuoteExpired`, `a0QuoteTermsUnchanged`);
- **the submit payload:** kind `withdraw_change`, `destination = ata`, `destinationOwner = owner` (REQUIRED since P2), `publicInputs` as decimals in circuit order, the named fields read from them big-endian, `cuLimit` 200,000. Before the payload exists, JS compares the five public inputs it can recompute with its own values (root, amount, `recipientField` = `be_mod_r` of its OWN ATA derivation, `mintHash`, fee = the quote's), and refuses an off-curve owner or a token account that is not `ATA(owner, mint)`;
- **the outcomes:** the frozen twelve, read from the body AND the HTTP status; a disagreement is not believed; `txSignature` present ⟺ forwarded; an unreadable answer is `relay_failed` with no signature (contract §1) unless it carries a `txSignature` (then `unknown`, reconciled); a deadline or a transport error on submit is `unknown`, never "not forwarded" (Task 1's hand-over). `a0SubmitDisposition` maps each to `verify | reconcile | not-forwarded`;
- **the relayed instruction** (`buildA0WithdrawChangeIx`): the `withdraw_with_change` the relayer lands for a payload, signed by the pinned relayer alone, held BYTE FOR BYTE (380 data bytes, 10 metas with flags) to `relayerLandedP1P2` (`withdraw_change` with grant, `withdraw_change_existing`), to `relayerLanded`, and to two relayed txs that landed AFTER the 2026-11-17 upgrade (`5F8Ks5qa…` fresh owner + grant, `5sKiWZTv…` existing owner), recorded once from the public devnet RPC;
- **R1′:** the IDL fixture swapped to the program side's byte copy `shielded-pool-a0-idl.json` `3ac8fda7…` (f3f8eff); M1b's deposit golden still passes; `programErrors.ts` maps all thirteen codes, 6011 `CpiNotAllowed` and 6012 `UnexpectedAccounts` included, into the deposit's `send-failed` detail;
- **R6:** a source guard (`noSelfRelay.test.ts`): only the deposit sends among the shielded modules and screens, the `withdraw_with_change` discriminator lives in three files, and the client names no key, transaction type or send call.

  export function parseA0RelayerQuote(body: unknown, ctx: A0QuoteContext): A0RelayerQuote;   // pure

  export function a0QuoteTermsUnchanged(a: A0RelayerQuote, b: A0RelayerQuote): boolean;  // fee, feePayer, grant (or its absence)
  export interface A0WithdrawChangePayload { kind: 'withdraw_change'; pool; mint; merkleRoot; nullifier; withdrawAmount; destination;

  export interface A0UnshieldTerms { owner: string; ata: string; amount: bigint; fee: bigint; merkleRoot: bigint }
  export const A0_WITHDRAW_CHANGE_PUBLIC_INPUTS;   // the seven names, circuit order

  export function buildA0WithdrawChangePayload(proof: A0Proof, terms: A0UnshieldTerms, quote: A0RelayerQuote): A0WithdrawChangePayload;
  export function a0NullifierRecordPda(nullifierHex: string): PublicKey;
  export function buildA0WithdrawChangeIx(payload: A0WithdrawChangePayload): TransactionInstruction;   // fee payer = the pinned relayer, its only signer
  export function submitA0WithdrawChange(payload: A0WithdrawChangePayload, transport?: RelayerRequestOptions): Promise<A0SubmitResult>;

Equality covers the root, nullifier, amount, change commitment, fee, proof, destination, the nullifier PDA, the fee payer as the one signer, `fee_destination = A0_RELAYER.feeDestination` and the pool's accounts in one comparison;
    - takes the fee payer from the quote, which `parseA0RelayerQuote` has already pinned to `A0_RELAYER.feePayer`;
    - uses `landed-withdraw-5F8Ks5qa.json` (create-ATA + grant, owner `AgPYn4odQNKwWBjvCtgG8G1supmLKaFHtbDVHmMT2KtP` pre-balance 0) and `landed-withdraw-5sKiWZTv.json` (create-ATA no-op, no grant) as positive controls on the CURRENT binary, beside the brief's `47k56NfB…` / `3oHktG2X…`. Both are recorded with M1b's `fetch-devnet-tx.mjs` schema (`noctura.a0.devnet-tx-fixture/1`), not M1b's tree-recording schema, so Task 4 needs a way to read them into a `SyncedTx` (`parseA0SyncedTx(signature, getTransaction answer)`; the recorded `result` is base64-encoded and must be decoded into the shape the real `Connection.getTransaction` returns — the Notes say how).
  - **Task 7** (the flow):
    - `fetchA0RelayerQuote(connection)` with the tree sync's devnet connection (one `getMinimumBalanceForRentExemption(0)` when the quote carries a grant);
    - `quote.gasGrantLamports === null` → the fresh option disabled (S11);
    - `buildA0WithdrawChangePayload(proof, {owner, ata, amount, fee: quote.fee, merkleRoot}, quote)`, with `owner` / `ata` from the native authorization (Task 6); its `E_A0_SUBMIT_PUBLIC_INPUTS` IS §6.6's "a mismatch aborts";
    - before submit: `a0QuoteExpired(q, Date.now())`, then re-fetch; `a0QuoteTermsUnchanged(old, new)` decides "submit the proof already made" vs "discard, new confirmation";
    - `submitA0WithdrawChange(payload)`, then `a0SubmitDisposition(result)`: `verify` (only `confirmed`) → sync retry + Task 4; `reconcile` → the note `pending` with `pendingSince = submitChainTime`, the reservation KEPT; `not-forwarded` → note untouched, `releaseA0FreshAccount`. `E_A0_RELAYER_URL` is the only throw (nothing was sent: a build error);
    - the payload carries the in-flight nullifier — memory only; never log it or the payload (§6.8, INV-NULL exception).
  - **Task 9** (the desk): `A0_RELAYER.feePayer` is the value the `signers == [feePayer]` assertion compares with (ruling 5); the desk keeps its own copy (`scripts/m1c-checkpoint/lib.mjs` `RELAYER_FEE_PAYER`, Task 1), and a desk test may hold the two equal.

**The rule, stated once.** The relayer is a party we do not control, so nothing it says is believed beyond what the
frozen contract lets it say: its quote must name our program, pool, mint and relayer key exactly; its fee is taken
at `minFee` and no other; its grant is held to what the chain's rent makes useful; its answer is read only when the
body and the status agree; and any claim that a transaction was forwarded — even in an answer we cannot read —
keeps the note and the reservation for the sync to decide, because the sync, not the relayer, is the authority on
what landed.

 * (Task 1's recorded native callbacks, `sslPinning/__testing__/realSslPinning.ts`).
 *
 * The expected table below is written from contract §1, not imported from the module.
 */
import {readFileSync} from 'fs';
import {join} from 'path';

jest.mock('@solana/web3.js', () =>
  jest.requireActual<typeof import('../__testing__/realWeb3')>('../__testing__/realWeb3').loadRealWeb3(),
);
jest.mock('react-native-ssl-pinning', () =>
  jest
    .requireActual<typeof import('../../../sslPinning/__testing__/realSslPinning')>('../../../sslPinning/__testing__/realSslPinning')
    .loadRealSslPinning(),
);

import {API_BASE} from '../../../../constants/programs';
import {nativeCalls, resetNative, setNativeCallback, setNativeResponder} from '../../../sslPinning/__testing__/realSslPinning';
import {A0_RELAYER_OUTCOMES} from '../pinnedControl';
import {
  A0_RELAYER_OUTCOME_TABLE,
  a0QuoteExpired,
  a0QuoteTermsUnchanged,
  a0SubmitDisposition,
  fetchA0RelayerQuote,
  interpretA0SubmitAnswer,
  isA0TxSignature,
  parseA0RelayerQuote,
  submitA0WithdrawChange,
} from '../relayerClient';
import type {A0QuoteContext, A0RelayerQuote, A0RentRpc, A0SubmitResult, A0WithdrawChangePayload} from '../relayerClient';

const REC = JSON.parse(
  readFileSync(join(__dirname, '../../../sslPinning/__tests__/fixtures/rn-ssl-pinning-callbacks.json'), 'utf8'),
) as {callbacks: Record<string, {args: unknown[]}>};
const cb = (name: string) => REC.callbacks[name]!.args;
/** A native callback with this status and JSON body (the recorded map shape). */
const reply = (status: number, body: unknown) =>
  status >= 200 && status < 300
    ? [null, {status, bodyString: JSON.stringify(body), headers: {}}]
    : [{status, bodyString: JSON.stringify(body), headers: {}}, null];

const GOLDEN = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(__dirname, 'fixtures/relayer-a0-golden-vectors.json'), 'utf8')) as {
  relayerLandedP1P2: {vectors: {withdraw_change: {landedSignature: string; payload: A0WithdrawChangePayload}}};
};
const SIG = GOLDEN.relayerLandedP1P2.vectors.withdraw_change.landedSignature;
const PAYLOAD = GOLDEN.relayerLandedP1P2.vectors.withdraw_change.payload;

/** The live quote (ICO state file "P1 + P2 LIVE"; maxFee 100,000 from the pool). */
const QUOTE = {
  programId: 'FeGSSsJtmA7GnMgnpj33JsiceSk1NyFopff2FtQFsMuH',
  pool: '8VMe4iZWiq3xQySywih9cciAmzTxMtkawMRYK6JuDdoT',
  mint: 'ERkpCFGaoWmeZPhKTUHumrqHTP1QmyHVhMJUnxbRPKCs',
  feePayer: '3jvhiz9qcJAe2zGHvRAiRYXiaFCdjEQrB9KuE5NuFaGe',
  maxFee: '100000',
  minFee: {transfer: '10000', withdraw_change: '10000'},
  gasGrantLamports: '3000000',
  validForSeconds: 60,
};
/** devnet getMinimumBalanceForRentExemption(0), measured 2026-11-17 18:48 UTC → floor 655,240. */
const RENT = 650_240n;
const ctx: A0QuoteContext = {fetchedAtMs: 1_000, rentExemptZeroLamports: RENT};
const GOBAM = 'GoBAmZzHvD6F4KHLNmBFh2wZAGE1dwwufeTbifSHEYfd'; // a valid key, not the relayer

const parse = (body: unknown, c = ctx) => () => parseA0RelayerQuote(body, c);
const without = (k: string) => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(QUOTE).filter(([key]) => key !== k));

beforeEach(() => resetNative());

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ the quote

describe('the quote (§6.4)', () => {
  it('the live quote: fee = exactly minFee.withdraw_change (R5), the grant held to rent(0) + 5,000, the fetch time kept', () => {
    expect(parseA0RelayerQuote(QUOTE, ctx)).toEqual({
      programId: QUOTE.programId,
      pool: QUOTE.pool,
      mint: QUOTE.mint,
      feePayer: QUOTE.feePayer,
      maxFee: 100_000n,
      minFee: {transfer: 10_000n, withdrawChange: 10_000n},
      gasGrantLamports: 3_000_000n,
      validForSeconds: 60,
      fee: 10_000n,
      grantFloorLamports: 655_240n,
      fetchedAtMs: 1_000,
    });
  });
  it('the fee is minFee.withdraw_change, never minFee.transfer', () => {
    const q = parseA0RelayerQuote({...QUOTE, minFee: {transfer: '20000', withdraw_change: '10000'}}, ctx);
    expect(q.fee).toBe(10_000n);
    expect(q.minFee).toEqual({transfer: 20_000n, withdrawChange: 10_000n});
  });
  it('no gasGrantLamports: a quote without a grant (the fresh option disabled, S11), no rent needed', () => {
    const q = parseA0RelayerQuote(without('gasGrantLamports'), {fetchedAtMs: 0, rentExemptZeroLamports: null});
    expect(q.gasGrantLamports).toBeNull();
    expect(q.grantFloorLamports).toBeNull();
  });
  it.each([
    ['programId', {...QUOTE, programId: 'Stake11111111111111111111111111111111111111'}],
    ['pool', {...QUOTE, pool: QUOTE.mint}],
    ['mint', {...QUOTE, mint: QUOTE.pool}],
  ])('a foreign %s → E_A0_QUOTE_FOREIGN', (_k, body) => {
    expect(parse(body)).toThrow(expect.objectContaining({code: 'E_A0_QUOTE_FOREIGN'}));
  });
  it('a fee payer that is a valid key but not the pinned relayer → E_A0_QUOTE_FEE_PAYER (ruling 9)', () => {
    expect(parse({...QUOTE, feePayer: GOBAM})).toThrow(expect.objectContaining({code: 'E_A0_QUOTE_FEE_PAYER'}));
  });
  it('minFee.withdraw_change above maxFee → E_A0_QUOTE_FEE_ABOVE_MAX with a clear message; equal passes', () => {
    expect(parse({...QUOTE, maxFee: '9999'})).toThrow(
      expect.objectContaining({code: 'E_A0_QUOTE_FEE_ABOVE_MAX', message: expect.stringContaining('above the pool')}),
    );
    expect(parseA0RelayerQuote({...QUOTE, maxFee: '10000'}, ctx).fee).toBe(10_000n);
  });
  it('the grant’s bounds: floor − 1 refused, floor and ceiling pass, ceiling + 1 refused (E_A0_QUOTE_GRANT)', () => {
    const g = (v: string) => parse({...QUOTE, gasGrantLamports: v});
    expect(g('655239')).toThrow(expect.objectContaining({code: 'E_A0_QUOTE_GRANT'}));
    expect(g('655240')).not.toThrow();
    expect(g('50000000')).not.toThrow();
    expect(g('50000001')).toThrow(expect.objectContaining({code: 'E_A0_QUOTE_GRANT'}));
    // the floor follows the chain, not a pinned number: at the contract's old rent (890,880) 895,879 refuses
    expect(parse({...QUOTE, gasGrantLamports: '895879'}, {fetchedAtMs: 0, rentExemptZeroLamports: 890_880n})).toThrow(
      expect.objectContaining({code: 'E_A0_QUOTE_GRANT'}),
    );
  });
  it('a grant without the cluster rent → E_A0_QUOTE_RENT (never checked against nothing)', () => {
    expect(parse(QUOTE, {fetchedAtMs: 0, rentExemptZeroLamports: null})).toThrow(
      expect.objectContaining({code: 'E_A0_QUOTE_RENT'}),
    );
  });
  it.each([
    ['maxFee with a leading zero', {...QUOTE, maxFee: '0100000'}],
    ['maxFee negative', {...QUOTE, maxFee: '-1'}],
    ['maxFee as a number', {...QUOTE, maxFee: 100000}],
    ['maxFee in exponent form', {...QUOTE, maxFee: '1e5'}],
    ['maxFee = 2^64', {...QUOTE, maxFee: '18446744073709551616'}],
    ['minFee.withdraw_change with a plus sign', {...QUOTE, minFee: {transfer: '10000', withdraw_change: '+10000'}}],
    ['minFee without withdraw_change', {...QUOTE, minFee: {transfer: '10000'}}],
    ['minFee with an extra kind', {...QUOTE, minFee: {...QUOTE.minFee, deposit: '1'}}],
    ['gasGrantLamports as a number', {...QUOTE, gasGrantLamports: 3000000}],
    ['validForSeconds 0', {...QUOTE, validForSeconds: 0}],
    ['validForSeconds 61', {...QUOTE, validForSeconds: 61}],
    ['validForSeconds 1.5', {...QUOTE, validForSeconds: 1.5}],
    ['validForSeconds as a string', {...QUOTE, validForSeconds: '60'}],
    ['a key the contract does not list', {...QUOTE, grantOnlyIf: 'x'}],
    ['an array', [QUOTE]],
    ['null', null],
  ])('%s → E_A0_QUOTE_INVALID', (_w, body) => {
    expect(parse(body)).toThrow(expect.objectContaining({code: 'E_A0_QUOTE_INVALID'}));
  });
  it('2^64 − 1 is a u64 (the bound is inclusive)', () => {
    expect(parseA0RelayerQuote({...QUOTE, maxFee: '18446744073709551615'}, ctx).maxFee).toBe(18446744073709551615n);
  });
});

describe('fetchA0RelayerQuote: over the pinned transport, rent read only for a grant', () => {
  const rentRpc = (value: unknown = 650240) => {
    const calls: unknown[][] = [];
    const rpc = {
      getMinimumBalanceForRentExemption: (...a: unknown[]) => {
        calls.push(a);
        return value instanceof Error ? Promise.reject(value) : Promise.resolve(value);
      },
    } as unknown as A0RentRpc;
    return {rpc, calls};
  };
  it('GET …/relayer/quote; one rent(0) request; fetchedAtMs = when the answer arrived', async () => {
    setNativeCallback(reply(200, QUOTE));
    const {rpc, calls} = rentRpc();
    // the clock reads how many requests had gone out when it was asked: 1 = after the answer
    const q = await fetchA0RelayerQuote(rpc, {now: () => nativeCalls().length * 1000 + calls.length});
    expect(nativeCalls().map(c => c.url)).toEqual([`${API_BASE}/relayer/quote`]);
    expect(calls).toEqual([[0]]);
    expect(q.fetchedAtMs).toBe(1000); // after the quote's answer, before the rent request
    expect(q.grantFloorLamports).toBe(655_240n);
  });
  it('a quote without a grant makes no RPC request', async () => {
    setNativeCallback(reply(200, without('gasGrantLamports')));
    const {rpc, calls} = rentRpc();
    expect((await fetchA0RelayerQuote(rpc)).gasGrantLamports).toBeNull();
    expect(calls).toEqual([]);
  });
  it.each([
    ['a 503 with its outcome', reply(503, {success: false, outcome: 'transfer_disabled'}), /503 \(transfer_disabled\)/],
    ['the plain-text 429 (body null)', cb('nonSuccess429Text'), /429 \(no outcome\)/],
    ['a transport failure', cb('transportFailure'), /not reached/],
    ['a pin failure', cb('pinFailure'), /not reached/],
  ])('%s → E_A0_QUOTE_UNAVAILABLE (no fallback, R6)', async (_w, args, msg) => {
    setNativeCallback(args);
    const {rpc, calls} = rentRpc();
    await expect(fetchA0RelayerQuote(rpc)).rejects.toMatchObject({code: 'E_A0_QUOTE_UNAVAILABLE', message: expect.stringMatching(msg)});
    expect(calls).toEqual([]);
  });
  it.each([
    ['the request fails', new Error('429 Too Many Requests')],
    ['it answers zero', 0],
    ['it answers a string', '650240'],
    ['it answers a fraction', 650240.5],
  ])('rent(0): %s → E_A0_QUOTE_RENT', async (_w, value) => {
    setNativeCallback(reply(200, QUOTE));
    await expect(fetchA0RelayerQuote(rentRpc(value).rpc)).rejects.toMatchObject({code: 'E_A0_QUOTE_RENT'});
  });
  it('a refused API base throws E_A0_RELAYER_URL (a build error, not "unavailable")', async () => {
    await expect(fetchA0RelayerQuote(rentRpc().rpc, {transport: {base: 'https://api.noc-tura.io/api'}})).rejects.toMatchObject({
      code: 'E_A0_RELAYER_URL',
    });
  });
});

describe('the re-quote rule (§6.7)', () => {
  const q = parseA0RelayerQuote(QUOTE, ctx); // fetched at 1,000 ms, valid 60 s
  it('expired from validForSeconds on (≥ 60,000 ms), not one ms before', () => {
    expect(a0QuoteExpired(q, 1_000 + 59_999)).toBe(false);
    expect(a0QuoteExpired(q, 1_000 + 60_000)).toBe(true);
  });
  it('the terms the user approved: fee, fee payer, grant (or its absence) — each change counts', () => {
    const same = parseA0RelayerQuote({...QUOTE, maxFee: '90000'}, {...ctx, fetchedAtMs: 99_999});
    expect(a0QuoteTermsUnchanged(q, same)).toBe(true);
    const variants: A0RelayerQuote[] = [
      {...q, fee: 10_001n},
      {...q, feePayer: GOBAM},
      {...q, gasGrantLamports: 3_000_001n},
      {...q, gasGrantLamports: null},
    ];
    for (const v of variants) {
      expect(a0QuoteTermsUnchanged(q, v)).toBe(false);
    }
  });
});

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ the outcomes

/** Contract §1, written out: outcome → HTTP status, and whether txSignature is present. */
const CONTRACT: Array<[string, number, 'always' | 'optional' | 'never']> = [
  ['confirmed', 200, 'always'],
  ['already_spent', 409, 'optional'],
  ['unconfirmed', 502, 'always'],
  ['relay_failed', 502, 'optional'],
  ['invalid_request', 400, 'never'],
  ['duplicate_in_flight', 429, 'never'],
  ['budget_exceeded', 429, 'never'],
  ['balance_too_low', 503, 'never'],
  ['unavailable', 503, 'never'],
  ['transfer_disabled', 503, 'never'],
  ['relayer_disabled', 503, 'never'],
  ['misconfigured', 500, 'never'],
];
const STATUSES = [200, 400, 409, 429, 500, 502, 503];

describe('the twelve outcomes (contract §1)', () => {
  it('the module’s table is the contract’s, in the order of Task 1’s list', () => {
    expect(Object.keys(A0_RELAYER_OUTCOME_TABLE)).toEqual([...A0_RELAYER_OUTCOMES]);
    expect(Object.entries(A0_RELAYER_OUTCOME_TABLE).map(([o, r]) => [o, r.status, r.signature])).toEqual(CONTRACT);
  });

  describe.each(CONTRACT)('%s (%i, signature %s)', (outcome, status, signature) => {
    const body = (withSig: boolean) => ({success: status === 200, outcome, ...(withSig ? {txSignature: SIG} : {})});
    const allowed = signature === 'never' ? [false] : signature === 'always' ? [true] : [false, true];

    it.each(allowed)('read at its own status (txSignature present: %s)', withSig => {
      const r = interpretA0SubmitAnswer({status, body: body(withSig)});
      expect(r.outcome).toBe(outcome);
      expect(r.txSignature).toBe(withSig ? SIG : null);
      expect(r.forwarded).toBe(withSig);
      expect(r.status).toBe(status);
    });

    it.each(STATUSES.filter(s => s !== status))('at %i it is not believed (outcome and status disagree)', other => {
      for (const withSig of [false, true]) {
        const r = interpretA0SubmitAnswer({status: other, body: body(withSig)});
        if (withSig) {
          expect(r).toEqual({outcome: 'unknown', status: other, forwarded: 'unknown', txSignature: SIG, cause: 'unreadable'});
        } else {
          expect(r).toEqual({outcome: 'relay_failed', status: other, forwarded: false, txSignature: null, recognised: false});
        }
      }
    });

    if (signature === 'always') {
      it('without its txSignature it is not believed → relay_failed, nothing forwarded', () => {
        expect(interpretA0SubmitAnswer({status, body: body(false)})).toEqual({
          outcome: 'relay_failed',
          status,
          forwarded: false,
          txSignature: null,
          recognised: false,
        });
      });
    }
    if (signature === 'never') {
      it('WITH a txSignature it claims a forward → unknown (reconcile), never "not forwarded"', () => {
        const r = interpretA0SubmitAnswer({status, body: body(true)});
        expect(r).toEqual({outcome: 'unknown', status, forwarded: 'unknown', txSignature: SIG, cause: 'unreadable'});
        expect(a0SubmitDisposition(r)).toBe('reconcile');
      });
    }
  });

  it('dispositions (§6.8): confirmed → verify; unconfirmed / already_spent / a forwarded relay_failed → reconcile; the rest → not-forwarded', () => {
    const d = (status: number, b: Record<string, unknown>) => a0SubmitDisposition(interpretA0SubmitAnswer({status, body: b}));
    expect(d(200, {outcome: 'confirmed', txSignature: SIG})).toBe('verify');
    expect(d(502, {outcome: 'unconfirmed', txSignature: SIG})).toBe('reconcile');
    expect(d(409, {outcome: 'already_spent', txSignature: SIG})).toBe('reconcile');
    expect(d(409, {outcome: 'already_spent'})).toBe('reconcile');
    expect(d(502, {outcome: 'relay_failed', txSignature: SIG})).toBe('reconcile');
    expect(d(502, {outcome: 'relay_failed'})).toBe('not-forwarded');
    for (const [o, s, sig] of CONTRACT) {
      if (sig === 'never') {
        expect(d(s, {outcome: o})).toBe('not-forwarded');
      }
    }
  });

  it('already_spent: alreadySpentIndexes [0] when known; absent, [], [1], "0" → null (undetermined, never "none")', () => {
    const idx = (v: unknown) =>
      (interpretA0SubmitAnswer({status: 409, body: {outcome: 'already_spent', alreadySpentIndexes: v}}) as Extract<
        A0SubmitResult,
        {outcome: 'already_spent'}
      >).alreadySpentIndexes;
    expect(idx([0])).toEqual([0]);
    expect(idx(undefined)).toBeNull();
    expect(idx([])).toBeNull();
    expect(idx([1])).toBeNull();
    expect(idx('0')).toBeNull();
  });

  it.each([
    ['body null (not JSON)', null],
    ['an array', [{outcome: 'confirmed', txSignature: SIG}]],
    ['an unknown outcome', {outcome: 'accepted'}],
    ['an outcome that is not a string', {outcome: 200}],
    ['no outcome', {success: true}],
  ])('unreadable without a signature (%s) → relay_failed, nothing forwarded (contract: "anything unrecognised")', (_w, body) => {
    for (const status of STATUSES) {
      expect(interpretA0SubmitAnswer({status, body})).toEqual({
        outcome: 'relay_failed',
        status,
        forwarded: false,
        txSignature: null,
        recognised: false,
      });
    }
  });

  it('a malformed txSignature claims a forward all the same → unknown, its value dropped', () => {
    for (const bad of [GOBAM, 'z'.repeat(88), SIG.replace(/.$/, '0'), null, 7]) {
      // a 32-byte key, 65 bytes, a character outside the alphabet, not a string
      expect(interpretA0SubmitAnswer({status: 200, body: {outcome: 'confirmed', txSignature: bad}})).toEqual({
        outcome: 'unknown',
        status: 200,
        forwarded: 'unknown',
        txSignature: null,
        cause: 'unreadable',
      });
    }
  });

  it('isA0TxSignature: base58 of exactly 64 bytes', () => {
    expect(isA0TxSignature(SIG)).toBe(true);
    expect(isA0TxSignature('1'.repeat(64))).toBe(true); // 64 zero bytes
    expect(isA0TxSignature('1'.repeat(63))).toBe(false);
    expect(isA0TxSignature(GOBAM)).toBe(false); // 32 bytes
    expect(isA0TxSignature(SIG.replace(/^./, 'l'))).toBe(false); // not in the alphabet
    expect(isA0TxSignature('z'.repeat(88))).toBe(false); // 65 bytes
  });
});

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ the submit, end to end

describe('submitA0WithdrawChange over the real ssl-pinning wrapper', () => {
  it('POST …/relayer/submit with JSON.stringify(payload), as is; a 200 confirmed is read', async () => {
    setNativeCallback(reply(200, {success: true, outcome: 'confirmed', txSignature: SIG}));
    const r = await submitA0WithdrawChange(PAYLOAD);
    const [call] = nativeCalls();
    expect(call!.url).toBe(`${API_BASE}/relayer/submit`);
    expect(call!.options).toMatchObject({method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(PAYLOAD), pkPinning: true});
    expect(r).toEqual({outcome: 'confirmed', status: 200, forwarded: true, txSignature: SIG});
  });
  it('every outcome at its status arrives through pinnedFetch as an answer, never a throw', async () => {
    for (const [outcome, status, sig] of CONTRACT) {
      resetNative();
      setNativeCallback(reply(status, {outcome, ...(sig === 'always' ? {txSignature: SIG} : {})}));
      const r = await submitA0WithdrawChange(PAYLOAD);
      expect([r.outcome, r.status]).toEqual([outcome, status]);
    }
  });
  it('the recorded 400 invalid_request: not forwarded', async () => {
    setNativeCallback(cb('nonSuccess400'));
    const r = await submitA0WithdrawChange(PAYLOAD);
    expect(r).toEqual({outcome: 'invalid_request', status: 400, forwarded: false, txSignature: null});
    expect(a0SubmitDisposition(r)).toBe('not-forwarded');
  });
  it('the recorded plain-text 429 (body null): relay_failed with no signature — never duplicate_in_flight / budget_exceeded by status alone', async () => {
    setNativeCallback(cb('nonSuccess429Text'));
    const r = await submitA0WithdrawChange(PAYLOAD);
    expect(r).toEqual({outcome: 'relay_failed', status: 429, forwarded: false, txSignature: null, recognised: false});
    expect(a0SubmitDisposition(r)).toBe('not-forwarded');
  });
  it.each([
    ['a transport failure', 'transportFailure'],
    ['a pin failure (E004)', 'pinFailure'],
  ])('%s on submit: unknown (the tx may have landed), reconcile — never "not forwarded"', async (_w, name) => {
    setNativeCallback(cb(name));
    const r = await submitA0WithdrawChange(PAYLOAD);
    expect(r).toEqual({outcome: 'unknown', status: null, forwarded: 'unknown', txSignature: null, cause: 'transport'});
    expect(a0SubmitDisposition(r)).toBe('reconcile');
  });
  it('the request that never settles (the recorded null-message failure) hits the deadline: unknown, reconcile', async () => {
    setNativeCallback(cb('failureNullMessage'));
    const r = await submitA0WithdrawChange(PAYLOAD, {deadlineMs: 50});
    expect(r).toEqual({outcome: 'unknown', status: null, forwarded: 'unknown', txSignature: null, cause: 'deadline'});
    expect(a0SubmitDisposition(r)).toBe('reconcile');
  });
  it('a refused API base throws E_A0_RELAYER_URL, nothing sent', async () => {
    setNativeResponder(() => {
      throw new Error('must not be called');
    });
    await expect(submitA0WithdrawChange(PAYLOAD, {base: 'https://api.noc-tura.io/api/v1/v1'})).rejects.toMatchObject({
      code: 'E_A0_RELAYER_URL',
    });
    expect(nativeCalls()).toHaveLength(0);
  });
});
```

Create `src/modules/shielded/a0/__tests__/relayerClient.golden.test.ts`:

/**
 * The relayer client's bytes against what LANDED (spec §14 JS: "instruction data and account metas
 * byte for byte against relayer-a0-golden-vectors.json (M1c)"; the brief's Task 3 row; R1′).
 *
 * Sources, none of them the code under test:
 *   - fixtures/relayer-a0-golden-vectors.json — the program side's golden vectors, a byte copy of
 *     their docs/zk-contract/relayer-a0-golden-vectors.json, unchanged since 5fa2379 (sha256 pinned
 *     below; `relayerLandedP1P2`: the payload the relayer took, `expectedIxDataHex` and
 *     `accountMetas` of the FeGSS… instruction it landed, the grant's `dataHex`);
 *   - fixtures/landed-withdraw-{5F8Ks5qa,5sKiWZTv}.json — two relayed withdraw_with_change that
 *     landed AFTER the 2026-11-17 upgrade (slot 523346473), recorded once by
 *     scripts/a0-fixtures/fetch-devnet-tx.mjs; each signature is verified over its message here;
 *   - the program side's public inputs (golden `publicInputs`), the IDL's discriminator and the
 *     facts of the ICO state file, as literals.
 * Every PDA / ATA expected value is derived here with the REAL @solana/web3.js.
 */

);
import {PublicKey, VersionedTransaction} from '@solana/web3.js';

import {A0, A0_RELAYER} from '../constants';
import {

import type {A0RelayerQuote, A0UnshieldTerms, A0WithdrawChangePayload} from '../relayerClient';
import type {A0Proof} from '../../../zkProver/nativeProverBridge';

const fx = (name: string) => readFileSync(join(__dirname, 'fixtures', name));

interface GoldenMeta {

interface GoldenWithdraw {

  gasGrant?: {from: string; to: string; lamports: string; dataHex: string};
  payload: A0WithdrawChangePayload;
  expectedIxDataHex: string;
  accountMetas: GoldenMeta[];
}
const GOLDEN_RAW = fx('relayer-a0-golden-vectors.json');
const GOLDEN = JSON.parse(GOLDEN_RAW.toString('utf8')) as {
  relayerLanded: {feePayer: string; vectors: {withdraw_change: GoldenWithdraw}};
  relayerLandedP1P2: {
    feePayer: string;
    gasGrantLamports: string;
    vectors: {withdraw_change: GoldenWithdraw; withdraw_change_existing: GoldenWithdraw};
  };
};
const P1P2 = GOLDEN.relayerLandedP1P2;

/** The live quote (ICO state file "P1 + P2 LIVE": minFee 10000/10000, grant 3000000, 60 s; maxFee 100,000 read from the pool). */
const QUOTE_BODY = {
  programId: 'FeGSSsJtmA7GnMgnpj33JsiceSk1NyFopff2FtQFsMuH',
  pool: '8VMe4iZWiq3xQySywih9cciAmzTxMtkawMRYK6JuDdoT',
  mint: 'ERkpCFGaoWmeZPhKTUHumrqHTP1QmyHVhMJUnxbRPKCs',
  feePayer: '3jvhiz9qcJAe2zGHvRAiRYXiaFCdjEQrB9KuE5NuFaGe',
  maxFee: '100000',
  minFee: {transfer: '10000', withdraw_change: '10000'},
  gasGrantLamports: '3000000',
  validForSeconds: 60,
};
/** devnet getMinimumBalanceForRentExemption(0), measured 2026-11-17 18:48 UTC. */
const RENT_ZERO = 650_240n;
const quote: A0RelayerQuote = parseA0RelayerQuote(QUOTE_BODY, {fetchedAtMs: 0, rentExemptZeroLamports: RENT_ZERO});

/** withdraw_change's mintHash = be_mod_r(ERkp…) — the program side's public input [4] in every vector. */
const MINT_HASH = 2682398932710728289451863586583737043718296808864885766580558010318135811236n;
const R = 21888242871839275222246405745257275088548364400416034343698204186575808495617n;
const hex64 = (d: string): string => BigInt(d).toString(16).padStart(64, '0');
const beModR = (b: Uint8Array): bigint => BigInt(`0x${Buffer.from(b).toString('hex')}`) % R;

/** The golden payload as Rust would hand it to JS: A0Proof (hex public inputs) + the unshield's terms. */
function asProof(p: A0WithdrawChangePayload): A0Proof {
  return {proofBytes: p.proofBytes, publicInputs: p.publicInputs.map(hex64)};
}
function termsOf(p: A0WithdrawChangePayload): A0UnshieldTerms {
  return {
    owner: p.destinationOwner,
    ata: p.destination,
    amount: BigInt(p.withdrawAmount),
    fee: BigInt(p.fee),
    merkleRoot: BigInt(p.publicInputs[0]!),
  };
}
const metasOf = (ix: ReturnType<typeof buildA0WithdrawChangeIx>): GoldenMeta[] =>
  ix.keys.map(k => ({pubkey: k.pubkey.toBase58(), isSigner: k.isSigner, isWritable: k.isWritable}));

describe('the fixtures', () => {
  it('the golden vectors are the program side’s relayer-a0-golden-vectors.json at 5fa2379 (unchanged at 2146368)', () => {
    expect(createHash('sha256').update(GOLDEN_RAW).digest('hex')).toBe(
      '5378f57643e9b5c545d7b2110d16233e7e1bb47d9492c176e5a94ceb27d97966',
    );
    expect(P1P2.feePayer).toBe('3jvhiz9qcJAe2zGHvRAiRYXiaFCdjEQrB9KuE5NuFaGe');
    expect(P1P2.gasGrantLamports).toBe('3000000');
  });
});

describe('A0_RELAYER: the pinned fee payer, and the two values derived from it here', () => {
  it('feePayer is the relayer key the golden vectors landed with', () => {
    expect(A0_RELAYER.feePayer).toBe(P1P2.feePayer);
    expect(A0_RELAYER.feePayer).toBe(GOLDEN.relayerLanded.feePayer);
  });
  it('feeDestination = ATA(feePayer, mint), derived here, = the landed fee_destination', () => {
    const ata = PublicKey.findProgramAddressSync(
      [

        new PublicKey('TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA').toBuffer(),
        new PublicKey(A0.mint).toBuffer(),
      ],
      new PublicKey('ATokenGPvbdGVxr1b2hvZbsiqW5xWH25efTNsLJA8knL'),
    )[0].toBase58();
    expect(A0_RELAYER.feeDestination).toBe(ata);
    expect(P1P2.vectors.withdraw_change.accountMetas[6]!.pubkey).toBe(ata);
    expect(a0AtaOf(new PublicKey(A0_RELAYER.feePayer)).toBase58()).toBe(ata);
  });
  it('wchangeVk = PDA(["wchange_vk", pool]) under FeGSS…, = the landed wchange_vk', () => {

      new PublicKey(A0.programId),
    )[0].toBase58();

describe.each([
  ['withdraw_change (fresh owner, create-ATA + grant)', 'withdraw_change'],
  ['withdraw_change_existing (existing owner, no grant)', 'withdraw_change_existing'],
] as const)('relayerLandedP1P2 %s', (_label, key) => {
  const g = P1P2.vectors[key];

  it('our payload is the golden payload BYTE FOR BYTE (JSON text, key order included)', () => {
    const ours = buildA0WithdrawChangePayload(asProof(g.payload), termsOf(g.payload), quote);
    expect(JSON.stringify(ours)).toBe(JSON.stringify(g.payload));
    expect(ours.destinationOwner).toBe(g.payload.destinationOwner); // REQUIRED since P2
    expect(ours.cuLimit).toBe(200_000);
  });

  it('each named field is its public input read big-endian; recipientField / mintHash are be_mod_r of the ATA / mint', () => {
    const p = g.payload;
    expect(BigInt(`0x${p.merkleRoot}`).toString()).toBe(p.publicInputs[0]);
    expect(BigInt(`0x${p.nullifier}`).toString()).toBe(p.publicInputs[1]);
    expect(p.withdrawAmount).toBe(p.publicInputs[2]);
    expect(beModR(new PublicKey(p.destination).toBytes()).toString()).toBe(p.publicInputs[3]);
    expect(beModR(new PublicKey(A0.mint).toBytes())).toBe(MINT_HASH);
    expect(p.publicInputs[4]).toBe(MINT_HASH.toString());
    expect(BigInt(`0x${p.changeCommitment}`).toString()).toBe(p.publicInputs[5]);
    expect(p.fee).toBe(p.publicInputs[6]);
  });

  it('the relayed instruction: data and account metas BYTE FOR BYTE the landed ones', () => {
    const ix = buildA0WithdrawChangeIx(g.payload);
    expect(ix.programId.toBase58()).toBe(A0.programId);
    expect(Buffer.from(ix.data).toString('hex')).toBe(g.expectedIxDataHex);
    expect(ix.data).toHaveLength(380);
    expect(metasOf(ix)).toEqual(g.accountMetas);
    // the one signer is the pinned relayer (R6: nothing of the wallet's signs a relayed exit)
    expect(metasOf(ix).filter(m => m.isSigner).map(m => m.pubkey)).toEqual([A0_RELAYER.feePayer]);
  });

  it('the nullifier record is PDA(["nullifier", n]) derived here', () => {
    const pda = PublicKey.findProgramAddressSync(
      [Buffer.from('nullifier'), Buffer.from(g.payload.nullifier, 'hex')],
      new PublicKey(A0.programId),
    )[0].toBase58();
    expect(a0NullifierRecordPda(g.payload.nullifier).toBase58()).toBe(pda);
    expect(g.accountMetas[4]!.pubkey).toBe(pda);
  });
});

describe('relayerLanded (pre-P2, the same relayer key): the instruction is the same encoding', () => {
  it('data and metas byte for byte', () => {
    const g = GOLDEN.relayerLanded.vectors.withdraw_change;
    const ix = buildA0WithdrawChangeIx(g.payload);
    expect(Buffer.from(ix.data).toString('hex')).toBe(g.expectedIxDataHex);
    expect(metasOf(ix)).toEqual(g.accountMetas);
  });
});

describe('the payload is refused before it exists when a public input is not ours (§6.6), each one', () => {
  const g = P1P2.vectors.withdraw_change.payload;
  const proof = asProof(g);
  const terms = termsOf(g);
  const withPi = (i: number, v: bigint): A0Proof => ({
    ...proof,
    publicInputs: proof.publicInputs.map((h, j) => (j === i ? v.toString(16).padStart(64, '0') : h)),
  });
  it('positive control: the golden terms pass', () => {
    expect(() => buildA0WithdrawChangePayload(proof, terms, quote)).not.toThrow();
  });
  it.each([
    ['merkleRoot (another root)', {...terms, merkleRoot: terms.merkleRoot + 1n}],
    ['withdrawAmount (another amount)', {...terms, amount: terms.amount + 1n}],
  ])('%s → E_A0_SUBMIT_PUBLIC_INPUTS', (_w, t) => {
    expect(() => buildA0WithdrawChangePayload(proof, t, quote)).toThrow(
      expect.objectContaining({code: 'E_A0_SUBMIT_PUBLIC_INPUTS'}),
    );
  });
  it.each([
    [3, 'recipientField'],
    [4, 'mintHash'],
    [6, 'fee'],
    [0, 'merkleRoot'],
    [2, 'withdrawAmount'],
  ])('public input %i (%s) altered in the proof → E_A0_SUBMIT_PUBLIC_INPUTS', (i, name) => {
    const v = BigInt(`0x${proof.publicInputs[i]}`) + 1n;
    expect(() => buildA0WithdrawChangePayload(withPi(i, v), terms, quote)).toThrow(
      expect.objectContaining({code: 'E_A0_SUBMIT_PUBLIC_INPUTS', message: expect.stringContaining(name)}),
    );
  });
  it('a fee that is not the quote’s minFee (R5) → E_A0_SUBMIT_ARGS', () => {
    expect(() => buildA0WithdrawChangePayload(withPi(6, 10001n), {...terms, fee: 10001n}, quote)).toThrow(
      expect.objectContaining({code: 'E_A0_SUBMIT_ARGS', message: expect.stringContaining('R5')}),
    );
  });
  it('a token account that is not ATA(owner, mint) → E_A0_SUBMIT_ARGS', () => {
    const other = P1P2.vectors.withdraw_change_existing.payload.destination;
    expect(() => buildA0WithdrawChangePayload(proof, {...terms, ata: other}, quote)).toThrow(
      expect.objectContaining({code: 'E_A0_SUBMIT_ARGS', message: expect.stringContaining('ATA(owner, mint)')}),
    );
  });
  it('an off-curve owner (the pool PDA) with its own ATA → E_A0_SUBMIT_ARGS', () => {
    const pool = new PublicKey(A0.pool);
    expect(PublicKey.isOnCurve(pool.toBytes())).toBe(false);
    expect(() =>
      buildA0WithdrawChangePayload(proof, {...terms, owner: A0.pool, ata: a0AtaOf(pool).toBase58()}, quote),
    ).toThrow(expect.objectContaining({code: 'E_A0_SUBMIT_ARGS', message: expect.stringContaining('curve')}));
  });
  it.each([
    ['6 public inputs', {...proof, publicInputs: proof.publicInputs.slice(0, 6)}],
    ['a public input ≥ r', {...proof, publicInputs: proof.publicInputs.map((h, j) => (j === 1 ? R.toString(16) : h))}],
    ['an uppercase public input', {...proof, publicInputs: proof.publicInputs.map((h, j) => (j === 5 ? h.toUpperCase() : h))}],
    ['a 255-byte proof', {...proof, proofBytes: proof.proofBytes.slice(2)}],
    ['an uppercase proof', {...proof, proofBytes: proof.proofBytes.toUpperCase()}],
  ])('%s → E_A0_SUBMIT_ARGS', (_w, p) => {
    expect(() => buildA0WithdrawChangePayload(p as A0Proof, terms, quote)).toThrow(
      expect.objectContaining({code: 'E_A0_SUBMIT_ARGS'}),
    );
  });
});

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ landed after the upgrade

interface TxFixture {
  genesisHash: string;
  slot: number;
  blockTime: number;
  signature: string;
  result: {meta: {err: unknown}; transaction: [string, string]};
}
const UPGRADE_SLOT = 523346473; // ICO state file, "2026-11-17 — FeGSS upgraded"
const CB = 'ComputeBudget111111111111111111111111111111';
const ATA_PROGRAM = 'ATokenGPvbdGVxr1b2hvZbsiqW5xWH25efTNsLJA8knL';
const SYS = '11111111111111111111111111111111';

describe.each([
  ['5F8Ks5qa', '75c43033cb241d44b9306050af12a07137b7e0b722bb55b5d01c798dae7e56a6', 523346606, [CB, ATA_PROGRAM, SYS, A0.programId], 1011],
  ['5sKiWZTv', '682ac2de718761d84e8324a5bea848ea2080fe886d2455a8619ba90d7478574e', 523346628, [CB, ATA_PROGRAM, A0.programId], 994],
] as const)('landed after the upgrade: %s', (prefix, digest, slot, order, size) => {
  const raw = fx(`landed-withdraw-${prefix}.json`);
  const f = JSON.parse(raw.toString('utf8')) as TxFixture;
  const wire = Buffer.from(f.result.transaction[0], 'base64');
  const tx = VersionedTransaction.deserialize(wire);
  const keys = tx.message.staticAccountKeys.map(k => k.toBase58());
  const ixs = tx.message.compiledInstructions.map(ci => ({
    program: keys[ci.programIdIndex]!,
    data: Buffer.from(ci.data),
    accounts: ci.accountKeyIndexes,
  }));

  it('the fixture: pinned, devnet, landed after the upgrade slot, no error, signed by the relayer alone', () => {
    expect(createHash('sha256').update(raw).digest('hex')).toBe(digest);
    expect(f.genesisHash).toBe(A0.genesisHash);
    expect(f.slot).toBe(slot);
    expect(f.slot).toBeGreaterThan(UPGRADE_SLOT);
    expect(f.result.meta.err).toBeNull();
    expect(wire).toHaveLength(size);
    expect(tx.message.header.numRequiredSignatures).toBe(1);
    expect(keys[0]).toBe(A0_RELAYER.feePayer);
    const msg = tx.message.serialize();
    expect(ed25519.verify(tx.signatures[0]!, msg, new PublicKey(keys[0]!).toBytes())).toBe(true);
    expect(f.signature.startsWith(prefix)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('the program order is the P1/P2 shape', () => {
    expect(ixs.map(i => i.program)).toEqual(order);
  });

  it('our encoder, fed the landed arguments and the create-ATA owner, rebuilds the FeGSS… instruction byte for byte (data, accounts, flags)', () => {
    const w = ixs.find(i => i.program === A0.programId)!;
    const ata = ixs.find(i => i.program === ATA_PROGRAM)!;
    // an independent reader of the landed data: disc | root | nullifier | amount LE | cc | fee LE | u32 256 | proof
    const d = w.data;
    expect(d.subarray(0, 8).toString('hex')).toBe('6cf44379ecf67997');
    expect(d).toHaveLength(380);
    expect(d.readUInt32LE(120)).toBe(256);
    const le = (o: number) => d.readBigUInt64LE(o).toString();
    const payload: A0WithdrawChangePayload = {
      kind: 'withdraw_change',
      pool: A0.pool,
      mint: A0.mint,
      merkleRoot: d.subarray(8, 40).toString('hex'),
      nullifier: d.subarray(40, 72).toString('hex'),
      withdrawAmount: le(72),
      destination: keys[w.accounts[3]!]!,
      destinationOwner: keys[ata.accounts[2]!]!,
      changeCommitment: d.subarray(80, 112).toString('hex'),
      fee: le(112),
      proofBytes: d.subarray(124).toString('hex'),
      publicInputs: [],
      cuLimit: 200_000,
    };
    expect(payload.fee).toBe('10000');
    expect(a0AtaOf(new PublicKey(payload.destinationOwner)).toBase58()).toBe(payload.destination);
    const ours = buildA0WithdrawChangeIx(payload);
    expect(Buffer.from(ours.data).equals(d)).toBe(true);
    const landedMetas = w.accounts.map(i => ({
      pubkey: keys[i]!,
      isSigner: tx.message.isAccountSigner(i),
      isWritable: tx.message.isAccountWritable(i),
    }));
    expect(metasOf(ours)).toEqual(landedMetas);
  });

  it('the grant, when there is one, is the golden grant data (3,000,000 lamports) to the create-ATA owner', () => {
    const grants = ixs.filter(i => i.program === SYS);
    if (prefix === '5sKiWZTv') {
      expect(grants).toHaveLength(0);
      return;
    }
    expect(grants).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(grants[0]!.data.toString('hex')).toBe(P1P2.vectors.withdraw_change.gasGrant!.dataHex);
    const ata = ixs.find(i => i.program === ATA_PROGRAM)!;
    expect(grants[0]!.accounts.map(i => keys[i])).toEqual([A0_RELAYER.feePayer, keys[ata.accounts[2]!]]);
  });
});

/**
 * The A0 program's errors (programErrors.ts; the controller's update R1′, 2026-11-17): the table's
 * codes and names are held to the IDL of the deployed binary — `fixtures/shielded-pool-a0-idl.json`,
 * the program side's byte copy at f3f8eff (its digest is pinned in depositIx.golden.test.ts) —
 * and a code is attributed to FeGSS… only when the runtime says FeGSS… raised it.
 */
import {readFileSync} from 'fs';
import {join} from 'path';
import {A0_PROGRAM_ERRORS, a0ProgramError, a0ProgramErrorOf, a0ProgramErrorText} from '../programErrors';

const IDL = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(__dirname, 'fixtures/shielded-pool-a0-idl.json'), 'utf8')) as {
  errors: Array<{code: number; name: string; msg: string}>;
};
const FEGSS = 'FeGSSsJtmA7GnMgnpj33JsiceSk1NyFopff2FtQFsMuH';
const TOKEN = 'TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA';

describe('the table is the IDL’s, code by code and name by name', () => {
  it('thirteen errors, 6000…6012, in the IDL’s order', () => {
    expect(A0_PROGRAM_ERRORS.map(e => [e.code, e.name])).toEqual(IDL.errors.map(e => [e.code, e.name]));
    expect(A0_PROGRAM_ERRORS.map(e => e.code)).toEqual([...Array(13).keys()].map(i => 6000 + i));
  });
  it('the two the upgrade appended: 6011 CpiNotAllowed, 6012 UnexpectedAccounts — each with the wallet’s message', () => {
    expect(IDL.errors.slice(-2).map(e => [e.code, e.name])).toEqual([
      [6011, 'CpiNotAllowed'],
      [6012, 'UnexpectedAccounts'],
    ]);
    expect(a0ProgramError(6011)?.message).toMatch(/top level.*built it wrong; nothing was spent/);
    expect(a0ProgramError(6012)?.message).toMatch(/more accounts.*built it wrong; nothing was spent/);
  });
  it('every message is the wallet’s own sentence (non-empty, not the IDL’s text)', () => {
    for (const e of A0_PROGRAM_ERRORS) {
      expect(e.message.length).toBeGreaterThan(10);
      expect(e.message).not.toBe(IDL.errors.find(i => i.code === e.code)!.msg);
    }
  });
  it('a number the binary does not raise is not mapped', () => {
    expect(a0ProgramError(6013)).toBeNull();
    expect(a0ProgramError(1)).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('a0ProgramErrorOf: attribution', () => {
  it('a log line naming FeGSS… (a SendTransactionError’s logs)', () => {
    const e = Object.assign(new Error('Simulation failed.'), {
      transactionLogs: [`Program ${FEGSS} invoke [1]`, `Program ${FEGSS} failed: custom program error: 0x177b`],
    });
    expect(a0ProgramErrorOf(e)?.name).toBe('CpiNotAllowed');
    expect(a0ProgramErrorOf({logs: [`Program ${FEGSS} failed: custom program error: 0x177c`]})?.name).toBe('UnexpectedAccounts');
  });
  it('the same number from another program is not ours', () => {
    expect(a0ProgramErrorOf({logs: [`Program ${TOKEN} failed: custom program error: 0x177b`]})).toBeNull();
  });
  it('the runtime’s message, only at the FeGSS… instruction’s index', () => {
    const e = new Error(
      'Simulation failed. \nMessage: Transaction simulation failed: Error processing Instruction 1: custom program error: 0x177c. \n',
    );
    expect(a0ProgramErrorOf(e, 1)?.code).toBe(6012);
    expect(a0ProgramErrorOf(e, 0)).toBeNull();
    expect(a0ProgramErrorOf(e)).toBeNull();
  });
  it('a TransactionError object {InstructionError: [i, {Custom: n}]}', () => {
    expect(a0ProgramErrorOf({InstructionError: [1, {Custom: 6011}]}, 1)?.name).toBe('CpiNotAllowed');
    expect(a0ProgramErrorOf({InstructionError: [0, {Custom: 6011}]}, 1)).toBeNull();
    expect(a0ProgramErrorOf({InstructionError: [1, 'InvalidAccountData']}, 1)).toBeNull();
  });
  it('anything else → null', () => {
    for (const e of [null, undefined, 'custom program error: 0x177b', 6011, new Error('blockhash not found')]) {
      expect(a0ProgramErrorOf(e, 1)).toBeNull();
    }
  });
  it('the text a screen shows', () => {
    expect(a0ProgramErrorText(a0ProgramError(6011)!)).toBe(`6011 CpiNotAllowed: ${a0ProgramError(6011)!.message}`);
  });
});
