Create `src/modules/shielded/__tests__/noSelfRelay.test.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * R6 — "No fallback to self-relay. With the relayer unavailable, an unshield fails; it never signs
 * with the user's key" — as a source guard (M1c Task 3). Read three ways, each with a positive
 * control on the same check:
 *  1. no shielded module or screen sends or signs a transaction, except the deposit
 *     (`a0/depositFlow.ts`: a shield is the user's own transaction by design, §5);
 *  2. the `withdraw_with_change` discriminator is named only where it is decoded (`syncedTx.ts`),
 *     defined (`constants.ts`) and encoded for comparison (`relayerClient.ts`) — no other module
 *     can build the instruction;
 *  3. `relayerClient.ts`, the one encoder, has no way to make, sign or send a transaction: no key,
 *     no transaction type, no send call (comments excluded — they may name what is absent).
 * Stated limit: these read this repository's sources, nothing injected at run time (§2).
 */
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../../..');
const SKIP = new Set(['__tests__', '__testing__', '__mocks__', 'node_modules']);

function walk(rel: string, out: string[]): string[] {
  const abs = path.join(ROOT, rel);
  if (!fs.existsSync(abs)) {
    return out;
  }
  for (const name of fs.readdirSync(abs)) {
    const r = path.join(rel, name);
    if (fs.statSync(path.join(ROOT, r)).isDirectory()) {
      if (!SKIP.has(name)) {
        walk(r, out);
      }
    } else if (/\.(ts|tsx)$/.test(name)) {
      out.push(r);
    }
  }
  return out;
}
const read = (f: string) => fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, f), 'utf8');
/** The text without comments (block and line), so a comment may name what is absent. */
const code = (t: string) => t.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, '').replace(/(^|[^:'"`])\/\/.*$/gm, '$1');

const SEND = /\b(sendRawTransaction|sendTransaction|sendEncodedTransaction|sendAndConfirm\w*|signAndSend\w*|signTransaction|signAllTransactions)\b/;
const WITHDRAW_DISC = /\bwithdrawWithChange\b|6cf44379ecf67997/;
const SIGNING = /\b(Keypair|secretKey|sign|signTransaction|Transaction|VersionedTransaction|TransactionMessage|compileMessage|compileToV0Message|compileToLegacyMessage|sendRawTransaction|sendTransaction|deriveTransparentKeypair|mnemonic|keychain)\b/;

const SHIELDED_TREES = ['src/modules/shielded', 'src/screens/shielded', 'src/modules/zkProver'];
const shieldedFiles = SHIELDED_TREES.flatMap(t => walk(t, []));
const srcFiles = walk('src', []);

const hits = (files: string[], re: RegExp, text: (f: string) => string = read) => files.filter(f => re.test(text(f)));

describe('R6: no self-relay path exists (source guard)', () => {
  it('reads the trees it claims to (non-vacuous)', () => {
    expect(shieldedFiles).toEqual(
      expect.arrayContaining([
        'src/modules/shielded/a0/relayerClient.ts',
        'src/modules/shielded/a0/depositFlow.ts',
        'src/modules/zkProver/nativeProverBridge.ts',
      ]),
    );
    expect(shieldedFiles.some(f => f.startsWith('src/screens/shielded/'))).toBe(true);
    expect(srcFiles.length).toBeGreaterThan(shieldedFiles.length);
  });

  it('1. only the deposit sends or signs among the shielded modules and screens', () => {

  });

    expect(SEND.test('await connection.sendRawTransaction(tx.serialize())')).toBe(true);

  });
  it('2. positive control: another module encoding it is flagged', () => {
    expect(WITHDRAW_DISC.test('hexBytes(A0_IX_DISCRIMINATOR.withdrawWithChange)')).toBe(true);
    expect(WITHDRAW_DISC.test("const d = '6cf44379ecf67997';")).toBe(true);
  });

    const text = code(read('src/modules/shielded/a0/relayerClient.ts'));
    expect(text).toContain('buildA0WithdrawChangeIx'); // non-vacuous: the code is there
    expect(text.match(SIGNING)).toBeNull();
  });
  it('3. positive control: a Keypair, a Transaction or a send in that code is flagged; the same words in a comment are not', () => {
    for (const bad of ['const k = Keypair.generate();', 'new Transaction().add(ix)', 'tx.sign([payer])', 'await c.sendTransaction(t)']) {
      expect(code(bad)).toMatch(SIGNING);
    }
    expect(code('// never a Keypair, never sign\n/* no Transaction */ const x = 1;')).not.toMatch(SIGNING);
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: The program errors and the deposit's `send-failed` detail.**

Create `src/modules/shielded/a0/programErrors.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The A0 pool program's errors, in the wallet's words (M1c; the controller's update R1′ of
 * 2026-11-17: FeGSS… was upgraded to the binary b0054981…, whose IDL 3ac8fda7… appends 6011
 * `CpiNotAllowed` and 6012 `UnexpectedAccounts` to the eleven before).
 *
 * THE BOUNDARY. The codes and names are facts (the IDL of the deployed binary,
 * `__tests__/fixtures/shielded-pool-a0-idl.json`; `programErrors.test.ts` holds this table to it
 * code by code and name by name). The messages are ours: they say what the code means for the
 * person holding the phone, and never claim more than the code does.
 *
 * WHERE A CODE CAN REACH THE WALLET. Only through a transaction the wallet sends itself — the
 * deposit (its preflight simulation, or a confirmation's `err`). An unshield is relayed: the
 * relayer's answer carries an outcome, never a program error (contract §1), so nothing here is
 * read from a relayer body. The deposit is one top-level FeGSS… instruction with exactly the IDL's
 * eight accounts, so 6011 / 6012 from a deposit mean the wallet's own builder is wrong — the
 * messages say so.
 *
 * ATTRIBUTION. A custom error number is only ours if FeGSS… raised it. Two readings, nothing else:
 *   - a log line `Program FeGSS… failed: custom program error: 0x…` (the runtime names the program);
 *   - the instruction index of `Error processing Instruction <i>: custom program error: 0x…` or of
 *     `{InstructionError: [i, {Custom: n}]}`, when the caller says which index is FeGSS…'s.
 * A number from any other program (the token program's 0x1 …) is never mapped.
 */
import {A0} from './constants';

export interface A0ProgramError {
  code: number;
  name: string;
  /** the wallet's sentence for it */
  message: string;
}

/** The deployed binary's errors (IDL 3ac8fda7…), with the wallet's messages. */
export const A0_PROGRAM_ERRORS: readonly A0ProgramError[] = [
  {code: 6000, name: 'BadVkLength', message: 'The pool’s verifying key has the wrong length. Nothing was spent.'},
  {code: 6001, name: 'BadProofLength', message: 'The proof is not the 256 bytes the pool reads. Nothing was spent.'},
  {code: 6002, name: 'InvalidProof', message: 'The pool did not accept the proof. Nothing was spent.'},
  {code: 6003, name: 'Unauthorized', message: 'Only the pool’s authority may do this.'},
  {code: 6004, name: 'AccountMismatch', message: 'An account in the transaction is not the pool’s. Nothing was spent.'},
  {code: 6005, name: 'TreeFull', message: 'The pool’s note tree is full: it takes no new notes.'},
  {code: 6006, name: 'RootNotFound', message: 'The tree root is no longer in the pool’s recent history. Sync and try again.'},
  {code: 6007, name: 'FeeExceedsMax', message: 'The fee is above the pool’s maximum. Nothing was spent.'},
  {code: 6008, name: 'DepositsPaused', message: 'This pool takes no deposits any more. Withdrawals still work.'},
  {code: 6009, name: 'VkChunkOutOfOrder', message: 'The pool’s verifying key is being written out of order.'},
  {code: 6010, name: 'VkIncomplete', message: 'The pool’s verifying key is not complete yet. Nothing was spent.'},
  {
    code: 6011,
    name: 'CpiNotAllowed',
    message:
      'The pool accepts this instruction only at the top level of a transaction. The wallet built it wrong; nothing was spent.',
  },
  {
    code: 6012,
    name: 'UnexpectedAccounts',
    message:
      'The transaction passed the pool more accounts than the instruction takes. The wallet built it wrong; nothing was spent.',
  },
];

const BY_CODE = new Map(A0_PROGRAM_ERRORS.map(e => [e.code, e]));

/** The table's entry for `code`, or null for a number the deployed binary does not raise. */
export function a0ProgramError(code: number): A0ProgramError | null {
  return BY_CODE.get(code) ?? null;
}

function hexCode(h: string): number | null {
  const n = parseInt(h, 16);
  return Number.isSafeInteger(n) ? n : null;
}

const LOG_FAILED = new RegExp(`^Program ${A0.programId} failed: custom program error: 0x([0-9a-fA-F]{1,8})$`);
const MSG_INDEXED = /Error processing Instruction (\d+): custom program error: 0x([0-9a-fA-F]{1,8})\b/;

function logsOf(e: object): unknown[] {
  for (const k of ['transactionLogs', 'logs'] as const) {
    const v = (e as Record<string, unknown>)[k];
    if (Array.isArray(v)) {
      return v;
    }
  }
  return [];
}

/**
 * The FeGSS… error inside `e` — a web3.js `SendTransactionError` (its logs, then its message), a
 * plain `Error` whose message carries the runtime's text, or a `TransactionError` object
 * `{InstructionError: [i, {Custom: n}]}` — or null. `programIxIndex` is the index of the FeGSS…
 * instruction in the transaction (1 in the deposit's `[ComputeBudget, deposit]`); without it only
 * a log line naming FeGSS… attributes a number.
 */
export function a0ProgramErrorOf(e: unknown, programIxIndex?: number): A0ProgramError | null {
  if (e === null || typeof e !== 'object') {
    return null;
  }
  for (const line of logsOf(e)) {
    const m = typeof line === 'string' ? LOG_FAILED.exec(line) : null;
    if (m) {
      const code = hexCode(m[1]!);
      return code === null ? null : a0ProgramError(code);
    }
  }
  if (programIxIndex === undefined) {
    return null;
  }
  const ie = (e as {InstructionError?: unknown}).InstructionError;
  if (Array.isArray(ie) && ie.length === 2 && ie[0] === programIxIndex) {
    const custom = (ie[1] as {Custom?: unknown} | null)?.Custom;
    return typeof custom === 'number' ? a0ProgramError(custom) : null;
  }
  const message = (e as {message?: unknown}).message;
  if (typeof message === 'string') {
    const m = MSG_INDEXED.exec(message);
    if (m && Number(m[1]) === programIxIndex) {
      const code = hexCode(m[2]!);
      return code === null ? null : a0ProgramError(code);
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/** `6011 CpiNotAllowed: <the wallet's message>` — the line a screen shows for a mapped error. */
export function a0ProgramErrorText(p: A0ProgramError): string {
  return `${p.code} ${p.name}: ${p.message}`;
}
```

Create `src/modules/shielded/a0/relayerClient.ts`:

```ts
/* eslint-disable no-bitwise -- byte-level encoding is part of what this file is about */
/**
 * The A0 relayer client (spec 2026-11-08 shielded A0 M1 §1 "Relayer", §6.4 quote, §6.7 submit,
 * §6.8 outcomes, R5, R6; the program side's relayer-a0-contract.md, frozen 2026-11-08 and amended
 * for P1 / P2, live on devnet since their coordinator 37ad673). Built on Task 1's transport
 * (`relayerTransport.ts`, proven on the phone), which hands back `{status, body}` for every HTTP
 * status and throws only for what is not an answer.
 *
 * THE QUOTE (§6.4). `GET /relayer/quote` is refused unless:
 *   - `programId`, `pool`, `mint` equal the pinned A0 constants, and `feePayer` equals the PINNED
 *     relayer key `A0_RELAYER.feePayer` (controller ruling 9 — stricter than §6.4's "a valid key");
 *   - `maxFee`, `minFee.{transfer, withdraw_change}` and `gasGrantLamports` are u64 CANONICAL
 *     decimal strings (no sign, no leading zero, ≤ 2^64 − 1), `validForSeconds` an integer 1..60;
 *   - `minFee.withdraw_change ≤ maxFee` — else the clear `E_A0_QUOTE_FEE_ABOVE_MAX`;
 *   - `gasGrantLamports`, when present, lies in [rent(0) + 5,000, 50,000,000], where rent(0) is
 *     the cluster's `getMinimumBalanceForRentExemption(0)` read at quote time (controller ruling 2:
 *     no floor number is pinned; 650,240 on devnet on 2026-11-17, so 655,240 today). Absent = no
 *     grant: the fresh-account option is disabled (S11), never an error here;
 *   - no key the frozen contract does not list is present.
 * The wallet's fee is EXACTLY `minFee.withdraw_change` (R5) and the time the answer arrived is
 * recorded (§6.4), for the re-quote rule of §6.7 (`a0QuoteExpired`, `a0QuoteTermsUnchanged`).
 *
 * THE SUBMIT (§6.7, contract §2). Kind `withdraw_change`, `destination = ata`, `destinationOwner =
 * owner` (REQUIRED since P2), `publicInputs` as decimal strings in the circuit's order, each named
 * field the big-endian reading of its entry (they are taken FROM the entries, so they agree by
 * construction), `cuLimit` 200,000. Before a payload exists, the five public inputs JS can
 * recompute are compared with its own values (§6.6): merkleRoot, withdrawAmount, recipientField
 * (`be_mod_r` of its OWN ATA derivation), mintHash (`be_mod_r` of the mint), fee (= the quote's).
 *
 * THE OUTCOMES (§6.8, contract §1). The twelve, each with its HTTP status; the outcome is read
 * from the body AND the status, and a disagreement is not believed. `txSignature` present ⟺
 * forwarded. An answer that cannot be read is what the contract says — `relay_failed` with no
 * signature (nothing forwarded) — unless it carries a `txSignature`, which claims a forward: then
 * it is `unknown` and reconciled through the sync, never released at once. A deadline or a
 * transport error on submit is `unknown` too (Task 1: the tx may have landed).
 *
 * NO SELF-RELAY (R6). This module builds no transaction, holds no key and sends nothing but the
 * JSON above; the one instruction it encodes (`buildA0WithdrawChangeIx`, the shape the relayer
 * lands, for the verifier) is signed by the pinned relayer key and by nothing else. With the
 * relayer unavailable an unshield fails. `noSelfRelay.test.ts` reads the sources for it.
 */
import {PublicKey, TransactionInstruction} from '@solana/web3.js';
import type {Connection} from '@solana/web3.js';
import {
  A0,
  A0_CU,
  A0_IX_DISCRIMINATOR,
  A0_NULLIFIER_SEED,
  A0_PROOF_BYTES,
  A0_RELAYER,
  A0_WITHDRAW_CHANGE_ARGS_BYTES,
  ASSOCIATED_TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
  SYSTEM_PROGRAM_ID,
  TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
} from './constants';
import {FIELD_MODULUS, toBe32Hex} from './fieldEquations';
import {A0RelayerDeadlineError, A0RelayerUrlError, relayerGetQuote, relayerPostSubmit} from './relayerTransport';
import type {RelayerHttpResult, RelayerRequestOptions} from './relayerTransport';
import type {A0Proof} from '../../zkProver/nativeProverBridge';

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ errors

export type A0RelayerErrorCode =
  /** the quote endpoint answered no quote (an outcome, a status) or was not reached */
  | 'E_A0_QUOTE_UNAVAILABLE'
  /** the quote's shape is not the contract's */
  | 'E_A0_QUOTE_INVALID'
  /** programId / pool / mint are not the pinned A0 constants */
  | 'E_A0_QUOTE_FOREIGN'
  /** feePayer is not the pinned relayer key */
  | 'E_A0_QUOTE_FEE_PAYER'
  /** minFee.withdraw_change is above maxFee */
  | 'E_A0_QUOTE_FEE_ABOVE_MAX'
  /** gasGrantLamports outside [rent(0) + 5,000, 50,000,000] */
  | 'E_A0_QUOTE_GRANT'
  /** the cluster's rent-exempt minimum could not be read */
  | 'E_A0_QUOTE_RENT'
  /** the unshield's own values (owner, ATA, amount, fee, proof shape) are not usable */
  | 'E_A0_SUBMIT_ARGS'
  /** a public input JS recomputes is not its own value */
  | 'E_A0_SUBMIT_PUBLIC_INPUTS';

export class A0RelayerError extends Error {
  readonly code: A0RelayerErrorCode;
  constructor(code: A0RelayerErrorCode, message: string) {
    super(`${code}: ${message}`);
    this.name = 'A0RelayerError';
    this.code = code;
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ outcomes

/**
 * The contract's twelve outcomes (§1), each with its HTTP status and whether `txSignature` is
 * always, sometimes or never present. In the order of `pinnedControl.ts`'s `A0_RELAYER_OUTCOMES`
 * (a test holds the two lists equal).
 */
export const A0_RELAYER_OUTCOME_TABLE = {
  confirmed: {status: 200, signature: 'always'},
  already_spent: {status: 409, signature: 'optional'},
  unconfirmed: {status: 502, signature: 'always'},
  relay_failed: {status: 502, signature: 'optional'},
  invalid_request: {status: 400, signature: 'never'},
  duplicate_in_flight: {status: 429, signature: 'never'},
  budget_exceeded: {status: 429, signature: 'never'},
  balance_too_low: {status: 503, signature: 'never'},
  unavailable: {status: 503, signature: 'never'},
  transfer_disabled: {status: 503, signature: 'never'},
  relayer_disabled: {status: 503, signature: 'never'},
  misconfigured: {status: 500, signature: 'never'},
} as const;

export type A0RelayerOutcome = keyof typeof A0_RELAYER_OUTCOME_TABLE;
/** The eight outcomes that never carry a signature: nothing was forwarded. */
export type A0RelayerRefusal = Exclude<A0RelayerOutcome, 'confirmed' | 'already_spent' | 'unconfirmed' | 'relay_failed'>;

/** What the submit's answer says, typed. `forwarded` is the load-bearing bit (§6.8). */
export type A0SubmitResult =
  | {outcome: 'confirmed'; status: 200; forwarded: true; txSignature: string}
  | {outcome: 'unconfirmed'; status: 502; forwarded: true; txSignature: string}
  | {
      outcome: 'already_spent';
      status: 409;
      forwarded: boolean;
      txSignature: string | null;
      /** the contract's `alreadySpentIndexes` when known; null = undetermined, never "none" */
      alreadySpentIndexes: readonly number[] | null;
    }
  | {
      outcome: 'relay_failed';
      status: number;
      forwarded: boolean;
      txSignature: string | null;
      /** false: the answer could not be read and is `relay_failed` by the contract's rule */
      recognised: boolean;
    }
  | {outcome: A0RelayerRefusal; status: number; forwarded: false; txSignature: null}
  | {
      outcome: 'unknown';
      status: number | null;
      forwarded: 'unknown';
      txSignature: string | null;
      /** deadline / transport: the request may have been forwarded; unreadable: the answer claims a forward */
      cause: 'deadline' | 'transport' | 'unreadable';
    };

/**
 * What the flow does next (§6.8): `verify` the landed tx (only `confirmed`), `reconcile` through
 * the tree sync (the note `pending`, the fresh reservation kept until the chain-time rule decides),
 * or `not-forwarded` (the note untouched, a `fresh-pending` reservation released).
 */
export type A0SubmitDisposition = 'verify' | 'reconcile' | 'not-forwarded';

export function a0SubmitDisposition(r: A0SubmitResult): A0SubmitDisposition {
  switch (r.outcome) {
    case 'confirmed':
      return 'verify';
    case 'unconfirmed':
    case 'already_spent':
    case 'unknown':
      return 'reconcile';
    case 'relay_failed':
      return r.forwarded ? 'reconcile' : 'not-forwarded';
    default:
      return 'not-forwarded';
  }
}

const B58 = '123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz';

/** A transaction signature: base58 of exactly 64 bytes (leading '1's are zero bytes). */
export function isA0TxSignature(s: unknown): s is string {
  if (typeof s !== 'string' || s.length < 64 || s.length > 88) {
    return false;
  }
  let n = 0n;
  for (const ch of s) {
    const v = B58.indexOf(ch);
    if (v < 0) {
      return false;
    }
    n = n * 58n + BigInt(v);
  }
  let zeros = 0;
  while (zeros < s.length && s[zeros] === '1') {
    zeros++;
  }
  const significant = n === 0n ? 0 : Math.ceil(n.toString(16).length / 2);
  return zeros + significant === 64;
}

function isPlainObject(v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> {
  return v !== null && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v);
}

/**
 * The submit's `{status, body}` read against the contract's table. Pure.
 *   - a readable answer: an object whose `outcome` is one of the twelve, whose status is that
 *     outcome's, and whose `txSignature` is present exactly as the table allows (and well formed);
 *   - anything else is unreadable: `unknown` (reconcile) when it carries a `txSignature` key — it
 *     claims a forward — else `relay_failed`, not forwarded, `recognised: false` (contract §1).
 * Other body keys (`success`, `error`, `alreadySpent`) are not read: the outcome and the status
 * decide.
 */
export function interpretA0SubmitAnswer(http: RelayerHttpResult): A0SubmitResult {
  const body = http.body;
  const unreadable = (): A0SubmitResult =>
    isPlainObject(body) && body.txSignature !== undefined
      ? {
          outcome: 'unknown',
          status: http.status,
          forwarded: 'unknown',
          txSignature: isA0TxSignature(body.txSignature) ? body.txSignature : null,
          cause: 'unreadable',
        }
      : {outcome: 'relay_failed', status: http.status, forwarded: false, txSignature: null, recognised: false};

  if (!isPlainObject(body) || typeof body.outcome !== 'string' || !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(A0_RELAYER_OUTCOME_TABLE, body.outcome)) {
    return unreadable();
  }
  const outcome = body.outcome as A0RelayerOutcome;
  const row = A0_RELAYER_OUTCOME_TABLE[outcome];
  if (http.status !== row.status) {
    return unreadable();
  }
  const hasSig = body.txSignature !== undefined;
  if (hasSig && !isA0TxSignature(body.txSignature)) {
    return unreadable();
  }
  if ((row.signature === 'always' && !hasSig) || (row.signature === 'never' && hasSig)) {
    return unreadable();
  }
  const sig = hasSig ? (body.txSignature as string) : null;
  switch (outcome) {
    case 'confirmed':
      return {outcome, status: 200, forwarded: true, txSignature: sig as string};
    case 'unconfirmed':
      return {outcome, status: 502, forwarded: true, txSignature: sig as string};
    case 'already_spent': {
      const idx = body.alreadySpentIndexes;
      // A withdraw_change spends one note: index 0 is the only one there is.
      const known = Array.isArray(idx) && idx.length === 1 && idx[0] === 0 ? [0] : null;
      return {outcome, status: 409, forwarded: sig !== null, txSignature: sig, alreadySpentIndexes: known};
    }
    case 'relay_failed':
      return {outcome, status: 502, forwarded: sig !== null, txSignature: sig, recognised: true};
    default:
      return {outcome, status: http.status, forwarded: false, txSignature: null};
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ the quote

/** A validated quote (§6.4). Every amount a BigInt in base units / lamports. */
export interface A0RelayerQuote {
  programId: string;
  pool: string;
  mint: string;
  /** = A0_RELAYER.feePayer (pinned) */
  feePayer: string;
  maxFee: bigint;
  minFee: {transfer: bigint; withdrawChange: bigint};
  /** null: no grant — the fresh-account option is disabled (S11) */
  gasGrantLamports: bigint | null;
  validForSeconds: number;
  /** the wallet's fee for a withdraw_change: exactly minFee.withdraw_change (R5) */
  fee: bigint;
  /** the floor the grant was held to (rent(0) + 5,000), null when there is no grant */
  grantFloorLamports: bigint | null;
  /** when the answer arrived (ms since the epoch, the phone's clock: only ages are taken from it) */
  fetchedAtMs: number;
}

const U64_MAX = (1n << 64n) - 1n;
const U64_DEC = /^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$/;
const QUOTE_KEYS = new Set([
  'programId',
  'pool',
  'mint',
  'feePayer',
  'maxFee',
  'minFee',
  'gasGrantLamports',
  'validForSeconds',
]);

function u64Dec(v: unknown, what: string): bigint {
  if (typeof v !== 'string' || !U64_DEC.test(v) || BigInt(v) > U64_MAX) {
    throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_QUOTE_INVALID', `${what} is not a u64 decimal string`);
  }
  return BigInt(v);
}

/** The context a quote is validated in: when it arrived, and the cluster's rent(0) when needed. */
export interface A0QuoteContext {
  fetchedAtMs: number;
  /** `getMinimumBalanceForRentExemption(0)`; required when the quote carries a grant */
  rentExemptZeroLamports: bigint | null;
}

/** §6.4, pure: the body of a 200 answer → a quote, or `A0RelayerError`. */
export function parseA0RelayerQuote(body: unknown, ctx: A0QuoteContext): A0RelayerQuote {
  if (!isPlainObject(body)) {
    throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_QUOTE_INVALID', 'the quote is not a JSON object');
  }
  for (const k of Object.keys(body)) {
    if (!QUOTE_KEYS.has(k)) {
      throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_QUOTE_INVALID', `the quote carries ${JSON.stringify(k)}, which the contract does not list`);
    }
  }
  if (body.programId !== A0.programId || body.pool !== A0.pool || body.mint !== A0.mint) {
    throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_QUOTE_FOREIGN', 'the quote is not for the pinned A0 program, pool and mint');
  }
  if (body.feePayer !== A0_RELAYER.feePayer) {
    throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_QUOTE_FEE_PAYER', `the quote's fee payer is not the pinned relayer ${A0_RELAYER.feePayer}`);
  }
  const maxFee = u64Dec(body.maxFee, 'maxFee');
  if (!isPlainObject(body.minFee) || Object.keys(body.minFee).sort().join(',') !== 'transfer,withdraw_change') {
    throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_QUOTE_INVALID', 'minFee must be {transfer, withdraw_change}');
  }
  const minFee = {
    transfer: u64Dec(body.minFee.transfer, 'minFee.transfer'),
    withdrawChange: u64Dec(body.minFee.withdraw_change, 'minFee.withdraw_change'),
  };
  const v = body.validForSeconds;
  if (typeof v !== 'number' || !Number.isInteger(v) || v < 1 || v > A0_RELAYER.maxValidForSeconds) {
    throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_QUOTE_INVALID', `validForSeconds must be an integer 1..${A0_RELAYER.maxValidForSeconds}`);
  }
  if (minFee.withdrawChange > maxFee) {
    throw new A0RelayerError(
      'E_A0_QUOTE_FEE_ABOVE_MAX',
      `the relayer's fee ${minFee.withdrawChange} is above the pool's maximum ${maxFee}; nothing can be submitted`,
    );
  }
  let gasGrantLamports: bigint | null = null;
  let grantFloorLamports: bigint | null = null;
  if (body.gasGrantLamports !== undefined) {
    gasGrantLamports = u64Dec(body.gasGrantLamports, 'gasGrantLamports');
    if (ctx.rentExemptZeroLamports === null) {
      throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_QUOTE_RENT', 'a grant cannot be checked without the cluster rent');
    }
    grantFloorLamports = ctx.rentExemptZeroLamports + A0_RELAYER.signatureFeeLamports;
    if (gasGrantLamports < grantFloorLamports || gasGrantLamports > A0_RELAYER.maxGasGrantLamports) {
      throw new A0RelayerError(
        'E_A0_QUOTE_GRANT',
        `gasGrantLamports ${gasGrantLamports} is outside [${grantFloorLamports}, ${A0_RELAYER.maxGasGrantLamports}]`,
      );
    }
  }
  return {
    programId: A0.programId,
    pool: A0.pool,
    mint: A0.mint,
    feePayer: A0_RELAYER.feePayer,
    maxFee,
    minFee,
    gasGrantLamports,
    validForSeconds: v,
    fee: minFee.withdrawChange,
    grantFloorLamports,
    fetchedAtMs: ctx.fetchedAtMs,
  };
}

/** The one cluster request a quote may need (generic: nothing in it is about a note, §6.4). */
export type A0RentRpc = Pick<Connection, 'getMinimumBalanceForRentExemption'>;

export interface A0QuoteOptions {
  transport?: RelayerRequestOptions;
  /** default Date.now */
  now?: () => number;
}

/**
 * §6.4: `GET /relayer/quote` → a validated quote. `rpc` is the devnet connection the tree sync
 * uses; it is asked `getMinimumBalanceForRentExemption(0)` only when the quote carries a grant.
 * Never a fallback (R6): a quote that is not there is `E_A0_QUOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.
 */
export async function fetchA0RelayerQuote(rpc: A0RentRpc, o: A0QuoteOptions = {}): Promise<A0RelayerQuote> {
  let http: RelayerHttpResult;
  try {
    http = await relayerGetQuote(o.transport);
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof A0RelayerUrlError) {
      throw e;
    }
    throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_QUOTE_UNAVAILABLE', `the relayer was not reached (${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)})`);
  }
  const fetchedAtMs = (o.now ?? Date.now)();
  if (http.status !== 200) {
    const said = isPlainObject(http.body) && typeof http.body.outcome === 'string' ? http.body.outcome : 'no outcome';
    throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_QUOTE_UNAVAILABLE', `the relayer answered ${http.status} (${said})`);
  }
  let rent: bigint | null = null;
  if (isPlainObject(http.body) && http.body.gasGrantLamports !== undefined) {
    let lamports: unknown;
    try {
      lamports = await rpc.getMinimumBalanceForRentExemption(0);
    } catch (e) {
      throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_QUOTE_RENT', `rent(0) could not be read (${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)})`);
    }
    if (typeof lamports !== 'number' || !Number.isSafeInteger(lamports) || lamports <= 0) {
      throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_QUOTE_RENT', `rent(0) is not a positive integer: ${String(lamports)}`);
    }
    rent = BigInt(lamports);
  }
  return parseA0RelayerQuote(http.body, {fetchedAtMs, rentExemptZeroLamports: rent});
}

/** §6.7: a quote older than its `validForSeconds` is re-fetched before submit. */
export function a0QuoteExpired(q: A0RelayerQuote, nowMs: number): boolean {
  return nowMs - q.fetchedAtMs >= q.validForSeconds * 1000;
}

/**
 * §6.7: a re-fetched quote may take the proof already made only if the terms the user approved
 * are the same — the fee (minFee.withdraw_change), the fee payer and the grant (or its absence).
 * Anything else: discard the proof, new confirmation.
 */
export function a0QuoteTermsUnchanged(a: A0RelayerQuote, b: A0RelayerQuote): boolean {
  return a.fee === b.fee && a.feePayer === b.feePayer && a.gasGrantLamports === b.gasGrantLamports;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ the payload

/** `POST /relayer/submit` for kind `withdraw_change` — the contract's §2 fields, in its order. */
export interface A0WithdrawChangePayload {
  kind: 'withdraw_change';
  pool: string;
  mint: string;
  merkleRoot: string;
  nullifier: string;
  withdrawAmount: string;
  destination: string;
  destinationOwner: string;
  changeCommitment: string;
  fee: string;
  proofBytes: string;
  publicInputs: string[];
  cuLimit: number;
}

/** The unshield's own values: the authorization's owner and ATA, the amount, the fee, the root. */
export interface A0UnshieldTerms {
  /** the destination wallet address (base58), on the Ed25519 curve */
  owner: string;
  /** the token account the authorization returned = ATA(owner, mint) */
  ata: string;
  /** base units, 1..2^64-1 */
  amount: bigint;
  /** = the quote's fee (R5) */
  fee: bigint;
  /** the root the path was computed against (the synced tree's) */
  merkleRoot: bigint;
}

/** The order of withdraw_change's public inputs (§1). */
export const A0_WITHDRAW_CHANGE_PUBLIC_INPUTS = [
  'merkleRoot',
  'nullifier',
  'withdrawAmount',
  'recipientField',
  'mintHash',
  'changeCommitment',
  'fee',
] as const;

const HEX32 = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const HEX_PROOF = new RegExp(`^[0-9a-f]{${2 * A0_PROOF_BYTES}}$`);

function beModR(bytes: Uint8Array): bigint {
  return BigInt(`0x${Buffer.from(bytes).toString('hex')}`) % FIELD_MODULUS;
}

function canonicalKey(s: string, what: string): PublicKey {
  let k: PublicKey;
  try {
    k = new PublicKey(s);
  } catch {
    throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_SUBMIT_ARGS', `${what} is not a public key`);
  }
  if (k.toBase58() !== s) {
    throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_SUBMIT_ARGS', `${what} is not in canonical base58`);
  }
  return k;
}

/** ATA(owner, mint) under the classic token program, computed here (never read from Rust). */
export function a0AtaOf(owner: PublicKey): PublicKey {
  return PublicKey.findProgramAddressSync(
    [owner.toBuffer(), new PublicKey(TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID).toBuffer(), new PublicKey(A0.mint).toBuffer()],
    new PublicKey(ASSOCIATED_TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID),
  )[0];
}

/**
 * §6.6 + §6.7: the submit payload for a proof Rust made (`a0Prove('withdraw_change', …)`), after
 * JS compared every public input it can recompute with its own value. The nullifier and the change
 * commitment cannot be recomputed in JS (R12, R9): they are checked when the tx lands (§6.8).
 * The payload carries the in-flight nullifier — keep it in memory only (Task 7).
 */
export function buildA0WithdrawChangePayload(
  proof: A0Proof,
  terms: A0UnshieldTerms,
  quote: A0RelayerQuote,
): A0WithdrawChangePayload {
  if (!Array.isArray(proof.publicInputs) || proof.publicInputs.length !== A0_WITHDRAW_CHANGE_PUBLIC_INPUTS.length) {
    throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_SUBMIT_ARGS', 'a withdraw_change proof has exactly 7 public inputs');
  }
  const pi = proof.publicInputs.map((h, i) => {
    if (typeof h !== 'string' || !HEX32.test(h)) {
      throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_SUBMIT_ARGS', `public input ${i} is not 64 lowercase hex`);
    }
    const v = BigInt(`0x${h}`);
    if (v >= FIELD_MODULUS) {
      throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_SUBMIT_ARGS', `public input ${i} is not a canonical field element`);
    }
    return v;
  });
  if (typeof proof.proofBytes !== 'string' || !HEX_PROOF.test(proof.proofBytes)) {
    throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_SUBMIT_ARGS', `the proof is not ${A0_PROOF_BYTES} bytes of lowercase hex`);
  }
  if (terms.amount < 1n || terms.amount > U64_MAX) {
    throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_SUBMIT_ARGS', 'amount must be 1..2^64-1 base units');
  }
  if (terms.fee !== quote.fee) {
    throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_SUBMIT_ARGS', `the fee ${terms.fee} is not the quote's minFee ${quote.fee} (R5)`);
  }
  const owner = canonicalKey(terms.owner, 'the destination owner');
  if (!PublicKey.isOnCurve(owner.toBytes())) {
    throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_SUBMIT_ARGS', 'the destination owner is not a wallet address (off the Ed25519 curve)');
  }
  const ata = canonicalKey(terms.ata, 'the destination token account');
  if (!a0AtaOf(owner).equals(ata)) {
    throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_SUBMIT_ARGS', 'the token account is not ATA(owner, mint)');
  }
  const ours: Array<[number, bigint]> = [
    [0, terms.merkleRoot],
    [2, terms.amount],
    [3, beModR(ata.toBytes())],
    [4, beModR(new PublicKey(A0.mint).toBytes())],
    [6, terms.fee],
  ];
  for (const [i, v] of ours) {
    if (pi[i] !== v) {
      throw new A0RelayerError(
        'E_A0_SUBMIT_PUBLIC_INPUTS',
        `public input ${i} (${A0_WITHDRAW_CHANGE_PUBLIC_INPUTS[i]}) is not this unshield's`,
      );
    }
  }
  return {
    kind: 'withdraw_change',
    pool: A0.pool,
    mint: A0.mint,
    merkleRoot: toBe32Hex(pi[0]!),
    nullifier: toBe32Hex(pi[1]!),
    withdrawAmount: pi[2]!.toString(),
    destination: terms.ata,
    destinationOwner: terms.owner,
    changeCommitment: toBe32Hex(pi[5]!),
    fee: pi[6]!.toString(),
    proofBytes: proof.proofBytes,
    publicInputs: pi.map(v => v.toString()),
    cuLimit: A0_CU.withdrawChange,
  };
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ the relayed instruction

function hexBytes(h: string): Uint8Array {
  return Uint8Array.from(Buffer.from(h, 'hex'));
}

function u64le(v: bigint): Uint8Array {
  const out = new Uint8Array(8);
  let x = v;
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    out[i] = Number(x & 0xffn);
    x >>= 8n;
  }
  return out;
}

/** The global nullifier-record PDA ["nullifier", n] under FeGSS… (n: 32 bytes BE hex). */
export function a0NullifierRecordPda(nullifierHex: string): PublicKey {
  if (!HEX32.test(nullifierHex) || BigInt(`0x${nullifierHex}`) >= FIELD_MODULUS) {
    throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_SUBMIT_ARGS', 'the nullifier is not a canonical 32-byte field element');
  }
  return PublicKey.findProgramAddressSync(
    [Buffer.from(A0_NULLIFIER_SEED), Buffer.from(nullifierHex, 'hex')],
    new PublicKey(A0.programId),
  )[0];
}

/**
 * The `withdraw_with_change` instruction the relayer lands for `payload` (contract §2: "Encoded as
 * withdraw_with_change(merkle_root, nullifier, amount u64 LE, change_commitment, fee u64 LE, proof
 * Vec<u8>), 380 bytes"; accounts in the IDL's order), with the PINNED relayer as fee payer and its
 * only signer. The wallet never sends it (R6): it is the shape the post-landing verifier compares
 * the landed instruction with, held byte for byte to `relayerLandedP1P2` and to two landed txs.
 */
export function buildA0WithdrawChangeIx(payload: A0WithdrawChangePayload): TransactionInstruction {
  for (const [k, v] of [
    ['merkleRoot', payload.merkleRoot],
    ['changeCommitment', payload.changeCommitment],
  ] as const) {
    if (!HEX32.test(v)) {
      throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_SUBMIT_ARGS', `${k} is not 64 lowercase hex`);
    }
  }
  if (!HEX_PROOF.test(payload.proofBytes)) {
    throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_SUBMIT_ARGS', `the proof is not ${A0_PROOF_BYTES} bytes of lowercase hex`);
  }
  if (!U64_DEC.test(payload.withdrawAmount) || !U64_DEC.test(payload.fee)) {
    throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_SUBMIT_ARGS', 'withdrawAmount / fee are not u64 decimal strings');
  }
  const amount = BigInt(payload.withdrawAmount);
  const fee = BigInt(payload.fee);
  if (amount < 1n || amount > U64_MAX || fee > U64_MAX) {
    throw new A0RelayerError('E_A0_SUBMIT_ARGS', 'withdrawAmount / fee are not u64');
  }
  const data = new Uint8Array(8 + A0_WITHDRAW_CHANGE_ARGS_BYTES);
  let o = 0;
  for (const part of [
    hexBytes(A0_IX_DISCRIMINATOR.withdrawWithChange),
    hexBytes(payload.merkleRoot),
    hexBytes(payload.nullifier),
    u64le(amount),
    hexBytes(payload.changeCommitment),
    u64le(fee),
    Uint8Array.of(A0_PROOF_BYTES & 0xff, (A0_PROOF_BYTES >>> 8) & 0xff, 0, 0),
    hexBytes(payload.proofBytes),
  ]) {
    data.set(part, o);
    o += part.length;
  }
  const meta = (pubkey: string | PublicKey, isWritable: boolean, isSigner = false) => ({
    pubkey: typeof pubkey === 'string' ? new PublicKey(pubkey) : pubkey,
    isSigner,
    isWritable,
  });
  return new TransactionInstruction({
    programId: new PublicKey(A0.programId),
    keys: [
      meta(A0.pool, false),
      meta(A0.merkleTree, true),
      meta(A0.vault, true),
      meta(payload.destination, true),
      meta(a0NullifierRecordPda(payload.nullifier), true),
      meta(A0_RELAYER.feePayer, true, true),
      meta(A0_RELAYER.feeDestination, true),
      meta(A0_RELAYER.wchangeVk, false),
      meta(TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID, false),
      meta(SYSTEM_PROGRAM_ID, false),
    ],
    data: Buffer.from(data),
  });
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ the submit

/**
 * §6.7: `POST /relayer/submit` with `payload` → the typed outcome. A deadline or a transport
 * error is `unknown` (the tx may have landed; reconcile), never "not forwarded". Only a refused
 * URL throws (`E_A0_RELAYER_URL`: nothing was sent).
 */
export async function submitA0WithdrawChange(
  payload: A0WithdrawChangePayload,
  transport: RelayerRequestOptions = {},
): Promise<A0SubmitResult> {
  let http: RelayerHttpResult;
  try {
    http = await relayerPostSubmit(JSON.stringify(payload), transport);
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof A0RelayerUrlError) {
      throw e;
    }
    return {
      outcome: 'unknown',
      status: null,
      forwarded: 'unknown',
      txSignature: null,
      cause: e instanceof A0RelayerDeadlineError ? 'deadline' : 'transport',
    };
  }
  return interpretA0SubmitAnswer(http);
}
```

#### Notes for the executor (Task 3)

- **The rulings this task took (each the most secure default; the owner may overturn any):**
  - **The grant floor is rent(0) + 5,000, with rent(0) read from the chain at quote time.** Controller ruling 2 says "refuses a
    quote whose grant is below it [rent(0)]" and pins no number. The task keeps §6.4's + 5,000 (one signature fee: the least
    that lets the fresh account exist AND sign once), so the floor is 5,000 above the ruling's literal reading and still
    follows the chain. Measured 2026-11-17 18:48 UTC: rent(0) = 650,240, floor 655,240. The contract's 895,880 (old rent) is
    not used anywhere. Cost if wrong: a grant in [rent(0), rent(0) + 5,000) is refused — a refused quote, never a stuck
    account; the live grant is 3,000,000.
  - **The rent read is the quote's only RPC request, and only when the quote carries a grant.** It is
    `getMinimumBalanceForRentExemption(0)` on the connection Task 7 passes (the tree sync's devnet one): a generic request,
    nothing in it is about a note (§2). A failure, a non-integer or a non-positive answer refuses (`E_A0_QUOTE_RENT`) —
    never "no floor". The fetch time is taken when the relayer's answer arrives, before the rent request (the quote's age
    is never under-counted).
  - **The quote is held to the frozen contract's key list.** An unlisted top-level key refuses (`E_A0_QUOTE_INVALID`), and so does
    a `minFee` with any kind besides `transfer` / `withdraw_change`. The contract is frozen and its amendments are announced
    first; a field we would silently ignore could carry terms we never checked. `validForSeconds` must be an integer
    1…60: a shorter validity only makes us re-quote sooner, a longer one would let a stale fee through §6.7. Cost if
    wrong: an unannounced additive change refuses every quote until a release — visible at once, never silent.
  - **The fee payer is pinned (ruling 9)** as `A0_RELAYER.feePayer`; `fee_destination` and `wchange_vk` are written as
    literals, like M1b's pool / tree / vault, and derived in the golden test with the real web3.js
    (`feeDestination = ATA(feePayer, mint)` = the golden `accountMetas[6]`, `wchangeVk = PDA(["wchange_vk", pool])` =
    `accountMetas[7]`).
  - **The outcome is believed only when the body and the status agree**, and `txSignature` is present exactly as contract §1
    allows (`confirmed`, `unconfirmed`: always; `already_spent`, `relay_failed`: optional; the eight others: never), base58
    of exactly 64 bytes. **One departure from the contract's letter:** contract §1 says "anything unrecognised is
    `relay_failed` with no signature". An unreadable answer that DOES carry a `txSignature` key claims a forward, so it
    becomes `unknown` (`cause: 'unreadable'`, disposition `reconcile`): the note goes `pending` and the reservation is kept
    until the chain-time rule decides, instead of being released at once. An unreadable answer without one is the
    contract's `relay_failed`, not forwarded — the coordinator's plain-text 429 included (Task 1's hand-over). Cost if
    wrong: a wait of about 5 minutes (chain time) before a garbled answer's note is usable again.
  - **On submit, a deadline, a transport error AND a pin failure are `unknown`** (reconcile). OkHttp checks pins after the
    handshake and before the request body is written, so a pin failure very likely sent nothing — but that is the
    native library's behaviour, not proven on this phone, and "unknown" costs only the wait. Only `E_A0_RELAYER_URL`
    throws (nothing was sent; a build error).
  - **`alreadySpentIndexes`:** a withdraw_change spends one note, so `[0]` is the only known answer; absent, `[]`, `[1]`
    or a non-array are `null` (undetermined — contract §1: "absence = undetermined, never 'none'"). It never changes the
    disposition (`already_spent` always reconciles).
  - **`relay_failed` WITH a signature reconciles.** §6.8 lists "any outcome without `txSignature`: untouched" but says
    nothing of a `relay_failed` that carries one (the relayer forwarded, then saw an error or could not confirm). The
    tx was forwarded, so it is treated like `unconfirmed`: the sync decides, the reservation stays.
  - **The re-quote "terms" are the fee (`minFee.withdraw_change`), the fee payer and the grant (or its absence).** §6.7
    says "same `minFee`, `feePayer`, `gasGrantLamports`". `minFee.transfer` and `maxFee` do not reach a withdraw_change
    (the fee is ours and already ≤ the new `maxFee`, or the new quote refuses), so a change in them does not force a new
    confirmation. Cost if wrong: one more confirmation in a rare case, if the owner rules otherwise.
  - **The payload builder refuses an off-curve owner and a token account that is not `ATA(owner, mint)`**, besides the
    five public-input comparisons of §6.6. The owner is "always a wallet address" (§6.1), Rust's `derive_ata` refuses
    off-curve owners (rev 3.2), and the relayer grants only on-curve owners — three places that must agree. The ATA is
    derived in JS (`a0AtaOf`, `findProgramAddressSync`), independent of Rust's; Task 6's abort-on-mismatch can call it.
  - **`buildA0WithdrawChangeIx` is app code, not a test helper.** It is the expected shape Task 4 compares the landed
    instruction with, one equality for every byte and account. It cannot become a self-relay: it takes no fee payer (the
    pinned relayer is its fee payer and only signer), the module has no transaction type, no key and no send call, and
    the R6 guard reads that.

**The rule, stated once.** The relayer says "confirmed"; the wallet believes the CHAIN, as the sync recorded it, and
only for the tx that spends exactly the note it approved: our pool, our nullifier (by `matchSpent`, never by a
compare in JS), Rust's change leaf, our fee to the pinned relayer's ATA, our amount to our ATA, the relayer's key as
the one signer, no key of ours signing or appearing except the owner, and SOL to the owner only as the quote's one
grant to an empty on-curve account. Anything else is a refusal with a name.

- [ ] **Step 1: The expected values of the post-upgrade landings, read from the wire by an independent reader.**

The two Task 3 recordings are base64 wire transactions. Their expected values must not come from the code under test
(`parseA0SyncedTx`) nor from web3.js, so a small offline reader decodes the legacy message by hand (compact-u16, keys,
instructions, `withdraw_with_change`'s §1 layout). Create `scripts/a0-fixtures/read-landed-withdraw.mjs`:

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * Reads the recorded wire bytes of a landed relayed `withdraw_with_change` (a `fetch-devnet-tx.mjs`
 * fixture, `encoding: 'base64'`) WITHOUT the wallet's code and without @solana/web3.js, and prints
 * the facts the post-landing verifier's positive controls expect (M1c Task 4): the signers, every
 * top-level instruction's program and its first accounts, the create-ATA-idempotent accounts, the
 * grant transfer, and the withdraw's destination / fee payer / fee destination / nullifier / amount /
 * change commitment / fee (§1 layout: disc 8 | merkle_root 32 | nullifier 32 | amount u64 LE |
 * change_commitment 32 | fee u64 LE | u32 256 | proof). Legacy messages only (the fixtures are).
 *
 * The literals in `src/modules/shielded/a0/__tests__/landedVerifier.test.ts` for 5F8Ks5qa… and
 * 5sKiWZTv… are this script's output. Offline; no network. Run from the repository root:
 *   node scripts/a0-fixtures/read-landed-withdraw.mjs <fixture.json> [...]
 */
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const B58 = '123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz';
function b58(bytes) {
  let n = BigInt(`0x${Buffer.from(bytes).toString('hex') || '0'}`);
  let s = '';
  while (n > 0n) {
    s = B58[Number(n % 58n)] + s;
    n /= 58n;
  }
  for (const x of bytes) {
    if (x !== 0) break;
    s = `1${s}`;
  }
  return s;
}
function shortvec(b, i) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  for (;;) {
    const x = b[i++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;
    if (x < 0x80) return [v, i];
  }
}
const u64le = (b, at) => Buffer.from(b.subarray(at, at + 8)).readBigUInt64LE(0);
const hex = b => Buffer.from(b).toString('hex');

const SYSTEM = '11111111111111111111111111111111';
const ATA = 'ATokenGPvbdGVxr1b2hvZbsiqW5xWH25efTNsLJA8knL';
const POOL_PROGRAM = 'FeGSSsJtmA7GnMgnpj33JsiceSk1NyFopff2FtQFsMuH';

function read(path) {
  const fx = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path, 'utf8'));
  const raw = Buffer.from(fx.result.transaction[0], 'base64');
  let [n, i] = shortvec(raw, 0);
  const signature = b58(raw.subarray(i, i + 64));
  i += 64 * n;
  const msg = raw.subarray(i);
  if (msg[0] & 0x80) throw new Error(`${path}: not a legacy message`);
  const header = [msg[0], msg[1], msg[2]];
  let j = 3;
  let nk;
  [nk, j] = shortvec(msg, j);
  const keys = [];
  for (let k = 0; k < nk; k++) keys.push(b58(msg.subarray(j + 32 * k, j + 32 * k + 32)));
  j += 32 * nk + 32; // keys, recent blockhash
  let ni;
  [ni, j] = shortvec(msg, j);
  const out = { signature, signers: keys.slice(0, header[0]), programs: [], createAta: [], transfers: [], withdraw: null };
  for (let x = 0; x < ni; x++) {
    const program = keys[msg[j++]];
    let na;
    [na, j] = shortvec(msg, j);
    const acc = [...msg.subarray(j, j + na)].map(a => keys[a]);
    j += na;
    let dl;
    [dl, j] = shortvec(msg, j);
    const data = msg.subarray(j, j + dl);
    j += dl;
    out.programs.push(program);
    if (program === ATA && dl === 1 && data[0] === 1) {
      out.createAta.push({ payer: acc[0], ata: acc[1], owner: acc[2], mint: acc[3] });
    } else if (program === SYSTEM && dl === 12 && data.readUInt32LE(0) === 2) {
      out.transfers.push({ from: acc[0], to: acc[1], lamports: u64le(data, 4).toString() });
    } else if (program === POOL_PROGRAM) {
      out.withdraw = {
        destination: acc[3],
        feePayer: acc[5],
        feeDestination: acc[6],
        nullifier: hex(data.subarray(40, 72)),
        amount: u64le(data, 72).toString(),
        changeCommitment: hex(data.subarray(80, 112)),
        fee: u64le(data, 112).toString(),
      };
    }
  }
  return out;
}

for (const p of process.argv.slice(2)) {
  console.log(JSON.stringify(read(p), null, 2));
}
```

```bash
node scripts/a0-fixtures/read-landed-withdraw.mjs src/modules/shielded/a0/__tests__/fixtures/landed-withdraw-5F8Ks5qa.json \
  src/modules/shielded/a0/__tests__/fixtures/landed-withdraw-5sKiWZTv.json
```

```json
  "signers": [

  "programs": [
```

RPC's JSON answer, the encoding the sync asks for and `recordedRpc.ts` serves, so the real `Connection.getTransaction`
parses it exactly as on the phone):

```ts
/**
 * TEST-ONLY: a `fetch-devnet-tx.mjs` fixture (the RPC's `getTransaction` answer with
 * `encoding: 'base64'`) re-encoded as the RPC's JSON answer — the encoding the tree sync asks for
 * and `recordedRpc.ts` serves — so the recorded relayed withdraws go through the REAL web3.js
 * `Connection.getTransaction` parsing and then `parseA0SyncedTx`, exactly as a synced tx does on
 * the phone (M1c Task 3's hand-over: "`parseA0SyncedTx` takes what the real
 * `Connection.getTransaction` returns"). Never imported by app code.
 *
 * The wire bytes are decoded by the REAL @solana/web3.js `VersionedTransaction.deserialize` (the
 * suite's `realWeb3` mock line makes the import below the real library). `meta` is the RPC's own,
 * unedited: its fields are the same in both encodings. Legacy messages only (both fixtures are);
 * anything else throws instead of guessing.
 */
import {VersionedTransaction} from '@solana/web3.js';
import {base58} from '@scure/base';
import type {RecordedTx} from './recordedRpc';

export interface DevnetTxFixture {
  schema: string;
  signature: string;
  result: {
    slot: number;
    blockTime: number | null;
    version: unknown;
    meta: RecordedTx['meta'];
    transaction: [string, string];
  };
}

export function jsonEncodedTx(fixture: DevnetTxFixture): RecordedTx {
  if (fixture.schema !== 'noctura.a0.devnet-tx-fixture/1' || fixture.result.transaction[1] !== 'base64') {
    throw new Error('landedTx: not a base64 fetch-devnet-tx.mjs fixture');
  }
  const vtx = VersionedTransaction.deserialize(Buffer.from(fixture.result.transaction[0], 'base64'));
  const msg = vtx.message;
  if (msg.version !== 'legacy' || fixture.result.version !== 'legacy' || msg.addressTableLookups.length !== 0) {
    throw new Error('landedTx: only legacy messages are re-encoded');
  }
  const signatures = vtx.signatures.map(s => base58.encode(s));
  if (signatures[0] !== fixture.signature) {
    throw new Error(`landedTx: the wire's first signature is not ${fixture.signature}`);
  }
  return {
    slot: fixture.result.slot,
    blockTime: fixture.result.blockTime,
    version: 'legacy',
    meta: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(fixture.result.meta)) as RecordedTx['meta'],
    transaction: {
      signatures,
      message: {
        accountKeys: msg.staticAccountKeys.map(k => k.toBase58()),
        header: {...msg.header},
        instructions: msg.compiledInstructions.map(ci => ({
          programIdIndex: ci.programIdIndex,
          accounts: [...ci.accountKeyIndexes],
          data: base58.encode(ci.data),
        })),
        recentBlockhash: msg.recentBlockhash,
      },
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * The post-landing verifier (spec §6 step 8, I13, S10, m-2; §14 JS "post-landing verification
 * refusing a foreign pool, a foreign fee payer, a wrong fee_destination, a wrong fee, a wrong
 * destination, a grant to an owner whose pre-balance was not 0, a grant of another amount or from
 * another payer, a grant to an off-curve owner, two top-level transfers …, a create-ATA with other
 * accounts, a missing nullifier, and any signer that is a key of this seed").
 *
 * POSITIVE CONTROLS — four relayed `withdraw_with_change` that LANDED on devnet with the uniform P2
 * shape, each read as the sync reads it (the REAL web3.js `Connection.getTransaction` over the
 * recorded answer, then `parseA0SyncedTx`):
 *   - 47k56NfB… (fresh owner, grant 3,000,000) and 3oHktG2X… (existing owner, no grant), recorded in
 *     fixtures/devnet-tree-5URd.json; expected values = the program side's golden
 *     `relayerLandedP1P2` (relayer-a0-golden-vectors.json, digest pinned in syncedTx.golden.test.ts);
 *   - 5F8Ks5qa… (fresh owner AgPYn4…, grant) and 5sKiWZTv… (existing owner GoBAm…, no grant), the
 *     post-upgrade landings recorded base64 by scripts/a0-fixtures/fetch-devnet-tx.mjs and re-encoded
 *     by __testing__/landedTx.ts; expected values = the output of
 *     scripts/a0-fixtures/read-landed-withdraw.mjs (its own wire decoder, no web3.js, no app code).
 * Every positive passes; every REFUSAL ROW is one mutation of a positive (a field of the recorded
 * SyncedTx, one input of the wallet's, or — where the record has no field for it — one edit of the
 * recorded transaction) and names the rule that fired.
 *
 * THE SEED SET is the real `a0SeedPublicKeys` (Task 2) over the "abandon … about" seed with main
 * `slip10:0` and a real `fresh-pending` reservation (`slip10:1`), held to the offline vectors.
 */
import {readFileSync} from 'fs';
import {join} from 'path';

jest.mock('@solana/web3.js', () =>
  jest.requireActual<typeof import('../__testing__/realWeb3')>('../__testing__/realWeb3').loadRealWeb3(),
);
import {PublicKey} from '@solana/web3.js';
import {clearAllStores, initSecureMmkv} from '../../../../store/mmkv/instances';
import {storeTransparentScheme} from '../../../keyDerivation/derivationScheme';
import {a0SeedPublicKeys, reserveA0FreshAccount, resetA0ReservationsForTests} from '../accountRegistry';
import type {A0HistoryRpc} from '../accountRegistry';
import {appendTopLevelIx, txOf} from '../__testing__/chainEdits';
import {jsonEncodedTx} from '../__testing__/landedTx';
import type {DevnetTxFixture} from '../__testing__/landedTx';
import {appendDeposit, appendDepositPair, appendWithdraw} from '../__testing__/ownHistory';
import {chainFrom, recordedConnection} from '../__testing__/recordedRpc';
import type {RecordedChain, RecordedFixture} from '../__testing__/recordedRpc';
import {A0} from '../constants';
import {A0_RELAYED_TOP_LEVEL_PROGRAMS, verifyLandedUnshield} from '../landedVerifier';
import type {A0LandedUnshieldExpectation, A0VerifyRefusal} from '../landedVerifier';
import {parseA0SyncedTx} from '../syncedTx';
import type {A0SyncedTx} from '../syncedTx';

const fx = (name: string) => readFileSync(join(__dirname, 'fixtures', name), 'utf8');
const TREE = JSON.parse(fx('devnet-tree-5URd.json')) as RecordedFixture;
const LANDED = ['5F8Ks5qa', '5sKiWZTv'].map(p => JSON.parse(fx(`landed-withdraw-${p}.json`)) as DevnetTxFixture);
interface GoldenWithdraw {
  landedSignature: string;
  payload: {nullifier: string; withdrawAmount: string; destination: string; destinationOwner: string; changeCommitment: string; fee: string};
}
const P1P2 = (JSON.parse(fx('relayer-a0-golden-vectors.json')) as {
  relayerLandedP1P2: {feePayer: string; gasGrantLamports: string; vectors: {withdraw_change: GoldenWithdraw; withdraw_change_existing: GoldenWithdraw}};
}).relayerLandedP1P2;
interface Vectors {
  seeds: {seed: string; accounts: {scheme: string; address: string}[]}[];
}
const [ABANDON, ZOO] = (JSON.parse(fx('a0-account-vectors.json')) as Vectors).seeds as [Vectors['seeds'][0], Vectors['seeds'][0]];
const vec = (scheme: string) => ABANDON.accounts.find(a => a.scheme === scheme)!.address;
/** An on-curve key that is not this seed's, not the relayer's and no positive's owner: "zoo … wrong" slip10:0. */
const OTHER = ZOO.accounts.find(a => a.scheme === 'slip10:0')!.address;
/** A key no recorded tx lists, to stand in for a foreign pool. */
const FOREIGN_POOL = 'Stake11111111111111111111111111111111111111';

const RELAYER = '3jvhiz9qcJAe2zGHvRAiRYXiaFCdjEQrB9KuE5NuFaGe';
const SYSTEM = '11111111111111111111111111111111';
const ATA_PROGRAM = 'ATokenGPvbdGVxr1b2hvZbsiqW5xWH25efTNsLJA8knL';
const TOKEN_PROGRAM = 'TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA';
const MEMO = 'MemoSq4gqABAXKb96qnH8TysNcWxMyWCqXgDLGmfcHr';
const GRANT = 3_000_000n;

/** One positive control: the signature prefix and every value the verifier is told to expect. */
interface Case {
  name: string;
  prefix: string;
  owner: string;
  ata: string;
  amount: bigint;
  fee: bigint;
  nullifier: string;
  changeCommitment: string;
  grant: bigint | null;
}
const golden = (prefix: string, g: GoldenWithdraw, grant: bigint | null, name: string): Case => ({
  name,
  prefix,
  owner: g.payload.destinationOwner,
  ata: g.payload.destination,
  amount: BigInt(g.payload.withdrawAmount),
  fee: BigInt(g.payload.fee),
  nullifier: g.payload.nullifier,
  changeCommitment: g.payload.changeCommitment,
  grant,
});
const CASES: Case[] = [
  golden('47k56NfB', P1P2.vectors.withdraw_change, GRANT, '47k56NfB… fresh owner, grant'),
  golden('3oHktG2X', P1P2.vectors.withdraw_change_existing, null, '3oHktG2X… existing owner'),
  // read-landed-withdraw.mjs output (Step 1)
  {
    name: '5F8Ks5qa… fresh owner, grant (post-upgrade)',
    prefix: '5F8Ks5qa',
    owner: 'AgPYn4odQNKwWBjvCtgG8G1supmLKaFHtbDVHmMT2KtP',
    ata: '2ot2kwhs7gFFPHAYNwkuNsUsfZp8hWAgzHpNQLx9pASu',
    amount: 400000n,
    fee: 10000n,
    nullifier: '0b2018b2e520bbf9420648d389a76aaad7a34b4c63e9afbf7f1f2e997888762d',
    changeCommitment: '0a579975eb2367144af135283e87e330ff775606bfac3a73c60ce08e7c60247c',
    grant: GRANT,
  },
  {
    name: '5sKiWZTv… existing owner (post-upgrade)',
    prefix: '5sKiWZTv',
    owner: 'GoBAmZzHvD6F4KHLNmBFh2wZAGE1dwwufeTbifSHEYfd',
    ata: '9hZSf8jMxBdqcvnYzj6EkQ2gPoZCoX2GcF8f1dgkyLsn',
    amount: 400000n,
    fee: 10000n,
    nullifier: '18be67342e46b85f7ccc83eecabf99cb9d8a6a05b40644c59224a775277526ed',
    changeCommitment: '15bca11de36cb63abb898e8ed26db888b1058453c5ef8bae21ce06dcaea4411f',
    grant: null,
  },
];
const GRANTED = CASES.filter(c => c.grant !== null);
const caseOf = (prefix: string) => CASES.find(c => c.prefix === prefix)!;

/** The recorded chain with the two base64 landings re-encoded into it. */
function baseChain(): RecordedChain {
  const chain = chainFrom(TREE);
  for (const f of LANDED) {
    chain.transactions[f.signature] = jsonEncodedTx(f);
  }
  return chain;
}
async function syncedOf(prefix: string, edit?: (chain: RecordedChain, sig: string) => void): Promise<A0SyncedTx> {
  const chain = baseChain();
  const {sig} = txOf(chain, prefix);
  edit?.(chain, sig);
  const {connection} = recordedConnection(chain);
  const tx = await connection.getTransaction(sig, {commitment: 'confirmed', maxSupportedTransactionVersion: 0});
  const r = tx && parseA0SyncedTx(sig, tx);
  if (!r) {
    throw new Error(`${prefix}: not a successful tx`);
  }
  return r;
}

/** A deep copy with every string mapped (BigInt kept) — the clone, and the key substitution. */
function mapStrings<T>(v: T, f: (s: string) => string): T {
  if (typeof v === 'string') {
    return f(v) as T;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(v)) {
    return v.map(x => mapStrings(x, f)) as T;
  }
  if (v !== null && typeof v === 'object') {
    return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(v).map(([k, x]) => [k, mapStrings(x, f)])) as T;
  }
  return v;
}

const ataOf = (owner: string): string =>
  PublicKey.findProgramAddressSync(
    [new PublicKey(owner).toBuffer(), new PublicKey(TOKEN_PROGRAM).toBuffer(), new PublicKey(A0.mint).toBuffer()],
    new PublicKey(ATA_PROGRAM),
  )[0].toBase58();
/** An off-curve address that no recorded tx lists (a PDA). */
const OFF_CURVE = PublicKey.findProgramAddressSync([Buffer.from('m1c-task4-off-curve')], new PublicKey(SYSTEM))[0].toBase58();

let SEED_KEYS: string[];
let MAIN: string;
let FRESH: string;
const synced: Record<string, A0SyncedTx> = {};

beforeAll(async () => {
  clearAllStores();
  initSecureMmkv('test-key');
  storeTransparentScheme({kind: 'slip10', account: 0});
  resetA0ReservationsForTests();
  const seed = Uint8Array.from(Buffer.from(ABANDON.seed, 'hex'));
  const noHistory: A0HistoryRpc = {
    getSignaturesForAddress: (async () => []) as unknown as A0HistoryRpc['getSignaturesForAddress'],
  };
  FRESH = (await reserveA0FreshAccount(noHistory, seed)).address;
  SEED_KEYS = a0SeedPublicKeys(seed);
  MAIN = vec('slip10:0');
  for (const c of CASES) {
    synced[c.prefix] = await syncedOf(c.prefix);
  }
});

function expectation(c: Case, o: Partial<A0LandedUnshieldExpectation> = {}): A0LandedUnshieldExpectation {
  return {
    txSignature: synced[c.prefix]!.signature,
    quote: {feePayer: RELAYER, gasGrantLamports: GRANT},
    authorization: {owner: c.owner, ata: c.ata, amount: c.amount, fee: c.fee},
    destinationKind: 'external',
    seedPublicKeys: SEED_KEYS,
    changeCommitment: c.changeCommitment,
    noteMatch: {chainNullifiers: [c.nullifier], answer: [0]},
    ...o,
  };
}
/** The positive `c` with its owner (and so its ATA) replaced by `owner` everywhere — tx and expectation. */
function withOwner(c: Case, owner: string): {tx: A0SyncedTx; c: Case} {
  const ata = ataOf(owner);
  const map = (s: string) => (s === c.owner ? owner : s === c.ata ? ata : s);
  return {tx: mapStrings(synced[c.prefix]!, map), c: {...c, owner, ata}};
}
const clone = (c: Case): A0SyncedTx => mapStrings(synced[c.prefix]!, s => s);
const refusal = (tx: A0SyncedTx, e: A0LandedUnshieldExpectation): A0VerifyRefusal | 'ok' => {
  const v = verifyLandedUnshield(tx, e);
  return v.ok ? 'ok' : v.code;
};
const ownerPre = (tx: A0SyncedTx, owner: string) => tx.preBalances.find(p => p.address === owner)!;

describe('the inputs are what they claim', () => {
  it('the seed set is the real a0SeedPublicKeys: main slip10:0, the reserved fresh slip10:1, cli — = the offline vectors', () => {
    expect(SEED_KEYS).toEqual([vec('slip10:0'), vec('slip10:1'), vec('cli')]);
    expect(FRESH).toBe(vec('slip10:1'));
  });
  it('the re-encoded base64 landings decode to the facts read-landed-withdraw.mjs printed', () => {
    const r = synced['5F8Ks5qa']!;
    expect(r.signers).toEqual([RELAYER]);
    expect(r.topLevelPrograms).toEqual(['ComputeBudget111111111111111111111111111111', ATA_PROGRAM, SYSTEM, A0.programId]);
    expect(r.systemTransfers).toEqual([{from: RELAYER, to: caseOf('5F8Ks5qa').owner, lamports: GRANT}]);
    expect(synced['5sKiWZTv']!.topLevelPrograms).toEqual(['ComputeBudget111111111111111111111111111111', ATA_PROGRAM, A0.programId]);
  });
  it('the off-curve owner is off the curve; the seed keys, OTHER and the owners are on it and distinct (non-vacuous rows)', () => {
    expect(PublicKey.isOnCurve(new PublicKey(OFF_CURVE).toBytes())).toBe(false);
    const keys = [...SEED_KEYS, OTHER, RELAYER, ...new Set(CASES.map(c => c.owner))];
    expect(new Set(keys).size).toBe(keys.length);
    for (const k of keys) {
      expect(PublicKey.isOnCurve(new PublicKey(k).toBytes())).toBe(true);
    }
  });
  it('the inner system calls of the ATA program and FeGSS… are in the logs, and the record holds the top-level transfer only', async () => {
    for (const c of GRANTED) {
      const chain = baseChain();
      const logs = txOf(chain, c.prefix).tx.meta.logMessages;
      expect(logs.filter(l => l === `Program ${SYSTEM} invoke [2]`).length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
      expect(synced[c.prefix]!.systemTransfers).toHaveLength(1);
    }
  });
});

describe('positive controls: the four landed relayed withdraws pass', () => {
  it.each(CASES.map(c => [c.name, c] as const))('%s', (_n, c) => {
    const v = verifyLandedUnshield(synced[c.prefix]!, expectation(c));
    expect(v).toEqual({
      ok: true,
      signature: synced[c.prefix]!.signature,
      changeLeaf: synced[c.prefix]!.leafInserted[0],
      grantLamports: c.grant,
      ownerPreLamports: c.grant === null ? ownerPre(synced[c.prefix]!, c.owner).lamports : 0n,
      destinationWithoutSol: false,
    });
    if (v.ok) {
      expect(v.changeLeaf.commitment).toBe(c.changeCommitment);
    }
  });
  it('found by reconcile (no relayed signature): txSignature null passes', () => {
    const c = CASES[0]!;
    expect(refusal(synced[c.prefix]!, expectation(c, {txSignature: null}))).toBe('ok');
  });
});

describe('accepted variants (§6 step 8)', () => {
  it('to my main account (a seed key as the OWNER is allowed): no grant, existing owner', () => {
    for (const c0 of CASES.filter(c => c.grant === null)) {
      const {tx, c} = withOwner(c0, MAIN);
      expect(refusal(tx, expectation(c, {destinationKind: 'main'}))).toBe('ok');
    }
  });
  it('to the fresh-pending account with the grant: ok, the SOL is there', () => {
    for (const c0 of GRANTED) {
      const {tx, c} = withOwner(c0, FRESH);
      const v = verifyLandedUnshield(tx, expectation(c, {destinationKind: 'fresh-pending'}));
      expect(v).toMatchObject({ok: true, grantLamports: GRANT, destinationWithoutSol: false});
    }
  });
  it('to the fresh-pending account WITHOUT a grant, owner at 0 lamports: accepted and reported "no SOL"', () => {
    for (const c0 of CASES.filter(c => c.grant === null)) {
      const {tx, c} = withOwner(c0, FRESH);
      ownerPre(tx, FRESH).lamports = 0n;
      const v = verifyLandedUnshield(tx, expectation(c, {destinationKind: 'fresh-pending'}));
      expect(v).toMatchObject({ok: true, grantLamports: null, ownerPreLamports: 0n, destinationWithoutSol: true});
      // the same tx to an external address is not reported
      expect(verifyLandedUnshield(tx, expectation(c))).toMatchObject({ok: true, destinationWithoutSol: false});
    }
  });
  it('a 0-lamport OFF-CURVE owner without a grant: accepted (the relayer never grants one)', () => {
    for (const c0 of CASES.filter(c => c.grant === null)) {
      const {tx, c} = withOwner(c0, OFF_CURVE);
      ownerPre(tx, OFF_CURVE).lamports = 0n;
      expect(verifyLandedUnshield(tx, expectation(c))).toMatchObject({ok: true, grantLamports: null});
    }
  });
});

/** A one-field mutation of the recorded SyncedTx, or of the wallet's own inputs. */
interface Row {
  name: string;
  code: A0VerifyRefusal;
  /** only the cases with a grant */
  grantOnly?: boolean;
  tx?: (t: A0SyncedTx, c: Case) => void;
  exp?: (c: Case) => Partial<A0LandedUnshieldExpectation>;
}
const w0 = (t: A0SyncedTx) => t.withdrawals[0]!;
const ROWS: Row[] = [
  // the wallet's own inputs
  {name: 'the authorization\'s ata is not ATA(owner)', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_ARGS', exp: c => ({authorization: {owner: c.owner, ata: ataOf(OTHER), amount: c.amount, fee: c.fee}})},
  {name: 'the owner is not a canonical key', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_ARGS', exp: c => ({authorization: {owner: `${c.owner}x`, ata: c.ata, amount: c.amount, fee: c.fee}})},
  {name: 'an amount of 0', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_ARGS', exp: c => ({authorization: {owner: c.owner, ata: c.ata, amount: 0n, fee: c.fee}})},
  {name: 'a negative fee', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_ARGS', exp: c => ({authorization: {owner: c.owner, ata: c.ata, amount: c.amount, fee: -1n}})},
  {name: 'the quote names another fee payer', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_ARGS', exp: () => ({quote: {feePayer: OTHER, gasGrantLamports: GRANT}})},
  {name: 'another signature than the relayed one', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_SIGNATURE', exp: c => ({txSignature: synced[c.prefix === '3oHktG2X' ? '47k56NfB' : '3oHktG2X']!.signature})},
  // signers and fee payer
  {name: 'a foreign fee payer (the tx\'s, static key 0)', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_FEE_PAYER', tx: t => {
    t.feePayer = OTHER;
  }},
  {name: 'a foreign fee payer (the instruction\'s fee_payer account)', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_FEE_PAYER', tx: t => {
    w0(t).feePayer = OTHER;
  }},
  {name: 'a second signer that is not ours', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_SIGNERS', tx: t => {
    t.signers.push(OTHER);
  }},
  // shape
  {name: 'a foreign pool (the record holds no withdraw on 8VMe…)', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_WITHDRAW', tx: t => {
    t.withdrawals = [];
  }},
  {name: 'a deposit beside the withdraw', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_WITHDRAW', tx: t => {
    t.deposits.push({amount: 1n, commitment: '0'.repeat(64), rho: '0'.repeat(64), depositor: OTHER, depositorTokenAccount: OTHER});
  }},
  {name: 'two withdraw_with_change on our pool', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_WITHDRAW', tx: t => {
    t.withdrawals.push({...w0(t)});
  }},
  {name: 'a second top-level FeGSS… instruction (not ours)', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_PROGRAMS', tx: t => {
    t.topLevelPrograms.push(A0.programId);
  }},
  {name: 'a top-level program outside the relayed shape', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_PROGRAMS', tx: t => {
    t.topLevelPrograms.push(MEMO);
  }},
  // the spend
  {name: 'a missing nullifier (no Withdraw event)', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_NULLIFIER', tx: t => {
    t.withdrawNullifiers = [];
  }},
  {name: 'two Withdraw events', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_NULLIFIER', tx: t => {
    t.withdrawNullifiers.push(t.withdrawNullifiers[0]!);
  }},
  {name: 'the Withdraw event is not the instruction\'s nullifier', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_NULLIFIER', tx: t => {
    w0(t).nullifier = '1'.repeat(64);
  }},
  {name: 'matchSpent does not attribute it to the note ([])', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_NULLIFIER', exp: c => ({noteMatch: {chainNullifiers: [c.nullifier], answer: []}})},
  {name: 'matchSpent was asked about other nullifiers', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_NULLIFIER', exp: () => ({noteMatch: {chainNullifiers: ['1'.repeat(64)], answer: [0]}})},
  // the change leaf
  {name: 'the change leaf is not Rust\'s commitment (event)', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_CHANGE_LEAF', tx: t => {
    t.leafInserted[0]!.commitment = '2'.repeat(64);
  }},
  {name: 'the change leaf is not Rust\'s commitment (instruction)', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_CHANGE_LEAF', tx: t => {
    w0(t).changeCommitment = '2'.repeat(64);
  }},
  {name: 'Rust proved another change commitment', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_CHANGE_LEAF', exp: () => ({changeCommitment: '2'.repeat(64)})},
  {name: 'no LeafInserted', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_CHANGE_LEAF', tx: t => {
    t.leafInserted = [];
  }},
  {name: 'a second LeafInserted after the change leaf', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_CHANGE_LEAF', tx: t => {
    t.leafInserted.push({...t.leafInserted[0]!, commitment: '2'.repeat(64), leafIndex: t.leafInserted[0]!.leafIndex + 1});
  }},
  // fee, destination, amount
  {name: 'a wrong fee_destination', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_FEE_DESTINATION', tx: t => {
    w0(t).feeDestination = ataOf(OTHER);
  }},
  {name: 'a wrong fee (the tx\'s)', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_FEE', tx: t => {
    w0(t).fee += 1n;
  }},
  {name: 'a wrong fee (the one we approved)', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_FEE', exp: c => ({authorization: {owner: c.owner, ata: c.ata, amount: c.amount, fee: c.fee + 1n}})},
  {name: 'a wrong destination', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_DESTINATION', tx: t => {
    w0(t).destination = ataOf(OTHER);
  }},
  {name: 'the owner is not listed by the tx', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_DESTINATION', tx: (t, c) => {
    t.preBalances = t.preBalances.filter(p => p.address !== c.owner);
  }},
  {name: 'another amount (the instruction\'s)', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_AMOUNT', tx: t => {
    w0(t).amount += 1n;
  }},
  {name: 'the destination received another amount', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_AMOUNT', tx: t => {
    w0(t).destinationTokenDelta = w0(t).destinationTokenDelta! - 1n;
  }},
  {name: 'the destination lists no token balance', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_AMOUNT', tx: t => {
    w0(t).destinationTokenDelta = null;
  }},
  {name: 'the vault moved another amount', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_AMOUNT', tx: t => {
    t.vaultTokenDelta -= 1n;
  }},
  // create-ATA
  {name: 'a create-ATA with another payer', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_CREATE_ATA', tx: t => {
    t.createAtaIdempotent[0]!.payer = OTHER;
  }},
  {name: 'a create-ATA with another ata', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_CREATE_ATA', tx: t => {
    t.createAtaIdempotent[0]!.ata = ataOf(MAIN);
  }},
  {name: 'a create-ATA with another owner', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_CREATE_ATA', tx: t => {
    t.createAtaIdempotent[0]!.owner = MAIN;
  }},
  {name: 'a create-ATA with another mint', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_CREATE_ATA', tx: t => {
    t.createAtaIdempotent[0]!.mint = 'So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112';
  }},
  // the seed
  {name: 'a key of this seed (the reserved fresh one) appears though it is not the owner', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_SEED_KEY', tx: t => {
    t.preBalances.push({address: FRESH, lamports: 0n});
  }},
  // the grant
  {name: 'a grant to an owner whose pre-balance was not 0', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_GRANT_PRE_BALANCE', grantOnly: true, tx: (t, c) => {
    ownerPre(t, c.owner).lamports = 1n;
  }},
  {name: 'a grant of another amount', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_GRANT_TERMS', grantOnly: true, tx: t => {
    t.systemTransfers[0]!.lamports -= 1n;
  }},
  {name: 'a grant from another payer', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_GRANT_TERMS', grantOnly: true, tx: t => {
    t.systemTransfers[0]!.from = OTHER;
  }},
  {name: 'a grant to another address', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_GRANT_TERMS', grantOnly: true, tx: t => {
    t.systemTransfers[0]!.to = OTHER;
  }},
  {name: 'a grant the quote did not carry', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_GRANT_TERMS', grantOnly: true, exp: () => ({quote: {feePayer: RELAYER, gasGrantLamports: null}})},
  {name: 'a grant the quote priced differently', code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_GRANT_TERMS', grantOnly: true, exp: () => ({quote: {feePayer: RELAYER, gasGrantLamports: GRANT + 1n}})},
];

describe('refusal rows: each one mutation of a landed positive, each naming its rule', () => {
  const table = ROWS.flatMap(r => (r.grantOnly ? GRANTED : CASES).map(c => [r.name, c.name, r, c] as const));
  it.each(table)('%s — %s', (_r, _c, row, c) => {
    const tx = clone(c);
    row.tx?.(tx, c);
    expect(refusal(tx, expectation(c, row.exp?.(c)))).toBe(row.code);
  });
});

describe('any signer that is a key of this seed refuses (I13) — every key of the set, every positive', () => {
  const table = CASES.flatMap(c => ['main slip10:0', 'fresh slip10:1', 'cli'].map((k, i) => [k, c.name, i, c] as const));
  it.each(table)('%s as a second signer — %s', (_k, _c, i, c) => {
    const tx = clone(c);
    tx.signers.push(SEED_KEYS[i]!);
    expect(refusal(tx, expectation(c))).toBe('E_A0_VERIFY_SEED_SIGNER');
  });
  it.each(CASES.map(c => [c.name, c] as const))('a seed key as THE signer and fee payer — %s', (_c, c) => {
    const tx = clone(c);
    tx.signers = [MAIN];
    tx.feePayer = MAIN;

  it('the owner of a main-account exit signing is a seed signer too', () => {

    tx.signers.push(MAIN);

  });
});

describe('a grant to an off-curve owner refuses', () => {
  it.each(GRANTED.map(c => [c.name, c] as const))('%s with its owner replaced by an off-curve key', (_n, c0) => {
    const {tx, c} = withOwner(c0, OFF_CURVE);
    expect(ownerPre(tx, OFF_CURVE).lamports).toBe(0n);
```
