```ts
/** Edits of the recorded TRANSACTION, where the record has no one field for the fact. */
const transferData = (lamports: bigint): Uint8Array => {
  const d = new Uint8Array(12);
  new DataView(d.buffer).setUint32(0, 2, true);
  new DataView(d.buffer).setBigUint64(4, lamports, true);
  return d;
};
const keysOf = (chain: RecordedChain, sig: string) => chain.transactions[sig]!.transaction.message.accountKeys;

describe('refusal rows on the recorded transaction', () => {
  it.each(CASES.map(c => [c.name, c] as const))('a foreign pool: pool 8VMe… replaced in the tx → no withdraw of ours — %s', async (_n, c) => {
    const tx = await syncedOf(c.prefix, (chain, sig) => {
      const keys = keysOf(chain, sig);
      keys[keys.indexOf(A0.pool)] = FOREIGN_POOL;
    });
    expect(tx.withdrawals).toEqual([]);
    expect(refusal(tx, expectation(c))).toBe('E_A0_VERIFY_WITHDRAW');
  });
  it.each(CASES.map(c => [c.name, c] as const))('two top-level transfers (a second one appended) — %s', async (_n, c) => {
    const tx = await syncedOf(c.prefix, (chain, sig) => {
      const t = chain.transactions[sig]!;
      const n = c.grant === null ? 2 : 1;
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        appendTopLevelIx(t, {program: SYSTEM, accounts: [RELAYER, c.owner], data: transferData(c.grant ?? 1n), blobs: []});
      }
    });
    expect(tx.systemTransfers).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(refusal(tx, expectation(c))).toBe('E_A0_VERIFY_GRANT_COUNT');
  });
  it.each(CASES.map(c => [c.name, c] as const))('a top-level System instruction that is not a transfer (Assign) — %s', async (_n, c) => {
    const tx = await syncedOf(c.prefix, (chain, sig) => {
      const assign = new Uint8Array(36);
      assign[0] = 1;
      appendTopLevelIx(chain.transactions[sig]!, {program: SYSTEM, accounts: [RELAYER], data: assign, blobs: []});
    });
    expect(refusal(tx, expectation(c))).toBe('E_A0_VERIFY_PROGRAMS');
  });
  it.each(CASES.map(c => [c.name, c] as const))('a top-level instruction of another program (Memo) — %s', async (_n, c) => {
    const tx = await syncedOf(c.prefix, (chain, sig) => {
      appendTopLevelIx(chain.transactions[sig]!, {program: MEMO, accounts: [], data: Uint8Array.from([0x6d]), blobs: []});
    });
    expect(tx.topLevelPrograms).toContain(MEMO);
    expect(A0_RELAYED_TOP_LEVEL_PROGRAMS).not.toContain(MEMO);
    expect(refusal(tx, expectation(c))).toBe('E_A0_VERIFY_PROGRAMS');
  });
  it.each(CASES.map(c => [c.name, c] as const))('the pre-P2 shape: the create-ATA instruction removed (controller ruling 3) — %s', async (_n, c) => {
    const tx = await syncedOf(c.prefix, (chain, sig) => {
      const t = chain.transactions[sig]!;
      const msg = t.transaction.message;
      const at = msg.instructions.findIndex(i => msg.accountKeys[i.programIdIndex] === ATA_PROGRAM);
      msg.instructions.splice(at, 1);
      const logs = t.meta.logMessages;
      const from = logs.indexOf(`Program ${ATA_PROGRAM} invoke [1]`);
      const to = logs.indexOf(`Program ${ATA_PROGRAM} success`);
      expect(from).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
      logs.splice(from, to - from + 1);
    });
    expect(tx.createAtaIdempotent).toEqual([]);
    expect(tx.topLevelPrograms).not.toContain(ATA_PROGRAM);
    expect(refusal(tx, expectation(c))).toBe('E_A0_VERIFY_CREATE_ATA');
  });
  it.each(CASES.map(c => [c.name, c] as const))('a top-level ATA instruction that is not create-idempotent (Create, data []) — %s', async (_n, c) => {
    const tx = await syncedOf(c.prefix, (chain, sig) => {
      appendTopLevelIx(chain.transactions[sig]!, {
        program: ATA_PROGRAM,
        accounts: [RELAYER, c.ata, c.owner, A0.mint, SYSTEM, TOKEN_PROGRAM],
        data: new Uint8Array(0),
        blobs: [],
      });
    });
    expect(tx.createAtaIdempotent).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(refusal(tx, expectation(c))).toBe('E_A0_VERIFY_PROGRAMS');
  });
  it.each(CASES.map(c => [c.name, c] as const))('two create-ATA-idempotent instructions — %s', async (_n, c) => {
    const tx = await syncedOf(c.prefix, (chain, sig) => {
      appendTopLevelIx(chain.transactions[sig]!, {
        program: ATA_PROGRAM,
        accounts: [RELAYER, c.ata, c.owner, A0.mint, SYSTEM, TOKEN_PROGRAM],
        data: Uint8Array.from([1]),
        blobs: [],
      });
    });
    expect(tx.createAtaIdempotent).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(refusal(tx, expectation(c))).toBe('E_A0_VERIFY_CREATE_ATA');
  });
});

describe('the M1b ledger carry: an appended (ownHistory) tx carries its OWN token movement', () => {
  const NULL = '0e'.padEnd(64, '1');
  const CHANGE = '0f'.padEnd(64, '2');
  async function appendedSynced(edit: (chain: RecordedChain) => string): Promise<A0SyncedTx> {
    const chain = chainFrom(TREE);
    const sig = edit(chain);
    const {connection} = recordedConnection(chain);
    const tx = await connection.getTransaction(sig, {commitment: 'confirmed', maxSupportedTransactionVersion: 0});
    return parseA0SyncedTx(sig, tx!)!;
  }
  // the 3UfCx5TD… template's destination (owner HV996…, ATA DzU8…, created in that tx)
  const P0 = {owner: 'HV996fcQT193sXfh3fgCEDjxsWwWxQC6cVdb1EyZxdJR', ata: 'DzU8HkTy7b5jK8LvahytrsgimF9Navxc9HgzA7y167Zt'};

  it('an unshield of 123,456 with fee 7,000: destination +123,456, vault −130,456 — and the verifier passes it', async () => {
    const t = await appendedSynced(chain => appendWithdraw(chain, {nullifier: NULL, changeCommitment: CHANGE, amount: 123456n, fee: 7000n}).signature);
    expect(t.withdrawals[0]).toMatchObject({amount: 123456n, fee: 7000n, destination: P0.ata, destinationTokenDelta: 123456n});
    expect(t.vaultTokenDelta).toBe(-130456n);
    const v = verifyLandedUnshield(t, {
      txSignature: t.signature,
      quote: {feePayer: RELAYER, gasGrantLamports: GRANT},
      authorization: {owner: P0.owner, ata: P0.ata, amount: 123456n, fee: 7000n},
      destinationKind: 'fresh-pending',
      seedPublicKeys: SEED_KEYS,
      changeCommitment: CHANGE,
      noteMatch: {chainNullifiers: [NULL], answer: [0]},
    });
    expect(v).toMatchObject({ok: true, grantLamports: null, ownerPreLamports: 0n, destinationWithoutSol: true});
    // negative control: the template's amount is not what this tx moved
    expect(
      refusal(t, {
        txSignature: t.signature,
        quote: {feePayer: RELAYER, gasGrantLamports: GRANT},
        authorization: {owner: P0.owner, ata: P0.ata, amount: 400000n, fee: 7000n},
        destinationKind: 'external',
        seedPublicKeys: SEED_KEYS,
        changeCommitment: CHANGE,
        noteMatch: {chainNullifiers: [NULL], answer: [0]},
      }),
    ).toBe('E_A0_VERIFY_AMOUNT');
  });
  it('an unshield larger than the template vault held (2,200,000): the vault held exactly amount + fee and ends at 0', async () => {
    let raw: RecordedChain['transactions'][string] | undefined;
    const t = await appendedSynced(chain => {
      const sig = appendWithdraw(chain, {nullifier: NULL, changeCommitment: CHANGE, amount: 5_000_000n, fee: 10_000n}).signature;
      raw = chain.transactions[sig];
      return sig;
    });
    expect(t.withdrawals[0]!.destinationTokenDelta).toBe(5_000_000n);
    expect(t.vaultTokenDelta).toBe(-5_010_000n);
    type Tb = {accountIndex: number; uiTokenAmount: {amount: string}};
    const vault = raw!.transaction.message.accountKeys.indexOf(A0.vault);
    const amountIn = (list: unknown) => (list as Tb[]).find(b => b.accountIndex === vault)!.uiTokenAmount.amount;
    expect([amountIn(raw!.meta.preTokenBalances), amountIn(raw!.meta.postTokenBalances)]).toEqual(['5010000', '0']);
  });
  it('without amount / fee the template\'s 400,000 / 10,000 (unchanged default)', async () => {
    const t = await appendedSynced(chain => appendWithdraw(chain, {nullifier: NULL, changeCommitment: CHANGE}).signature);
    expect(t.withdrawals[0]).toMatchObject({amount: 400000n, fee: 10000n, destinationTokenDelta: 400000n});
    expect(t.vaultTokenDelta).toBe(-410000n);
  });
  it('a deposit of 777 moves 777 into the vault (the template moved 1,000,000)', async () => {
    const t = await appendedSynced(chain => appendDeposit(chain, {amount: 777n, commitment: CHANGE, rho: NULL}).signature);
    expect(t.deposits[0]!.amount).toBe(777n);
    expect(t.vaultTokenDelta).toBe(777n);
  });
  it('a deposit larger than the template depositor held (9,000,000 > 4,000,000) and a pair of 5 + 6', async () => {
    const big = await appendedSynced(chain => appendDeposit(chain, {amount: 9_000_000n, commitment: CHANGE, rho: NULL}).signature);
    expect(big.vaultTokenDelta).toBe(9_000_000n);
    const pair = await appendedSynced(
      chain =>
        appendDepositPair(chain, {amount: 5n, commitment: CHANGE, rho: NULL}, {amount: 6n, commitment: '10'.padEnd(64, '3'), rho: '11'.padEnd(64, '4')})
          .signature,
    );
    expect(pair.deposits.map(d => d.amount)).toEqual([5n, 6n]);
    expect(pair.vaultTokenDelta).toBe(11n);
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * The post-landing verifier (spec 2026-11-08 shielded A0 M1 §6 step 8, I13, S10, m-2; §14 JS
 * "post-landing verification refusing …"). A PURE function over ONE `SyncedTx` (the record the tree
 * sync built, §9 — never a transaction fetched by its signature, I3) and what the wallet itself
 * holds: the quote, the native authorization's `{owner, ata, amount, fee}`, the seed's public-key
 * set (`a0SeedPublicKeys`, Task 2), the change commitment Rust proved, and `matchSpent`'s answer.
 * It makes no request, reads no store and holds no secret. Only an `ok: true` verdict lets the flow
 * (Task 7) mark the note spent, store the change note and promote a `fresh-pending` destination.
 *
 * The rules, each a refusal code of its own (a test names the rule that fired):
 *   - SIGNERS: no signer is a key of this seed (`E_A0_VERIFY_SEED_SIGNER`, checked first), and the
 *     signers are exactly `[the quote's feePayer]` (`E_A0_VERIFY_SIGNERS`);
 *   - FEE PAYER: the tx's fee payer (static key 0) and the instruction's `fee_payer` account are the
 *     quote's, which is the pinned relayer key (controller ruling 9);
 *   - SHAPE: the top-level programs are only ComputeBudget, the ATA program, the System program and
 *     FeGSS…; exactly one FeGSS… instruction, and it is a `withdraw_with_change` on pool 8VMe… /
 *     tree 5URd… (the record holds only those, §9); every top-level System instruction is a decoded
 *     `transfer` and every ATA instruction a decoded create-idempotent (none hides from the rules
 *     below);
 *   - NULLIFIER: exactly one admitted `Withdraw` event, equal to the instruction's nullifier (two
 *     CHAIN values), and `matchSpent` was asked about exactly this tx's nullifiers and attributed
 *     them to the note being spent (`[0]` for `ownRhos = [that note's rho]`) — never a JS compare
 *     with a nullifier the wallet holds (R12);
 *   - CHANGE LEAF: exactly one admitted `LeafInserted`; it and the instruction's change commitment
 *     equal Rust's change commitment (m-4: the only independent check JS has of it);
 *   - FEE DESTINATION = ATA(feePayer, mint) (derived here); FEE = ours; DESTINATION = our ATA, which
 *     is ATA(owner, mint) derived here; AMOUNT: the instruction's amount is ours, the destination's
 *     token delta is exactly ours and the vault's is exactly −(amount + fee);
 *   - CREATE-ATA: exactly one create-ATA-idempotent, `(payer feePayer, ata, owner, mint)` — the
 *     uniform shape is REQUIRED now P2 is live (controller ruling 3; a relayed tx without it refuses);
 *   - SEED KEYS: the only key of this seed the tx lists at all is the destination owner;
 *   - THE GRANT (S10, m-2): on top-level `SystemProgram.transfer`s only, never on balance deltas (the
 *     inner system calls of the ATA program and FeGSS… are not in the record, §9): at most one; if
 *     one, the quote carries a grant and the transfer is exactly `gasGrantLamports`, from the fee
 *     payer to the owner, whose pre-balance in this tx was 0 and who is on the Ed25519 curve.
 * Accepted without a grant: an owner holding 0 lamports (off curve, or withheld by P1's per-owner
 * marker). For a `fresh-pending` destination that is REPORTED (`destinationWithoutSol`): the exit is
 * ours, the account holds no SOL, and the wallet still never funds it (§6 step 10).
 */
import {PublicKey} from '@solana/web3.js';
import {A0, A0_RELAYER, ASSOCIATED_TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID, SYSTEM_PROGRAM_ID} from './constants';
import type {A0AccountRole} from './accountRegistry';
import {a0AtaOf} from './relayerClient';
import type {A0RelayerQuote} from './relayerClient';
import type {A0LeafInserted, A0SyncedTx} from './syncedTx';

/** The Compute Budget program: the relayer sets the CU limit (200,000) with it. */
export const COMPUTE_BUDGET_PROGRAM_ID = 'ComputeBudget111111111111111111111111111111';

/** The only programs a relayed withdraw may call at the top level. */
export const A0_RELAYED_TOP_LEVEL_PROGRAMS: readonly string[] = [
  COMPUTE_BUDGET_PROGRAM_ID,
  ASSOCIATED_TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
  SYSTEM_PROGRAM_ID,
  A0.programId,
];

export type A0VerifyRefusal =
  /** the wallet's own inputs are not usable (owner not a canonical key, ata ≠ ATA(owner), quote fee payer not pinned) */
  | 'E_A0_VERIFY_ARGS'
  /** the tx is not the one the relayer said it landed */
  | 'E_A0_VERIFY_SIGNATURE'
  /** a signer is a key of this seed */
  | 'E_A0_VERIFY_SEED_SIGNER'
  /** the signers are not exactly [the quote's fee payer] */
  | 'E_A0_VERIFY_SIGNERS'
  /** the tx's or the instruction's fee payer is not the quote's */
  | 'E_A0_VERIFY_FEE_PAYER'
  /** a top-level program outside the relayed shape, or an undecoded System / ATA instruction */
  | 'E_A0_VERIFY_PROGRAMS'
  /** not exactly one withdraw_with_change on pool 8VMe… / tree 5URd… */
  | 'E_A0_VERIFY_WITHDRAW'
  /** the Withdraw event / matchSpent do not attribute the spend to the note being spent */
  | 'E_A0_VERIFY_NULLIFIER'
  /** the change leaf is not exactly one LeafInserted carrying Rust's change commitment */
  | 'E_A0_VERIFY_CHANGE_LEAF'
  | 'E_A0_VERIFY_FEE_DESTINATION'
  | 'E_A0_VERIFY_FEE'
  | 'E_A0_VERIFY_DESTINATION'
  /** the instruction's amount, the destination's token delta or the vault's is not ours */
  | 'E_A0_VERIFY_AMOUNT'
  /** not exactly one create-ATA-idempotent (feePayer, ata, owner, mint) */
  | 'E_A0_VERIFY_CREATE_ATA'
  /** a key of this seed other than the destination owner appears in the tx */
  | 'E_A0_VERIFY_SEED_KEY'
  /** more than one top-level transfer */
  | 'E_A0_VERIFY_GRANT_COUNT'
  /** the transfer is not exactly the quote's grant from the fee payer to the owner (or the quote has none) */
  | 'E_A0_VERIFY_GRANT_TERMS'
  /** a grant to an owner whose pre-balance in the tx was not 0 */
  | 'E_A0_VERIFY_GRANT_PRE_BALANCE'
  /** a grant to an owner off the Ed25519 curve */
  | 'E_A0_VERIFY_GRANT_OFF_CURVE';

/** The destination's kind: a registry role, or an address outside this seed. */
export type A0DestinationKind = A0AccountRole | 'external';

export interface A0LandedUnshieldExpectation {
  /** the signature the relayer returned; null when the tx was found by matchSpent (reconcile) */
  txSignature: string | null;
  quote: Pick<A0RelayerQuote, 'feePayer' | 'gasGrantLamports'>;
  /** the native authorization's values (§4), and the fee the user approved */
  authorization: {owner: string; ata: string; amount: bigint; fee: bigint};
  destinationKind: A0DestinationKind;
  /** `a0SeedPublicKeys(seed)`: every registry entry, the seed's `cli` key and `slip10:0` */
  seedPublicKeys: readonly string[];
  /** the change commitment Rust proved (the proof's public input), 64 lowercase hex */
  changeCommitment: string;
  /** `a0MatchSpent(handle, chainNullifiers, [rho of the note being spent])`: what was asked and the answer */
  noteMatch: {chainNullifiers: readonly string[]; answer: readonly number[]};
}

export type A0LandedUnshieldVerdict =
  | {
      ok: true;
      signature: string;
      /** the change note's leaf (its commitment is Rust's) */
      changeLeaf: A0LeafInserted;
      /** the grant the owner received in this tx, or null */
      grantLamports: bigint | null;
      /** the owner's lamports before this tx */
      ownerPreLamports: bigint;
      /** a `fresh-pending` destination that got no grant and holds 0 lamports: shown as "no SOL" */
      destinationWithoutSol: boolean;
    }
  | {ok: false; code: A0VerifyRefusal; detail: string};

const refuse = (code: A0VerifyRefusal, detail: string): A0LandedUnshieldVerdict => ({ok: false, code, detail});

function canonicalKey(s: string): PublicKey | null {
  try {
    const k = new PublicKey(s);
    return k.toBase58() === s ? k : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** §6 step 8: may the wallet believe this landed unshield? Pure; see the module comment. */
export function verifyLandedUnshield(
  tx: A0SyncedTx,
  expect: A0LandedUnshieldExpectation,
): A0LandedUnshieldVerdict {
  const {quote, authorization: auth} = expect;
  const owner = canonicalKey(auth.owner);
  if (!owner) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_ARGS', 'the owner is not a canonical public key');
  }
  if (a0AtaOf(owner).toBase58() !== auth.ata) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_ARGS', 'the authorization\'s ata is not ATA(owner, mint)');
  }
  if (quote.feePayer !== A0_RELAYER.feePayer) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_ARGS', 'the quote\'s fee payer is not the pinned relayer key');
  }
  if (auth.amount <= 0n || auth.fee < 0n) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_ARGS', 'amount must be positive and fee not negative');
  }
  if (expect.txSignature !== null && tx.signature !== expect.txSignature) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_SIGNATURE', `${tx.signature} is not the relayed ${expect.txSignature}`);
  }
  const seed = new Set(expect.seedPublicKeys);

  // signers and fee payer
  const seedSigner = tx.signers.find(s => seed.has(s));
  if (seedSigner !== undefined) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_SEED_SIGNER', `${seedSigner} is a key of this seed and signed the tx`);
  }
  if (tx.signers.length !== 1 || tx.signers[0] !== quote.feePayer) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_SIGNERS', `signers ${tx.signers.join(',')} are not [${quote.feePayer}]`);
  }
  if (tx.feePayer !== quote.feePayer) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_FEE_PAYER', `the tx's fee payer ${tx.feePayer} is not the quote's`);
  }

  // shape
  const foreign = tx.topLevelPrograms.find(p => !A0_RELAYED_TOP_LEVEL_PROGRAMS.includes(p));
  if (foreign !== undefined) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_PROGRAMS', `top-level program ${foreign} is not in the relayed shape`);
  }
  const count = (p: string) => tx.topLevelPrograms.filter(x => x === p).length;
  if (count(A0.programId) !== 1) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_PROGRAMS', `${count(A0.programId)} top-level FeGSS… instructions`);
  }
  if (count(SYSTEM_PROGRAM_ID) !== tx.systemTransfers.length) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_PROGRAMS', 'a top-level System instruction is not a transfer');
  }
  if (count(ASSOCIATED_TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID) !== tx.createAtaIdempotent.length) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_PROGRAMS', 'a top-level ATA instruction is not a create-idempotent');
  }
  if (tx.withdrawals.length !== 1 || tx.deposits.length !== 0) {
    return refuse(
      'E_A0_VERIFY_WITHDRAW',
      `${tx.withdrawals.length} withdraw_with_change and ${tx.deposits.length} deposits on pool ${A0.pool}`,
    );
  }
  const w = tx.withdrawals[0]!;
  if (w.feePayer !== quote.feePayer) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_FEE_PAYER', `the instruction's fee_payer ${w.feePayer} is not the quote's`);
  }

  // the spend: chain values and matchSpent's attribution
  if (tx.withdrawNullifiers.length !== 1 || tx.withdrawNullifiers[0] !== w.nullifier) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_NULLIFIER', `${tx.withdrawNullifiers.length} Withdraw events, or one that is not the instruction's`);
  }
  const asked = expect.noteMatch.chainNullifiers;
  if (asked.length !== 1 || asked[0] !== tx.withdrawNullifiers[0]) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_NULLIFIER', 'matchSpent was not asked about this tx\'s Withdraw nullifier');
  }
  const answer = expect.noteMatch.answer;
  if (answer.length !== 1 || answer[0] !== 0) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_NULLIFIER', `matchSpent answered ${JSON.stringify(answer)}: the spend is not the note's`);
  }

  // the change leaf
  if (tx.leafInserted.length !== 1) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_CHANGE_LEAF', `${tx.leafInserted.length} LeafInserted events`);
  }
  const leaf = tx.leafInserted[0]!;
  if (leaf.commitment !== expect.changeCommitment || w.changeCommitment !== expect.changeCommitment) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_CHANGE_LEAF', 'the change leaf is not the commitment Rust proved');
  }

  // fee, destination, amount
  if (w.feeDestination !== a0AtaOf(new PublicKey(quote.feePayer)).toBase58()) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_FEE_DESTINATION', `${w.feeDestination} is not ATA(feePayer, mint)`);
  }
  if (w.fee !== auth.fee) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_FEE', `fee ${w.fee} is not ${auth.fee}`);
  }
  if (w.destination !== auth.ata) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_DESTINATION', `destination ${w.destination} is not our ${auth.ata}`);
  }
  if (w.amount !== auth.amount) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_AMOUNT', `instruction amount ${w.amount} is not ${auth.amount}`);
  }
  if (w.destinationTokenDelta !== auth.amount) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_AMOUNT', `the destination received ${String(w.destinationTokenDelta)}, not ${auth.amount}`);
  }
  if (tx.vaultTokenDelta !== -(auth.amount + auth.fee)) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_AMOUNT', `the vault moved ${tx.vaultTokenDelta}, not −${auth.amount + auth.fee}`);
  }

  // create-ATA-idempotent: required, exactly ours
  if (tx.createAtaIdempotent.length !== 1) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_CREATE_ATA', `${tx.createAtaIdempotent.length} create-ATA-idempotent instructions, not 1`);
  }
  const c = tx.createAtaIdempotent[0]!;
  if (c.payer !== quote.feePayer || c.ata !== auth.ata || c.owner !== auth.owner || c.mint !== A0.mint) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_CREATE_ATA', 'the create-ATA is not (feePayer, ata, owner, mint)');
  }

  // the seed: only the destination owner may appear
  const seedKey = tx.preBalances.find(p => seed.has(p.address) && p.address !== auth.owner);
  if (seedKey !== undefined) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_SEED_KEY', `${seedKey.address}, a key of this seed, appears in the tx`);
  }

  // the grant (S10, m-2): top-level transfers only
  const ownerPre = tx.preBalances.find(p => p.address === auth.owner)?.lamports;
  if (ownerPre === undefined) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_DESTINATION', 'the owner is not listed by the tx');
  }
  if (tx.systemTransfers.length > 1) {
    return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_GRANT_COUNT', `${tx.systemTransfers.length} top-level transfers`);
  }
  let grantLamports: bigint | null = null;
  if (tx.systemTransfers.length === 1) {
    const g = tx.systemTransfers[0]!;
    // a quote without a grant (null) matches no transfer's lamports: refused here too
    if (g.lamports !== quote.gasGrantLamports || g.from !== quote.feePayer || g.to !== auth.owner) {
      return refuse(
        'E_A0_VERIFY_GRANT_TERMS',
        `transfer ${g.lamports} ${g.from} → ${g.to} is not the quote's ${String(quote.gasGrantLamports)} feePayer → owner`,
      );
    }
    if (ownerPre !== 0n) {
      return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_GRANT_PRE_BALANCE', `the owner held ${ownerPre} lamports before the grant`);
    }
    if (!PublicKey.isOnCurve(owner.toBytes())) {
      return refuse('E_A0_VERIFY_GRANT_OFF_CURVE', 'a grant to an owner off the Ed25519 curve');
    }
    grantLamports = g.lamports;
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    signature: tx.signature,
    changeLeaf: leaf,
    grantLamports,
    ownerPreLamports: ownerPre,
    destinationWithoutSol: expect.destinationKind === 'fresh-pending' && grantLamports === null && ownerPre === 0n,
  };
}
```

#### Notes for the executor (Task 4)

- **The rulings this task took (each the most secure default; the owner may overturn any):**
  - **Fields, not bytes.** Task 3's hand-over suggested comparing the landed instruction with `buildA0WithdrawChangeIx(payload)`.
    The brief's row makes the verifier a pure function over ONE `SyncedTx`, and §9's record carries the decoded fields, not
    the instruction's bytes or account flags; reopening the sync to keep them is outside M1c (§9: "M1c consumes it, does
    not reopen the sync"). The fields cover every value that is OURS: the nullifier (by `matchSpent`), the change commitment,
    the amount, the fee, the destination, the fee payer and the fee destination. The rest — the root, the proof, the
    nullifier-record PDA, `wchange_vk` — the chain itself checked when the tx succeeded: the program verifies the proof
    against `[root, nullifier, amount, recipientField(destination), mintHash, change, fee]`. Task 3's byte-for-byte golden
    already holds OUR encoder to the landed bytes. Cost if wrong: none for safety; a byte compare can be added beside
    the fields if §9 ever keeps the raw instruction.
  - **The redundant "no grant in the quote" branch was removed** after mutation V30 survived as an equivalent mutant: a
    quote without a grant (`null`) equals no transfer's lamports, so the one comparison refuses it with the same code.
  - **The shape is closed** (beyond §6.8's letter): top-level programs only ComputeBudget, ATA, System, FeGSS…; exactly one
    FeGSS… instruction; every top-level System instruction must decode as a `transfer` and every ATA instruction as a
    create-idempotent. Without it, a top-level `TransferWithSeed` to the owner, or a non-idempotent ATA instruction, would
    sit outside the grant and create-ATA rules (the record only holds what it decoded). All four landed txs fit; the
    contract is frozen, so an extra instruction is an unannounced change. Cost if wrong: an unshield whose landed tx carries
    an instruction the contract never announced is refused until a release — visible, never silent.
  - **Signers exactly `[quote.feePayer]`** (the desk's ruling 5, applied here too) AFTER the seed-signer rule, so a seed
    signer is always reported as `E_A0_VERIFY_SEED_SIGNER` (the I13 row) and any other extra signer as
    `E_A0_VERIFY_SIGNERS`. The quote's fee payer must equal the pin `A0_RELAYER.feePayer` (ruling 9) even though
    `parseA0RelayerQuote` already pinned it — the verifier does not rely on its caller.
  - **The vault's token delta** must be exactly −(amount + fee), beside the destination's +amount (§6.8 "the token amount
    moved is ours"). The fee destination's delta is not in the record (§9); the fee is held by the instruction and the
    vault delta together.
  - **`matchSpent` is passed in, asked about the tx's own nullifiers.** The verifier stays pure (no handle, no await): the
    caller asks `a0MatchSpent(handle, tx.withdrawNullifiers, [the note's rho])` and passes what it asked AND the answer; the
    verifier refuses if it was asked about anything else or the answer is not `[0]`. The event's nullifier is compared with
    the instruction's — two CHAIN values; no nullifier the wallet holds is compared in JS (R12).
  - **`destinationWithoutSol` only for `fresh-pending`.** §6.8 reports "a `fresh-pending` destination" without a grant; a main
    or external owner at 0 lamports is not reported (the main may simply be empty; an external address is not ours to
    describe). A `fresh-pending` owner that already held SOL (it was not fresh after all) is accepted and not reported;
    no rule of §6.8 refuses it, and the funds landed.
  - **A refusal is not a "not landed".** The verdict says the tx is not the unshield we approved; the sync remains the
    authority on what landed. Task 7 decides the user-visible state; this task proposes: the note stays `pending` (never
    `unspent` — a refused tx MAY still have spent it), the code is shown, and the reconcile path does not release a
    `fresh-pending` reservation on a refusal.
  - **The test seed set is real.** `a0SeedPublicKeys` over "abandon … about" with main `slip10:0` and one real reservation
    (`reserveA0FreshAccount` with a history fake that answers `[]`) → `[slip10:0, slip10:1, cli]`, held to the offline
    vectors (`a0-account-vectors.json`, Task 2) — so the seed-signer rows test Task 2's set as the flow will pass it.
- **Deviations from the brief:**
  - The positive controls are FOUR, not two: the brief's `47k56NfB…` / `3oHktG2X…` were already recorded by M1b (in
    `devnet-tree-5URd.json`, JSON encoding), so nothing was fetched; Task 3's post-upgrade `5F8Ks5qa…` / `5sKiWZTv…` are
    added so the verifier is proven on the CURRENT binary too. `scripts/a0-fixtures/fetch-devnet-tx.mjs` was not run.
  - "a relayed tx without create-ATA" (ruling 3) has no recorded instance: every relayed withdraw on the tree (P0's
    `3UfCx5TD…` included) carries create-ATA-idempotent. The row removes the instruction and its log frame from each
    recorded positive and re-parses it. The brief's "the pre-P2 recorded `3UfCx5TD…` as its fixture" does not hold: that
    tx HAS the create-ATA (top-level programs ComputeBudget, ATA, FeGSS…); it is used instead as the template of the
    ledger rows, where it passes the verifier.
  - §14's "each against both shapes, with and without create-ATA" becomes: each row against every positive it applies
    to (both shapes of today: with and without the grant); the without-create-ATA shape is itself a refusal row (ruling 3).
  - Added beyond the row: the closed-shape rule (above), the relayed-signature check (`txSignature`), the `deposits`
    count, and the argument checks (`ata = ATA(owner)`, the pinned fee payer, amount > 0, fee ≥ 0).
- **Spec rev 3.4 lines** follow this list. **What the next tasks must know:** see Interfaces → "What later tasks rely on".
  `withOwner` in the test (an owner / ATA substitution over a `SyncedTx`) is test-local; Task 7's fake needs the same
  substitution on the RECORDED tx if it lands to our own destination.
- **Environment:** no network request was made. One full Jest run alone took 55–57 s; the first printed "A worker process has failed to
  exit gracefully" once, next to `backupModule.test.ts`, as in Task 2's runs (not investigated). The red copies and
  every mutation copy under `/home/user/Solana/Project/m1c-mut/` were deleted; nothing is left running.

#### Spec rev 3.4 lines (Task 4)
- §6.8 "verifies on chain": the verifier is `verifyLandedUnshield`, a pure function over the synced record; it compares the
  record's decoded fields, not the instruction's bytes (the chain verified the proof against the public inputs; §9 keeps
  no raw instruction).
- §6.8 create-ATA: since P2 is live (37ad673) exactly one create-ATA-idempotent `(feePayer, ata, owner, mint)` is REQUIRED; a
  relayed tx without it refuses (controller ruling 3).
- §6.8 shape (added): the top-level programs are only ComputeBudget, the ATA program, the System program and FeGSS…; exactly one
  FeGSS… instruction (one `withdraw_with_change` on our pool, no deposit); every top-level System instruction is a transfer
  and every ATA instruction a create-idempotent; the signers are exactly `[the pinned relayer]`, a seed signer refused
  first; the vault's token delta is exactly −(amount + fee).
- §6.8 the spend: `matchSpent` is asked about the tx's Withdraw nullifiers alone and must answer `[0]` for the note being spent;
  the Withdraw event must equal the instruction's nullifier.
- §6.8 "no SOL": reported only for a `fresh-pending` destination without a grant whose owner held 0 lamports.
- §14 JS "each against both shapes, with and without create-ATA" → each row against the four landed positives it applies to
  (with and without the grant); the without-create-ATA shape is a refusal row.
### Task 5: Recovery of change notes and exit accounts, and S15 — `src/modules/shielded/a0/recovery.ts` (spec §7 "Change notes" + "Accounts", §8 `spentTx`, R12, I6, S9; S15; the brief's update R6′). What it adds:
- **the attribution and `spentTx` (§8):** after M1b's ONE `matchSpent` gives the spent-status of the deposit notes, each synced `Withdraw` nullifier `n` (public: it is on chain) is asked about once, locally, `matchSpent(handle, [n], spentRhos)`, in sync order, until every spent note is attributed. The tx carrying `n` becomes that note's `spentTx`. A core that says "spent" and then attributes nothing, or names two notes for one nullifier, is refused (`E_A0_RECOVERY_NATIVE`), so the loop cannot spin;
- **the change notes (§7):** from that tx's `withdraw_with_change` whose nullifier argument is `n`: `rho_change = Poseidon3(0x13, n, 0)` computed in JS (`a0ChangeRho`, the frozen `rhoOut(·, 0)` of `fieldEquations.ts`), `changeAmount = input − amount − fee` from the INSTRUCTION (`a0ChangeAmount`), and Rust's `commitment(changeAmount, rho_change)` must equal the instruction's `change_commitment`; the leaf index is that value's `LeafInserted` in the same tx. The new change notes' spent-status is one more `matchSpent` over every synced nullifier, and the attribution repeats for the spent ones (the recursion). A spend of ours whose change leaf is not ours is counted (`unmatchedChangeLeaves`), never imported, never thrown. A zero change is still a leaf and still a note (amount 0). Two successful withdrawals with one nullifier refuse (`E_A0_RECOVERY_DUPLICATE_NULLIFIER`) — read only when a note of ours is spent;
- **the exit accounts (§7 "Accounts", I6):** the destination of every withdrawal that spent one of OUR notes is compared with `ATA(slip10:n, mint)` for n = 0, 1, … (derived locally), stopping `A0_ACCOUNT_DISCOVERY_GAP` = 20 past the highest match (controller ruling 7) or once every destination matched. `cli` wallets walk nothing (S9). The matches go to Task 2's `addA0RecoveredExitAccounts` as `fresh-exit` (a `fresh-pending` one is promoted; the main stays the main). A restore always creates the registry;
- **the restore's order:** sync → `keysOpen` (on a COPY of the seed, which it wipes) → deposits → change notes → `keysClose` → the account walk (on the caller's seed, wiped at the end) → the REGISTRY write → the NOTES write → R13's stats (five new counters). The registry goes first: the note record's absence is what makes the next start restore again, so a failed registry write leaves a restore that repeats;
- **chain truth for note state (`noteStore.ts` merge):** a chain spend that names its tx now wins over a stored `spent` note too (fills or corrects `spentTx`); a stored pending unshield whose spend landed becomes `spent` with the landed tx (that was already so);
- **the program side's golden change commitments (R6′):** `docs/zk-contract/change-commitment-golden.json` at their 2146368, a byte copy pinned by sha256, COMPARED step by step with our code (`a0ChangeRho`, `a0ChangeAmount`, `fieldEquations.ts`, the offline fake, our pinned `mintHash`), with the three wrong commitments they reject as negative controls;
- **the exit-account vectors:** `slip10:0..30` addresses and their ATAs for both test mnemonics, written by a new offline generator (`scripts/a0-vectors/gen-exit-account-vectors.mjs`: Node crypto, its own Ed25519 decompression check, its own base58; no web3.js, no app code), anchored to the extension's `slip10:0` and to three published ATAs; CI re-derives it with `--check` and a negative control;
- **S15:** `A0_DEPOSIT_GAP_LIMIT` 20 → **100** in recovery, hence in the pre-check's `E_A0_DEPOSIT_PRECHECK_GAP` refusal (it compares against recovery's result), the readout comment, the M1b desk (`A0_GAP_LIMIT`, its test) and the M1b README; the tests move to 99 / 100 / 101 with controls. The account gap stays 20;
- **`@scure/base` declared** in `package.json` (`^2.0.0`, the 2.0.0 the lockfile already resolved as a dependency of `@scure/bip32` / `@scure/bip39`); `depositFlow.ts` is unchanged (ruling below);
- **I-3 still holds with change notes and an exit account in:** the recording-Connection test's chain now carries a change note, a spend of it to the seed's `slip10:1`, and the restore's requests are still EXACTLY the tree sync's; two new positive controls (a balance read of the exit account, a change note's nullifier-PDA lookup) are flagged.

Totals: 62 new Jest tests: 2 new suites (`changeRecovery.test.ts` 32, `changeCommitment.golden.test.ts` 26), plus 4 rows in the existing suites (recovery +1, restoreRequests +2, depositFlow +1); the M1b desk's test edited in place; one new offline generator with a CI `--check` and its negative control; 26 named mutations, 26/26 red (first round: 1 survivor closed, 1 hang turned into a fast failure). No Rust, Kotlin or Android change.

**Spec:** §7 "Change notes" ("for each spent note, its spending tx is the `SyncedTx` whose `Withdraw` nullifier `matchSpent` attributed to it (already synced; that nullifier is public now). `rho_change = Poseidon3(TAG_RHO, nullifier, 0)` (JS can compute it: the nullifier is public), the amount is the input minus the instruction's `amount` minus its `fee`, the leaf index and commitment come from its `LeafInserted`, and `commitment(changeAmount, rho_change)` must equal that commitment. Recurse. *(Rev 3.3: … the attribution is one further local `matchSpent(handle, [n], spentRhos)` per synced `Withdraw` nullifier, in M1c; M1b leaves `spentTx` unset.)*"); §7 "Accounts" ("each recovered unshield's `destination` token account is compared with `ATA(slip10:n, mint)` for `n = 0, 1, 2, …` (derived locally); a match adds `slip10:n` to the registry as `fresh-exit`. Stop after 20 consecutive indices without a match past the highest match … it is local, so it reveals nothing to the RPC"); §7 "Deposits" (the gap limit, now S15's 100); §7 intro ("It makes no RPC request specific to one of our notes (I3)"); §3 "Change note" and "No pre-spend nullifier in JS (R12)"; §8 (`spentTx`: "only `spent` carries `spentTx`"); §14 JS ("**restore makes no note-specific request (I-3)**"; "change-note and account recovery on recorded fixtures, and our recomputed change commitment against the program side's golden `changeCommitment` row (§15) (M1c)"); §15 ("a golden `changeCommitment` row with its inputs … needed for M1c's change-note recovery test"). Decisions S15 ("The deposit-recovery gap limit is raised from 20 to 100 … Applies to recovery (§7) and every place the limit appears (pre-check GAP refusal, readout, README); lands with M1c"). The brief's Task 5 row; controller ruling 7 (the account gap stays 20) and update R6′ (the golden exists; copy, pin, COMPARE); Task 2's hand-over (`addA0RecoveredExitAccounts`, `A0_ACCOUNT_DISCOVERY_GAP`, "a restore must create the registry even with no match"). **Not here:**
- the unshield flow's settle path (Task 7). It stores the change note it proved, and it should store it exactly as a restore would (Interfaces, "What later tasks rely on");
- the readout of the new counters and the checkpoint's restore lines (Task 9);
- the spec text itself: its S15 and §7 edits are listed under "Spec rev 3.4 lines";
- **no Rust change.** §7 needs no native call M1a does not export (`matchSpent`, `commitment` and `keysOpen` / `keysClose` are enough), so no cargo gate applies. The golden's `nk` / `change_d` cannot be fed through the bridge (`keysOpen` takes a seed); the Rust half is held through the key vectors (Notes). No Kotlin or Android file changes, so no Gradle gate applies.

- Produces — `src/modules/shielded/a0/recovery.ts`:
  ```ts
  export const A0_DEPOSIT_GAP_LIMIT = 100;                       // S15 (was 20)
  export type A0RecoveryErrorCode = 'E_A0_RECOVERY_LEAF' | 'E_A0_RECOVERY_DUPLICATE_RHO' | 'E_A0_RECOVERY_NATIVE'
    | 'E_A0_RECOVERY_DUPLICATE_NULLIFIER';                       // new
  export function a0ChangeRho(nullifierHex: string): string;     // Poseidon3(0x13, n, 0) of a PUBLIC nullifier, 64 hex
  export function a0ChangeAmount(inputAmount: bigint, withdrawAmount: bigint, fee: bigint): bigint | null;   // null: spend > input
  export interface A0ChangeRecovery {
    notes: A0Note[];               // the deposits given (spent ones now with spentTx), then the change notes, in the order found
    changeNotes: number;
    unmatchedChangeLeaves: number; // spends of ours whose change leaf is not ours — not imported
    exitDestinations: string[];    // destination token accounts of withdrawals that spent our notes, distinct
    attributionCalls: number;      // the local matchSpent([n], …) calls
  }
  export async function recoverA0ChangeNotes(handle: A0Handle, tree: A0VerifiedTree, deposits: readonly A0Note[]): Promise<A0ChangeRecovery>;
  export interface A0ExitAccountRecovery { indices: number[]; tried: number }
  export function recoverA0ExitAccountIndices(seed: Uint8Array, destinations: readonly string[]): A0ExitAccountRecovery;   // local; writes nothing
  // A0RestoreStats gains: changeNotes, unmatchedChangeLeaves, attributionCalls, accountIndicesTried, exitAccounts (numbers);
  //   ownNotes / spentNotes now count change notes too
  // A0RestoreResult gains: exitAccounts: string[]   (the schemes added to, or promoted in, the registry)
  // restoreA0FromSeed(connection, seed, {sync?, bound?}) — same signature; also writes v1_accounts (before v1_a0_notes)
  ```
- Produces — `src/modules/shielded/a0/noteStore.ts`: `mergeA0RecoveredNotes` — same signature; a recovered `spent` note that names its `spentTx` replaces a stored `spent` note (one without `spentTx` does not).
- Produces — `src/modules/shielded/a0/__testing__/ownHistory.ts` (test-only): `appendWithdraw(chain, {nullifier, changeCommitment, amount?, fee?, to?: {owner, ata}})`; `appendWithdrawPair(chain, first, second)` (two `withdraw_with_change` in ONE tx, the second's change leaf not the first `LeafInserted`).
- **What later tasks rely on:**
  - **Task 7** (the settle path) stores the change note of a landed unshield. To agree with a later restore it must store exactly `{commitment: <proof public input 5>, amount: a0ChangeAmount(note.amount, amount, fee), rho: a0ChangeRho(<the in-flight nullifier, public input 1>), leafIndex: verdict.changeLeaf.leafIndex, status: 'unspent'}` — no `depositIndex` — and mark the spent note `spent` with `spentTx = verdict.signature`. A zero change is stored too (amount 0). `a0ChangeRho` is the one JS use of the in-flight nullifier besides the payload: compute it before the nullifier is dropped. After that the store holds the change note's rho, never its nullifier;
  - **Task 7** (reconcile): a restore while an unshield is pending turns the note `spent` with the landed tx when the chain shows the spend (chain truth); while the chain does not, the pending unshield is left for Task 7's reconciliation (M1b's merge rule, unchanged). A `fresh-pending` destination the restore finds landed is promoted by the restore itself (`addA0RecoveredExitAccounts`), so Task 7's `promoteA0FreshAccount` must accept `'already'` (it does, Task 2);
  - **Task 9** reads the restore's counts from `A0RestoreStats` (`ownNotes`, `spentNotes`, `changeNotes`, `exitAccounts`, `accountIndicesTried`, `unmatchedChangeLeaves`) and the restored registry from `loadA0AccountRegistry()`; none of the five new counters is read out yet (`checkpointReadout.ts` builds its payload from a fixed list). The M1b README's expected deposit-walk numbers are now 102 / 101.

**The rule, stated once.** A restore believes the chain and the seed, nothing else: a note is ours only if Rust's commitment
says so, it is spent only if Rust's `matchSpent` says so, the tx that spent it is the one whose public nullifier Rust
names, and its change is ours only if Rust's commitment of OUR equation (the instruction's amount and fee, `rho_change`
from the public nullifier, `d_self`) equals the leaf. Every comparison is local; the requests are the sync's and no
other.

Create `scripts/a0-vectors/gen-exit-account-vectors.mjs`:

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * Offline generator of the exit-account vectors the A0 restore's account walk is tested against
 * (spec 2026-11-08 shielded A0 M1 §7 "Accounts": "each recovered unshield's destination token
 * account is compared with ATA(slip10:n, mint) for n = 0, 1, 2, …"; M1c Task 5).
 *
 * THE ANTI-CIRCULARITY BOUNDARY. The app derives `slip10:n` with core/keys/transparent.ts
 * (micro-key-producer/slip10 + @noble/curves) and the ATA with @solana/web3.js
 * `findProgramAddressSync` (relayerClient.ts `a0AtaOf`). Nothing here imports either, nor any
 * base58 or curve library: every value comes from Node's own crypto (OpenSSL) and the few lines
 * below —
 *   - the BIP-39 seed: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512, 2048 rounds, salt "mnemonic";
 *   - SLIP-0010 ed25519 (hardened only), path m/44'/501'/n'/0'; the public key through OpenSSL
 *     (PKCS#8 private key → SPKI export) — as gen-account-vectors.mjs (Task 2) does;
 *   - the ATA: the program-derived address of [owner, TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID, mint] under the associated
 *     token program — SHA-256(seeds ‖ [bump] ‖ program id ‖ "ProgramDerivedAddress"), bump from
 *     255 down, the first candidate that is NOT an Ed25519 point. "Is a point" is curve25519-dalek's
 *     `CompressedEdwardsY::decompress().is_some()` (what Solana's `is_on_curve` calls): y = the 255
 *     low bits little-endian (mod p), u = y² − 1, v = d·y² + 1, and u/v must be a square mod p
 *     (Euler's criterion, 0 included) — with BigInt arithmetic here;
 *   - base58: the Bitcoin alphabet, by BigInt division.
 * Before anything is written the script holds itself to facts it did not compute:
 *   - slip10:0 of "abandon … about" is HAgk14JpMQLgt6rVgv7cBQFJWFto5Dqxi472uT3DKpqk (the extension's
 *     published vector; also a0-account-vectors.json), and slip10:0..3 of both mnemonics equal
 *     a0-account-vectors.json (Task 2's independent run);
 *   - three ATAs the program side and the chain published: ATA(relayer fee payer 3jvhiz…FaGe) =
 *     9643JXJm…knME9 (the relayer's fee destination, src/modules/shielded/a0/constants.ts
 *     A0_RELAYER.feeDestination), ATA(pool 8VMe…, an off-curve owner) = 3A7JjFg4…juYC (the pool's
 *     vault, A0.vault) and ATA(HV996…ZxdJR) = DzU8HkTy…67Zt (the destination the relayer created
 *     in the landed 3UfCx5TD…, recorded in fixtures/devnet-tree-5URd.json).
 *
 * Output: src/modules/shielded/a0/__tests__/fixtures/a0-exit-account-vectors.json — for both
 * mnemonics, slip10:0 … slip10:30 with address and ATA. Run by hand from the repository root:
 *   node scripts/a0-vectors/gen-exit-account-vectors.mjs           write the fixture
 *   node scripts/a0-vectors/gen-exit-account-vectors.mjs --check   regenerate and compare, write nothing
 */
import {createHash, createHmac, createPrivateKey, createPublicKey, pbkdf2Sync} from 'node:crypto';
import {readFileSync, writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {dirname, join, relative, resolve} from 'node:path';
import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';

const ROOT = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');
const OUT = join(ROOT, 'src/modules/shielded/a0/__tests__/fixtures/a0-exit-account-vectors.json');
const ACCOUNT_VECTORS = join(ROOT, 'src/modules/shielded/a0/__tests__/fixtures/a0-account-vectors.json');
const OUT_REL = relative(ROOT, OUT);

const fail = msg => {
  console.error(`gen-exit-account-vectors: ${msg}`);
  process.exit(1);
};

const MNEMONICS = [
  'abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about',
  'zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo wrong',
];
const LAST_INDEX = 30;
const MINT = 'ERkpCFGaoWmeZPhKTUHumrqHTP1QmyHVhMJUnxbRPKCs';
const TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID = 'TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA';
const ASSOCIATED_TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID = 'ATokenGPvbdGVxr1b2hvZbsiqW5xWH25efTNsLJA8knL';
const ANCHOR_ACCOUNT = 'HAgk14JpMQLgt6rVgv7cBQFJWFto5Dqxi472uT3DKpqk';
const ANCHOR_ATAS = [
  {owner: '3jvhiz9qcJAe2zGHvRAiRYXiaFCdjEQrB9KuE5NuFaGe', ata: '9643JXJm5ZZwv8yaTozQ2qMeVw6xHQWhquGsD87knME9', what: 'the relayer fee destination'},
  {owner: '8VMe4iZWiq3xQySywih9cciAmzTxMtkawMRYK6JuDdoT', ata: '3A7JjFg4ZbZrEsvAZReSaWxjCvi5NZUTAyAZaLfQjuYC', what: 'the pool vault'},
  {owner: 'HV996fcQT193sXfh3fgCEDjxsWwWxQC6cVdb1EyZxdJR', ata: 'DzU8HkTy7b5jK8LvahytrsgimF9Navxc9HgzA7y167Zt', what: '3UfCx5TD…\'s destination'},
];

const B58 = '123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz';
function base58(bytes) {
  let n = BigInt(`0x${Buffer.from(bytes).toString('hex') || '0'}`);
  let out = '';
  while (n > 0n) {
    out = B58[Number(n % 58n)] + out;
    n /= 58n;
  }
  for (const b of bytes) {
    if (b !== 0) break;
    out = `1${out}`;
  }
  return out;
}
function unbase58(s) {
  let n = 0n;
  for (const ch of s) {
    const v = B58.indexOf(ch);
    if (v < 0) fail(`not base58: ${s}`);
    n = n * 58n + BigInt(v);
  }
  let hex = n.toString(16);
  if (hex.length % 2) hex = `0${hex}`;
  const body = n === 0n ? Buffer.alloc(0) : Buffer.from(hex, 'hex');
  let zeros = 0;
  while (s[zeros] === '1') zeros++;
  const out = Buffer.concat([Buffer.alloc(zeros), body]);
  if (out.length !== 32) fail(`${s} is ${out.length} bytes, not 32`);
  return out;
}

const seedOf = mnemonic => pbkdf2Sync(Buffer.from(mnemonic.normalize('NFKD')), Buffer.from('mnemonic'), 2048, 64, 'sha512');

function slip10Ed25519(seed, path) {
  let I = createHmac('sha512', 'ed25519 seed').update(seed).digest();
  let k = I.subarray(0, 32);
  let c = I.subarray(32);
  for (const i of path) {
    const data = Buffer.alloc(37);
    k.copy(data, 1);
    data.writeUInt32BE((i + 0x80000000) >>> 0, 33);
    I = createHmac('sha512', c).update(data).digest();
    k = I.subarray(0, 32);
    c = I.subarray(32);
  }
  return Buffer.from(k);
}

const PKCS8_ED25519 = Buffer.from('302e020100300506032b657004220420', 'hex');
function ed25519Public(privateKey32) {
  const priv = createPrivateKey({key: Buffer.concat([PKCS8_ED25519, privateKey32]), format: 'der', type: 'pkcs8'});
  const spki = createPublicKey(priv).export({format: 'der', type: 'spki'});
  if (spki.length !== 44) fail(`unexpected SPKI length ${spki.length}`);
  return spki.subarray(12);
}

// ---- Ed25519 "is a point" (curve25519-dalek CompressedEdwardsY::decompress), BigInt
const P = 2n ** 255n - 19n;
const D = (((-121665n * modPow(121666n, P - 2n)) % P) + P) % P;
function modPow(b, e) {
  let r = 1n;
  b %= P;
  while (e > 0n) {
    if (e & 1n) r = (r * b) % P;
    b = (b * b) % P;
    e >>= 1n;
  }
  return r;
}
function isOnCurve(bytes32) {
  const le = Buffer.from(bytes32).reverse();
  const y = (BigInt(`0x${le.toString('hex')}`) & ((1n << 255n) - 1n)) % P;
  const yy = (y * y) % P;
  const u = (yy - 1n + P) % P;
  const v = (D * yy + 1n) % P;
  const ratio = (u * modPow(v, P - 2n)) % P;
  if (ratio === 0n) return true;
  return modPow(ratio, (P - 1n) / 2n) === 1n;
}
if (D !== 37095705934669439343138083508754565189542113879843219016388785533085940283555n) fail('d is wrong');

function ataOf(ownerBase58) {
  const seeds = [unbase58(ownerBase58), unbase58(TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID), unbase58(MINT)];
  const program = unbase58(ASSOCIATED_TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID);
  for (let bump = 255; bump >= 0; bump--) {
    const h = createHash('sha256');
    for (const s of seeds) h.update(s);
    h.update(Buffer.from([bump])).update(program).update(Buffer.from('ProgramDerivedAddress'));
    const candidate = h.digest();
    if (!isOnCurve(candidate)) return base58(candidate);
  }
  fail(`no bump for ${ownerBase58}`);
}

for (const a of ANCHOR_ATAS) {
  const got = ataOf(a.owner);
  if (got !== a.ata) fail(`ATA(${a.owner}) is ${got}, not ${a.ata} (${a.what})`);
}

const accountVectors = JSON.parse(readFileSync(ACCOUNT_VECTORS, 'utf8'));
const seeds = MNEMONICS.map(mnemonic => {
  const seed = seedOf(mnemonic);
  const known = accountVectors.seeds.find(s => s.mnemonic === mnemonic);
  if (!known || known.seed !== seed.toString('hex')) fail(`the seed of "${mnemonic}" differs from a0-account-vectors.json`);
  const accounts = [];
  for (let n = 0; n <= LAST_INDEX; n++) {
    const address = base58(ed25519Public(slip10Ed25519(seed, [44, 501, n, 0])));
    const k = known.accounts.find(a => a.scheme === `slip10:${n}`);
    if (k && k.address !== address) fail(`slip10:${n} of "${mnemonic}" differs from a0-account-vectors.json`);
    accounts.push({scheme: `slip10:${n}`, address, ata: ataOf(address)});
  }
  return {mnemonic, accounts};
});
if (seeds[0].accounts[0].address !== ANCHOR_ACCOUNT) fail(`slip10:0 is ${seeds[0].accounts[0].address}, not ${ANCHOR_ACCOUNT}`);
const all = seeds.flatMap(s => s.accounts.flatMap(a => [a.address, a.ata]));
if (new Set(all).size !== all.length) fail('two vectors share an address');

const doc = {
  description:
    `slip10:n (SLIP-0010 ed25519 m/44'/501'/n'/0') addresses and their associated token accounts for the A0 mint ${MINT}, n = 0..${LAST_INDEX} (spec §7 "Accounts"). ` +
    'Written by scripts/a0-vectors/gen-exit-account-vectors.mjs from Node crypto (PBKDF2, HMAC-SHA512, OpenSSL Ed25519, SHA-256), its own Ed25519 decompression check and its own base58; it imports neither core/keys/transparent.ts nor @solana/web3.js nor micro-key-producer nor @noble. ' +
    'Anchored to the extension\'s slip10:0 vector, to a0-account-vectors.json and to three published ATAs (relayer fee destination, pool vault, 3UfCx5TD…\'s destination). Rerun: node scripts/a0-vectors/gen-exit-account-vectors.mjs [--check].',
  mint: MINT,
  seeds,
};
const text = `${JSON.stringify(doc, null, 2)}\n`;

if (process.argv.includes('--check')) {
  const current = readFileSync(OUT, 'utf8');
  if (current !== text) fail(`${OUT_REL} differs from a fresh run`);
  console.log(`gen-exit-account-vectors: ${OUT_REL} matches (${seeds.length} seeds × ${seeds[0].accounts.length} accounts)`);
} else {
  writeFileSync(OUT, text);
  console.log(`gen-exit-account-vectors: wrote ${OUT_REL} (${seeds.length} seeds × ${seeds[0].accounts.length} accounts)`);
}
```

```diff
+    data,
+    blobs: [leafBlob(LEAF_INSERTED, second.changeCommitment, leafIndex, root), Uint8Array.from([...fromHex(WITHDRAW), ...fromHex(second.nullifier)])],
+  });
+  // the tx's net movement is both unshields
+  moveTokens(tx, [
+    {index: ix.accounts[2]!, delta: -(firstAmount + firstFee + second.amount + second.fee)},
+    {index: ix.accounts[3]!, delta: firstAmount + second.amount},
+    {index: ix.accounts[6]!, delta: firstFee + second.fee},
+  ]);
+  return {signature: a.signature, leafIndices: [a.leafIndex, leafIndex]};
+}
```

```ts
/**
 * The change note's equations against the program side's circuit-validated golden vectors (spec §3
 * "Change note", §7 "Change notes", §15 "a golden changeCommitment row with its inputs"; the M1c
 * brief's update R6′).
 *
 * THE SOURCE — fixtures/change-commitment-golden.json, a BYTE COPY of the program side's
 * docs/zk-contract/change-commitment-golden.json at their commit 2146368 (written by their
 * zk/scripts/gen-change-commitment-golden.mjs; each vector's witness accepted by the
 * withdraw_change circuit, a Groth16 proof from the published keys/v2 zkey verifying with
 * publicSignals[5] == changeCommitment, and three wrong commitments rejected). Pinned below by its
 * sha256. Its own header: "COMPUTE every step from the spec and COMPARE; do not read these into a
 * builder" — so nothing here feeds a golden value into the code under test as an expected input
 * of a builder; every step is COMPUTED by our code from the vector's `in` and compared with the
 * vector's `steps` / `changeCommitment`.
 *
 * WHAT IS OURS, AND HOW EACH PIECE IS HELD:
 *   - `a0ChangeRho` (recovery.ts — the one change equation computed in JS, on a public
 *     nullifier) and `a0ChangeAmount`: against every vector's `rho_change` / `changeAmount`;
 *   - the frozen equations of `fieldEquations.ts` (`nullifier`, `addrField`, `commitment`): every
 *     step and the change commitment. `fieldEquations.ts` is what the offline key-vector generator
 *     (`scripts/a0-vectors/gen-key-vectors.mjs`) computes `a0-key-vectors.json` with, and the Rust
 *     core is held to that file (`keys_match_the_offline_vectors_for_every_fixture_seed`: nullifier,
 *     rhoChange, commitment for 25 notes) — so this file closes the chain golden → JS equations →
 *     key vectors → Rust without a Rust change;
 *   - the offline fake of the native core (`offlineA0.ts`, under every recovery suite): its
 *     `rhoChange` against every vector, so the change-note recovery tests built on the fake
 *     inherit the golden composition;
 *   - our pinned `mintHash` (`A0_MINT_HASH`, and the key vectors' `constants.mintHash`): equal to the
 *     A0-mint vectors' `in.mintHash`.
 * The Rust bridge cannot be given these vectors' `nk` / `change_d`: `keysOpen` takes a seed, and
 * every own note uses `change_d = d_self` (R9). That is the stated reason the Rust half is held
 * through the key vectors, not here.
 *
 * NEGATIVE CONTROLS: the same comparison is shown to fail for the three wrong commitments the
 * program side rejects (amount + 1, j = 1, d_in instead of change_d), so a pass is not vacuous.
 */
import {createHash} from 'crypto';
import {readFileSync} from 'fs';
import {join} from 'path';
import {addrField, commitment, nullifier, rhoOut, toBe32Hex} from '../fieldEquations';
import {a0ChangeAmount, a0ChangeRho} from '../recovery';
import {A0_MINT_HASH} from '../depositFlow';
import {KEY_VECTORS, OfflineA0Keys} from '../__testing__/offlineA0';

interface Fe {
  dec: string;
  hexBE32: string;
}
interface ChangeVector {
  label: string;
  in: {
    nk: Fe;
    d_in: Fe;
    change_d: Fe;
    rho_in: Fe;
    inputAmount: string;
    withdrawAmount: string;
    fee: string;
    mintHash: Fe;
    recipientField: Fe;
  };
  steps: {changeAmount: string; nullifier_in: Fe; rho_change: Fe; addrField_self: Fe};
  changeCommitment: Fe;
  context: {inputCommitment: Fe; merkleRootLeafAtIndex0: Fe};
}

const RAW = readFileSync(join(__dirname, 'fixtures/change-commitment-golden.json'));
const GOLDEN = JSON.parse(RAW.toString('utf8')) as {schema: string; equations: Record<string, string>; vectors: ChangeVector[]};
const ZK_GOLDEN = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(__dirname, 'golden-vectors.json'), 'utf8')) as {
  publicInputVectors: {withdraw_change: {name: string; hexBE32: string}[]};
};

const fe = (v: Fe): bigint => {
  const n = BigInt(v.dec);
  expect(toBe32Hex(n)).toBe(v.hexBE32); // the vector's two encodings agree
  return n;
};
const hex = (n: bigint): string => toBe32Hex(n);

describe('the fixture', () => {
  it('is the byte copy of the program side\'s file at 2146368 (sha256 pinned), schema 1, three vectors', () => {
    expect(createHash('sha256').update(RAW).digest('hex')).toBe(
      'e56160c0ea8e2c8b2ad1f10b93f72ab82ffb8856685d8cb937e78af539068198',
    );
    expect(GOLDEN.schema).toBe('noctura.zk.change-commitment-golden/1');
    expect(GOLDEN.vectors.map(v => v.label)).toEqual(['golden_vectors_withdraw_change', 'a0_devnet_mint_relayed', 'zero_change']);
  });

  it('states the equations of our §3 (their names, our tags and argument order)', () => {
    expect(GOLDEN.equations).toEqual({
      changeAmount: 'inputAmount - withdrawAmount - fee',
      nullifier_in: 'Poseidon3(TAG_NULL=0x11, nk, rho_in)',
      rho_change: 'Poseidon3(TAG_RHO=0x13, nullifier_in, 0)',
      addrField_self: 'Poseidon3(TAG_ADDR=0x12, nk, change_d)',
      changeCommitment: 'Poseidon5(TAG_CM=0x10, addrField_self, changeAmount, mintHash, rho_change)',
    });
  });

  it('its first vector IS the zk golden file\'s withdraw_change public-input case (changeCommitment 124709b8…, nullifier 01dfc21e…)', () => {
    const v = GOLDEN.vectors[0]!;
    const pub = Object.fromEntries(ZK_GOLDEN.publicInputVectors.withdraw_change.map(p => [p.name, p.hexBE32]));
    expect(v.changeCommitment.hexBE32).toBe(pub.changeCommitment);
    expect(v.steps.nullifier_in.hexBE32).toBe(pub.nullifier);
    expect(v.context.merkleRootLeafAtIndex0.hexBE32).toBe(pub.merkleRoot);
  });
});

describe.each(GOLDEN.vectors.map(v => [v.label, v] as const))('vector %s — every step computed by our code, compared', (_label, v) => {
  it('changeAmount = input − withdraw − fee (a0ChangeAmount)', () => {
    expect(a0ChangeAmount(BigInt(v.in.inputAmount), BigInt(v.in.withdrawAmount), BigInt(v.in.fee))).toBe(BigInt(v.steps.changeAmount));
  });

  it('nullifier_in = Poseidon3(0x11, nk, rho_in) (fieldEquations)', () => {
    expect(hex(nullifier(fe(v.in.nk), fe(v.in.rho_in)))).toBe(v.steps.nullifier_in.hexBE32);
  });

  it('rho_change = Poseidon3(0x13, nullifier_in, 0): recovery\'s a0ChangeRho, fieldEquations\' rhoOut(·, 0) and the offline fake agree with it', () => {
    const n = v.steps.nullifier_in.hexBE32;
    expect(a0ChangeRho(n)).toBe(v.steps.rho_change.hexBE32);
    expect(hex(rhoOut(fe(v.steps.nullifier_in), 0))).toBe(v.steps.rho_change.hexBE32);
    expect(new OfflineA0Keys('00'.repeat(32)).rhoChange(n)).toBe(v.steps.rho_change.hexBE32);
  });

  it('addrField_self = Poseidon3(0x12, nk, change_d) — our addrField(nk, d) with d = change_d', () => {
    expect(hex(addrField(fe(v.in.nk), fe(v.in.change_d)))).toBe(v.steps.addrField_self.hexBE32);
  });

  it('changeCommitment = Poseidon5(0x10, addrField_self, changeAmount, mintHash, rho_change), composed from OUR steps end to end', () => {
    const nk = fe(v.in.nk);
    const nIn = nullifier(nk, fe(v.in.rho_in));
    const amount = a0ChangeAmount(BigInt(v.in.inputAmount), BigInt(v.in.withdrawAmount), BigInt(v.in.fee))!;
    const cm = commitment({
      addrField: addrField(nk, fe(v.in.change_d)),
      amount,
      mintHash: fe(v.in.mintHash),
      rho: BigInt(`0x${a0ChangeRho(hex(nIn))}`),
    });
    expect(hex(cm)).toBe(v.changeCommitment.hexBE32);
  });

  it('the input note: inputCommitment = commitment(addrField(nk, d_in), input, mintHash, rho_in) (the note being spent)', () => {
    const cm = commitment({
      addrField: addrField(fe(v.in.nk), fe(v.in.d_in)),
      amount: BigInt(v.in.inputAmount),
      mintHash: fe(v.in.mintHash),
      rho: fe(v.in.rho_in),
    });
    expect(hex(cm)).toBe(v.context.inputCommitment.hexBE32);
  });

  it('NEGATIVE controls — the three wrong commitments the program side rejects do not compare equal', () => {
    const nk = fe(v.in.nk);
    const nIn = nullifier(nk, fe(v.in.rho_in));
    const base = {
      addrField: addrField(nk, fe(v.in.change_d)),
      amount: BigInt(v.steps.changeAmount),
      mintHash: fe(v.in.mintHash),
      rho: rhoOut(nIn, 0),
    };
    expect(hex(commitment(base))).toBe(v.changeCommitment.hexBE32); // the positive twin
    expect(hex(commitment({...base, amount: base.amount + 1n}))).not.toBe(v.changeCommitment.hexBE32);
    expect(hex(commitment({...base, rho: rhoOut(nIn, 1)}))).not.toBe(v.changeCommitment.hexBE32);
    expect(hex(commitment({...base, addrField: addrField(nk, fe(v.in.d_in))}))).not.toBe(v.changeCommitment.hexBE32);
  });
});

describe('our pinned mintHash', () => {
  it('equals the A0-mint vectors\' in.mintHash (be_mod_r of ERkp…), as the depositFlow constant and the offline key vectors pin it', () => {
    for (const v of GOLDEN.vectors.slice(1)) {
      expect(v.in.mintHash.hexBE32).toBe(A0_MINT_HASH);
      expect(v.in.mintHash.hexBE32).toBe(KEY_VECTORS.constants.mintHash);
    }
    // control: the first vector's mintHash is the zk file's synthetic 555555555, not ours
    expect(GOLDEN.vectors[0]!.in.mintHash.hexBE32).not.toBe(A0_MINT_HASH);
  });
});

describe('a0ChangeAmount refuses a spend above the input (null), and 0 is a change', () => {
  it('rows', () => {
    expect(a0ChangeAmount(10n, 4n, 6n)).toBe(0n);
    expect(a0ChangeAmount(10n, 4n, 7n)).toBeNull();
    expect(a0ChangeAmount(10n, 11n, 0n)).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * Recovery of change notes and exit accounts from the seed (spec §7 "Change notes" and
 * "Accounts", §8 `spentTx`, R12, I6, S9; M1c Task 5).
 *
 * THE CHAIN is the recorded devnet history of tree 5URd… (fixtures/devnet-tree-5URd.json), served

 * with the test seed's own deposits and RELAYED UNSHIELDS (ownHistory.ts: clones of the landed
 * 3DR6F7oW… and 3UfCx5TD…, the tree account advanced as the program advances it). Every rho,
 * commitment, nullifier and change value of an own note comes from the OFFLINE equations
 * (offlineA0.ts, held to a0-key-vectors.json, and — for the change equation — to the program side's
 * golden in changeCommitment.golden.test.ts); never from the code under test. The native core is
 * the offline fake behind the real bridge; every call it gets is logged.
 *
 * THE ACCOUNTS: `slip10:n` addresses and their ATAs come from fixtures/a0-exit-account-vectors.json,
 * written by scripts/a0-vectors/gen-exit-account-vectors.mjs from Node's own crypto (no web3.js,
 * no core/keys code), anchored to the extension's slip10:0 and to three published ATAs.
 */
jest.mock('@solana/web3.js', () =>
  jest.requireActual<typeof import('../__testing__/realWeb3')>('../__testing__/realWeb3').loadRealWeb3(),
);
jest.mock('react-native', () => ({
  NativeModules: {
    NocturaProver: jest.requireActual<typeof import('../__testing__/offlineA0')>('../__testing__/offlineA0').createFakeProverNative(),
  },
}));
import {readFileSync} from 'fs';
import {join} from 'path';
import {NativeModules} from 'react-native';
import {PublicKey} from '@solana/web3.js';
import {clearAllStores, initSecureMmkv, mmkvSecure} from '../../../../store/mmkv/instances';
import {storeTransparentScheme} from '../../../keyDerivation/derivationScheme';
import {OTHER_SEED, TEST_SEED, offlineKeys, seedBytes, strangerField} from '../__testing__/offlineA0';
import type {FakeProverNative} from '../__testing__/offlineA0';
import {appendDeposit, appendWithdraw, appendWithdrawPair} from '../__testing__/ownHistory';
import {chainFrom, recordedConnection} from '../__testing__/recordedRpc';
import type {RecordedChain, RecordedFixture} from '../__testing__/recordedRpc';
import {A0_ACCOUNT_DISCOVERY_GAP, loadA0AccountRegistry, reserveA0FreshAccount, resetA0ReservationsForTests} from '../accountRegistry';
import {a0AtaOf} from '../relayerClient';
import {addA0PendingDeposit, confirmA0Deposit, loadA0NoteStore, mergeA0RecoveredNotes} from '../noteStore';
import {A0RecoveryError, loadA0LastRestoreStats, restoreA0FromSeed} from '../recovery';

const TREE = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(__dirname, 'fixtures/devnet-tree-5URd.json'), 'utf8')) as RecordedFixture;
interface ExitVectors {
  mint: string;
  seeds: {mnemonic: string; accounts: {scheme: string; address: string; ata: string}[]}[];
}
const EXIT = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(__dirname, 'fixtures/a0-exit-account-vectors.json'), 'utf8')) as ExitVectors;
const fake = NativeModules.NocturaProver as unknown as FakeProverNative;
const own = offlineKeys(TEST_SEED);
const other = offlineKeys(OTHER_SEED);
const KEY = 'v1_a0_notes';
/** the template's amount and fee (3UfCx5TD…), used when a row gives none */
const T_AMOUNT = 400_000n;
const T_FEE = 10_000n;

/** slip10:n of the test seed (abandon … about) / of the other seed (zoo … wrong), from the offline vectors */
const acct = (n: number, seed = 0) => EXIT.seeds[seed]!.accounts[n]!;
/** an address outside both seeds ("Another address"): the relayer-landed P0's owner HV996… and its ATA */
const STRANGER = {owner: 'HV996fcQT193sXfh3fgCEDjxsWwWxQC6cVdb1EyZxdJR', ata: 'DzU8HkTy7b5jK8LvahytrsgimF9Navxc9HgzA7y167Zt'};
const to = (n: number, seed = 0) => ({owner: acct(n, seed).address, ata: acct(n, seed).ata});

const fresh = (): RecordedChain => chainFrom(TREE);
const restore = (chain: RecordedChain, seed: Uint8Array = seedBytes(TEST_SEED)) =>
  restoreA0FromSeed(recordedConnection(chain).connection, seed, {sync: {useCache: false}});
const callsOf = (m: string) => fake.calls.filter(c => c.method === m);

/** Our deposit at counter `i`. */
const ownDeposit = (chain: RecordedChain, i: bigint, amount: bigint) => {
  const rho = own.rho(i);
  const commitment = own.commitment(amount, rho);
  return {rho, amount, commitment, ...appendDeposit(chain, {amount, rho, commitment})};
};
/**
 * Our relayed unshield of the note `{rho, amount}` with OUR change (the offline equations: rho_change
 * = Poseidon3(0x13, nullifier, 0), changeAmount = input − amount − fee, commitment under d_self).
 */
const ownUnshield = (
  chain: RecordedChain,
  note: {rho: string; amount: bigint},
  o: {amount?: bigint; fee?: bigint; to?: {owner: string; ata: string}; changeOverride?: string} = {},
) => {
  const amount = o.amount ?? T_AMOUNT;
  const fee = o.fee ?? T_FEE;
  const nullifier = own.nullifier(note.rho);
  const rho = own.rhoChange(nullifier);
  const changeAmount = note.amount - amount - fee;
  const commitment = own.commitment(changeAmount, rho);
  const w = appendWithdraw(chain, {nullifier, changeCommitment: o.changeOverride ?? commitment, amount, fee, to: o.to});
  return {rho, amount: changeAmount, commitment, nullifier, ...w};
};

beforeEach(() => {
  clearAllStores();
  initSecureMmkv('test-key');
  storeTransparentScheme({kind: 'slip10', account: 0});
  resetA0ReservationsForTests();
  fake.reset();
});

describe('the vectors this suite stands on', () => {
  it('the exit-account vectors agree with the app\'s ATA derivation (a0AtaOf) for every slip10:0..30 of both seeds — and with the published anchors', () => {
    expect(EXIT.mint).toBe('ERkpCFGaoWmeZPhKTUHumrqHTP1QmyHVhMJUnxbRPKCs');
    expect(acct(0).address).toBe('HAgk14JpMQLgt6rVgv7cBQFJWFto5Dqxi472uT3DKpqk');
    for (const s of EXIT.seeds) {
      expect(s.accounts.map(a => a.scheme)).toEqual([...Array(31).keys()].map(n => `slip10:${n}`));
      for (const a of s.accounts) {

    }
    expect(a0AtaOf(new PublicKey(STRANGER.owner)).toBase58()).toBe(STRANGER.ata);
  });

  it('the offline change values are the golden composition (spot check: rhoChange = the key vectors\' row)', () => {
    const n = TEST_SEED.notes[0]!;
    expect(own.rho(BigInt(n.depositIndex))).toBe(n.rho);
    expect(own.nullifier(n.rho)).toBe(n.nullifier);
    expect(own.rhoChange(n.nullifier)).toBe(n.rhoChange);
  });
});

describe('change notes (§7 "Change notes")', () => {
  it('one deposit, one relayed unshield with our change: the deposit is spent naming its spending tx; the change note comes back with its leaf', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();
    const d0 = ownDeposit(chain, 0n, 1_000_000n);

    expect(loadA0LastRestoreStats()).toEqual(res.stats);
  });

  it('the native calls: the change commitment is Rust\'s commitment(input − amount − fee, rho_change) with rho_change computed in JS; the attribution asks one nullifier at a time', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();

      ['1000000', d0.rho],

    const all = ms[0]![0] as string[];
    expect(all[all.length - 1]).toBe(u.nullifier);
    // 1: spent-status of the deposits; 2…: attribution, [n] by [n] over the synced nullifiers; last: the change note's spent-status
    expect(ms[0]).toEqual([all, [d0.rho]]);

    const chain = fresh();

    const u1 = ownUnshield(chain, d0, {to: STRANGER});
    const u2 = ownUnshield(chain, u1, {amount: 1_000_000n, to: STRANGER});
    const res = await restore(chain);
    expect(res.notes).toEqual([
      {commitment: d0.commitment, amount: 5_000_000n, rho: d0.rho, depositIndex: 0n, leafIndex: 17, status: 'spent', spentTx: u1.signature},
      {commitment: u1.commitment, amount: 4_590_000n, rho: u1.rho, leafIndex: 18, status: 'spent', spentTx: u2.signature},
      {commitment: u2.commitment, amount: 3_580_000n, rho: u2.rho, leafIndex: 19, status: 'unspent'},
    ]);
    expect(res.stats).toMatchObject({changeNotes: 2, spentNotes: 2});
  });

  it('two deposits spent in the reverse order of their counters: each is attributed to ITS spending tx (no positional pairing)', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();
    const d0 = ownDeposit(chain, 0n, 700_000n);
    const d1 = ownDeposit(chain, 1n, 800_000n);
    const u1 = ownUnshield(chain, d1, {to: STRANGER});
    const u0 = ownUnshield(chain, d0, {to: STRANGER});
    const res = await restore(chain);
    const byRho = new Map(res.notes.map(n => [n.rho, n]));
    expect(byRho.get(d0.rho)).toMatchObject({status: 'spent', spentTx: u0.signature});
    expect(byRho.get(d1.rho)).toMatchObject({status: 'spent', spentTx: u1.signature});
    expect(byRho.get(u0.rho)).toMatchObject({amount: 290_000n, leafIndex: u0.leafIndex, status: 'unspent'});
    expect(byRho.get(u1.rho)).toMatchObject({amount: 390_000n, leafIndex: u1.leafIndex, status: 'unspent'});
    expect(res.notes).toHaveLength(4);

  it('two unshields in ONE transaction, a stranger\'s first: our change takes the leaf of ITS commitment, not the first leaf', async () => {

  });

  it('the change amount is the INSTRUCTION\'s: a change committed under another fee than the instruction carries is not ours (and its positive twin is)', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();
    const d0 = ownDeposit(chain, 0n, 1_000_000n);
    // the leaf commits to 1,000,000 − 400,000 − 20,000; the instruction says fee 10,000
    const wrong = own.commitment(580_000n, own.rhoChange(own.nullifier(d0.rho)));
    ownUnshield(chain, d0, {fee: 10_000n, to: STRANGER, changeOverride: wrong});
    expect((await restore(chain)).stats).toMatchObject({changeNotes: 0, unmatchedChangeLeaves: 1});
    clearAllStores();
    initSecureMmkv('test-key');
    const twin = fresh();
    const t0 = ownDeposit(twin, 0n, 1_000_000n);
    ownUnshield(twin, t0, {fee: 20_000n, to: STRANGER, changeOverride: wrong});
    expect((await restore(twin)).notes.map(n => n.amount)).toEqual([1_000_000n, 580_000n]);
  });

  it('the change rho is j = 0 of the PUBLIC nullifier: a leaf made with j = 1 is not ours', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();
    const d0 = ownDeposit(chain, 0n, 1_000_000n);
    const { poseidon3 } = jest.requireActual<typeof import('poseidon-lite')>('poseidon-lite');
    const rhoJ1 = poseidon3([0x13n, BigInt(`0x${own.nullifier(d0.rho)}`), 1n]).toString(16).padStart(64, '0');
    ownUnshield(chain, d0, {to: STRANGER, changeOverride: own.commitment(590_000n, rhoJ1)});
    expect((await restore(chain)).stats).toMatchObject({changeNotes: 0, unmatchedChangeLeaves: 1});
  });

  it('SOMEONE ELSE\'s unshields are not attributed to us (their nullifiers answer [] one by one) and import nothing', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();
    const d0 = ownDeposit(chain, 0n, 1_000_000n);
    const theirs = other.rho(0n);
    appendDeposit(chain, {amount: 900_000n, rho: theirs, commitment: other.commitment(900_000n, theirs)});
    appendWithdraw(chain, {
      nullifier: other.nullifier(theirs),
      changeCommitment: other.commitment(490_000n, other.rhoChange(other.nullifier(theirs))),
      to: to(1),
    });
    const res = await restore(chain);
    expect(res.notes).toEqual([{commitment: d0.commitment, amount: 1_000_000n, rho: d0.rho, depositIndex: 0n, leafIndex: 17, status: 'unspent'}]);
    expect(res.exitAccounts).toEqual([]); // the stranger's exit to OUR slip10:1 ATA is not "ours": no spend of ours went there
    expect(callsOf('matchSpent')).toHaveLength(1); // nothing spent → no attribution
  });

  it('no JS-side nullifier of an UNSPENT note is held: the store and the restore stats name none (R12)', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();
    const d0 = ownDeposit(chain, 0n, 5_000_000n);
    const u1 = ownUnshield(chain, d0, {to: STRANGER});
    await restore(chain);
    const text = mmkvSecure()!.getString(KEY)! + mmkvSecure()!.getString('v1_a0_last_restore')!;
    expect(text).not.toContain(own.nullifier(u1.rho)); // the unspent change note's future nullifier
    expect(text).toContain(u1.rho); // control: the store does hold the change note
  });
});

describe('the native core held to its contract during the attribution', () => {
  it('matchSpent naming two notes for ONE nullifier → E_A0_RECOVERY_NATIVE, the handle closed, nothing written', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();
    const d0 = ownDeposit(chain, 0n, 1_000_000n);
    const d1 = ownDeposit(chain, 1n, 1_000_000n);
    ownUnshield(chain, d0, {to: STRANGER});
    ownUnshield(chain, d1, {to: STRANGER});
    const real = fake.matchSpent.bind(fake);
    const spy = jest.spyOn(fake, 'matchSpent').mockImplementation(async (h, chainNullifiers, ownRhos) =>
      chainNullifiers.length === 1 && ownRhos.length === 2 ? [0, 1] : real(h, chainNullifiers, ownRhos),
    );
    const err = await restore(chain).catch((e: unknown) => e);
    spy.mockRestore();
    expect((err as A0RecoveryError).code).toBe('E_A0_RECOVERY_NATIVE');
    expect(fake.liveHandle()).toBeNull();
    expect(mmkvSecure()!.getString(KEY)).toBeUndefined();
    expect(mmkvSecure()!.getString('v1_accounts')).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('"spent" by the full matchSpent, then no nullifier attributes it → E_A0_RECOVERY_NATIVE (the loop cannot spin)', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();
    const d0 = ownDeposit(chain, 0n, 1_000_000n);
    ownUnshield(chain, d0, {to: STRANGER});
    const real = fake.matchSpent.bind(fake);
    let single = 0;
    const spy = jest.spyOn(fake, 'matchSpent').mockImplementation(async (h, chainNullifiers, ownRhos) => {
      if (chainNullifiers.length !== 1) {
        return real(h, chainNullifiers, ownRhos);
      }
      // a recovery without the guard would ask forever (and starve Jest's timers): fail it fast instead
      if (++single > 200) {
        throw new Error('the attribution is spinning');
      }
      return [];
    });
    const err = await restore(chain).catch((e: unknown) => e);
    spy.mockRestore();
    expect((err as A0RecoveryError).code).toBe('E_A0_RECOVERY_NATIVE');
    expect(single).toBeLessThan(200); // one pass over the synced nullifiers, then the refusal
    expect(fake.liveHandle()).toBeNull();
  });

  it('an out-of-range attribution answer → E_A0_RECOVERY_NATIVE', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();
    const d0 = ownDeposit(chain, 0n, 1_000_000n);
    ownUnshield(chain, d0, {to: STRANGER});
    const real = fake.matchSpent.bind(fake);
    const spy = jest.spyOn(fake, 'matchSpent').mockImplementation(async (h, chainNullifiers, ownRhos) =>
      chainNullifiers.length === 1 ? [1] : real(h, chainNullifiers, ownRhos),
    );
    const err = await restore(chain).catch((e: unknown) => e);
    spy.mockRestore();
    expect((err as A0RecoveryError).code).toBe('E_A0_RECOVERY_NATIVE');
  });
});

describe('two successful withdrawals with one nullifier (impossible on chain: the nullifier PDA is init)', () => {
  it('refuse the recovery when a note of ours is spent (E_A0_RECOVERY_DUPLICATE_NULLIFIER), the handle closed, nothing written', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();
```
