Create `android/app/src/main/java/com/nocturawallet/prover/A0ConfirmController.kt`:

```kotlin
package com.nocturawallet.prover

import android.app.Activity
import android.app.AlertDialog
import android.graphics.Typeface
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.os.SystemClock
import android.util.TypedValue
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.ScrollView
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.biometric.BiometricManager
import androidx.biometric.BiometricPrompt
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import androidx.fragment.app.FragmentActivity
import androidx.lifecycle.Lifecycle
import androidx.lifecycle.LifecycleEventObserver
import com.nocturawallet.R

/** How a confirmation ends: Rust's answer to `authorizeUnshield`, or a refusal. */
internal sealed class A0ConfirmOutcome {
    /** `authId` (32 hex, from Rust) and the owner / token account Rust parsed and the human approved. */
    data class Approved(val authId: String, val owner: String, val ata: String) : A0ConfirmOutcome()

    data class Refused(val code: String, val message: String) : A0ConfirmOutcome()
}

/** The two Kotlin-only Rust calls (§3), injectable so the instrumented test can run without the library. */
internal interface A0UnshieldNative {
    fun parse(owner: String, amount: String, fee: String): A0Result

    fun authorize(handle: String, owner: String, amount: String, fee: String): A0Result
}

/**
 * The dialog (§4 step 3, I10): Rust's values only, the owner whole, `FLAG_SECURE` on its window,
 * non-system overlays hidden on API 31+, an approve control that filters obscured touches and
 * reports the gesture's obscured flags to the machine (FLAG_WINDOW_IS_PARTIALLY_OBSCURED is not
 * filtered by `filterTouchesWhenObscured`; the machine ignores it).
 */
internal class A0ConfirmDialog private constructor(val dialog: AlertDialog, val approve: Button) {
    companion object {
        fun build(
            activity: Activity,
            p: A0ParsedUnshield,
            onApprove: (touchFlags: Int) -> Unit,
            onCancel: () -> Unit,
        ): A0ConfirmDialog {
            val res = activity.resources
            val text = A0ConfirmText.render(
                p,
                destinationLabel = res.getString(R.string.a0_confirm_destination_label),
                tokenAccountLabel = res.getString(R.string.a0_confirm_token_account_label),
                amountFormat = res.getString(R.string.a0_confirm_amount_line),
                feeFormat = res.getString(R.string.a0_confirm_fee_line),
                poolLabel = res.getString(R.string.a0_confirm_pool_label),
            )
            val dp = { v: Int -> TypedValue.applyDimension(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_DIP, v.toFloat(), res.displayMetrics).toInt() }
            val column = LinearLayout(activity).apply {
                orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
                setPadding(dp(24), dp(8), dp(24), dp(8))
            }
            fun line(s: String, sp: Float, bold: Boolean = false, mono: Boolean = false, top: Int = 0) =
                TextView(activity).apply {
                    this.text = s
                    setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, sp)
                    typeface = when {
                        mono -> Typeface.MONOSPACE
                        bold -> Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
                        else -> Typeface.DEFAULT
                    }
                    // whole, wrapped: no maxLines, no ellipsis (the owner is never truncated)
                    ellipsize = null
                    maxLines = Int.MAX_VALUE
                    setPadding(0, dp(top), 0, 0)
                    column.addView(this)
                }
            line(text.destinationLabel, 14f, bold = true)
            line(text.owner, 16f, mono = true, top = 4)
            line(text.tokenAccountLabel, 12f, bold = true, top = 12)
            line(text.ata, 12f, mono = true, top = 2)
            line(text.amountLine, 15f, top = 16)
            line(text.feeLine, 14f, top = 8)
            line(text.poolLabel, 12f, bold = true, top = 12)
            line(text.pool, 12f, mono = true, top = 2)

            val buttons = LinearLayout(activity).apply {
                orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
                setPadding(0, dp(16), 0, 0)
            }
            val cancel = Button(activity).apply { setText(R.string.a0_confirm_cancel) }
            val approve = Button(activity).apply {
                setText(R.string.a0_confirm_approve)
                // I10: a touch delivered while another window covers this one is dropped by the framework...
                filterTouchesWhenObscured = true
            }
            // ...and a partly covered one reaches the listener with its flag, which the machine ignores.
            var gesture = 0
            approve.setOnTouchListener { _, ev ->
                gesture = A0Touch.accumulate(gesture, ev.actionMasked, ev.flags)
                false
            }
            approve.setOnClickListener {
                val flags = gesture
                gesture = 0
                onApprove(flags)
            }
            cancel.setOnClickListener { onCancel() }
            buttons.addView(cancel, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f))
            buttons.addView(approve, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f))
            column.addView(buttons)

            val dialog = AlertDialog.Builder(activity)
                .setTitle(R.string.a0_confirm_title)
                .setView(ScrollView(activity).apply { addView(column) })
                .setCancelable(true)
                .create()
            dialog.setCanceledOnTouchOutside(false)
            dialog.setOnCancelListener { onCancel() }
            val window = dialog.window ?: throw IllegalStateException("the dialog has no window")
            window.setFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SECURE, WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SECURE)
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S) {
                window.setHideOverlayWindows(true)
            }
            return A0ConfirmDialog(dialog, approve)
        }
    }
}

/**
 * `confirmUnshield` (§4): one process-wide controller, one [A0ConfirmMachine]. JS calls [start]
 * on the native-modules thread; everything that touches a view runs on the UI thread; every
 * outcome is delivered once through `settle`.
 *
 * Order: claim the one slot (refused while another is in flight, or with no foreground
 * FragmentActivity) → Rust `parseUnshield` (a refusal is Rust's code) → the authenticators for
 * this API level ([A0Authenticators]) and `canAuthenticate` → on the UI thread, the activity must
 * still be RESUMED → the dialog, a lifecycle observer (pause / stop / destroy → fail closed) and
 * the 60 s timer → approve (unobscured) → BiometricPrompt → on its success, before the deadline,
 * Rust `authorizeUnshield(handle, owner, amount, fee)` with the PARSED values → `{authId, owner,
 * ata}`. JS never reaches `authorizeUnshield`; it gets back an id it cannot forge.
 */
internal class A0ConfirmController(
    private val native: A0UnshieldNative,
    private val sdkInt: Int = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT,
    private val canAuthenticate: (Activity, Int) -> Boolean = { a, auth ->
        BiometricManager.from(a).canAuthenticate(auth) == BiometricManager.BIOMETRIC_SUCCESS
    },
    timeoutMs: Long = A0ConfirmMachine.TIMEOUT_MS,
) {
    private val machine = A0ConfirmMachine({ SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() }, timeoutMs)
    private val timeoutMs = timeoutMs
    private val main = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())

    private class Live(
        val ticket: Long,
        val handle: String,
        val parsed: A0ParsedUnshield,
        val activity: FragmentActivity,
        val authenticators: Int,
        val settle: (A0ConfirmOutcome) -> Unit,
    ) {
        var dialog: A0ConfirmDialog? = null
        var prompt: BiometricPrompt? = null
        var observer: LifecycleEventObserver? = null
        var timer: Runnable? = null
    }

    @Volatile private var live: Live? = null

    fun start(activity: Activity?, handle: String, owner: String, amount: String, fee: String, settle: (A0ConfirmOutcome) -> Unit) {
        val fa = activity as? FragmentActivity
        val present = fa != null && !fa.isFinishing && !fa.isDestroyed
        val ticket = when (val b = machine.begin(present)) {
            is A0ConfirmMachine.Begin.Refused -> return settle(refused(b.refusal))
            is A0ConfirmMachine.Begin.Started -> b.ticket
        }
        fa!!
        val parsed = try {
            when (val r = native.parse(owner, amount, fee)) {
                is A0Result.Err -> return end(ticket, settle, A0ConfirmOutcome.Refused(r.code, r.message))
                is A0Result.Ok -> A0ParsedUnshield.from(r.value)
                    ?: return end(ticket, settle, A0ConfirmOutcome.Refused(A0Result.INTERNAL, "the parsed unshield is unreadable"))
            }
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            return end(ticket, settle, A0ConfirmOutcome.Refused(A0Result.INTERNAL, "internal error"))
        }
        val auth = A0Authenticators.forApi(sdkInt)
        val usable = try {
            auth != null && canAuthenticate(fa, auth)
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            false
        }
        if (auth == null || !usable) {
            machine.fail(ticket, A0ConfirmRefusal.NO_AUTHENTICATOR)
            return settle(refused(A0ConfirmRefusal.NO_AUTHENTICATOR))
        }
        val l = Live(ticket, handle, parsed, fa, auth, settle)
        live = l
        main.post { showDialog(l) }
    }

    /** `keysClose` / a second `keysOpen`: a confirmation still waiting for the human fails closed. */
    fun sessionChanged() {
        val (t, step) = machine.sessionChanged()
        val l = live
        if (step is A0ConfirmMachine.Step.Refuse && l != null && l.ticket == t) finish(l, step.refusal)
    }

    private fun end(ticket: Long, settle: (A0ConfirmOutcome) -> Unit, o: A0ConfirmOutcome.Refused) {
        machine.fail(ticket, A0ConfirmRefusal.UI)
        settle(o)
    }

    private fun refused(r: A0ConfirmRefusal) = A0ConfirmOutcome.Refused(r.code, r.message)

    private fun showDialog(l: Live) {
        if (machine.live() != l.ticket) return
        try {
            if (!l.activity.lifecycle.currentState.isAtLeast(Lifecycle.State.RESUMED)) {
                return apply(l, machine.interrupted(l.ticket))
            }
            val d = A0ConfirmDialog.build(
                l.activity,
                l.parsed,
                onApprove = { flags -> onApprove(l, flags) },
                onCancel = { apply(l, machine.cancel(l.ticket)) },
            )
            l.dialog = d
            val obs = LifecycleEventObserver { _, e ->
                if (e == Lifecycle.Event.ON_PAUSE || e == Lifecycle.Event.ON_STOP || e == Lifecycle.Event.ON_DESTROY) {
                    apply(l, machine.interrupted(l.ticket))
                }
            }
            l.observer = obs
            l.activity.lifecycle.addObserver(obs)
            val timer = Runnable { apply(l, machine.timeout(l.ticket)) }
            l.timer = timer
            main.postDelayed(timer, timeoutMs)
            d.dialog.show()
            apply(l, machine.shown(l.ticket))
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            apply(l, machine.fail(l.ticket, A0ConfirmRefusal.UI))
        }
    }

    private fun onApprove(l: Live, touchFlags: Int) {
        val step = machine.approve(l.ticket, touchFlags)
        if (step !is A0ConfirmMachine.Step.Continue) return apply(l, step)
        l.dialog?.approve?.isEnabled = false
        try {
            val res = l.activity.resources
            val info = BiometricPrompt.PromptInfo.Builder()
                .setTitle(res.getString(R.string.a0_prompt_title))
                .setSubtitle(res.getString(R.string.a0_prompt_subtitle))
                .setAllowedAuthenticators(l.authenticators)
                .setConfirmationRequired(true)
                .apply {
                    if (!A0Authenticators.allowsCredential(l.authenticators)) {
                        setNegativeButtonText(res.getString(R.string.a0_confirm_cancel))
                    }
                }
                .build()
            val prompt = BiometricPrompt(
                l.activity,
                ContextCompat.getMainExecutor(l.activity),
                object : BiometricPrompt.AuthenticationCallback() {
                    override fun onAuthenticationSucceeded(result: BiometricPrompt.AuthenticationResult) {
                        onPromptSucceeded(l)
                    }

                    override fun onAuthenticationError(errorCode: Int, errString: CharSequence) {
                        val byUser = errorCode == BiometricPrompt.ERROR_USER_CANCELED ||
                            errorCode == BiometricPrompt.ERROR_NEGATIVE_BUTTON
                        apply(l, machine.promptError(l.ticket, byUser))
                    }
                    // onAuthenticationFailed (a finger that did not match) is not terminal: the prompt stays up.
                },
            )
            l.prompt = prompt
            prompt.authenticate(info)
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            apply(l, machine.fail(l.ticket, A0ConfirmRefusal.UI))
        }
    }

    private fun onPromptSucceeded(l: Live) {
        val step = machine.promptSucceeded(l.ticket)
        if (step !is A0ConfirmMachine.Step.Authorize) return apply(l, step)
        val p = l.parsed
        val outcome = try {
            when (val r = native.authorize(l.handle, p.owner, p.amount, p.fee)) {
                is A0Result.Ok -> (r.value as? String)
                    ?.let { A0ConfirmOutcome.Approved(it, p.owner, p.ata) }
                    ?: A0ConfirmOutcome.Refused(A0Result.INTERNAL, "the authorization is unreadable")
                is A0Result.Err -> A0ConfirmOutcome.Refused(r.code, r.message)
            }
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            A0ConfirmOutcome.Refused(A0Result.INTERNAL, "internal error")
        }
        if (machine.authorized(l.ticket)) {
            cleanup(l)
            l.settle(outcome)
        }
    }

    private fun apply(l: Live, step: A0ConfirmMachine.Step) {
        if (step is A0ConfirmMachine.Step.Refuse) finish(l, step.refusal)
    }

    /** Settles a refusal (the machine already went IDLE) and tears the UI down on the UI thread. */
    private fun finish(l: Live, r: A0ConfirmRefusal) {
        l.settle(refused(r))
        if (Looper.myLooper() == Looper.getMainLooper()) cleanup(l) else main.post { cleanup(l) }
    }

    private fun cleanup(l: Live) {
        l.timer?.let { main.removeCallbacks(it) }
        l.observer?.let { l.activity.lifecycle.removeObserver(it) }
        try {
            l.prompt?.cancelAuthentication()
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            // the prompt may already be gone with its fragment
        }
        try {
            l.dialog?.dialog?.dismiss()
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            // the window may already be gone with its activity
        }
        if (live === l) live = null
    }
}

/** The process-wide controller over the real library (like Rust's state, one per process). */
internal object A0Confirmations {
    private object RustUnshield : A0UnshieldNative {
        private fun call(native: () -> String?): A0Result =
            try {
                NocturaNativeLib.ensureLoaded()
                A0Result.parse(native())
            } catch (e: UnsatisfiedLinkError) {
                A0Result.Err(A0Result.UNAVAILABLE, "the native library is unavailable")
            }

        override fun parse(owner: String, amount: String, fee: String) = call { NocturaA0Native.parseUnshield(owner, amount, fee) }

        override fun authorize(handle: String, owner: String, amount: String, fee: String) =
            call { NocturaA0Native.authorizeUnshield(handle, owner, amount, fee) }
    }

    /** The one binding of the two Kotlin-only natives; [NocturaProverModule]'s internals delegate here. */
    val rust: A0UnshieldNative = RustUnshield

    val controller: A0ConfirmController by lazy { A0ConfirmController(RustUnshield) }
}
```

```diff
+export class A0ConfirmResultError extends Error {
+  readonly code = 'E_A0_CONFIRM_RESULT' as const;
+  constructor(message: string) {

+    this.name = 'A0ConfirmResultError';

+
+const AUTH_ID = /^[0-9a-f]{32}$/;
+const BASE58_KEY = /^[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{32,44}$/;
+
+/**
+ * `confirmUnshield(handle, owner, amount, fee) -> {authId, owner, ata}` (spec §4): native parses
+ * the request in Rust, shows ITS OWN dialog with Rust's values, asks BiometricPrompt, and only on
+ * that approval Rust records a single-use authorization (120 s from the approval). Rejects with
+ * Rust's code (a malformed owner / amount / fee) or `E_A0_CONFIRM_…` (busy, no foreground
+ * activity, no usable authenticator, cancelled, 60 s timeout, biometric failure, paused or
+ * recreated, the key session changed, the dialog failed). The answer's SHAPE is checked here;
+ * that its `ata` is ATA(owner, mint) is the caller's check (`confirmA0Unshield`, which aborts on a
+ * mismatch).
+ */
+export async function a0ConfirmUnshield(
+  handle: A0Handle,
+  owner: string,
+  amount: bigint,
+  fee: bigint,
+): Promise<A0UnshieldApproval> {
+  const r = await requireNative().confirmUnshield(handle, owner, u64(amount, 'amount'), u64(fee, 'fee'));
+  if (typeof r !== 'object' || r === null || Array.isArray(r)) {
+    throw new A0ConfirmResultError('the confirmation answer is not an object');
+  }
+  const o = r as Record<string, unknown>;
+  const keys = Object.keys(o).sort();
+  if (keys.join(',') !== 'ata,authId,owner') {
+    throw new A0ConfirmResultError(`the confirmation answer has the keys [${keys.join(',')}]`);
+  }
+  const {authId, owner: approvedOwner, ata} = o;
+  if (typeof authId !== 'string' || !AUTH_ID.test(authId)) {
+    throw new A0ConfirmResultError('the authId is not 32 lowercase hex');
+  }
+  if (typeof approvedOwner !== 'string' || !BASE58_KEY.test(approvedOwner)) {
+    throw new A0ConfirmResultError('the approved owner is not a base58 key');
+  }
+  if (typeof ata !== 'string' || !BASE58_KEY.test(ata)) {
+    throw new A0ConfirmResultError('the approved token account is not a base58 key');
+  }
+  return {authId, owner: approvedOwner, ata};
+}
```

Create `src/modules/shielded/a0/unshieldConfirm.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The JS half of the native confirmation (spec 2026-11-08 shielded A0 M1 §4 step 4, §6 step 5):
 * `confirmA0Unshield(handle, {owner, amount, fee})` asks native to confirm — Rust parses, Kotlin
 * shows its own dialog and BiometricPrompt, Rust records a single-use authorization — and then
 * holds the answer to the request:
 *
 *   - the approved owner must be EXACTLY the owner JS asked for (Rust returns the base58 of the
 *     32 bytes it decoded; a canonical request comes back unchanged);
 *   - the approved token account must equal JS's OWN `ATA(owner, mint)` (`a0AtaOf`: web3.js
 *     `findProgramAddressSync([owner, TOKEN_PROGRAM, mint], ASSOCIATED_TOKEN_PROGRAM)` — what
 *     spl-token's `getAssociatedTokenAddressSync` computes; the app does not depend on spl-token).
 *
 * A mismatch ABORTS the unshield (`E_A0_CONFIRM_MISMATCH`): nothing is proved with that `authId`.
 * It stays recorded in Rust until the caller's `finally` closes the handle (`keysClose` kills it,
 * §3) or its 120 s run out — the flow (Task 7) opens one handle per unshield and closes it in a
 * `finally`, so an aborted approval cannot outlive the attempt.
 *
 * The amount and fee are not returned: Rust bound them to the `authId` exactly as the human saw
 * them, and `prove` puts them into the proof's public inputs, which the payload builder compares
 * with JS's own (§6.6) before anything is sent.
 */
import {PublicKey} from '@solana/web3.js';
import {a0ConfirmUnshield} from '../../zkProver/nativeProverBridge';
import type {A0Handle, A0UnshieldApproval} from '../../zkProver/nativeProverBridge';
import {a0AtaOf} from './relayerClient';

export interface A0UnshieldConfirmRequest {
  /** The destination OWNER (a wallet address, base58) — never a token account (§6.1). */
  owner: string;
  /** Base units the destination receives. */
  amount: bigint;
  /** The quote's `minFee.withdraw_change` (R5), taken from the shielded balance. */
  fee: bigint;
}

export class A0ConfirmMismatchError extends Error {
  readonly code = 'E_A0_CONFIRM_MISMATCH' as const;
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'A0ConfirmMismatchError';
  }
}

export interface A0UnshieldConfirmDeps {
  confirm?: typeof a0ConfirmUnshield;
}

export async function confirmA0Unshield(
  handle: A0Handle,
  req: A0UnshieldConfirmRequest,
  deps: A0UnshieldConfirmDeps = {},
): Promise<A0UnshieldApproval> {
  const confirm = deps.confirm ?? a0ConfirmUnshield;
  const approval = await confirm(handle, req.owner, req.amount, req.fee);
  if (approval.owner !== req.owner) {
    throw new A0ConfirmMismatchError('the approved owner is not the requested one');
  }
  let owner: PublicKey;
  try {
    owner = new PublicKey(approval.owner);
  } catch {
    throw new A0ConfirmMismatchError('the approved owner is not a public key');
  }
  if (a0AtaOf(owner).toBase58() !== approval.ata) {
    throw new A0ConfirmMismatchError('the approved token account is not ATA(owner, mint)');
  }
  return approval;
}
```

Create `android/app/src/androidTest/java/com/nocturawallet/prover/A0ConfirmWindowTest.kt` (the phone's half — compiled here, run on the phone):

```kotlin
package com.nocturawallet.prover

import android.app.Activity
import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Build
import android.os.SystemClock
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.view.WindowManager
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.nocturawallet.MainActivity
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference
import org.json.JSONObject
import org.junit.After
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.Test

/**
 * The native confirmation's window ON THE PHONE (spec §4 "Window and lifecycle rules", I10; §14
 * "Kotlin (M1c)") — what only a real window shows; the decision logic is the JVM's
 * (A0ConfirmMachineTest). Instruments the installed devnet RELEASE app like M1aCheckpointTest
 * (`testBuildType "release"`); this class lives in the test APK only. Run one class at a time:
 *
 *   adb shell am instrument -w -r -e class com.nocturawallet.prover.A0ConfirmWindowTest \
 *     com.nocturawallet.devnet.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner
 *
 * No Rust call is made: the controller rows use a fake [A0UnshieldNative] (parse answers a fixed
 * record, authorize is never reached — no row here approves a biometric), and an authenticator
 * check that says "usable", so the rows run on a phone with or without an enrolled biometric.
 * What these rows cannot show: the BiometricPrompt itself (a human finger), whether the system
 * prompt pauses the activity on this phone's OEM build (if it does, every confirmation fails
 * closed with E_A0_CONFIRM_INTERRUPTED — the M1c checkpoint's unshield shows it), and an overlay
 * drawn by another app (hidden-overlay is read off the window's attributes, not watched).
 */
class A0ConfirmWindowTest {
    private val inst = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
    private lateinit var activity: Activity

    private val parsed = A0ParsedUnshield(
        owner = "GoBAmZzHvD6F4KHLNmBFh2wZAGE1dwwufeTbifSHEYfd",
        ata = "9hZSf8jMxBdqcvnYzj6EkQ2gPoZCoX2GcF8f1dgkyLsn",
        amount = "1500000000",
        fee = "10000",
        humanAmount = "1.5",
        humanFee = "0.00001",
        pool = "8VMe4iZWiq3xQySywih9cciAmzTxMtkawMRYK6JuDdoT",
    )

    private val fake = object : A0UnshieldNative {
        override fun parse(owner: String, amount: String, fee: String): A0Result = A0Result.Ok(
            JSONObject()
                .put("owner", parsed.owner).put("ata", parsed.ata).put("amount", parsed.amount).put("fee", parsed.fee)
                .put("humanAmount", parsed.humanAmount).put("humanFee", parsed.humanFee).put("pool", parsed.pool),
        )

        override fun authorize(handle: String, owner: String, amount: String, fee: String): A0Result =
            throw AssertionError("no row here may reach authorizeUnshield")
    }

    @Before
    fun launch() {
        val intent = Intent(inst.targetContext, MainActivity::class.java).addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)
        activity = inst.startActivitySync(intent)
        inst.waitForIdleSync()
    }

    @After
    fun finish() {
        inst.runOnMainSync { activity.finish() }
    }

    private fun <T> onMain(block: () -> T): T {
        val out = AtomicReference<T>()
        inst.runOnMainSync { out.set(block()) }
        return out.get()
    }

    private fun tap(target: android.view.View, flags: Int) {
        val loc = IntArray(2)
        inst.runOnMainSync { target.getLocationInWindow(loc) }
        val x = loc[0] + target.width / 2f
        val y = loc[1] + target.height / 2f
        val t = SystemClock.uptimeMillis()
        for ((action, at) in listOf(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN to t, MotionEvent.ACTION_UP to t + 50)) {
            val props = arrayOf(MotionEvent.PointerProperties().apply { id = 0; toolType = MotionEvent.TOOL_TYPE_FINGER })
            val coords = arrayOf(MotionEvent.PointerCoords().apply { this.x = x; this.y = y; pressure = 1f; size = 1f })
            // the public obtain(...) overload that carries `flags` — how the framework marks an obscured window
            val ev = MotionEvent.obtain(t, at, action, 1, props, coords, 0, 0, 1f, 1f, 0, 0, android.view.InputDevice.SOURCE_TOUCHSCREEN, flags)
            inst.runOnMainSync { target.rootView.dispatchTouchEvent(ev) }
            ev.recycle()
        }
        inst.waitForIdleSync()
    }

    @Test
    fun theDialogsWindowIsSecureAndHidesOverlaysOnApi31() {
        val d = onMain { A0ConfirmDialog.build(activity, parsed, onApprove = {}, onCancel = {}).also { it.dialog.show() } }
        try {
            val attrs = onMain { d.dialog.window!!.attributes }
            assertTrue("FLAG_SECURE", attrs.flags and WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SECURE != 0)
            assertTrue("filterTouchesWhenObscured", d.approve.filterTouchesWhenObscured)
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S) {
                // setHideOverlayWindows sets a private flag; LayoutParams.toString names it
                val s = attrs.toString()
                assertTrue("HIDE_NON_SYSTEM_OVERLAY_WINDOWS not in $s", s.contains("HIDE_NON_SYSTEM_OVERLAY_WINDOWS"))
            }
        } finally {
            inst.runOnMainSync { d.dialog.dismiss() }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun anObscuredTouchDoesNotApproveAndACleanOneDoes() {
        val m = A0ConfirmMachine({ SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() })
        val t = (m.begin(true) as A0ConfirmMachine.Begin.Started).ticket
        val steps = mutableListOf<A0ConfirmMachine.Step>()
        val d = onMain {
            A0ConfirmDialog.build(activity, parsed, onApprove = { f -> steps.add(m.approve(t, f)) }, onCancel = {})
                .also { it.dialog.show() }
        }
        try {
            m.shown(t)
            tap(d.approve, MotionEvent.FLAG_WINDOW_IS_OBSCURED) // dropped by the framework: no click at all
            assertEquals(emptyList<A0ConfirmMachine.Step>(), steps)
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
                tap(d.approve, MotionEvent.FLAG_WINDOW_IS_PARTIALLY_OBSCURED) // reaches the click; the machine ignores it
                assertEquals(listOf<A0ConfirmMachine.Step>(A0ConfirmMachine.Step.Ignore), steps)
                steps.clear()
            }
            tap(d.approve, 0) // positive control: a clean tap approves
            assertEquals(listOf<A0ConfirmMachine.Step>(A0ConfirmMachine.Step.Continue), steps)
        } finally {
            inst.runOnMainSync { d.dialog.dismiss() }
        }
    }

    private class Outcomes {
        val latch = CountDownLatch(1)
        val got = AtomicReference<A0ConfirmOutcome>()
        val settle: (A0ConfirmOutcome) -> Unit = { o ->
            check(got.compareAndSet(null, o)) { "settled twice: ${got.get()} then $o" }
            latch.countDown()
        }

        fun await(seconds: Long): A0ConfirmOutcome {
            assertTrue("no outcome within $seconds s", latch.await(seconds, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            return got.get()
        }
    }

    private fun controller(timeoutMs: Long = A0ConfirmMachine.TIMEOUT_MS) =
        A0ConfirmController(fake, canAuthenticate = { _, _ -> true }, timeoutMs = timeoutMs)

    private fun refusal(r: A0ConfirmRefusal) = A0ConfirmOutcome.Refused(r.code, r.message)

    @Test
    fun aNullActivityRefusesWithNoDialog() {
        val o = Outcomes()
        controller().start(null, "1", parsed.owner, parsed.amount, parsed.fee, o.settle)
        assertEquals(refusal(A0ConfirmRefusal.NO_ACTIVITY), o.await(1))
    }

    @Test
    fun aSecondRequestWhileOneIsInFlightIsRefused() {
        val c = controller()
        val first = Outcomes()
        c.start(activity, "1", parsed.owner, parsed.amount, parsed.fee, first.settle)
        inst.waitForIdleSync()
        val second = Outcomes()
        c.start(activity, "1", parsed.owner, parsed.amount, parsed.fee, second.settle)
        assertEquals(refusal(A0ConfirmRefusal.BUSY), second.await(1))
        c.sessionChanged() // end the first (keysClose)
        assertEquals(refusal(A0ConfirmRefusal.SESSION), first.await(5))
    }

    @Test
    fun recreatingTheActivityDuringTheDialogFailsClosed() {
        val c = controller()
        val o = Outcomes()
        c.start(activity, "1", parsed.owner, parsed.amount, parsed.fee, o.settle)
        inst.waitForIdleSync()
        inst.runOnMainSync { activity.recreate() }
        assertEquals(refusal(A0ConfirmRefusal.INTERRUPTED), o.await(10))
    }

    @Test
    fun noApprovalWithinTheTimeoutRefuses() {
        val c = controller(timeoutMs = 1_500)
        val o = Outcomes()
        c.start(activity, "1", parsed.owner, parsed.amount, parsed.fee, o.settle)
        val r = o.await(10)
        assertNotNull(r)
        assertEquals(refusal(A0ConfirmRefusal.TIMEOUT), r)
    }
}
```

Create `scripts/android-jvm/check-reports.mjs`:

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * The Kotlin JVM test job's own check (M1c Task 6, controller ruling 10): Gradle's exit status
 * alone does not say WHICH tests ran — a `--tests` filter that matches one class still passes, a
 * class whose every test is skipped (`assumeTrue`) still passes. This reads the JUnit XML reports
 * Gradle wrote and requires, for EVERY named class: exactly one report, at least one test, and
 * zero failures, errors and skipped tests. Any other report present is an error too (the job
 * runs exactly the classes it names).
 *
 *   node scripts/android-jvm/check-reports.mjs <reports dir> <fully.qualified.Class> [...]
 *
 * Exit 0 = every class ran and passed; 1 = a class is missing / empty / failed / skipped, or an
 * unnamed report is present; 2 = usage. Tested by check-reports.test.mjs (positive and negative
 * controls over hand-written reports).
 */
import {readdirSync, readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {join} from 'node:path';

export function readSuites(dir) {
  const out = new Map();
  for (const f of readdirSync(dir)) {
    if (!/^TEST-.*\.xml$/.test(f)) {
      continue;
    }
    const xml = readFileSync(join(dir, f), 'utf8');
    const m = /<testsuite\b([^>]*)>/.exec(xml);
    if (!m) {
      throw new Error(`${f}: no <testsuite> element`);
    }
    const attr = name => {
      const a = new RegExp(`\\b${name}="([^"]*)"`).exec(m[1]);
      if (!a) {
        throw new Error(`${f}: <testsuite> has no ${name}`);
      }
      return a[1];
    };
    const num = name => {
      const v = attr(name);
      if (!/^\d+$/.test(v)) {
        throw new Error(`${f}: ${name}="${v}" is not a count`);
      }
      return Number(v);
    };
    const name = attr('name');
    if (out.has(name)) {
      throw new Error(`two reports for ${name}`);
    }
    out.set(name, {tests: num('tests'), skipped: num('skipped'), failures: num('failures'), errors: num('errors')});
  }
  return out;
}

export function judge(suites, expected) {
  const problems = [];
  for (const cls of expected) {
    const s = suites.get(cls);
    if (!s) {
      problems.push(`${cls}: no report — it did not run`);
      continue;
    }
    if (s.tests === 0) {
      problems.push(`${cls}: 0 tests`);
    }
    for (const k of ['failures', 'errors', 'skipped']) {
      if (s[k] !== 0) {
        problems.push(`${cls}: ${s[k]} ${k}`);
      }
    }
  }
  for (const name of suites.keys()) {
    if (!expected.includes(name)) {
      problems.push(`${name}: a report for a class the job does not name`);
    }
  }
  return problems;
}

if (import.meta.url === `file://${process.argv[1]}`) {
  const [dir, ...expected] = process.argv.slice(2);
  if (!dir || expected.length === 0) {
    console.error('usage: check-reports.mjs <reports dir> <Class> [...]');
    process.exit(2);
  }
  const suites = readSuites(dir);
  const problems = judge(suites, expected);
  if (problems.length > 0) {
    for (const p of problems) {
      console.error(`FAIL ${p}`);
    }
    process.exit(1);
  }
  const total = expected.reduce((n, c) => n + suites.get(c).tests, 0);
  console.log(`${expected.length} classes, ${total} tests, all ran and passed (0 skipped)`);
}
```

Create `.github/workflows/android-jvm.yml`:

```yaml
name: Android JVM tests

# The Kotlin JVM unit tests of the prover module (android/app/src/test/). Until M1c no workflow ran
# them (M1a's stated "known gap"); M1c Task 6 puts the native unshield confirmation's security
# logic in Kotlin (A0ConfirmMachine: the obscured touch, the null activity, the one request in
# flight, the recreation, the 60 s timeout, keysClose / keysOpen), so controller ruling 10 reverses
# the gap on purpose: this job runs them on every change to their inputs.
#
# Kept cheap: `testDebugUnitTest` (the release unit-test task also runs Metro), the pure classes
# only (`--tests`), 2 workers, the Kotlin compiler in-process, no NDK, no Rust. NOT run here, stated:
# A0JniTest and M1aCheckpointHostTest — they load the HOST build of libnoctura_prover.so and the
# pinned key files (they refuse to skip under CI), which is the native-prover workflow's domain;
# they stay a desk run (`NOCTURA_A0_HOST_LIB_DIR=… ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest`).
#
# Gradle's exit status does not say which tests ran, so check-reports.mjs reads the JUnit XML and
# requires every named class to have run ≥ 1 test with 0 failures / errors / SKIPPED, and no other
# class; its own node tests (positive and negative controls) run first.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['android/**', 'native/noctura-prover/jni-exports.txt', 'native/noctura-prover/tests/fixtures/a0-ata-vectors.json', 'scripts/android-jvm/**', '.github/workflows/android-jvm.yml', 'package-lock.json']
  pull_request:
    paths: ['android/**', 'native/noctura-prover/jni-exports.txt', 'native/noctura-prover/tests/fixtures/a0-ata-vectors.json', 'scripts/android-jvm/**', '.github/workflows/android-jvm.yml', 'package-lock.json']
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  kotlin-jvm-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    env:
      FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: 'true'
      CLASSES: >-
        com.nocturawallet.prover.A0ConfirmMachineTest
        com.nocturawallet.prover.A0AuthenticatorsTest
        com.nocturawallet.prover.A0ConfirmTextTest
        com.nocturawallet.prover.ReactSurfaceTest
        com.nocturawallet.prover.A0AbiTest
        com.nocturawallet.prover.A0ResultTest
        com.nocturawallet.prover.A0SeedTest
        com.nocturawallet.prover.M1aCheckpointDeviceFailuresTest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: The report checker's own tests (positive and negative controls)
        run: node --no-warnings --test scripts/android-jvm/check-reports.test.mjs

      # The React Native Gradle plugin, autolinking and every native module's Android project come
      # from node_modules. npm pinned as in the other workflows (the lockfile writer).
      - run: npm install -g npm@11.6.2
      - run: npm ci

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
          cache: gradle

      - name: Run the pure Kotlin JVM tests
        working-directory: android
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          args=()
          for c in $CLASSES; do args+=(--tests "$c"); done
          ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest "${args[@]}" --console=plain --max-workers=2 \
            -Pkotlin.compiler.execution.strategy=in-process -PreactNativeArchitectures=arm64-v8a

      - name: Assert every named class ran, none skipped, nothing else ran
        run: node scripts/android-jvm/check-reports.mjs android/app/build/test-results/testDebugUnitTest $CLASSES
```

It shows: `FLAG_SECURE` on the dialog's window; on API 31+ the hide-overlay private flag, read from `WindowManager.LayoutParams.toString()` (if that row alone fails, read `adb shell dumpsys window windows` for the dialog's `pfl=` before calling it a product failure — the reading is the uncertain part); an obscured tap dropped by the framework, a partly obscured tap reaching the machine and ignored, a clean tap approving; a null activity, a second request, a recreation and a 1.5 s timeout settling with their codes. What NO automated row shows, and the checkpoint's first unshield does: the system `BiometricPrompt` with a real finger or credential; whether this phone's OEM build pauses the activity while the system prompt is up (if it does, every confirmation fails closed with `E_A0_CONFIRM_INTERRUPTED` — visible at once, never silent; the owner decides, nothing is relaxed in code); a real overlay drawn by another app; screenshots blocked / the recents thumbnail blank.

#### Notes for the executor (Task 6)

- **The rulings this task took (each the most secure default; the owner may overturn any):**
  - **The authenticator matrix (ruling 8), measured in Step 1 and held by `A0AuthenticatorsTest` against the library's own code:**

    | API level | allowed authenticators | why |
    |---|---|---|
    | 30 and up | `BIOMETRIC_STRONG \| DEVICE_CREDENTIAL` | supported (`isSupportedCombination`); the framework prompt shows the credential itself, inside the prompt |
    | 28–29 | `BIOMETRIC_STRONG` | `STRONG \| CREDENTIAL` is unsupported here; `WEAK \| CREDENTIAL` would admit a Class 2 biometric (§4 says "strong") |
    | 24–27 | `BIOMETRIC_STRONG` | `STRONG \| CREDENTIAL` is accepted, but its credential path is androidx's own button launching the `KeyguardManager` confirm-credential ACTIVITY, which pauses ours — I10 fails that closed every time, so offering it would offer a button that always fails |
    | below 24 | none — refused | below minSdk |

    `BIOMETRIC_WEAK` is never allowed, on any level. A device whose level allows only `BIOMETRIC_STRONG` and that has no strong biometric enrolled is refused (`canAuthenticate` ≠ `BIOMETRIC_SUCCESS` → `E_A0_CONFIRM_NO_AUTHENTICATOR`) — the "level with no safe combination refuses" of ruling 8, applied per device. This is STRICTER than the app's keychain (`BIOMETRY_ANY_OR_DEVICE_PASSCODE`, which admits a weak biometric); §4's text ("a strong biometric or the device credential") decides. Cost if wrong: a phone below API 30 with only a Class 2 face unlock cannot unshield (it gets the refusal, never a weaker prompt). The owner's phone's API level decides which row the checkpoint proves (Task 9 records `ro.build.version.sdk`).
  - **The 60 s run from the request** (`begin`), not from the dialog being drawn, and cover the dialog AND the prompt; an approval at or past the deadline is a timeout even if the main-thread timer has not fired yet (the clock is `SystemClock.elapsedRealtime`, which counts deep sleep, like Rust's CLOCK_BOOTTIME). Rust's 120 s start at the approval, as §4 says.
  - **An obscured gesture is ignored, not refused** (§4: "A touch delivered while obscured is ignored"): the dialog stays up and a clean tap works. `filterTouchesWhenObscured` drops a fully obscured touch in the framework, but it does NOT filter `FLAG_WINDOW_IS_PARTIALLY_OBSCURED` (API 29+), so the gesture's flags — every event from DOWN to UP, OR-ed — go to the machine, which ignores either flag. A click that is not a touch (an accessibility action) carries no flags and reaches the prompt, which still needs the human's biometric.
  - **Pause, stop or destroy fails closed**, and the activity is re-checked RESUMED just before the dialog shows (a request that raced a backgrounding never draws a dialog). The prompt runs with our dialog still on screen behind it (the user sees the destination while authenticating); both are torn down on every ending.
  - **`keysClose` / a second `keysOpen` fail a confirmation that is still waiting for the human** (`E_A0_CONFIRM_SESSION`), before the native call. Once the biometric has approved, the Rust call is already under way on the UI thread; Rust's one mutex orders it against the close, and either order leaves no live authorization (a close after the record kills it; a stale handle is refused), so the machine leaves that window to Rust.
  - **Rust gets the PARSED values** (`owner`, `amount`, `fee` from `parseUnshield`'s answer — what the human saw), never the strings JS passed. For a canonical request they are equal; a non-canonical one was refused by the parse.
  - **One process-wide controller and one binding.** `A0Confirmations` holds the controller (like Rust's state, one per process — a React reload makes a new module, not a second confirmation slot) and the one `A0UnshieldNative` over the JNI; the module's Kotlin-only `parseUnshield` / `authorizeUnshield` delegate to it, so `ReactSurfaceTest` still finds them bound and non-React.
  - **JS's ATA comparison lives in `confirmA0Unshield` (`src/modules/shielded/a0/unshieldConfirm.ts`), not in the bridge.** The bridge stays free of web3.js (it checks only the answer's shape); the comparison uses Task 3's `a0AtaOf` — web3.js `findProgramAddressSync([owner, TOKEN_PROGRAM, mint], ATA_PROGRAM)`, which is exactly what spl-token's `getAssociatedTokenAddressSync` computes; the app does not depend on spl-token and this task does not add it. The owner is compared too (Rust returns its own base58 of the 32 bytes; a mismatch can only be a bug, and it aborts). On a mismatch the `authId` stays recorded in Rust until the caller's `finally` closes the handle — no new native call was added to burn it.
  - **The dialog is built from platform widgets** (`android.app.AlertDialog`, `TextView`s, two `Button`s, monospace addresses, no truncation) — it is UNDRAWN in `index.html` (§2: "the confirmation dialog [is] undrawn"). Stated loudly for the owner's visual pass (Task 9's list); its wording is the resource's and §4's.
  - **`HIDE_OVERLAY_WINDOWS` is in the manifest of BOTH APKs** (the Kotlin is in both; only the devnet build's JS can reach it once Task 8 un-hides the route). It is a normal permission (no prompt, no settings entry). The production APK gains it with no behaviour change.
  - **`androidx.biometric:biometric:1.1.0` declared explicitly.** The APK already carried 1.1.0 through react-native-keychain (as a bare `@aar`, so not on the app's compile classpath); declaring the same version adds no class to the APK and makes the matrix's measurement the APK's library.
  - **The CI job (ruling 10), kept cheap.** Its own workflow (`android-jvm.yml`, path-filtered: `android/**`, the two fixtures and `jni-exports.txt` the tests read, `scripts/android-jvm/**`, the workflow, `package-lock.json`), `testDebugUnitTest` (the release unit-test task runs Metro), the eight pure classes by `--tests`, `--max-workers=2`, the compiler in-process, `-PreactNativeArchitectures=arm64-v8a`, setup-java's Gradle cache; no NDK, no Rust, no keys. Measured here: 44 s warm. A cold runner adds `npm ci` and the first compile of every React Native library module's debug classes — not measured (no runner in the dry run); the 45-minute limit is a guess with a wide margin. **Not in CI, stated:** `A0JniTest` and `M1aCheckpointHostTest` — they need the host library and the key files and refuse to skip under `CI` — so they stay a desk run; folding them into `native-prover.yml` (which already builds the host library and fetches the keys) is a possible follow-up, not done here (that job is already 90 minutes). `check-reports.mjs` exists because Gradle's green does not say which classes ran: a `--tests` typo, a renamed class or an `assumeTrue` that skips every row would all be green without it.
  - **The privacy guard reads the strings resource now**, with a positive control (it is the dialog's resource) and a planted "unlinkable" as the negative control. Task 8 widens the guard to the new screen directories.
- **The env file of the dry run.** The owner's `.env.devnet` was NOT read (it holds a Helius key). The devnet APK and the Gradle runs used `/home/user/Solana/Project/m1c-mut/env.devnet` (Step 6: the non-secret keys, plus the PUBLIC devnet RPC `https://api.devnet.solana.com` as `HELIUS_RPC_URL` / `HELIUS_WS_URL`), deleted afterwards. The executor builds the checkpoint's APKs from the owner's corrected `.env.devnet` (Task 1 / Task 9 README); the JVM tests read nothing from either.
- **Deviations from the brief:**
  - the brief names "an instrumented test on the phone for what only a real window shows (FLAG_SECURE set, overlay hiding on API 31+)"; `A0ConfirmWindowTest` also runs the controller's refusal rows on the real activity (null activity, busy, recreation, timeout, session) with a fake Rust binding — cheap, and the JVM cannot run the controller (it needs a `Looper`);

- **Not covered by a mutation, stated:** the controller (`A0ConfirmController`) — its wiring to the machine (that `onPromptSucceeded` asks the machine before calling Rust, that it passes the parsed values, that `finish` settles once) is read by review and exercised by `A0ConfirmWindowTest` on the phone, not by a JVM row: the JVM cannot construct it (`Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())`, `SystemClock`). The dialog's layout (whole addresses, no ellipsis) likewise.

### Task 7: The unshield flow and its reconciliation — `src/modules/shielded/a0/unshieldFlow.ts` (spec §6 steps 1–9, R5, R6, R12, I-2, I7, I13, S3, S9, S10, S11; §8 the pending unshield; §10 the fresh reservation; the controller's refusal semantics), the pending unshield in the note store, the `linked` mark in the registry, and the reconciliation joined to M1b's startup step and "Check again". What it adds:
- `unshieldA0(connection, seed, {destination, amount}, options)` — one call per unshield, in §6.7's order: the checks → `sync` (the verified tree, the note's path) → `quote` (Task 3) → the destination (S3/S9/S11: `fresh` only for a `slip10` wallet with a grant in the quote, reserved as `fresh-pending` here; `main`; `external`, refused when it is any key of this seed) → `approval` (Task 6's native confirmation) → `proof` (the allow-list witness; Task 3's builder compares the five public inputs JS recomputes) → the re-quote rule (stale + same terms → the same proof; changed → the proof discarded, a NEW confirmation) → `submitChainTime` (`getSlot` → `getBlockTime`) → the PENDING UNSHIELD written (`pendingSince` + the approved intent, one write) → `submit` → the outcome by Task 3's disposition. `confirmed` → the tree sync, 1 + 10 runs 3 s apart, until it lists the relayed signature → `matchSpent` + Task 4's verifier → the settle;
- the settle (the controller's ruling): verified → the note `spent`, the change note stored exactly as Task 5's restore recovers it (a zero change included), a fresh account `fresh-exit`; REFUSED → LOUD (`landed-unverified` + a readout line, never retried): the note `spent` all the same, the change recorded only when the landed leaf is ours, a seed-key signer → `fresh-exit` AND `linked`; a tx the relayer named that does not spend the note leaves it `pending`;
- `reconcileA0PendingUnshields(connection, seed | null, options)` — the chain clock FIRST, then a completed tree sync: a Withdraw `matchSpent` attributes → the settle with the STORED intent (the verifier runs after a kill too); none and the chain past `pendingSince + 300 s` → `unspent`, the reservation released (a quiet pool included); reservations no pending unshield names → released (promoted when the synced history names them); nothing to decide → no request;
- the note store: `markA0PendingUnshield`, `revertA0PendingUnshield`, `settleA0Unshield` and the optional `unshield` intent; the registry: `linked` on `fresh-exit` and `promoteA0FreshAccount(…, {linked})`; three readout events; `runA0Startup` step 3; "Check again" reconciling pending unshields (one keychain read, only when one exists);
- the test world: the live relayer fake (`__testing__/liveRelayer.ts`, landings in the RECORDED shapes of `47k56NfB…` / `3oHktG2X…` / `3UfCx5TD…` carrying OUR proof's values to OUR owner and ATA), the fake core's confirmation and offline `withdraw_change` prover (`offlineA0.ts`), the chain clock and rent in `liveDevnet.ts`, `appendWithdraw`'s templates; the kill tests.

    - the kill window opens at `unshield-submitting` (the pending unshield is written, the relayer request follows): the desk kills on that line;
    - CP2's "a second unshield started while the first is pending picks the next index" needs TWO unspent notes (the second unshield spends the other one; a pending note is never a source);
    - the startup line is unchanged; a settled / reverted pending unshield after a restart reads out as `unshield-reconcile`.

**The rule, stated once.** An unshield is one call that owns everything secret about it — the handle, the one
authorization, the proof and the payload that carry the in-flight nullifier — and lets none of it outlive the call; what
it writes BEFORE the relayer is asked (the pending unshield: when, and exactly what the human approved) is what lets
anyone later — this call, a "Check again", the next start after a kill — decide the note from the CHAIN alone: a
Withdraw that Rust attributes to the note means spent, whatever the relayer said and whatever the verifier thinks of
the rest; no such Withdraw once the chain's own clock is 300 s past the submit means it never landed. The relayer's
answer only chooses how long to wait; the verifier only decides whether the user is told "landed and verified" or,
loudly, "landed, but failed verification".

```diff
+/**
+ * The withdraw_change circuit computed OFFLINE for one live authorization (spec §3 `prove`, §1
+ * public inputs). Throws the Rust core's codes for a witness it would refuse.
+ */
+export function offlineWithdrawProof(
+  keys: OfflineA0Keys,
+  witnessJson: string,
+  auth: {ata: string; amount: bigint; fee: bigint},
+): {proofBytes: string; publicInputs: string[]} {
+  const w = JSON.parse(witnessJson) as Record<string, unknown>;
+  if (Object.keys(w).sort().join(',') !== 'inputAmount,merkleRoot,pathElements,pathIndices,rho') {
+    throw new NativeRefusal('E_A0_WITNESS_UNKNOWN_KEY', `fake withdraw prover: keys ${Object.keys(w).join(',')}`);
+  }
+  const root = canonical(w.merkleRoot, 'merkleRoot');
+  const rho = canonical(w.rho, 'rho');
+  const input = u64(w.inputAmount, 'inputAmount');
+  const els = w.pathElements as unknown[];
+  const idx = w.pathIndices as unknown[];
+  if (!Array.isArray(els) || !Array.isArray(idx) || els.length !== 20 || idx.length !== 20) {
+    throw new NativeRefusal('E_A0_WITNESS_VALUE', 'the path is not 20 levels');
+  }
+  if (auth.amount + auth.fee > input) {
+    throw new NativeRefusal('E_A0_WITHDRAW_EXCEEDS_INPUT', `${auth.amount} + ${auth.fee} > ${input}`);
+  }
+  let cur = BigInt(`0x${keys.commitment(input, rho)}`);
+  els.forEach((e, i) => {
+    const sib = BigInt(`0x${canonical(e, `pathElements[${i}]`)}`);
+    if (idx[i] !== 0 && idx[i] !== 1) {
+      throw new NativeRefusal('E_A0_WITNESS_VALUE', `pathIndices[${i}]`);
+    }
+    cur = idx[i] === 1 ? poseidon2([sib, cur]) : poseidon2([cur, sib]);
+  });
+  if (hex64(cur) !== root) {
+    throw new NativeRefusal('E_A0_WITNESS_NOT_IN_TREE', 'the path does not reach merkleRoot');
+  }
+  const nullifier = keys.nullifier(rho);
+  const change = keys.commitment(input - auth.amount - auth.fee, keys.rhoChange(nullifier));
+  const publicInputs = [
+    root,
+    nullifier,
+    hex64(auth.amount),
+    hex64(beModR(base58.decode(auth.ata))),
+    hex64(MINT_HASH),
+    change,
+    hex64(auth.fee),
+  ];
+  const seed = enc.encode(publicInputs.join(''));
+  const proof = cat(...[4, 5, 6, 7].map(k => sha512(cat(Uint8Array.of(k), seed))));
+  return {proofBytes: Buffer.from(proof).toString('hex'), publicInputs};
+}
```

Create `src/modules/shielded/a0/__testing__/liveRelayer.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * TEST-ONLY: a "live" A0 relayer over the live devnet fake (never imported by app code; it is
 * NEVER the real relayer — no test contacts api.noc-tura.io).
 *
 * It is plugged in as the relayer transport's `fetchImpl` (`relayerTransport.ts` is unchanged:
 * the real URL check, the real JSON parsing, the real deadline). `GET …/relayer/quote` answers the
 * contract's quote (`quote`, editable; `gasGrantLamports` only when the relayer grants).
 * `POST …/relayer/submit` checks the payload the way the coordinator does what the wallet relies
 * on (kind, the destination = ATA(destinationOwner) from the OFFLINE vectors, the fee = the quote's
 * minFee, the named fields = the public inputs read big-endian) and then does what the test
 * scripted (`script`, one entry per submit; default `confirmed`):
 *   - landing = the relayer's tx in the RECORDED shape (`ownHistory.appendWithdraw`): a clone of
 *     the landed `47k56NfB…` (create-ATA + the grant, the owner at 0 lamports) when the quote
 *     grants and the owner is not `funded`, else of `3oHktG2X…` (create-ATA no-op, no grant) —
 *     carrying OUR nullifier, change commitment, amount, fee, root and proof bytes, to OUR owner
 *     and ATA, at the chain's clock; the tree account advanced as the program does it;
 *   - `confirmed` → lands, answers 200 `{outcome: confirmed, txSignature}`; `hideForSyncs: k` keeps
 *     it out of the tree's signature list for the next k tree walks (RPC lag, I-2); `mutate` edits
 *     the landed recorded tx (a refusal row);
 *   - `unconfirmed` → lands or not (`lands`), answers 502 with the signature;
 *   - `already_spent` → 409, no signature; `relay_failed` → 502 without a signature (nothing
 *     forwarded; `before` runs first, e.g. to push the root out of the ring); `raw` → the given
 *     status and body (a refusal, or an answer the contract does not allow; `lands` lands first and
 *     `"<landed>"` in the body is replaced by the signature); `transport` → the request throws;
 *     `hang` → never answers (the transport's deadline decides);
 *   - `kill` → lands or not, and the answer never comes (the app died waiting); `abandon()` ends it.
 * A nullifier that already landed answers `already_spent` whatever the script says (the chain's
 * `init` of the nullifier record would refuse the tx).
 */
import type {PinnedFetchResponse} from '../../../sslPinning/pinnedFetch';
import type {RelayerRequestOptions} from '../relayerTransport';
import {offlineAta} from './offlineA0';
import {appendWithdraw} from './ownHistory';
import {blobsOf, freshSignature, toHex} from './chainEdits';
import type {WithdrawTemplate} from './ownHistory';
import type {LiveDevnet} from './liveDevnet';
import type {RecordedTx} from './recordedRpc';

export const LIVE_RELAYER_BASE = 'https://live-relayer.invalid/api/v1';
export const RELAYER_FEE_PAYER = '3jvhiz9qcJAe2zGHvRAiRYXiaFCdjEQrB9KuE5NuFaGe';
export const LIVE_GRANT = 3_000_000n;
export const LIVE_FEE = 10_000n;

export type RelayerScript =
  | {
      answer: 'confirmed';
      hideForSyncs?: number;
      template?: WithdrawTemplate;
      mutate?: (tx: RecordedTx) => void;
      /** land another change commitment than the payload's (a relayer that swapped it; the tree stays consistent) */
      changeCommitment?: string;
    }
  | {answer: 'unconfirmed'; lands: boolean; template?: WithdrawTemplate}
  | {answer: 'already_spent'}
  | {answer: 'relay_failed'; before?: () => void}
  | {answer: 'raw'; status: number; body: unknown; lands?: boolean}
  | {answer: 'transport'}
  | {answer: 'hang'}
  | {answer: 'kill'; lands: boolean};

export interface LiveRelayer {
  /** pass as `options.transport` */
  transport: RelayerRequestOptions;
  /** the quote body served (edit it between calls) */
  quote: Record<string, unknown>;
  quoteRequests: number;
  /** the payloads received, parsed */
  submits: Record<string, unknown>[];
  /** the signatures landed, in order */
  landed: string[];
  /** consumed one per submit */
  script: RelayerScript[];
  /** owners that already hold SOL (no grant for them) */
  funded: Set<string>;
  /** end every answer the `kill` entries left hanging (they reject as a transport error) */
  abandon(): void;
}

const status = {confirmed: 200, unconfirmed: 502, already_spent: 409, relay_failed: 502} as const;

function respond(code: number, body: unknown): PinnedFetchResponse {
  const text = JSON.stringify(body);
  return {status: code, headers: {}, json: async () => JSON.parse(text) as unknown, text: async () => text};
}

const be = (hex: string): string => BigInt(`0x${hex}`).toString();

export function liveRelayer(net: LiveDevnet, o: {grant?: boolean} = {}): LiveRelayer {
  const hanging: ((e: Error) => void)[] = [];
  const hidden: {entry: (typeof net.chain.signatures)[number]; walks: number}[] = [];
  const previous = net.onRequest;
  net.onRequest = (method, params) => {
    if (method === 'getSignaturesForAddress' && params[0] === net.chain.tree) {
      for (const h of [...hidden]) {
        h.walks -= 1;
        if (h.walks < 0) {
          net.chain.signatures.unshift(h.entry);
          hidden.splice(hidden.indexOf(h), 1);
        }
      }
    }
    previous?.(method, params);
  };

  const r: LiveRelayer = {
    transport: {base: LIVE_RELAYER_BASE, fetchImpl: undefined},
    quote: {
      programId: 'FeGSSsJtmA7GnMgnpj33JsiceSk1NyFopff2FtQFsMuH',
      pool: '8VMe4iZWiq3xQySywih9cciAmzTxMtkawMRYK6JuDdoT',
      mint: 'ERkpCFGaoWmeZPhKTUHumrqHTP1QmyHVhMJUnxbRPKCs',
      feePayer: RELAYER_FEE_PAYER,
      maxFee: '100000',
      minFee: {transfer: LIVE_FEE.toString(), withdraw_change: LIVE_FEE.toString()},
      ...(o.grant === false ? {} : {gasGrantLamports: LIVE_GRANT.toString()}),
      validForSeconds: 60,
    },
    quoteRequests: 0,
    submits: [],
    landed: [],
    script: [],
    funded: new Set(),
    abandon() {
      for (const reject of hanging.splice(0)) {
        reject(new Error('live relayer: the app died waiting for this answer'));
      }
    },
  };

  const land = (p: Record<string, string>, template?: WithdrawTemplate, changeCommitment?: string): string => {
    const grants = r.quote.gasGrantLamports !== undefined && !r.funded.has(p.destinationOwner!);
    const sig = appendWithdraw(net.chain, {
      nullifier: p.nullifier!,
      changeCommitment: changeCommitment ?? p.changeCommitment!,
      amount: BigInt(p.withdrawAmount!),
      fee: BigInt(p.fee!),
      to: {owner: p.destinationOwner!, ata: p.destination!},
      template: template ?? (grants ? '47k56NfB' : '3oHktG2X'),
      ...(net.clock.blockTime !== null ? {blockTime: net.clock.blockTime} : {}),
      merkleRoot: p.merkleRoot!,
      proofBytes: p.proofBytes!,
    }).signature;
    r.landed.push(sig);
    return sig;
  };

  const submit = async (body: string): Promise<PinnedFetchResponse> => {
    const p = JSON.parse(body) as Record<string, string> & {publicInputs: string[]; cuLimit: number};
    r.submits.push(p);
    const pi = p.publicInputs;
    const minFee = (r.quote.minFee as {withdraw_change: string}).withdraw_change;
    if (
      p.kind !== 'withdraw_change' ||
      p.destination !== offlineAta(p.destinationOwner!) ||
      p.fee !== minFee ||
      p.cuLimit !== 200_000 ||
      !Array.isArray(pi) ||
      pi.length !== 7 ||
      pi[0] !== be(p.merkleRoot!) ||
      pi[1] !== be(p.nullifier!) ||
      pi[2] !== p.withdrawAmount ||
      pi[5] !== be(p.changeCommitment!) ||
      pi[6] !== p.fee
    ) {
      return respond(400, {outcome: 'invalid_request', error: 'live relayer: the payload does not hold together'});
    }
    const withdrawBlob = `c0f1c9d946965af7${p.nullifier!}`;
    const spentBefore = Object.values(net.chain.transactions).some(t => blobsOf(t).some(b => toHex(b.bytes) === withdrawBlob));
    if (spentBefore) {
      return respond(409, {outcome: 'already_spent', alreadySpentIndexes: [0]});
    }
    const s = r.script.shift() ?? {answer: 'confirmed'};
    switch (s.answer) {
      case 'confirmed': {
        const sig = land(p, s.template, s.changeCommitment);
        const tx = net.chain.transactions[sig]!;
        s.mutate?.(tx);
        if (s.hideForSyncs !== undefined && s.hideForSyncs > 0) {
          const i = net.chain.signatures.findIndex(e => e.signature === sig);
          hidden.push({entry: net.chain.signatures.splice(i, 1)[0]!, walks: s.hideForSyncs});
        }
        return respond(status.confirmed, {success: true, outcome: 'confirmed', txSignature: sig});
      }
      case 'unconfirmed': {
        // a forwarded tx that did not land still has a signature: a fresh one nobody lists
        const sig = s.lands ? land(p, s.template) : freshSignature(200 + r.submits.length);
        return respond(status.unconfirmed, {success: false, outcome: 'unconfirmed', txSignature: sig});
      }
      case 'already_spent':
        return respond(status.already_spent, {outcome: 'already_spent'});
      case 'relay_failed':
        s.before?.();
        return respond(status.relay_failed, {outcome: 'relay_failed', error: 'live relayer: simulation failed'});
      case 'raw': {
        const sig = s.lands ? land(p) : null;
        const text = JSON.stringify(s.body).replace('"<landed>"', JSON.stringify(sig));
        return respond(s.status, JSON.parse(text) as unknown);
      }
      case 'transport':
        throw new Error('live relayer: connection reset');
      case 'hang':
        return new Promise<PinnedFetchResponse>((_ok, reject) => {
          hanging.push(reject);
        });
      case 'kill':
        if (s.lands) {
          land(p);
        }
        net.killed = true;
        return new Promise<PinnedFetchResponse>((_ok, reject) => {
          hanging.push(reject);
        });
    }
  };

  r.transport.fetchImpl = async (url, init) => {
    if (url === `${LIVE_RELAYER_BASE}/relayer/quote` && init?.method === 'GET') {
      r.quoteRequests += 1;
      return respond(200, r.quote);
    }
    if (url === `${LIVE_RELAYER_BASE}/relayer/submit` && init?.method === 'POST') {
      return submit(String(init.body));
    }
    throw new Error(`live relayer: ${init?.method ?? '?'} ${url} is not the contract's`);
  };
  return r;
}
```

Create `src/modules/shielded/a0/__testing__/unshieldWorld.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * TEST-ONLY: the world an A0 unshield runs in, for the flow and reconciliation suites (never
 * imported by app code): the recorded devnet tree + the test seed's own deposits (offline
 * equations, `ownHistory.appendDeposit`), those notes `unspent` in the encrypted store, the live
 * devnet fake (`liveDevnet.ts`), the live relayer over it (`liveRelayer.ts`), and the fake native
 * core approving every confirmation (`offlineA0.ts`). The suite owns the jest mocks (the real
 * web3.js, the fake NocturaProver) and hands the fake in.
 */
import {readFileSync} from 'fs';
import {join} from 'path';
import type {AssetIO} from '../../../zkProver/provingAssets';
import {mergeA0RecoveredNotes} from '../noteStore';
import {EXIT_ACCOUNT_VECTORS, TEST_SEED, offlineKeys} from './offlineA0';
import type {FakeProverNative} from './offlineA0';
import {appendDeposit} from './ownHistory';
import {chainFrom} from './recordedRpc';
import type {RecordedFixture} from './recordedRpc';
import {liveDevnet} from './liveDevnet';
import type {LiveDevnet} from './liveDevnet';
import {liveRelayer} from './liveRelayer';
import type {LiveRelayer} from './liveRelayer';

export const TREE = JSON.parse(
  readFileSync(join(__dirname, '../__tests__/fixtures/devnet-tree-5URd.json'), 'utf8'),
) as RecordedFixture;
/** the recorded tree's leaf count (slot 522620135) */
export const RECORDED_LEAVES = 17;
export const own = offlineKeys(TEST_SEED);

/** The test seed's slip10:n (address, ATA) and the other seed's slip10:0 — offline vectors. */
export const ACCOUNT = (n: number) => EXIT_ACCOUNT_VECTORS[0]!.accounts[n]!;
export const MAIN = ACCOUNT(0);
export const OTHER = EXIT_ACCOUNT_VECTORS[1]!.accounts[0]!;

/** The withdraw_change key files, "present and pinned" (the digests are §1's). */
export const WITHDRAW_IO: AssetIO = {
  cachePath: (id, kind) => `/cache/${id}.${kind}`,
  exists: async () => true,
  download: async () => undefined,
  sha256: async p =>
    p.endsWith('.zkey')
      ? 'ec55bdbbbfedb9823a57e5a3131c457a259fe8a690c087b82ad8b7efd3d756f2'
      : '01b0ec1f28dec05e712b2fa0524c7b212409abf330b3380119d8e64d9845e0b9',
  remove: async () => undefined,
};

export interface OwnNote {
  rho: string;
  amount: bigint;
  commitment: string;
  leafIndex: number;
  nullifier: string;
}

export interface UnshieldWorld {
  net: LiveDevnet;
  relayer: LiveRelayer;
  notes: OwnNote[];
}

/**
 * Deposits of `amounts` (counters 0, 1, …) appended to the recorded tree and stored `unspent`;
 * the relayer grants unless `grant: false`; the main and the other seed's account hold SOL.
 * The caller has opened the encrypted store.
 */
export function unshieldWorld(fake: FakeProverNative, o: {amounts?: bigint[]; grant?: boolean} = {}): UnshieldWorld {
  const net = liveDevnet(chainFrom(TREE));
  const notes = (o.amounts ?? [1_000_000n]).map((amount, i) => {
    const rho = own.rho(BigInt(i));
    const commitment = own.commitment(amount, rho);
    const {leafIndex} = appendDeposit(net.chain, {amount, commitment, rho});
    return {rho, amount, commitment, leafIndex, nullifier: own.nullifier(rho)};
  });
  mergeA0RecoveredNotes(
    notes.map((n, i) => ({commitment: n.commitment, amount: n.amount, rho: n.rho, depositIndex: BigInt(i), leafIndex: n.leafIndex, status: 'unspent' as const})),
    BigInt(notes.length),
  );
  const relayer = liveRelayer(net, {grant: o.grant});
  relayer.funded.add(MAIN.address);
  relayer.funded.add(OTHER.address);
  fake.reset();
  fake.setConfirmer(() => 'approve');
  return {net, relayer, notes};
}

/** The change note an unshield of `note` for `amount` + `fee` leaves, from the offline equations. */
export function expectedChange(note: OwnNote, amount: bigint, fee: bigint): {rho: string; amount: bigint; commitment: string} {
  const rho = own.rhoChange(note.nullifier);
  const change = note.amount - amount - fee;
  return {rho, amount: change, commitment: own.commitment(change, rho)};
}
```

```ts
// ------------------------------------------------------------------ the outcomes (§6 step 8)

describe('nothing forwarded → the note unspent again, the reservation released', () => {
  it.each([
    ['invalid_request', 400],
    ['duplicate_in_flight', 429],
    ['budget_exceeded', 429],
    ['balance_too_low', 503],
    ['unavailable', 503],
    ['transfer_disabled', 503],
    ['relayer_disabled', 503],
    ['misconfigured', 500],
  ])('%s (%i)', async (outcome, status) => {

    expect(noteOf(w.notes[0]!.rho).pendingSince).toBeUndefined();
    expect(noteOf(w.notes[0]!.rho).unshield).toBeUndefined();
    expect(registry()).toEqual([{scheme: 'slip10:0', role: 'main'}]);
  });

  it('relay_failed without a signature, the root still in the ring: not sent (one confirmation only)', async () => {
    w.relayer.script.push({answer: 'relay_failed'});

    expect(fake.approvals).toBe(1);
    expect(registry()).toEqual([{scheme: 'slip10:0', role: 'main'}]);
  });

  it('an answer the contract does not allow (confirmed, no signature) is relay_failed, not forwarded (contract §1)', async () => {
    w.relayer.script.push({answer: 'raw', status: 200, body: {outcome: 'confirmed'}});
    expect(await run(fresh(400_000n))).toEqual({status: 'not-sent', outcome: 'relay_failed'});
    expect(noteOf(w.notes[0]!.rho).status).toBe('unspent');
  });
});

describe('confirmed: the sync retry bound (I-2)', () => {
  let atSubmit = 0;
  const mark = {onStage: (s: A0UnshieldStage) => (s === 'submit' ? (atSubmit = w.net.requests.length) : undefined)};

  it('RPC lag: the signature appears on the 4th sync after the answer → settled', async () => {
    w.relayer.script.push({answer: 'confirmed', hideForSyncs: 3});
    expect(await run(fresh(400_000n), mark)).toMatchObject({status: 'spent'});
    expect(treeWalks(atSubmit)).toBe(4);
  });

  it(`never listed: exactly 1 + ${RETRIES} syncs, then pending ("not-in-sync"), the note pending, the reservation kept`, async () => {
    w.relayer.script.push({answer: 'confirmed', hideForSyncs: 1000});
    const out = await run(fresh(400_000n), mark);
    expect(out).toEqual({status: 'pending', signature: w.relayer.landed[0], reason: 'not-in-sync'});
    expect(treeWalks(atSubmit)).toBe(1 + RETRIES);
    expect(noteOf(w.notes[0]!.rho).status).toBe('pending');
    expect(registry()).toContainEqual({scheme: 'slip10:1', role: 'fresh-pending'});
  });

  it(`the default pause between those syncs is ${PAUSE_MS} ms`, async () => {
    const real = global.setTimeout;
    const pauses: number[] = [];
    const spy = jest.spyOn(global, 'setTimeout').mockImplementation(((fn: () => void, ms?: number) => {
      if (ms === PAUSE_MS) {
        pauses.push(ms);
        return real(fn, 0);
      }
      return real(fn, ms);
    }) as typeof setTimeout);
    try {
      w.relayer.script.push({answer: 'confirmed', hideForSyncs: 2});
      expect(await run(fresh(400_000n), {confirmSyncDelayMs: undefined})).toMatchObject({status: 'spent'});
    } finally {
      spy.mockRestore();
    }
    expect(pauses).toEqual([PAUSE_MS, PAUSE_MS]);
  });
});

describe('the re-quote → re-confirm rule (§6 step 7, I7)', () => {
  let clockMs = 1_800_000_000_000;
  const asked: {fee: string}[] = [];
  const atDialog = (first: () => void) => {

    fake.setConfirmer(req => {
      asked.push({fee: req.fee});
      n += 1;
      if (n === 1) {
        clockMs += 60_000; // the human took a minute: the quote (validForSeconds 60) is stale at submit
        first();
      }
      return 'approve';
    });
  };
  beforeEach(() => {
    asked.length = 0;
  });
  const proves = () => fake.calls.filter(c => c.method === 'prove').length;

  it('stale, same terms → re-fetched, the SAME proof submitted (one confirmation, one prove)', async () => {

    expect([fake.approvals, proves(), w.relayer.submits.length]).toEqual([1, 1, 1]);
  });

    atDialog(() => {

    });

    expect(w.relayer.submits[0]).toMatchObject({fee: '12000'});

    expect(fake.liveAuth()).toBeNull();
  });

  it('stale, the grant withdrawn → a fresh account is no longer offered: refused, nothing sent, the reservation released', async () => {

    });

    expect(w.relayer.submits).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(registry()).toEqual([{scheme: 'slip10:0', role: 'main'}]);
    expect(noteOf(w.notes[0]!.rho).status).toBe('unspent');
  });

  it('stale, the new fee leaves less than the amount in the note → refused, nothing sent', async () => {
    atDialog(() => {
      w.relayer.quote.maxFee = '1000000';
      w.relayer.quote.minFee = {transfer: '10000', withdraw_change: '700000'};
    });
    expect(await codeOf(run(fresh(400_000n), {now: () => clockMs}))).toBe('E_A0_UNSHIELD_TERMS');
    expect(w.relayer.submits).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('relay_failed after the root left the 64-root ring → re-synced, a new path, a NEW confirmation, then landed', async () => {
    w.relayer.script.push({
      answer: 'relay_failed',
      before: () => {
        for (let k = 0; k < 64; k++) {
          w.net.landForeign({amount: 1n + BigInt(k), commitment: strangerField(500 + k), rho: strangerField(900 + k)});
        }
      },
    });
    const out = await run(fresh(400_000n));
    expect(out).toMatchObject({status: 'spent', changeLeafIndex: RECORDED_LEAVES + 1 + 64});
    expect([fake.approvals, proves(), w.relayer.submits.length]).toEqual([2, 2, 2]);
    expect(w.relayer.submits[1]!.merkleRoot).not.toBe(w.relayer.submits[0]!.merkleRoot);
    expect(registry()).toContainEqual({scheme: 'slip10:1', role: 'fresh-exit'});
  }, 90_000); // 64 appended deposits, synced twice: ~10 s alone
});

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ a refused landing is LOUD

/** Replace the landed tx's Withdraw nullifier (event + instruction argument) with `n`. */
function withNullifier(tx: RecordedTx, n: string): void {
  const line = blobsOf(tx).find(b => toHex(b.bytes.subarray(0, 8)) === 'c0f1c9d946965af7')!.line;
  setBlob(tx, line, Uint8Array.from([...fromHex('c0f1c9d946965af7'), ...fromHex(n)]));
  const msg = tx.transaction.message;
  const ix = msg.instructions.find(i => msg.accountKeys[i.programIdIndex] === 'FeGSSsJtmA7GnMgnpj33JsiceSk1NyFopff2FtQFsMuH')!;
  const data = base58.decode(ix.data);
  data.set(fromHex(n), 40);
  ix.data = base58.encode(data);
}
/** Set the landed tx's top-level SystemProgram.transfer to `lamports`. */
function withGrant(tx: RecordedTx, lamports: bigint): void {
  const msg = tx.transaction.message;
  const ix = msg.instructions.find(i => msg.accountKeys[i.programIdIndex] === '11111111111111111111111111111111')!;
  const data = base58.decode(ix.data);
  new DataView(data.buffer, data.byteOffset).setBigUint64(4, lamports, true);
  ix.data = base58.encode(data);
}
```
