```js
  ata: 'ATokenGPvbdGVxr1b2hvZbsiqW5xWH25efTNsLJA8knL',
  token: 'TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA',
  bpfUpgradeable: 'BPFLoaderUpgradeab1e11111111111111111111111',
};
/** The relayer's fee payer, pinned (controller ruling 9; = lib.mjs RELAYER_FEE_PAYER). */
export const RELAYER_FEE_PAYER = '3jvhiz9qcJAe2zGHvRAiRYXiaFCdjEQrB9KuE5NuFaGe';
/**
 * The deployed binary since 2026-11-17 (the program side's upgrade 25h52FQX…, f3f8eff; the
 * controller's R1′): sha256 of the ELF the programData account holds.
 */
export const DEPLOYED_BINARY_SHA256 = 'b0054981ab0019ff5af81ed46d5443a6e6467f23aff5b506fc661b73d5d65d1b';

export const WITHDRAW_CHANGE = {
  disc: '6cf44379ecf67997',
  dataBytes: 8 + 32 + 32 + 8 + 32 + 8 + 4 + 256,
  accounts: [
    'pool',
    'merkle_tree',
    'vault',
    'destination_token_account',
    'nullifier_record',
    'fee_payer',
    'fee_destination_token_account',
    'wchange_vk',
    'token_program',
    'system_program',
  ],
};
const WITHDRAW_EVENT = { disc: 'c0f1c9d946965af7', bytes: 40 };
const LEAF_EVENT = { disc: '59f3d408d7bfbb98', bytes: 80 };
/** `WithdrawChangeVkAccount`: 8 disc | authority 32 | pool 32 | bump 1 | pad 7 | written u32 | pad 4 | vk 960. */
export const WCHANGE_VK_LAYOUT = { size: 8 + 32 + 32 + 1 + 7 + 4 + 4 + 960, pool: 40, written: 80, vk: 88, vkBytes: 960 };

const hex = b => Buffer.from(b).toString('hex');
const sha256 = (...parts) => {
  const h = createHash('sha256');
  for (const p of parts) {
    h.update(p);
  }
  return new Uint8Array(h.digest());
};
const u64le = (b, at) => Buffer.from(b.subarray(at, at + 8)).readBigUInt64LE(0);
const u32le = (b, at) => Buffer.from(b.subarray(at, at + 4)).readUInt32LE(0);

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------- keys and PDAs

/** Whether a 32-byte key is a point on Ed25519 (Solana's `is_on_curve`: it decompresses). */
export function isOnCurve(address) {
  try {
    ed25519.Point.fromBytes(base58.decode(address));
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/** `find_program_address`: the first bump from 255 down whose hash is OFF the curve. */
export function findPda(seeds, programId) {
  const program = base58.decode(programId);
  for (let bump = 255; bump >= 0; bump--) {
    const h = sha256(...seeds, Uint8Array.of(bump), program, new TextEncoder().encode('ProgramDerivedAddress'));
    const address = base58.encode(h);
    if (!isOnCurve(address)) {
      return { address, bump };
    }
  }
  throw new Error('no bump');
}

/** The associated token account of (owner, mint) — seeds [owner, token program, mint] under the ATA program. */
export function ataOf(owner, mint = A0.mint) {
  return findPda([base58.decode(owner), base58.decode(PROGRAMS.token), base58.decode(mint)], PROGRAMS.ata).address;
}

/** The `wchange_vk` account of a pool: seeds ["wchange_vk", pool] under the A0 program (spec R1-I6). */
export function wchangeVkAddress(pool = A0.pool) {
  return findPda([new TextEncoder().encode('wchange_vk'), base58.decode(pool)], A0.programId).address;
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------- the wire

function shortvec(b, i) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  for (;;) {
    const x = b[i++];
    if (x === undefined) {
      throw new Error('truncated');
    }
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;
    if (x < 0x80) {
      return [v, i];
    }
  }
}

/** A wire transaction (legacy message only — every relayed tx is one): signatures, keys, instructions. */
export function decodeWire(raw) {
  let [n, i] = shortvec(raw, 0);
  const signatures = [];
  for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
    signatures.push(base58.encode(raw.subarray(i, i + 64)));
    i += 64;
  }
  const msg = raw.subarray(i);
  if (msg[0] & 0x80) {
    return { versioned: true, signatures };
  }
  const header = { required: msg[0], readonlySigned: msg[1], readonlyUnsigned: msg[2] };
  let j = 3;
  let nk;
  [nk, j] = shortvec(msg, j);
  const keys = [];
  for (let k = 0; k < nk; k++) {
    keys.push(base58.encode(msg.subarray(j, j + 32)));
    j += 32;
  }
  j += 32; // the recent blockhash
  let ni;
  [ni, j] = shortvec(msg, j);
  const instructions = [];
  for (let x = 0; x < ni; x++) {
    const program = keys[msg[j++]];
    let na;
    [na, j] = shortvec(msg, j);
    const accounts = [...msg.subarray(j, j + na)].map(a => keys[a]);
    j += na;
    let dl;
    [dl, j] = shortvec(msg, j);
    const data = Uint8Array.from(msg.subarray(j, j + dl));
    j += dl;
    instructions.push({ program, accounts, data });
  }
  if (j !== msg.length) {
    throw new Error(`${msg.length - j} bytes after the instructions`);
  }
  return { versioned: false, signatures, header, keys, instructions };
}

/** The `Program data:` events the A0 program emitted in its OWN top-level frame (invoke stack exactly [FeGSS…]). */
function frameEvents(logs) {
  const out = [];
  const stack = [];
  for (const line of logs ?? []) {
    let m = /^Program (\S+) invoke \[(\d+)\]$/.exec(line);
    if (m) {
      stack.push(m[1]);
      continue;
    }
    if (/^Program (\S+) (success|failed: .*)$/.test(line)) {
      stack.pop();
      continue;
    }
    m = /^Program data: (\S+)$/.exec(line);
    if (m && stack.length === 1 && stack[0] === A0.programId) {
      out.push(base64.decode(m[1]));
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * A `getTransaction(sig, {encoding: 'base64', maxSupportedTransactionVersion: 0})` result decoded
 * for the §6.8 checks (null for null). Every top-level instruction of the four programs the
 * relayed shape uses is read by its layout; anything else is listed in `foreign`.
 */
export function decodeRelayedTx(result) {
  if (!result) {
    return null;
  }
  const raw = base64.decode(result.transaction[0]);
  const w = decodeWire(raw);
  const meta = result.meta ?? {};
  const base = { slot: result.slot, blockTime: result.blockTime, ok: meta.err === null, err: meta.err ?? null, signature: w.signatures[0] };
  if (w.versioned) {
    return { ...base, versioned: true };
  }
  const keys = w.keys;
  const signers = keys.slice(0, w.header.required);
  const programs = w.instructions.map(x => x.program);
  const withdraws = [];
  const createAta = [];
  const system = [];
  const foreign = [];
  for (const x of w.instructions) {
    if (x.program === A0.programId) {
      if (hex(x.data.subarray(0, 8)) !== WITHDRAW_CHANGE.disc || x.data.length !== WITHDRAW_CHANGE.dataBytes || x.accounts.length !== WITHDRAW_CHANGE.accounts.length) {
        withdraws.push({ malformed: true, disc: hex(x.data.subarray(0, 8)), dataBytes: x.data.length, accounts: x.accounts.length });
        continue;
      }
      const d = x.data;
      withdraws.push({
        ...Object.fromEntries(WITHDRAW_CHANGE.accounts.map((n, k) => [n, x.accounts[k]])),
        merkleRoot: hex(d.subarray(8, 40)),
        nullifier: hex(d.subarray(40, 72)),
        amount: u64le(d, 72),
        changeCommitment: hex(d.subarray(80, 112)),
        fee: u64le(d, 112),
        proofLength: u32le(d, 120),
      });
    } else if (x.program === PROGRAMS.ata) {
      createAta.push({ idempotent: x.data.length === 1 && x.data[0] === 1, accounts: x.accounts });
    } else if (x.program === PROGRAMS.system) {
      const transfer = x.data.length === 12 && u32le(x.data, 0) === 2 && x.accounts.length === 2;
      system.push(transfer ? { transfer: true, from: x.accounts[0], to: x.accounts[1], lamports: u64le(x.data, 4) } : { transfer: false, dataBytes: x.data.length });
    } else if (x.program !== PROGRAMS.computeBudget) {
      foreign.push(x.program);
    }
  }
  const withdrawEvents = [];
  const leafInserted = [];
  for (const b of frameEvents(meta.logMessages)) {
    const disc = hex(b.subarray(0, 8));
    if (disc === WITHDRAW_EVENT.disc) {
      withdrawEvents.push(b.length === WITHDRAW_EVENT.bytes ? { nullifier: hex(b.subarray(8, 40)) } : { malformed: true });
    } else if (disc === LEAF_EVENT.disc) {
      leafInserted.push(
        b.length === LEAF_EVENT.bytes ? { commitment: hex(b.subarray(8, 40)), leafIndex: Number(u64le(b, 40)), root: hex(b.subarray(48, 80)) } : { malformed: true },
      );
    }
  }
  const index = a => keys.indexOf(a);
  const lamports = (which, a) => (index(a) < 0 ? null : BigInt(meta[which]?.[index(a)] ?? 0));
  const tokens = (which, a) => {
    const e = (meta[which] ?? []).find(t => t.accountIndex === index(a) && t.mint === A0.mint);
    return e ? BigInt(e.uiTokenAmount.amount) : null;
  };
  return {
    ...base,
    versioned: false,
    signers,
    feePayer: keys[0],
    keys,
    programs,
    withdraws,
    createAta,
    system,
    foreign,
    withdrawEvents,
    leafInserted,
    preLamports: a => lamports('preBalances', a),
    postLamports: a => lamports('postBalances', a),
    preTokens: a => tokens('preTokenBalances', a),
    postTokens: a => tokens('postTokenBalances', a),
  };
}

/**
 * Every §6.8 condition on ONE relayed unshield, from the chain alone, against what the phone said
 * it submitted (`sub`, the `unshield-submitting` readout: owner, ata, amount, fee, feePayer,
 * gasGrantLamports, seedKeys) and its outcome (`out`: changeLeafIndex, grantLamports). Returns
 * `{checks: [{name, pass, detail}], grant: {lamports, ownerPreLamports} | null, ownerPreLamports,
 * ataPreTokens, ataPostTokens}`. A check never passes on a missing value.
 */
export function judgeRelayedUnshield({ tx, sub, out }) {
  const checks = [];
  const add = (name, pass, detail) => checks.push({ name, pass: Boolean(pass), detail });
  if (!tx) {
    add('landed', false, 'not found on devnet (getTransaction answered null)');
    return { checks, grant: null, ownerPreLamports: null, ataPreTokens: null, ataPostTokens: null };
  }
  add('landed', tx.ok && !tx.versioned, `slot ${tx.slot}, err ${JSON.stringify(tx.err)}${tx.versioned ? ', a versioned message (not the relayed shape)' : ''}`);
  if (tx.versioned) {
    return { checks, grant: null, ownerPreLamports: null, ataPreTokens: null, ataPostTokens: null };
  }
  const fp = RELAYER_FEE_PAYER;
  const allowed = new Set([PROGRAMS.computeBudget, PROGRAMS.ata, PROGRAMS.system, A0.programId]);
  const wd = tx.withdraws.filter(x => !x.malformed);
  const w = wd.length === 1 && tx.withdraws.length === 1 ? wd[0] : null;
  add(
    'program',
    w && tx.foreign.length === 0 && tx.programs.every(p => allowed.has(p)),
    `top level: ${tx.programs.map(p => p.slice(0, 6)).join(', ')}; withdraw_with_change ${wd.length} of ${tx.withdraws.length} FeGSS instruction(s)${tx.foreign.length ? `; FOREIGN ${tx.foreign.join(',')}` : ''}`,
  );
  if (!w) {
    return { checks, grant: null, ownerPreLamports: null, ataPreTokens: null, ataPostTokens: null };
  }
  const vault = ataOf(A0.pool);
  add(
    'pool',
    w.pool === A0.pool && w.merkle_tree === A0.merkleTree && w.vault === vault && w.wchange_vk === wchangeVkAddress() && w.token_program === PROGRAMS.token && w.system_program === PROGRAMS.system,
    `pool ${w.pool}, tree ${w.merkle_tree}, vault ${w.vault} (ATA(pool) ${vault}), wchange_vk ${w.wchange_vk}`,
  );
  const we = tx.withdrawEvents;
  add('withdraw-event', we.length === 1 && we[0].nullifier === w.nullifier, `${we.length} Withdraw event(s) in FeGSS's frame; nullifier = the instruction's: ${we[0]?.nullifier === w.nullifier}`);
  const li = tx.leafInserted.filter(l => !l.malformed);
  add(
    'change-leaf',
    tx.leafInserted.length === 1 && li.length === 1 && li[0].commitment === w.changeCommitment && Number.isInteger(out?.changeLeafIndex) && li[0].leafIndex === out.changeLeafIndex,
    `LeafInserted ${li.map(l => `${l.commitment.slice(0, 12)}… leaf ${l.leafIndex}`).join(', ') || 'none'}; instruction change ${w.changeCommitment.slice(0, 12)}…; the phone's change leaf ${out?.changeLeafIndex ?? 'none'}`,
  );
  add(
    'fee-payer',
    tx.signers.length === 1 && tx.signers[0] === fp && tx.feePayer === fp && w.fee_payer === fp && sub.feePayer === fp,
    `signers [${tx.signers.join(', ')}], tx fee payer ${tx.feePayer}, instruction fee_payer ${w.fee_payer}, the quote's ${sub.feePayer} (pinned ${fp})`,
  );
  const feeAta = ataOf(fp);
  const feeDelta = tx.postTokens(feeAta) !== null ? tx.postTokens(feeAta) - (tx.preTokens(feeAta) ?? 0n) : null;
  add('fee-destination', w.fee_destination_token_account === feeAta, `${w.fee_destination_token_account} (ATA(fee payer) ${feeAta})`);
  add('fee', w.fee === BigInt(sub.fee) && feeDelta === BigInt(sub.fee), `instruction fee ${w.fee}, the fee destination's token delta ${feeDelta}, ours ${sub.fee}`);
  const ownAta = ataOf(sub.owner);
  const ataPre = tx.preTokens(ownAta);
  const ataPost = tx.postTokens(ownAta);
  const destDelta = ataPost !== null ? ataPost - (ataPre ?? 0n) : null;
  const vaultDelta = tx.postTokens(vault) !== null && tx.preTokens(vault) !== null ? tx.postTokens(vault) - tx.preTokens(vault) : null;
  add(
    'destination',
    w.destination_token_account === sub.ata && sub.ata === ownAta && w.amount === BigInt(sub.amount) && destDelta === BigInt(sub.amount) && vaultDelta === -(BigInt(sub.amount) + BigInt(sub.fee)),
    `instruction destination ${w.destination_token_account}, ours ${sub.ata} (ATA(${sub.owner}) ${ownAta}); amount ${w.amount}, its token delta ${destDelta}, ours ${sub.amount}; vault delta ${vaultDelta}`,
  );
  const transfers = tx.system.filter(s => s.transfer);
  const ownerPre = tx.preLamports(sub.owner);
  let grant = null;
  let grantOk;
  let grantDetail;
  if (tx.system.length !== transfers.length) {
    grantOk = false;
    grantDetail = 'a top-level System instruction that is not a transfer';
  } else if (transfers.length > 1) {
    grantOk = false;
    grantDetail = `${transfers.length} top-level transfers`;
  } else if (transfers.length === 1) {
    const t = transfers[0];
    grant = { lamports: t.lamports, ownerPreLamports: ownerPre };
    grantOk =
      sub.gasGrantLamports !== null && t.lamports === BigInt(sub.gasGrantLamports) && t.from === fp && t.to === sub.owner && ownerPre === 0n && isOnCurve(sub.owner) && out?.grantLamports === t.lamports.toString();
    grantDetail = `one top-level transfer of ${t.lamports} from ${t.from} to ${t.to} (quote ${sub.gasGrantLamports}, owner pre-balance ${ownerPre}, on curve ${isOnCurve(sub.owner)}, the phone saw ${out?.grantLamports})`;
  } else {
    grantOk = out?.grantLamports === null;
    grantDetail = `no top-level transfer (owner pre-balance ${ownerPre}; the phone saw ${out?.grantLamports})`;
  }
  add('grant', grantOk, grantDetail);
  const ca = tx.createAta;
  const want = [fp, sub.ata, sub.owner, A0.mint, PROGRAMS.system, PROGRAMS.token];
  add(
    'create-ata',
    ca.length === 1 && ca[0].idempotent && ca[0].accounts.length === want.length && want.every((k, i) => ca[0].accounts[i] === k),
    ca.length ? ca.map(c => `${c.idempotent ? 'CreateIdempotent' : 'NOT idempotent'} (${c.accounts.join(', ')})`).join('; ') : 'no create-ATA-idempotent (the uniform shape requires one)',
  );
  const seed = new Set(sub.seedKeys ?? []);
  const seedSigners = tx.signers.filter(k => seed.has(k));
  const seedInTx = tx.keys.filter(k => seed.has(k));
  add(
    'no-seed-signer',
    Array.isArray(sub.seedKeys) && sub.seedKeys.length >= 1 && seedSigners.length === 0 && seedInTx.every(k => k === sub.owner),
    `${sub.seedKeys?.length ?? 0} seed keys read out; seed keys among the signers: ${seedSigners.join(',') || 'none'}; in the tx: ${seedInTx.join(',') || 'none'} (allowed: only the destination owner)`,
  );
  return { checks, grant, ownerPreLamports: ownerPre, ataPreTokens: ataPre, ataPostTokens: ataPost };
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------- the deployed binary

/**
 * The ELF an upgradeable program's programData account holds: the account is
 * `u32 tag 3 | u64 slot | Option<Pubkey> authority (1 + 32)` = 45 bytes, then the ELF, then zero
 * padding up to the allocated length. The ELF's length is read from its OWN header (section
 * headers last: e_shoff + e_shnum × e_shentsize — trailing zero bytes are part of a real ELF,
 * so the padding cannot be found by stripping zeros), and everything after it must be zero.
 * Returns `{sha256, elfBytes, paddingBytes, authority}` or `{error}`.
 */
export function programDataBinary(data) {
  if (data.length < 45 + 64 || u32le(data, 0) !== 3) {
    return { error: `not a programData account (${data.length} bytes, tag ${data.length >= 4 ? u32le(data, 0) : 'none'})` };
  }
  const authority = data[12] === 1 ? base58.encode(data.subarray(13, 45)) : null;
  const elf = data.subarray(45);
  if (hex(elf.subarray(0, 4)) !== '7f454c46' || elf[4] !== 2 || elf[5] !== 1) {
    return { error: 'the program bytes are not a 64-bit little-endian ELF' };
  }
  const b = Buffer.from(elf);
  const shoff = Number(b.readBigUInt64LE(0x28));
  const shentsize = b.readUInt16LE(0x3a);
  const shnum = b.readUInt16LE(0x3c);
  const phoff = Number(b.readBigUInt64LE(0x20));
  const phentsize = b.readUInt16LE(0x36);
  const phnum = b.readUInt16LE(0x38);
  const elfBytes = Math.max(shoff + shnum * shentsize, phoff + phnum * phentsize);
  if (elfBytes > elf.length || shentsize !== 64) {
    return { error: `the ELF header says ${elfBytes} bytes (shentsize ${shentsize}); the account holds ${elf.length}` };
  }
  const padding = elf.subarray(elfBytes);
  if (padding.some(x => x !== 0)) {
    return { error: `${padding.length} bytes after the ELF are not all zero` };
  }
  return { sha256: hex(sha256(elf.subarray(0, elfBytes))), elfBytes, paddingBytes: padding.length, authority };
}

/** The program account of an upgradeable program: `u32 tag 2 | programData pubkey`. */
export function programDataAddressOf(programAccountData) {
  if (programAccountData.length !== 36 || u32le(programAccountData, 0) !== 2) {
    return null;
  }
  return base58.encode(programAccountData.subarray(4, 36));
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------- the wchange_vk

const be32 = dec => {
  const h = BigInt(dec).toString(16).padStart(64, '0');
  if (h.length !== 64) {
    throw new Error('a coordinate above 2^256');
  }
  return Buffer.from(h, 'hex');
};
/**
 * A snarkjs verifying key (vk.json) written in the program's byte encoding — EIP-197: a G1 point
 * x‖y big-endian, a G2 point x.c1‖x.c0‖y.c1‖y.c0 (snarkjs writes G2 as [c0, c1]) — alpha 64 |
 * beta 128 | gamma 128 | delta 128 | IC n×64. Our own writer; the chain's bytes are compared with it.
 */
export function vkBytesFromSnarkjs(vk) {
  if (vk.protocol !== 'groth16' || vk.curve !== 'bn128' || vk.IC.length !== vk.nPublic + 1) {
    throw new Error('not a groth16 / bn128 verifying key with nPublic + 1 IC points');
  }
  const g1 = p => {
    if (p[2] !== '1') {
      throw new Error('a G1 point is not affine');
    }
    return Buffer.concat([be32(p[0]), be32(p[1])]);
  };
  const g2 = p => {
    if (p[2][0] !== '1' || p[2][1] !== '0') {
      throw new Error('a G2 point is not affine');
    }
    return Buffer.concat([be32(p[0][1]), be32(p[0][0]), be32(p[1][1]), be32(p[1][0])]);
  };
  return Buffer.concat([g1(vk.vk_alpha_1), g2(vk.vk_beta_2), g2(vk.vk_gamma_2), g2(vk.vk_delta_2), ...vk.IC.map(g1)]);
}

/** Anchor's account discriminator: sha256("account:<Name>")[0..8]. */
export const accountDiscriminator = name => hex(sha256(new TextEncoder().encode(`account:${name}`)).subarray(0, 8));

/**
 * The `wchange_vk` account (getAccountInfo, base64) against the pinned withdraw_change VK:
 * owner = the A0 program, its address = PDA(["wchange_vk", pool]), the discriminator
 * `account:WithdrawChangeVkAccount`, its pool = 8VMe…, `written` = all 960 bytes, and the 960 VK
 * bytes = the pinned vk.json in the program's encoding. One `{pass, detail}` per check.
 */
export function judgeWchangeVk({ address, account, pinnedVk }) {
  const checks = [];
  const add = (name, pass, detail) => checks.push({ name, pass: Boolean(pass), detail });
  const expected = wchangeVkAddress();
  add('address', address === expected, `${address} (PDA ["wchange_vk", pool] ${expected})`);
  if (!account) {
    add('account', false, 'no account at that address');
    return checks;
  }
  const data = Buffer.from(base64.decode(account.data[0]));
  add('owner', account.owner === A0.programId, `owner ${account.owner}`);
  add('layout', data.length === WCHANGE_VK_LAYOUT.size && hex(data.subarray(0, 8)) === accountDiscriminator('WithdrawChangeVkAccount'), `${data.length} bytes (a WithdrawChangeVkAccount is ${WCHANGE_VK_LAYOUT.size}), discriminator ${hex(data.subarray(0, 8))}`);
  if (data.length !== WCHANGE_VK_LAYOUT.size) {
    return checks;
  }
  const pool = base58.encode(data.subarray(WCHANGE_VK_LAYOUT.pool, WCHANGE_VK_LAYOUT.pool + 32));
  const written = data.readUInt32LE(WCHANGE_VK_LAYOUT.written);
  add('pool', pool === A0.pool, `pool ${pool}`);
  add('written', written === WCHANGE_VK_LAYOUT.vkBytes, `written ${written} of ${WCHANGE_VK_LAYOUT.vkBytes} bytes`);
  const onChain = data.subarray(WCHANGE_VK_LAYOUT.vk, WCHANGE_VK_LAYOUT.vk + WCHANGE_VK_LAYOUT.vkBytes);
  const pinned = vkBytesFromSnarkjs(pinnedVk);
  const firstDiff = [...onChain].findIndex((x, i) => x !== pinned[i]);
  add('vk', pinned.length === onChain.length && firstDiff < 0, firstDiff < 0 && pinned.length === onChain.length ? `the 960 VK bytes on chain = withdraw_change_vk.json (alpha, beta, gamma, delta, 8 IC points)` : `differs from withdraw_change_vk.json at byte ${firstDiff} (pinned ${pinned.length} bytes)`);
  return checks;
}
```

Create `scripts/m1c-checkpoint/chain.test.mjs`:

```js
/**
 * The M1c desk's own chain reading (chain.mjs): every §6.8 condition on a relayed unshield, the
 * deployed binary's digest, the wchange_vk against the pinned VK — held to what the CHAIN wrote,
 * never to the app's code:
 *   - the two relayed withdraws recorded once from devnet (src/modules/shielded/a0/__tests__/
 *     fixtures/landed-withdraw-{5F8Ks5qa,5sKiWZTv}.json, scripts/a0-fixtures/fetch-devnet-tx.mjs):
 *     5F8Ks5qa… is the fresh-owner shape with the 3,000,000-lamport grant, 5sKiWZTv… the
 *     existing-owner shape without; their PDAs (the vault, the fee destination, the destination
 *     ATA, wchange_vk) are the accounts the program itself accepted — the positive controls of
 *     `findPda` / `ataOf`;
 *   - the wchange_vk account recorded once (fixtures/devnet-chain-facts.json, `chain-facts
 *     --record`, slot 523482591) against native/noctura-prover's pinned withdraw_change_vk.json;
 *   - the programData reading on a synthetic ELF built here field by field, and — when
 *     NOCTURA_A0_PROGRAM_SO names the program side's built shielded_pool.so — on the real binary
 *     (skipped LOUDLY otherwise).
 * Each check is shown to FAIL on a one-field mutation of the recorded transaction (or the phone's
 * readout). No network, no device: node --test scripts/m1c-checkpoint/*.test.mjs
 */
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { test } from 'node:test';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { base58, base64 } from '@scure/base';
import * as C from './chain.mjs';

const HERE = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const ROOT = join(HERE, '../..');
const fixture = sig => JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(ROOT, `src/modules/shielded/a0/__tests__/fixtures/landed-withdraw-${sig}.json`), 'utf8'));
const FACTS = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(HERE, 'fixtures/devnet-chain-facts.json'), 'utf8'));
const PINNED_VK = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(ROOT, 'native/noctura-prover/tests/fixtures/a0-vk/withdraw_change_vk.json'), 'utf8'));
const FP = '3jvhiz9qcJAe2zGHvRAiRYXiaFCdjEQrB9KuE5NuFaGe';

// the recorded facts (read-landed-withdraw.mjs's output; the tx logs) — written out, not computed here
const FRESH = {
  sig: '5F8Ks5qa',
  sub: { owner: 'AgPYn4odQNKwWBjvCtgG8G1supmLKaFHtbDVHmMT2KtP', ata: '2ot2kwhs7gFFPHAYNwkuNsUsfZp8hWAgzHpNQLx9pASu', amount: '400000', fee: '10000', feePayer: FP, gasGrantLamports: '3000000', seedKeys: ['AgPYn4odQNKwWBjvCtgG8G1supmLKaFHtbDVHmMT2KtP', 'DaiWcqhB9YpdqXUypDAF97WTAEY9bEdwjfX4eDFp9yNc'] },
  out: { changeLeafIndex: 20, grantLamports: '3000000' },
};
const EXISTING = {
  sig: '5sKiWZTv',
  sub: { owner: 'GoBAmZzHvD6F4KHLNmBFh2wZAGE1dwwufeTbifSHEYfd', ata: '9hZSf8jMxBdqcvnYzj6EkQ2gPoZCoX2GcF8f1dgkyLsn', amount: '400000', fee: '10000', feePayer: FP, gasGrantLamports: '3000000', seedKeys: ['DaiWcqhB9YpdqXUypDAF97WTAEY9bEdwjfX4eDFp9yNc'] },
  out: { changeLeafIndex: 22, grantLamports: null },
};
const decoded = (c, edit = r => r) => C.decodeRelayedTx(edit(structuredClone(fixture(c.sig).result)));
const failing = ({ c, sub = {}, out = {}, edit }) =>
  C.judgeRelayedUnshield({ tx: decoded(c, edit), sub: { ...c.sub, ...sub }, out: { ...c.out, ...out } })
    .checks.filter(x => !x.pass)
    .map(x => x.name);

/** Re-encode the recorded wire transaction after editing its decoded message (keys / instruction data). */
function editWire(result, f) {
  const raw = Buffer.from(base64.decode(result.transaction[0]));
  const w = C.decodeWire(raw);
  f(w);
  const sv = n => {
    const out = [];
    do {
      let b = n & 0x7f;
      n >>= 7;
      if (n) {
        b |= 0x80;
      }
      out.push(b);
    } while (n);
    return out;
  };
  const sigEnd = 1 + 64 * w.signatures.length;
  const blockhash = raw.subarray(sigEnd + 3 + sv(w.keys.length).length + 32 * w.keys.length, sigEnd + 3 + sv(w.keys.length).length + 32 * w.keys.length + 32);
  const parts = [raw.subarray(0, sigEnd), Buffer.from([w.header.required, w.header.readonlySigned, w.header.readonlyUnsigned]), Buffer.from(sv(w.keys.length))];
  for (const k of w.keys) {
    parts.push(Buffer.from(base58.decode(k)));
  }
  parts.push(blockhash, Buffer.from(sv(w.instructions.length)));
  for (const x of w.instructions) {
    parts.push(Buffer.from([w.keys.indexOf(x.program)]), Buffer.from(sv(x.accounts.length)), Buffer.from(x.accounts.map(a => w.keys.indexOf(a))), Buffer.from(sv(x.data.length)), Buffer.from(x.data));
  }
  result.transaction[0] = base64.encode(Buffer.concat(parts));
  return result;
}

test('the wire reader round-trips the recorded transactions byte for byte (the editor below is faithful)', () => {
  for (const c of [FRESH, EXISTING]) {
    const r = fixture(c.sig).result;
    assert.equal(editWire(structuredClone(r), () => undefined).transaction[0], r.transaction[0]);
  }
});

test('positive controls: both recorded relayed withdraws pass every §6.8 check', () => {
  for (const c of [FRESH, EXISTING]) {
    const j = C.judgeRelayedUnshield({ tx: decoded(c), sub: c.sub, out: c.out });
    assert.deepEqual(j.checks.map(x => [x.name, x.pass]), [
      ['landed', true], ['program', true], ['pool', true], ['withdraw-event', true], ['change-leaf', true], ['fee-payer', true],
      ['fee-destination', true], ['fee', true], ['destination', true], ['grant', true], ['create-ata', true], ['no-seed-signer', true],
    ], c.sig);
  }
  const f = C.judgeRelayedUnshield({ tx: decoded(FRESH), sub: FRESH.sub, out: FRESH.out });
  assert.deepEqual([f.grant.lamports, f.grant.ownerPreLamports, f.ataPreTokens, f.ataPostTokens], [3000000n, 0n, null, 400000n]);
  const e = C.judgeRelayedUnshield({ tx: decoded(EXISTING), sub: EXISTING.sub, out: EXISTING.out });
  assert.deepEqual([e.grant, e.ownerPreLamports, e.ataPreTokens, e.ataPostTokens], [null, 3466370962n, 3500000n, 3900000n]);
});

test('the PDAs the program accepted: the vault, wchange_vk, the fee destination and both destination ATAs', () => {
  const t = decoded(FRESH).withdraws[0];
  assert.equal(C.ataOf('8VMe4iZWiq3xQySywih9cciAmzTxMtkawMRYK6JuDdoT'), t.vault);
  assert.equal(C.wchangeVkAddress(), t.wchange_vk);
  assert.equal(C.ataOf(FP), t.fee_destination_token_account);
  assert.equal(C.ataOf(FRESH.sub.owner), t.destination_token_account);
  assert.equal(C.ataOf(EXISTING.sub.owner), decoded(EXISTING).withdraws[0].destination_token_account);
  // the on-curve test: wallet keys are points, PDAs are not
  assert.equal(C.isOnCurve(FRESH.sub.owner), true);
  assert.equal(C.isOnCurve(FP), true);
  assert.equal(C.isOnCurve(t.vault), false);
  assert.equal(C.isOnCurve(t.wchange_vk), false);
});

test('each §6.8 check FAILS on a one-field mutation (the recorded tx or the phone\'s readout)', () => {
  const cases = [
    ['landed', { c: FRESH, edit: r => ({ ...r, meta: { ...r.meta, err: { InstructionError: [3, { Custom: 6001 }] } } }) }],
    ['grant', { c: FRESH, out: { grantLamports: null } }],
    ['grant', { c: FRESH, sub: { gasGrantLamports: '2000000' } }],
    ['grant', { c: FRESH, sub: { gasGrantLamports: null } }],
    ['grant', { c: FRESH, edit: r => ({ ...r, meta: { ...r.meta, preBalances: r.meta.preBalances.map((b, i) => (i === 5 ? 1 : b)) } }) }],
    ['grant', { c: EXISTING, out: { grantLamports: '3000000' } }],
    ['change-leaf', { c: FRESH, out: { changeLeafIndex: 21 } }],
    ['change-leaf', { c: FRESH, out: { changeLeafIndex: undefined } }],
    ['fee-payer', { c: FRESH, sub: { feePayer: 'GoBAmZzHvD6F4KHLNmBFh2wZAGE1dwwufeTbifSHEYfd' } }],
    ['fee', { c: FRESH, sub: { fee: '10001' } }],
    ['destination', { c: FRESH, sub: { amount: '400001' } }],
    ['destination', { c: FRESH, sub: { ata: EXISTING.sub.ata } }],
    ['no-seed-signer', { c: FRESH, sub: { seedKeys: [...FRESH.sub.seedKeys, FP] } }],
    ['no-seed-signer', { c: FRESH, sub: { seedKeys: [...FRESH.sub.seedKeys, '9643JXJm5ZZwv8yaTozQ2qMeVw6xHQWhquGsD87knME9'] } }],
    ['no-seed-signer', { c: FRESH, sub: { seedKeys: [] } }],
    ['withdraw-event', { c: FRESH, edit: r => ({ ...r, meta: { ...r.meta, logMessages: r.meta.logMessages.filter(l => !l.startsWith('Program data: wPHJ')) } }) }],
  ];
  for (const [name, m] of cases) {
    assert.ok(failing(m).includes(name), `${name}: ${JSON.stringify({ ...m, edit: Boolean(m.edit) })} → ${failing(m)}`);
  }
  // the fee destination: another token account in the instruction's slot 6
  assert.ok(failing({ c: FRESH, edit: r => editWire(r, w => {
    const k = w.keys.indexOf('9643JXJm5ZZwv8yaTozQ2qMeVw6xHQWhquGsD87knME9');
    w.keys[k] = '2ot2kwhs7gFFPHAYNwkuNsUsfZp8hWAgzHpNQLx9pASu';
    for (const x of w.instructions) {
      x.accounts = x.accounts.map(a => (a === '9643JXJm5ZZwv8yaTozQ2qMeVw6xHQWhquGsD87knME9' ? '2ot2kwhs7gFFPHAYNwkuNsUsfZp8hWAgzHpNQLx9pASu' : a));
    }
  }) }).includes('fee-destination'));
});

test('the shape rules: a foreign pool, two transfers, a non-transfer System call, a missing or other create-ATA, a foreign program, a second signer', () => {
  const withIx = (c, f) => failing({ c, edit: r => editWire(r, f) });
  const pool = '8VMe4iZWiq3xQySywih9cciAmzTxMtkawMRYK6JuDdoT';
  assert.ok(withIx(FRESH, w => {
    w.keys[w.keys.indexOf(pool)] = 'GoBAmZzHvD6F4KHLNmBFh2wZAGE1dwwufeTbifSHEYfd';
    for (const x of w.instructions) {
      x.accounts = x.accounts.map(a => (a === pool ? 'GoBAmZzHvD6F4KHLNmBFh2wZAGE1dwwufeTbifSHEYfd' : a));
    }
  }).includes('pool'));
  const sys = w => w.instructions.find(x => x.program === C.PROGRAMS.system);
  assert.ok(withIx(FRESH, w => w.instructions.splice(2, 0, { ...sys(w), data: Uint8Array.from(sys(w).data) })).includes('grant')); // two transfers
  assert.ok(withIx(FRESH, w => { sys(w).data = Uint8Array.of(0, 0, 0, 0); }).includes('grant')); // not a transfer
  assert.ok(withIx(FRESH, w => { w.instructions = w.instructions.filter(x => x.program !== C.PROGRAMS.ata); }).includes('create-ata'));
  assert.ok(withIx(FRESH, w => { w.instructions.find(x => x.program === C.PROGRAMS.ata).data = Uint8Array.of(0); }).includes('create-ata')); // Create, not idempotent
  assert.ok(withIx(EXISTING, w => {
    const a = w.instructions.find(x => x.program === C.PROGRAMS.ata);
    a.accounts = [a.accounts[0], a.accounts[1], FP, ...a.accounts.slice(3)]; // another owner
  }).includes('create-ata'));
  assert.ok(withIx(FRESH, w => { w.instructions.find(x => x.program === C.PROGRAMS.computeBudget).program = C.PROGRAMS.token; }).includes('program'));
  assert.ok(withIx(FRESH, w => { w.instructions.push({ ...w.instructions.find(x => x.program === C.A0.programId) }); }).includes('program'));
  assert.ok(withIx(FRESH, w => { w.header.required = 2; }).includes('fee-payer')); // a second signer
  assert.ok(withIx(FRESH, w => {
    const x = w.instructions.find(i => i.program === C.A0.programId);
    x.data = Uint8Array.from([...x.data.subarray(0, 120), 0, 1, 0, 0, ...x.data.subarray(124)]).subarray(0, 379); // 379 bytes
  }).includes('program'));
});

test('only the A0 program\'s OWN top-level frame counts: its events from an inner invocation are not the withdraw\'s', () => {
  const inject = r => {
    const logs = r.meta.logMessages;
    const leaf = logs.find(l => l.startsWith('Program data: WfPU'));
    const i = logs.indexOf('Program ATokenGPvbdGVxr1b2hvZbsiqW5xWH25efTNsLJA8knL invoke [1]');
    logs.splice(i + 1, 0, `Program ${C.A0.programId} invoke [2]`, leaf, 'Program data: wPHJ2UaWWvcLIBiy5SC7+UIGSNOJp2qq16NLTGPpr79/Hy6ZeIh2LQ==', `Program ${C.A0.programId} success`);
    return r;
  };
  const t = decoded(FRESH, inject);
  assert.equal(t.leafInserted.length, 1);
  assert.equal(t.withdrawEvents.length, 1);
  assert.deepEqual(failing({ c: FRESH, edit: inject }), []);
  // control: the same lines in the top-level frame are counted — two LeafInserted, two Withdraw → refused
  const top = r => {
    const logs = r.meta.logMessages;
    const end = logs.lastIndexOf(`Program ${C.A0.programId} success`);
    logs.splice(end, 0, logs.find(l => l.startsWith('Program data: WfPU')), logs.find(l => l.startsWith('Program data: wPHJ')));
    return r;
  };
  assert.deepEqual(failing({ c: FRESH, edit: top }), ['withdraw-event', 'change-leaf']);
});

test('a missing tx or a versioned message is not judged as landed', () => {
  assert.deepEqual(C.judgeRelayedUnshield({ tx: null, sub: FRESH.sub, out: FRESH.out }).checks.map(c => [c.name, c.pass]), [['landed', false]]);
  const r = fixture(FRESH.sig).result;
  const raw = Buffer.from(base64.decode(r.transaction[0]));
  raw[65] |= 0x80; // the message's first byte: a version prefix
  const v = C.decodeRelayedTx({ ...r, transaction: [base64.encode(raw), 'base64'] });
  assert.equal(v.versioned, true);
  assert.deepEqual(C.judgeRelayedUnshield({ tx: v, sub: FRESH.sub, out: FRESH.out }).checks.map(c => [c.name, c.pass]), [['landed', false]]);
});

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ the deployed binary

/** A minimal 64-bit LE ELF of `size` bytes whose section headers END it (the last 8 bytes zero, as a real .so's). */
function syntheticElf(size, shnum = 3) {
  const b = Buffer.alloc(size, 0xab);
  b.write('7f454c46', 0, 'hex');
  b[4] = 2; // ELFCLASS64
  b[5] = 1; // little-endian
  const shoff = size - shnum * 64;
  b.writeBigUInt64LE(64n, 0x20); // e_phoff
  b.writeBigUInt64LE(BigInt(shoff), 0x28); // e_shoff
  b.writeUInt16LE(56, 0x36); // e_phentsize
  b.writeUInt16LE(1, 0x38); // e_phnum
  b.writeUInt16LE(64, 0x3a); // e_shentsize
  b.writeUInt16LE(shnum, 0x3c); // e_shnum
  b.fill(0, size - 8); // the last section header's sh_entsize = 0
  return b;
}
const programData = (elf, padding, authority = 'GoBAmZzHvD6F4KHLNmBFh2wZAGE1dwwufeTbifSHEYfd') => {
  const head = Buffer.alloc(45);
  head.writeUInt32LE(3, 0);
  head.writeBigUInt64LE(523346473n, 4);
  head[12] = 1;
  Buffer.from(base58.decode(authority)).copy(head, 13);
  return Buffer.concat([head, elf, Buffer.alloc(padding)]);
};

test('programData: the ELF is cut by its own header (its trailing zeros kept), the padding must be zero', () => {
  const elf = syntheticElf(4096);
  const sha = createHash('sha256').update(elf).digest('hex');
  const r = C.programDataBinary(programData(elf, 1000));
  assert.deepEqual(r, { sha256: sha, elfBytes: 4096, paddingBytes: 1000, authority: 'GoBAmZzHvD6F4KHLNmBFh2wZAGE1dwwufeTbifSHEYfd' });
  // negative controls: stripping trailing zeros would give ANOTHER digest; a non-zero padding byte, a
  // truncated ELF, another tag refuse
  assert.notEqual(createHash('sha256').update(elf.subarray(0, 4088)).digest('hex'), sha);
  const dirty = programData(elf, 1000);
  dirty[dirty.length - 1] = 1;
  assert.match(C.programDataBinary(dirty).error, /not all zero/);
  assert.match(C.programDataBinary(programData(elf, 0).subarray(0, 45 + 4000)).error, /the ELF header says 4096/);
  const tag = programData(elf, 0);
  tag.writeUInt32LE(2, 0);
  assert.match(C.programDataBinary(tag).error, /not a programData account/);
  // the program account's pointer: tag 2 + the programData key — the recorded FeGSS account
  const p = base64.decode(FACTS.program.answer.value.data[0]);
  assert.equal(C.programDataAddressOf(p), FACTS.programData.address);
  assert.equal(C.findPda([base58.decode(C.A0.programId)], C.PROGRAMS.bpfUpgradeable).address, FACTS.programData.address);
});

const SO = process.env.NOCTURA_A0_PROGRAM_SO;
test('programData of the REAL binary: the program side\'s built shielded_pool.so reads as b0054981…', { skip: SO && existsSync(SO) ? false : 'SKIPPED LOUDLY: set NOCTURA_A0_PROGRAM_SO=<program side>/target/deploy/shielded_pool.so to run it on the real ELF' }, () => {
  const so = readFileSync(SO);
  const r = C.programDataBinary(programData(so, 15712));
  assert.equal(r.sha256, C.DEPLOYED_BINARY_SHA256);
  assert.equal(r.elfBytes, so.length);
});

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ the wchange_vk

test('wchange_vk: the recorded account equals the pinned withdraw_change_vk.json (sha256 43dafca7…); each field can fail', () => {
  assert.equal(createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(ROOT, 'native/noctura-prover/tests/fixtures/a0-vk/withdraw_change_vk.json'))).digest('hex'), '43dafca79a0523fcffb4a9719f67b4a260cbce2047b9a00c9abff0223134e5cd');
  const account = FACTS.wchangeVk.answer.value;
  const ok = C.judgeWchangeVk({ address: FACTS.wchangeVk.address, account, pinnedVk: PINNED_VK });
  assert.deepEqual(ok.map(c => [c.name, c.pass]), [['address', true], ['owner', true], ['layout', true], ['pool', true], ['written', true], ['vk', true]]);
  const flip = at => {
    const d = Buffer.from(base64.decode(account.data[0]));
    d[at] ^= 1;
    return { ...account, data: [base64.encode(d), 'base64'] };
  };
  const failed = (o = {}) => C.judgeWchangeVk({ address: FACTS.wchangeVk.address, account, pinnedVk: PINNED_VK, ...o }).filter(c => !c.pass).map(c => c.name);
  assert.deepEqual(failed({ account: flip(88 + 959) }), ['vk']); // the last IC byte
  assert.deepEqual(failed({ account: flip(88) }), ['vk']); // alpha's first byte
  assert.deepEqual(failed({ account: flip(80) }), ['written']);
  assert.deepEqual(failed({ account: flip(40) }), ['pool']);
  assert.deepEqual(failed({ account: flip(0) }), ['layout']);
  assert.deepEqual(failed({ account: { ...account, owner: C.PROGRAMS.system } }), ['owner']);
  assert.deepEqual(failed({ address: FACTS.programData.address }), ['address']);
  assert.deepEqual(failed({ pinnedVk: { ...PINNED_VK, vk_delta_2: PINNED_VK.vk_gamma_2 } }), ['vk']);
  // G2's coordinate order matters: c0/c1 swapped in beta is another key
  const swapped = { ...PINNED_VK, vk_beta_2: [[PINNED_VK.vk_beta_2[0][1], PINNED_VK.vk_beta_2[0][0]], PINNED_VK.vk_beta_2[1], PINNED_VK.vk_beta_2[2]] };
  assert.deepEqual(failed({ pinnedVk: swapped }), ['vk']);
  assert.deepEqual(failed({ account: null }).slice(-1), ['account']);
});
```

```diff
diff --git a/scripts/m1c-checkpoint/device.mjs b/scripts/m1c-checkpoint/device.mjs
index 1de4fc3..c42e421 100644
--- a/scripts/m1c-checkpoint/device.mjs
+++ b/scripts/m1c-checkpoint/device.mjs
@@ -1,12 +1,18 @@
 /**
  * The M1c checkpoint's phone-side steps with an injected adb (so device.test.mjs drives them with a
  * mocked one and no device is ever touched by a test). Task 1: the trigger of the `pinnedFetch`
- * on-device control and the wait for its readout lines. Every call goes through M1a's guard
- * (`install.mjs` `guarded`): nothing that uninstalls, clears or deletes reaches adb.
+ * on-device control and the wait for its readout lines. Task 9: the submit hold's trigger and the
+ * kill inside it, the MANUAL wipe (the owner's phone refuses `pm clear`), the phone's API level and
+ * the instrumented confirmation-window run. Every call goes through M1a's guard (`install.mjs`
+ * `guarded`): nothing that uninstalls, clears or deletes reaches adb — the one sanctioned clear stays
+ * M1b's `clearDevnetAppData` (`../m1b-checkpoint/device.mjs`), and a manual wipe sends no clear at all.
  */
 import * as I from '../m1a-checkpoint/install.mjs';
 import * as L from './lib.mjs';
 
+/** `am start` of the devnet app on a deep link — the exact adb arguments. */
+const viewArgs = link => Object.freeze(['shell', 'am', 'start', '-W', '-a', 'android.intent.action.VIEW', '-d', link, L.DEVNET_PACKAGE]);
+
 /** `am start` of the devnet app on the control's deep link — the exact adb arguments. */
 export const TRIGGER_ARGS = Object.freeze([
   'shell', 'am', 'start', '-W',
@@ -39,3 +45,145 @@ export function triggerPinnedControl({ adb, sleep, knownRunKeys = [], pollSecond
   }
   return { started, run: null, readouts, polls, startOutput };
 }
+
+// ------------------------------------------------------------------ M1c Task 9
+
+/** `am start` of the devnet app on the submit-hold link (`submitHold.ts`) — the exact adb arguments. */
+export const HOLD_ARGS = viewArgs(L.SUBMIT_HOLD_LINK);
+
+/**
+ * Sends the hold link, then reads `logcat -d` every `pollSeconds` until a NEW `submit-hold armed`
+ * readout appears (not among `knownIds`, the ids recorded before), or `timeoutSeconds`.
+ * Returns `{started, armed, readouts, startOutput}`.
+ */
+export function armSubmitHold({ adb, sleep, knownIds = [], pollSeconds = 2, timeoutSeconds = 30 }) {
+  const call = I.guarded(adb);
+  const startOutput = call([...HOLD_ARGS]).out;
+  const started = /Status: ok/.test(startOutput);
+  const known = new Set(knownIds);
+  let readouts = [];
+  for (let waited = 0; waited <= timeoutSeconds; waited += pollSeconds) {
+    sleep(pollSeconds);
+    readouts = L.readoutsFromLog(call(['logcat', '-d']).out).readouts;
+    const armed = readouts.find(r => r.event === 'submit-hold' && r.state === 'armed' && !known.has(`${r.session}-${r.seq}`));
+    if (armed) {
+      return { started, armed, readouts, startOutput };
+    }
+  }
+  return { started, armed: null, readouts, startOutput };
+}
+
+/**
+ * The kill inside the hold: fed the live log (`adb logcat`), it collects readouts and, the FIRST
+ * time a NEW `unshield-submitting` line with `heldMs > 0` appears, force-stops the devnet app at
+ * once (once). A line without a hold never kills (an ordinary unshield is never cut); `known` are
+ * the ids recorded before the stream started (logcat replays its buffer first).
+ */
+export class HeldSubmitKiller {
+  constructor({ kill, known = [], now = () => new Date().toISOString() }) {
+    this.kill = kill;
+    this.now = now;
+    this.buffer = '';
+    this.text = '';
+    this.seen = new Set(known);
+    this.killed = null;
+  }
+
+  /** Feed a chunk of log output; returns the readouts completed by it ({seenAt, readout}). */
+  push(chunk) {
+    this.buffer += chunk;
+    const cut = this.buffer.lastIndexOf('\n');
+    if (cut < 0) {
+      return [];
+    }
+    this.text += this.buffer.slice(0, cut + 1);
+    this.buffer = this.buffer.slice(cut + 1);
+    const fresh = [];
+    for (const r of L.readoutsFromLog(this.text).readouts) {
+      const id = `${r.session}-${r.seq}`;
+      if (this.seen.has(id)) {
+        continue;
+      }
+      this.seen.add(id);
+      fresh.push({ seenAt: this.now(), readout: r });
+      if (!this.killed && r.event === 'unshield-submitting' && Number.isInteger(r.heldMs) && r.heldMs > 0) {
+        const answer = this.kill();
+        this.killed = { at: this.now(), session: r.session, seq: r.seq, owner: r.owner, heldMs: r.heldMs, answer: answer?.out ?? '' };
+      }
+    }
+    return fresh;
+  }
+}
+
+/** The kill: `am force-stop` of the DEVNET app — the process dies, no data is touched. */
+export function killDevnetApp(adb) {
+  return I.guarded(adb)(['shell', 'am', 'force-stop', L.DEVNET_PACKAGE]);
+}
+
+/**
+ * The MANUAL wipe (the owner's OnePlus refuses `pm clear` from adb: SecurityException,
+ * CLEAR_APP_USER_DATA). The desk sends NO clear; it prints the owner's steps for one of these,
+ * waits for the owner, and records `{at, pkg, answer: "manual: <how>"}` — honestly what happened.
+ * The restore is judged as after `pm clear`: by the first `startup` readout after `at`, which must
+ * say `restoredBecause: no-record` (a record that survived would say null — the line fails).
+ */
+export const MANUAL_WIPES = Object.freeze({
+  'clear-data': [
+    `Android Settings → Apps → "Noctura devnet" (${L.DEVNET_PACKAGE} — NOT "Noctura", the production wallet) → Storage → Clear storage / Clear data → OK.`,
+    'Do not open the devnet app yet.',
+  ],
+  'in-app': [
+    'Open the DEVNET app ("Noctura devnet") → Settings → Wipe wallet → confirm (its warning names the recovery phrase and the shielded notes).',
+    'Stop on the onboarding screen: do not import yet.',
+  ],
+  reinstall: [
+    `Uninstall "Noctura devnet" (${L.DEVNET_PACKAGE}) by hand — long-press its icon → App info → Uninstall. NEVER "Noctura" (the production wallet).`,
+    'Then run `install --apks …` again from this desk (M1a\'s rules: a first install of the devnet app), and do not open it yet.',
+  ],
+});
+
+/** Why a manual wipe is refused, or null. */
+export function manualWipeRefusal(how) {
+  return Object.hasOwn(MANUAL_WIPES, how) ? null : `--manual needs one of ${Object.keys(MANUAL_WIPES).join(' | ')} (got ${JSON.stringify(how ?? null)})`;
+}
+
+/** The record of a manual wipe the owner confirmed. */
+export function manualWipeRecord(how, at) {
+  const why = manualWipeRefusal(how);
+  if (why) {
+    throw new I.CheckpointStop(why);
+  }
+  return { at, pkg: L.DEVNET_PACKAGE, answer: `manual: ${how}`, how, steps: MANUAL_WIPES[how] };
+}
+
+/** `pm clear` refused by the phone (the OnePlus): the hint the desk prints with the STOP. */
+export function wipeRefusedHint(message) {
+  return /SecurityException|CLEAR_APP_USER_DATA|Permission Denial/i.test(String(message))
+    ? 'this phone refuses `pm clear` from adb (SecurityException: CLEAR_APP_USER_DATA). Nothing was cleared. Wipe by hand instead: `wipe --manual clear-data` (or in-app | reinstall) — README "The wipe"'
+    : null;
+}
+
+/** The phone's facts the checkpoint records: model, Android release, API level (an integer or null). */
+export function readPhone(adb) {
+  const call = I.guarded(adb);
+  const prop = k => call(['shell', 'getprop', k]).out.trim();
+  const sdk = Number.parseInt(prop('ro.build.version.sdk'), 10);
+  return { model: prop('ro.product.model'), release: prop('ro.build.version.release'), sdk: Number.isInteger(sdk) ? sdk : null };
+}
+
+/** The instrumented class of Task 6, one class, on the installed devnet app + its test APK. */
+export const INSTRUMENT_ARGS = Object.freeze([
+  'shell', 'am', 'instrument', '-w', '-r',
+  '-e', 'class', 'com.nocturawallet.prover.A0ConfirmWindowTest',
+  `${L.TEST_PACKAGE}/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner`,
+]);
+
+/** `am instrument -r` output judged: exactly `OK (6 tests)` and the runner's success code. */
+export function instrumentVerdict(out) {
+  const okLine = /^OK \((\d+) tests?\)/m.exec(out);
+  const pass = okLine !== null && Number(okLine[1]) === 6 && /INSTRUMENTATION_CODE: -1/.test(out);
+  return {
+    pass,
+    detail: pass ? 'OK (6 tests)' : (/^(FAILURES!!!.*|Tests run: .*|.*Error.*|INSTRUMENTATION_FAILED.*)$/m.exec(out)?.[1] ?? 'no OK line — see instrument-confirm.txt'),
+  };
+}
```

```diff
+  const exits = freshLanded.filter(u => ok(u)).map(u => u.sub.owner);
+  const accounts = restoredAccounts?.accounts ?? null;
+  add(
+    'M1c.R3',
+    'wipe and restore: the fresh accounts come back — every fresh account an unshield of this checkpoint landed on is fresh-exit in the restored registry, and nothing is fresh-pending',
+    accounts && exits.length >= 1 && exits.every(a => accounts.some(e => e.address === a && e.role === 'fresh-exit')) && !accounts.some(e => e.role === 'fresh-pending'),
+    !restoredAccounts
+      ? 'no "startup-accounts" readout of the restored start'
+      : `restored registry: ${accounts ? accounts.map(e => `${e.address.slice(0, 6)}… ${e.role}`).join(', ') : `unreadable ${restoredAccounts.accountsError}`}; expected fresh-exit: ${exits.map(a => `${a.slice(0, 6)}…`).join(', ') || 'none'}; the restore's counters: ${JSON.stringify(restoredAccounts.restore)}`,
+  );
+
+  // K — the chain facts (one devnet read each)
+  add(
+    'M1c.K1',
+    `the deployed A0 program: the programData's ELF has sha256 ${C.DEPLOYED_BINARY_SHA256.slice(0, 16)}… (the upgrade of 2026-11-17, R1′)`,
+    facts?.binary?.sha256 === C.DEPLOYED_BINARY_SHA256,
+    facts?.binary ? (facts.binary.error ? `programData ${facts.binaryAddress}: ${facts.binary.error}` : `programData ${facts.binaryAddress}: ELF ${facts.binary.elfBytes} bytes + ${facts.binary.paddingBytes} zero bytes, sha256 ${facts.binary.sha256}, upgrade authority ${facts.binary.authority}`) : 'not read (`verify` reads it)',
+  );
+  add(
+    'M1c.K2',
+    'the withdraw_change VK read from chain (wchange_vk, PDA ["wchange_vk", pool]) equals the pinned withdraw_change_vk.json (R1-I6)',
+    Array.isArray(facts?.vk) && facts.vk.length >= 6 && facts.vk.every(c => c.pass),
+    Array.isArray(facts?.vk) ? facts.vk.map(c => `${c.pass ? 'ok' : 'FAIL'} ${c.name}: ${c.detail}`).join('; ') : 'not read',
+  );
+
+  // A / L / N
+  for (const l of apkLines) {
+    add(l.id, l.text, l.pass, l.detail);
+  }
+  add('M1c.A4', 'the APKs are of the commit checked (apks/COMMIT = HEAD, tree clean)', commit && commit.apks === commit.head && !/dirty/.test(commit.head ?? ''), `apks ${commit?.apks}, HEAD ${commit?.head}`);
+  for (const [id, text] of [
+    ['M1c.L1', 'the devnet release APK launches on the phone'],
+    ['M1c.L2', 'the production APK of the same commit launches on the phone; no readout line in its log'],
+    ['M1c.L3', 'the production app after the owner\'s unlock: alive, no crash, no readout line'],
+  ]) {
+    const l = launches.find(x => x.id === id);
+    add(id, l?.text ?? text, l?.pass, l?.detail ?? 'not run');
+  }
+  const row = authenticatorRow(phone?.sdk);
+  add('M1c.N1', 'the phone\'s API level is recorded; it decides which row of the authenticator matrix this checkpoint proved', row !== null, phone ? `${phone.model} API ${phone.sdk}: ${row ?? 'below minSdk 24'}` : 'not read (`phone`)');
+  add('M1c.N2', 'the native confirmation\'s window on the phone: A0ConfirmWindowTest passed (FLAG_SECURE, overlay hiding on API 31+, obscured taps, the refusal rows)', phone?.instrument?.pass, phone?.instrument?.detail ?? 'not run (`phone --instrument`)');
+  return { lines, info };
+}
```

```diff
+  assert.deepEqual(failsWith(r => { delete r.chain.histories[HELD]; }), ['M1c.F3']);
+});
+
+test('M1c.R1–R3: the wipe record, no-record at the first start, the same notes with a change leaf, the fresh account back', () => {
+  assert.deepEqual(failsWith(r => { r.wipe = null; }), ['M1c.R1', 'M1c.R2', 'M1c.R3']);
+  assert.deepEqual(failsWith(r => { r.wipe.answer = 'Failed'; }), ['M1c.R1']);
+  assert.deepEqual(failsWith(r => { r.wipe.answer = 'manual:'; }), ['M1c.R1']);
+  assert.deepEqual(failsWith(r => { r.wipe.pkg = L.PRODUCTION_PACKAGE; }), ['M1c.R1']);
+  assert.deepEqual(failsWith(r => { r.wipe.answer = 'Success'; }), []); // pm clear's answer is the other admitted record
+  assert.deepEqual(failsWith(r => { rowOf(r, x => x.event === 'startup' && x.restoredBecause === 'no-record').restoredBecause = null; }), ['M1c.R1']);
+  assert.deepEqual(failsWith(r => { rowOf(r, x => x.event === 'startup' && x.restoredBecause === 'no-record').notes.unspentNotes.pop(); }), ['M1c.R2']);
+  // a restore that brought back only notes that are no change leaf of this checkpoint
+  assert.deepEqual(failsWith(r => {
+    for (const x of r.readouts.filter(y => y.readout.event === 'startup' && y.readout.notes?.unspent === 3)) {
+      x.readout.notes.unspentNotes = [OTHER_NOTE];
+    }
+  }), ['M1c.R2']);
+  // the restart before the wipe is older than the last unshield event: refused, not compared
+  assert.deepEqual(failsWith(r => {
+    const i = r.readouts.findIndex(x => x.readout.event === 'unshield-reconcile' && x.readout.reverted === 1);
+    r.readouts[i].seenAt = new Date(Date.parse(r.wipe.at) - 500).toISOString();
+  }), ['M1c.R2']);

+  // (and F3: a registry after the revert still names the released reservation)
+  assert.deepEqual(failsWith(r => { rowOf(r, x => x.event === 'startup-accounts' && x.restoredBecause === 'no-record').accounts.push({ address: HELD, role: 'fresh-pending', linked: false }); }), ['M1c.F3', 'M1c.R3']);

+test('M1c.K1 / K2 / A4 / L / N: the binary digest, the VK, the commit, the launches, the API level and the window test', () => {

+});

+  assert.deepEqual(Object.entries(v).filter(([, p]) => p), []);
+});

+});
```

```diff
+  const confirm = opt(M1B.CONFIRM_WIPE.slice(2));
+  const why = M1B.wipeRefusal(L.DEVNET_PACKAGE, confirm);
+  if (why) {
+    throw new I.CheckpointStop(why);
+  }
+  const how = opt('manual');
+  // a wipe that is not the judged one (the cli wallet's switch, README CP1c) never replaces wipe.json
+  const label = opt('label');
+  if (label !== undefined && !/^[a-z0-9-]{1,20}$/.test(label)) {
+    throw new I.CheckpointStop(`--label must be a short lowercase name (got ${JSON.stringify(label)})`);
+  }
+  const wipeFile = label ? `wipe-${label}.json` : 'wipe.json';
+  if (flag('manual') && D.manualWipeRefusal(how)) {
+    throw new I.CheckpointStop(D.manualWipeRefusal(how));
+  }
+  oneDevice();
+  collect(); // every readout of before the wipe is recorded as before it
+  const bar = '!'.repeat(100);
+  if (flag('manual')) {
+    // the installed devnet app must be this checkpoint's (the signer check; nothing is installed or cleared)
+    const pre = I.preflightInstall({ adb, pkg: L.DEVNET_PACKAGE, apk: a.devnet, apkSigners, sha256File, outDir: OUT });
+    if (!pre.installed) {
+      throw new I.CheckpointStop(`${L.DEVNET_PACKAGE} is not installed — nothing to wipe (run \`install\` first)`);
+    }
+    console.error(`${bar}\nMANUAL WIPE of ${L.DEVNET_PACKAGE} (the DEVNET app's wallet) — never ${L.PRODUCTION_PACKAGE}. The desk sends nothing.\n${bar}`);
+    D.MANUAL_WIPES[how].forEach((s, i) => console.log(`  ${i + 1}. ${s}`));
+    const rl = createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: process.stdout });
+    const answer = await rl.question('Press Enter once that is done (BEFORE you import the phrase), or type "abort": ');
+    rl.close();
+    if (answer.trim().toLowerCase() === 'abort') {
+      throw new I.CheckpointStop('the manual wipe was aborted by the owner — nothing recorded');
+    }
+    const w = D.manualWipeRecord(how, new Date().toISOString());
+    collect(); // anything written since is recorded AFTER the wipe (a restore that already ran is judged)
+    adb(['logcat', '-c']);
+    json(wipeFile, { ...w, signer: pre.apkSigners, rollback: pre.rollback });
+    appendFileSync(join(OUT, 'installs.log.jsonl'), JSON.stringify({ at: w.at, step: 'wipe', file: wipeFile, pkg: w.pkg, answer: w.answer }) + '\n');
+    console.log(`recorded "${w.answer}" at ${w.at}: now open the devnet app${how === 'reinstall' ? ' (after `install`)' : ''}, IMPORT the phrase, unlock, wait for the balance; then \`collect\``);
+    return;
+  }
+  console.error(`${bar}\nWIPING ${L.DEVNET_PACKAGE} (the DEVNET app's data, its devnet wallet) — never ${L.PRODUCTION_PACKAGE}. Ctrl-C within 10 s to stop.\n${bar}`);
+  sleep(10);
+  let r;
+  try {
+    r = M1B.clearDevnetAppData({ adb: rawAdb, pkg: L.DEVNET_PACKAGE, confirm, apk: a.devnet, apkSigners, sha256File, outDir: OUT });
+  } catch (e) {
+    const hint = e instanceof I.CheckpointStop ? D.wipeRefusedHint(e.message) : null;
+    if (hint) {
+      throw new I.CheckpointStop(`${e.message}\n  ${hint}`);
+    }
+    throw e;
+  }
+  adb(['logcat', '-c']);
+  const w = { at: new Date().toISOString(), ...r };
+  json(wipeFile, w);
+  appendFileSync(join(OUT, 'installs.log.jsonl'), JSON.stringify({ at: w.at, step: 'wipe', file: wipeFile, pkg: w.pkg, answer: w.answer }) + '\n');
+  console.log(`wiped ${w.pkg} (${w.answer}) at ${w.at}: open the devnet app, IMPORT the phrase, unlock, wait for the balance; then \`collect\``);
+}
+
+function prod() {
+  const a = apks();
+  oneDevice();
+  collect();
+  adb(['shell', 'am', 'force-stop', L.DEVNET_PACKAGE]); // only the production app may run (the readout check)
+  const [p] = I.preflightAll({
+    adb: rawAdb,
+    apkSigners,
+    sha256File,
+    outDir: OUT,
+    allowFreshProduction: flag(I.ALLOW_FRESH_PRODUCTION.slice(2)),
+    targets: [{ pkg: L.PRODUCTION_PACKAGE, apk: a.production }],
+  });
+  appendFileSync(join(OUT, 'installs.log.jsonl'), JSON.stringify({ at: new Date().toISOString(), step: 'prod', packages: [p] }) + '\n');
+  if (p.fresh) {
+    const bar = '!'.repeat(100);
+    console.error(`${bar}\n${I.noWalletLine(L.PRODUCTION_PACKAGE)}\n${bar}`);
+    sleep(15);
+  } else {
+    console.log(`${L.PRODUCTION_PACKAGE}: same signer; rollback ${p.rollback.dir}\n  restore with: ${p.rollback.command}\ninstalling production.apk over the installed wallet — its data is kept …`);
+  }
+  I.installApk({ adb: rawAdb, pkg: L.PRODUCTION_PACKAGE, apk: a.production });
+  saveLaunch(
+    M1B.launchCheck({
+      adb: rawAdb,
+      pkg: L.PRODUCTION_PACKAGE,
+      id: 'M1c.L2',
+      text: 'the production APK of the same commit launches on the phone; no readout line in its log',
+      wait: () => sleep(10),
+      expectNoReadout: true,
+    }),
+  );
+  console.log('now UNLOCK the production wallet on the phone (do not open the devnet app), then run `prod-check`');
+}
+
+function prodCheck() {
+  oneDevice();
+  const devnetPid = adb(['shell', 'pidof', L.DEVNET_PACKAGE]).out.trim();
+  const l = M1B.afterCheck({
+    adb: rawAdb,
+    pkg: L.PRODUCTION_PACKAGE,
+    id: 'M1c.L3',
+    text: "the production app after the owner's unlock: alive, no crash, no readout line",
+    expectNoReadout: true,
+  });
+  if (devnetPid) {
+    l.pass = false;
+    l.detail += `; the devnet app is RUNNING (pid ${devnetPid}) — its lines would be indistinguishable: run \`prod\` again`;
+  }
+  saveLaunch(l);
+}
+
+function phone() {
+  oneDevice();
+  const p = D.readPhone(rawAdb);
+  const prev = readJson('phone.json', {});
+  let instrument = prev.instrument ?? null;
+  if (flag('instrument')) {
+    const a = apks();
+    existsSync(a.test) || die(`missing ${a.test} — build it with NOCTURA_A0_KEYS_DIR set (README "Build")`);
+    const pre = I.preflightAll({
+      adb: rawAdb,
+      apkSigners,
+      sha256File,
+      outDir: OUT,
+      targets: [
+        { pkg: L.DEVNET_PACKAGE, apk: a.devnet },
+        { pkg: L.TEST_PACKAGE, apk: a.test },
+      ],
+    });
+    appendFileSync(join(OUT, 'installs.log.jsonl'), JSON.stringify({ at: new Date().toISOString(), step: 'phone', packages: pre }) + '\n');
+    I.installApk({ adb: rawAdb, pkg: L.TEST_PACKAGE, apk: a.test, extra: ['-t'] });
+    console.log('running A0ConfirmWindowTest on the phone (keep it unlocked; ≈ 1 min) …');
+    const out = adb([...D.INSTRUMENT_ARGS]).out;
+    writeFileSync(join(OUT, 'instrument-confirm.txt'), out);
+    instrument = { ...D.instrumentVerdict(out), at: new Date().toISOString() };
+  }
+  json('phone.json', { ...p, row: L.authenticatorRow(p.sdk), instrument, at: new Date().toISOString() });
+  console.log(`${p.model} (Android ${p.release}, API ${p.sdk}): ${L.authenticatorRow(p.sdk) ?? 'below minSdk 24'}${instrument ? `; A0ConfirmWindowTest: ${instrument.pass ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} ${instrument.detail}` : ''}`);
+}
+
+/** The chain facts in ONE batch: the program, its programData, the wchange_vk account. */
+async function readChainFacts(url) {
+  const programData = C.findPda([base58.decode(C.A0.programId)], C.PROGRAMS.bpfUpgradeable).address;
+  const vkAddress = C.wchangeVkAddress();
+  const [slot, program, data, vk] = await devnetBatch(url, [
+    { method: 'getSlot', params: [{ commitment: 'confirmed' }] },
+    { method: 'getAccountInfo', params: [C.A0.programId, B64] },
+    { method: 'getAccountInfo', params: [programData, B64] },
+    { method: 'getAccountInfo', params: [vkAddress, B64] },
+  ]);
+  const pointer = program?.value ? C.programDataAddressOf(base64.decode(program.value.data[0])) : null;
+  let binary;
+  if (!program?.value || program.value.owner !== C.PROGRAMS.bpfUpgradeable || !program.value.executable) {
+    binary = { error: `the program account is not an executable of the upgradeable loader (owner ${program?.value?.owner})` };
+  } else if (pointer !== programData) {
+    binary = { error: `the program points at ${pointer}, its derived programData is ${programData}` };
+  } else if (!data?.value || data.value.owner !== C.PROGRAMS.bpfUpgradeable) {
+    binary = { error: 'no programData account owned by the upgradeable loader' };
+  } else {
+    binary = C.programDataBinary(base64.decode(data.value.data[0]));
+  }
+  const pinnedVk = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(ROOT, 'native/noctura-prover/tests/fixtures/a0-vk/withdraw_change_vk.json'), 'utf8'));
+  return {
+    slot,
+    readAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+    rpcHost: new URL(url).hostname,
+    binaryAddress: programData,
+    binary,
+    vk: C.judgeWchangeVk({ address: vkAddress, account: vk?.value ?? null, pinnedVk }),
+    raw: { program, vkAccount: vk, vkAddress },
+  };
+}
+
+async function chainFacts() {
+  const url = opt('rpc', DEFAULT_RPC);
+  const f = await readChainFacts(url);
+  const lines = L.judgeM1c({ readouts: [], chain: { txs: {}, histories: {} }, facts: f }).lines.filter(l => l.id === 'M1c.K1' || l.id === 'M1c.K2');
+  console.log(`devnet via ${f.rpcHost} at slot ${f.slot} (${f.readAt})`);
+  lines.forEach(printLine);
+  const file = opt('record');
+  if (file) {
+    // the fixture: the two small accounts as the RPC answered them (never the 446 KB programData)
+    writeFileSync(
+      resolve(file),
+      JSON.stringify(
+        {
+          schema: 'noctura.a0.devnet-chain-facts/1',
+          cluster: 'devnet',
+          genesisHash: L.DEVNET.genesisHash,
+          rpc: new URL(url).origin,
+          fetchedAt: f.readAt,
+          slot: f.slot,
+          program: { address: C.A0.programId, answer: f.raw.program },
+          wchangeVk: { address: f.raw.vkAddress, answer: f.raw.vkAccount },
+          programData: { address: f.binaryAddress, binary: f.binary },
+        },
+        null,
+        2,
+      ) + '\n',
+    );
+    console.log(`recorded → ${resolve(file)}`);
+  }
+  process.exit(lines.every(l => l.pass) ? 0 : 1);
+}
+
+async function verify() {
+  const url = opt('rpc', DEFAULT_RPC);
+  mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
+  const readouts = recorded();
+  const kill = readJson('kill.json');
+  const wipeRec = readJson('wipe.json');
+  const sigs = L.unshieldSignatures(readouts);
+  const txAnswers = sigs.length
+    ? await devnetBatch(url, sigs.map(s => ({ method: 'getTransaction', params: [s, { encoding: 'base64', maxSupportedTransactionVersion: 0, commitment: 'confirmed' }] })))
+    : [];
+  const txs = Object.fromEntries(sigs.map((s, i) => [s, txAnswers[i] ?? null]));
+  // the held unshield's account: no history at all means nothing of it ever reached the chain
+  const held = kill ? [kill.owner] : [];
+  const histAnswers = held.length ? await devnetBatch(url, held.map(a => ({ method: 'getSignaturesForAddress', params: [a, { limit: 10, commitment: 'confirmed' }] }))) : [];
+  const histories = Object.fromEntries(held.map((a, i) => [a, (histAnswers[i] ?? []).map(s => s.signature)]));
+  const facts = await readChainFacts(url);
+  json('chain.json', { txs, histories, facts: { ...facts, raw: undefined }, readAt: facts.readAt, rpcHost: facts.rpcHost });
+
+  const apkDir = opt('apks', join(ROOT, 'build/m1c-checkpoint/apks'));
+  const config = existsSync(join(apkDir, 'CONFIG.json')) ? JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(apkDir, 'CONFIG.json'), 'utf8')) : {};
+  const apksCommit = existsSync(join(apkDir, 'COMMIT')) ? readFileSync(join(apkDir, 'COMMIT'), 'utf8').trim() : null;
+  const head = execFileSync('git', ['-C', ROOT, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim();
+  const dirty = execFileSync('git', ['-C', ROOT, 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=no'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim();
+  const pinned = L.judgePinnedControl({ readouts: readouts.map(x => x.readout), apiBase: config.devnet?.API_BASE });
+  const { lines, info } = L.judgeM1c({
+    readouts,
+    chain: { txs, histories },
+    facts,
+    wipe: wipeRec,
+    kill,
+    launches: readJson('launches.json', []),
+    apkLines: L.judgeApkConfig(config),
+    commit: { head: dirty ? `${head} (dirty)` : head, apks: apksCommit },
+    phone: readJson('phone.json'),
+  });
+  const every = [...pinned, ...lines];
+  console.log(`M1c checkpoint — ${OUT} (devnet via ${facts.rpcHost}, slot ${facts.slot}, ${facts.readAt})`);
+  every.forEach(printLine);
+  for (const i of info) {
+    console.log(`\n${'!'.repeat(100)}\n${i}\n${'!'.repeat(100)}`);
+  }
+  const failed = every.filter(l => !l.pass).length;
+  console.log(failed ? `FAILED (${failed} line${failed > 1 ? 's' : ''})` : 'CHECKPOINT PASSED');
+  return failed ? 1 : 0;
+}
+
+/** A STOP halts the checkpoint: printed, exit 3, nothing after it runs. */
+async function stopping(f) {
+  try {
+    return await f();
+  } catch (e) {
+    if (e instanceof I.CheckpointStop) {
+      console.error(`STOP: ${e.message}`);
+      process.exit(3);
+    }
+    throw e;
+  }
+}
+
+const commands = {
+  'check-apks': checkApks,
+  install: () => stopping(install),
+  collect: () => stopping(() => {
+    oneDevice();
+    collect();
+  }),
+  watch: () => stopping(watch),
+  'pinned-control': () => stopping(pinnedControl),
+  balances,
+  'hold-kill': () => stopping(holdKill),
+  wipe: () => stopping(wipe),
+  prod: () => stopping(prod),
+  'prod-check': () => stopping(prodCheck),
+  phone: () => stopping(phone),
+  'chain-facts': chainFacts,
+  verify: async () => process.exit(await verify()),
+};
+if (!commands[cmd]) {
+  console.error(readFileSync(new URL(import.meta.url), 'utf8').split('\n').slice(1, 55).join('\n'));
+  process.exit(2);
 }
+await commands[cmd]();
```

Create `src/modules/shielded/a0/__tests__/checkpointReadoutM1c.test.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The M1c checkpoint readout (checkpointReadout.ts, M1c Task 9; spec §16 M1c): the unshield lines
 * the desk reads (`unshield-submitting` with its context, `unshield-outcome`, `unshield-reconcile`),
 * the registry line after each startup (`startup-accounts`) and the submit hold's lines
 * (`submit-hold`, submitHold.ts).
 *
 * THE CONTRACT. `scripts/m1c-checkpoint/fixtures/unshield-sample.txt` was written by hand (eleven
 * JSON objects in the documented field order, values taken from the recorded relayed withdraws
 * 5sKiWZTv… / 5F8Ks5qa… and from sha256 of fixed strings) — neither by this module nor by the
 * desk's parser. This suite holds the app's lines to it byte for byte; the desk's
 * `scripts/m1c-checkpoint/lib.test.mjs` parses the same file. A change on either side that the
 * other does not follow turns one of the two red.
 *
 * THE GATE. The context of `unshield-submitting` derives the seed's public keys: it is computed
 * only with the gate open (a closed gate never calls it — the production build never derives
 * them for a log line).
 */
import {readFileSync} from 'fs';
import {join} from 'path';
import {
  readA0StartupAccounts,
  readA0SubmitHold,
  readA0UnshieldOutcome,
  readA0UnshieldReconcile,
  readA0UnshieldSubmitting,
  resetA0ReadoutForTests,
} from '../checkpointReadout';
import type {A0ReadoutUnshield, A0ReadoutUnshieldContext} from '../checkpointReadout';
import type {A0AccountEntry} from '../accountRegistry';
import type {A0StartupResult, A0StartupState} from '../startup';
import {A0_SUBMIT_HOLD_LINK, A0_SUBMIT_HOLD_MS, armA0SubmitHold, resetA0SubmitHoldForTests, takeA0SubmitHold} from '../submitHold';

const SAMPLE = readFileSync(join(__dirname, '../../../../../scripts/m1c-checkpoint/fixtures/unshield-sample.txt'), 'utf8')
  .split('\n')
  .filter(Boolean);

// The sample's inputs (the values written into the hand-made file).
const S1 = 'kz4u7m1c';
const S2 = 'kz4u9x2d';
const MAIN = 'GoBAmZzHvD6F4KHLNmBFh2wZAGE1dwwufeTbifSHEYfd';
const MAIN_ATA = '9hZSf8jMxBdqcvnYzj6EkQ2gPoZCoX2GcF8f1dgkyLsn';
const F1 = 'AgPYn4odQNKwWBjvCtgG8G1supmLKaFHtbDVHmMT2KtP';
const F1_ATA = '2ot2kwhs7gFFPHAYNwkuNsUsfZp8hWAgzHpNQLx9pASu';
const F2 = 'AuUTDTY6ge45h1Z61eCJYiX4VYb3JvuGvnTevNvHq4BA';
const F2_ATA = '74GmPmHDtij41KMFd2i9giNLDUdRaWAXTTZxtpu7ayGN';
const CLI = 'DaiWcqhB9YpdqXUypDAF97WTAEY9bEdwjfX4eDFp9yNc';
const OTHER = '5pHpWLNFQz89brhH6h5Lbqy2zT1jdjh6hjKT7fFMeEkb';
const OTHER_ATA = 'D7e1jdGHeomw2dT6n5DXJASSABZC6dgyPH6WJ326uqb6';
const FEE_PAYER = '3jvhiz9qcJAe2zGHvRAiRYXiaFCdjEQrB9KuE5NuFaGe';
const SIG_MAIN = '5sKiWZTvwSzNiKzFsK6DFrQGoksbv2enc1NffvxoPGJNdusd6fZa585GSxnG6om7c4JrsA7uDovQKaSc8SnQVwMr';
const SIG_FRESH = '5F8Ks5qawFYWdhjPVogs8S7cx3fY68QC4qzpJ6VcfLEyHT4UCH7oty6i5cHRwma1FDLwpeF8PaWdQVHqhJGmVcZM';
// Values that must NEVER reach a line: the registry's scheme strings (the index), a rho, the nullifier.
const RHO = 'ab'.repeat(32);
const NULLIFIER = '0b2018b2e520bbf9420648d389a76aaad7a34b4c63e9afbf7f1f2e997888762d';

const entry = (scheme: string, address: string, role: A0AccountEntry['role']): A0AccountEntry => ({scheme, address, role});
const REG1 = [entry('slip10:0', MAIN, 'main'), entry('slip10:7', F1, 'fresh-exit')];
const REG2 = [...REG1, entry('slip10:9', F2, 'fresh-pending')];

const ready = (result: Partial<A0StartupResult>): A0StartupState => ({
  phase: 'ready',
  result: {
    restoredBecause: null,
    restore: null,
    reconcile: {confirmed: [], dropped: [], stillPending: [], skipped: 0},
    unshields: {settled: [], reverted: [], stillPending: [], skipped: 0, released: [], promoted: []},
    ...result,
  },
});
const RESTORED = ready({
  restoredBecause: 'no-record',
  restore: {
    treeTransactions: 40,
    failedTransactions: 0,
    listedSignatures: 40,
    fetchedTransactions: 40,
    syncDurationMs: 3000,
    durationMs: 4000,
    depositIndicesTried: 102,
    depositsInHistory: 20,
    withdrawNullifiersInHistory: 6,
    ownNotes: 3,
    spentNotes: 1,
    foreignRhoHits: 0,
    highestHit: 1,
    changeNotes: 1,
    unmatchedChangeLeaves: 0,
    attributionCalls: 2,
    accountIndicesTried: 22,
    exitAccounts: 1,
    finishedAt: '2026-11-18T09:00:00.500Z',
    r13TriggerReached: false,
  },
});

const U_MAIN: A0ReadoutUnshield = {owner: MAIN, ata: MAIN_ATA, amount: 400_000n, fee: 10_000n, destination: 'main'};
const U_F2: A0ReadoutUnshield = {owner: F2, ata: F2_ATA, amount: 10_000n, fee: 10_000n, destination: 'fresh'};
const U_OTHER: A0ReadoutUnshield = {owner: OTHER, ata: OTHER_ATA, amount: 10_000n, fee: 10_000n, destination: 'external'};
const U_F1: A0ReadoutUnshield = {owner: F1, ata: F1_ATA, amount: 400_000n, fee: 10_000n, destination: 'fresh'};
const ctx = (registry: A0AccountEntry[], seedKeys: string[], heldMs: number): (() => A0ReadoutUnshieldContext) => () => ({
  feePayer: FEE_PAYER,
  gasGrantLamports: 3_000_000n,
  walletKind: 'slip10',
  seedKeys,
  registry,
  heldMs,
});

function emitTheSample(): string[] {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  let t = 0;
  const times = [
    '09:00:01', '09:00:02', '09:00:03', '09:00:04', '09:00:05', '09:00:06',
    '09:01:00', '09:01:30', '09:01:40', '09:01:50', '09:06:00',
  ];
  const o = (session: string) => ({sink: (l: string) => lines.push(l), enabled: true, session, now: () => new Date(`2026-11-18T${times[t++]}.000Z`)});
  readA0StartupAccounts(RESTORED, () => REG1, o(S1));
  readA0UnshieldSubmitting(U_MAIN, ctx(REG1, [MAIN, F1, CLI], 0), o(S1));
  readA0UnshieldOutcome(U_MAIN, {status: 'spent', signature: SIG_MAIN, changeLeafIndex: 22, changeAmount: 123n, grantLamports: null, destinationWithoutSol: false}, o(S1));
  readA0SubmitHold('armed', 30_000, o(S1));
  readA0SubmitHold('taken', 30_000, o(S1));
  readA0UnshieldSubmitting(U_F2, ctx(REG2, [MAIN, F1, F2, CLI], 30_000), o(S1));
  // the next process (after the kill): its sequence starts again at 1
  resetA0ReadoutForTests();
  readA0UnshieldReconcile({settled: [], reverted: [], stillPending: [{rho: RHO, reason: 'in-window'}], skipped: 0, released: [], promoted: []}, o(S2));
  readA0UnshieldOutcome(U_OTHER, {status: 'pending', signature: null, reason: 'unknown', detail: `sentinel ${NULLIFIER}`}, o(S2));
  readA0UnshieldOutcome(U_OTHER, {status: 'not-sent', outcome: 'invalid_request'}, o(S2));
  readA0UnshieldOutcome(
    U_F1,
    {status: 'landed-unverified', signature: SIG_FRESH, code: 'E_A0_VERIFY_SEED_SIGNER', detail: `sentinel ${NULLIFIER}`, note: 'spent', changeRecorded: true, linked: true},
    o(S2),
  );
  readA0UnshieldReconcile(
    {
      settled: [{rho: RHO, signature: SIG_FRESH, verified: true, code: null, changeRecorded: true}],
      reverted: [{rho: RHO}],
      stillPending: [],
      skipped: 0,
      released: ['slip10:9'],
      promoted: ['slip10:7'],
    },
    o(S2),
  );
  return lines;
}

beforeEach(() => {
  resetA0ReadoutForTests();
  resetA0SubmitHoldForTests();
});

describe('the contract with the desk (the hand-written sample)', () => {
  it('the app emits exactly the eleven sample lines for the sample inputs', () => {
    expect(SAMPLE.length).toBe(11);
    expect(emitTheSample()).toEqual(SAMPLE);
  });
  it('no scheme string (the registry index), no rho, no nullifier, no change amount, no detail reaches a line', () => {
    const all = emitTheSample().join('\n');
    for (const secret of ['slip10:', RHO, NULLIFIER, 'sentinel', '"changeAmount"', '"123"']) {
      expect(all).not.toContain(secret);
    }
    // positive control: the same search finds what IS public
    expect(all).toContain(F2);
    expect(all).toContain(SIG_FRESH);
    expect(all).toContain('"fresh-pending"');
  });
});

describe('the gate and the context', () => {
  it('closed gate: the context is never computed and nothing is emitted', () => {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const context = jest.fn(ctx(REG1, [MAIN], 0));
    readA0UnshieldSubmitting(U_MAIN, context, {sink: l => lines.push(l), enabled: false});
    readA0StartupAccounts(RESTORED, () => REG1, {sink: l => lines.push(l), enabled: false});
    readA0SubmitHold('armed', 30_000, {sink: l => lines.push(l), enabled: false});
    expect(context).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(lines).toEqual([]);
    // control: the same calls with the gate open emit three lines and compute the context once
    readA0UnshieldSubmitting(U_MAIN, context, {sink: l => lines.push(l), enabled: true});
    readA0StartupAccounts(RESTORED, () => REG1, {sink: l => lines.push(l), enabled: true});
    readA0SubmitHold('armed', 30_000, {sink: l => lines.push(l), enabled: true});
    expect(context).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(lines).toHaveLength(3);
  });
  it('a context that throws is reported by its code only; the line is still written', () => {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    readA0UnshieldSubmitting(
      U_MAIN,
      () => {
        throw Object.assign(new Error(`sentinel ${RHO}`), {code: 'E_A0_ACCOUNTS_CORRUPT'});
      },
      {sink: l => lines.push(l), enabled: true, session: 'x'},
    );
    const p = JSON.parse(lines[0]!.split(' ').slice(3).join(' '));
    expect(p).toMatchObject({event: 'unshield-submitting', owner: MAIN, contextError: 'E_A0_ACCOUNTS_CORRUPT'});
    expect(p.seedKeys).toBeUndefined();
    expect(lines[0]).not.toContain('sentinel');
  });
  it('an unreadable registry after a startup: its code, never an empty list; no registry record: null', () => {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const o = {sink: (l: string) => lines.push(l), enabled: true, session: 'x'};
    readA0StartupAccounts(ready({}), () => {
      throw Object.assign(new Error('x'), {code: 'E_A0_ACCOUNTS_CORRUPT'});
    }, o);
    readA0StartupAccounts(ready({}), () => null, o);
    readA0StartupAccounts({phase: 'error', code: 'E_X', message: 'm'}, () => REG1, o);
    readA0StartupAccounts({phase: 'running'}, () => REG1, o);
    const ps = lines.map(l => JSON.parse(l.split(' ').slice(3).join(' ')));
    expect(ps).toHaveLength(2); // only `ready` reads out
    expect(ps[0]).toMatchObject({accounts: null, accountsError: 'E_A0_ACCOUNTS_CORRUPT', restore: null});
    expect(ps[1]).toMatchObject({accounts: null, accountsError: null});
  });
});

describe('the submit hold (submitHold.ts)', () => {
  it('the link and the hold are the stated ones', () => {
    expect(A0_SUBMIT_HOLD_LINK).toBe('noctura://a0-hold-next-submit');
    expect(A0_SUBMIT_HOLD_MS).toBe(30_000);
  });
  it('armed with the gate open: the NEXT take answers 30 s once, then 0; each step read out', () => {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const o = {sink: (l: string) => lines.push(l), session: 'h'};
    expect(takeA0SubmitHold(true, o)).toBe(0);
    expect(armA0SubmitHold(true, o)).toBe(true);
    expect(takeA0SubmitHold(true, o)).toBe(30_000);
    expect(takeA0SubmitHold(true, o)).toBe(0);
    expect(lines.map(l => JSON.parse(l.split(' ').slice(3).join(' ')).state)).toEqual(['armed', 'taken']);
  });
  it('gate closed: arming arms nothing; a hold armed earlier is not taken under a closed gate', () => {
    expect(armA0SubmitHold(false)).toBe(false);
    expect(takeA0SubmitHold(true, {enabled: true, sink: () => undefined})).toBe(0);
    armA0SubmitHold(true, {sink: () => undefined});
    expect(takeA0SubmitHold(false)).toBe(0);
    // and it is spent by that closed take (never held over to a later open one)
    expect(takeA0SubmitHold(true, {sink: () => undefined})).toBe(0);
  });
  it('the default gate under Jest\'s production config is closed: nothing arms', () => {
    expect(armA0SubmitHold()).toBe(false);
    expect(takeA0SubmitHold()).toBe(0);
  });
});
```

```diff
+ * the nullifier never). Together they say which addresses are one wallet's — devnet only, in the

+  registry: readonly A0AccountEntry[];

+const registryFields = (entries: readonly A0AccountEntry[]): Json[] =>
+  entries.map(e => ({address: e.address, role: e.role, linked: e.linked === true}));
+
+/**
+ * Just before the relayer is asked to submit (the pending unshield is written) — the kill window
+ * opens here. `context` is read only when the gate is open (it derives the seed's public keys): the
+ * production build never computes it. A context that throws is reported by its code only
+ * (`contextError`) — a readout never breaks the flow it reports on.
+ */
+export function readA0UnshieldSubmitting(
+  u: A0ReadoutUnshield,
+  context: () => A0ReadoutUnshieldContext,
+  o: A0ReadoutOptions = {},
+): void {
+  if (!a0ReadoutActive(o)) {
+    return;
+  }
+  let f: {[k: string]: Json};
+  try {
+    const c = context();
+    f = {
+      feePayer: c.feePayer,
+      gasGrantLamports: c.gasGrantLamports === null ? null : c.gasGrantLamports.toString(),
+      walletKind: c.walletKind,
+      seedKeys: [...c.seedKeys],
+      registry: registryFields(c.registry),
+      heldMs: c.heldMs,
+    };
+  } catch (e) {
+    f = {contextError: typeof (e as {code?: unknown})?.code === 'string' ? (e as {code: string}).code : 'E_A0_READOUT_CONTEXT'};
+  }

 }

@@ -367,3 +431,52 @@ export function readA0UnshieldReconcile(r: A0UnshieldReconcileReport, o: A0Reado
```
